name: Battle Scarf of the Rift

title: Brightly Colored Scarf
flavorText: A striped, multicolored, knitted winter scarf that seems absurdly long.
name: Brightly Colored Scarf

title: Sentinel Guard Captain's Badge
flavorText: A badge carried by high-ranking officers of the Sentinel Guard.
name: Sentinel Guard Captain's Badge

title: Burnished Judgment Badge
flavorText: A badge worn by the famed Justices of Bergama. A fence might be able to ransom this back to its original owner.
name: Burnished Judgment Badge

title: Badge of the Ra Gada
flavorText: This ancient military badge was given to the warlords of the Ra Gada when they first arrived on Tamriel's shores.
name: Badge of the Ra Gada

title: Murcien's Badge of Courage
flavorText: Sir Etienne of Murcien's Hamlet recognized his officers with these badges if they displayed bravery in the field.
name: Murcien's Badge of Courage

title: Dragonstar Enforcer Badge
flavorText: Thuggish Dragonstar caravan enforcers all wear this badge. It's become a symbol of the harsher side of commerce.
name: Dragonstar Enforcer Badge

title: Common Buckle
flavorText: There is nothing flashy about this buckle. Its previous owner was likely of modest or practical temperament.
name: Common Buckle

title: Nord Clan Neckerchief
flavorText: A triangular piece of cloth, decorated with the markings of a Nord clan, usually worn about the leader's neck.
name: Nord Clan Neckerchief

title: Summerset Silk Neckerchief
flavorText: A colorful cloth made of the finest Summerset silk and worn around the neck, it can be pulled up to protect from sea spray.
name: Summerset Silk Neckerchief

title: Monocular Loupe
flavorText: Perfect for the appraiser of fine art and jewelry. Lacking a chain, it is not recommended for the easily shocked.
name: Monocular Loupe

title: Fine Silken Ascot Neckerchief
flavorText: Red and green silk neckerchief with elaborate cursive praises of the Tribunal, and a tag, "Steamfont Laundry."
name: Fine Silken Ascot Neckerchief

title: Vicecanon's Cloth-of-Gold Armband
flavorText: Symbol of office for a Vicecanon of Stormhold and "All Surrounding Domains Appertaining Thereto," says the label.
name: Vicecanon's Cloth-of-Gold Armband

title: House Ravenwatch Sash
flavorText: A decorative sash bearing the colors and crest of House Ravenwatch of Rivenspire.
name: House Ravenwatch Sash

title: Covenant Blue Sash
flavorText: A silken sash, dyed a deep ocean blue.
name: Covenant Blue Sash

title: High Priest's Sash
flavorText: A gold-embroidered sash, modeled after the one worn by the High Priest of Satakalaam.
name: High Priest's Sash

title: Seventh Legion Sash
flavorText: This elegant sash is handed out to Imperial agents so that when the legion arrives, they can prove their loyalty.
name: Seventh Legion Sash

title: Silver Sash
flavorText: A shining sash made from a finespun, fragile material and studded with rubies on its ends.
name: Silver Sash

title: Saint Pelin's Prayer Shawl
flavorText: Sisters who pledge themselves to the Order of Saint Pelin often wear these prayer shawls.
name: Saint Pelin's Prayer Shawl

title: Tribunal Mourning Stole
flavorText: A brightly colored stole worn to honor the dead, as per the traditions set forth by the Tribunal.
name: Tribunal Mourning Stole

title: Wood Elf Dance Shawl
flavorText: Traditional attire for engaging in Wood Elf ritual dances, the frolicker usually wears this diaphanous cloth—and nothing more.
name: Wood Elf Dance Shawl

title: Feathery Finery Shawl
flavorText: Wood Elves consider this shawl made of blue-bunting feathers to be stylish, while most everyone else think it looks ridiculous.
name: Feathery Finery Shawl

title: Arkay Mourning Shawl
flavorText: A dark-colored shawl worn to honor the dead, as per the traditions set forth in the "Cycles of Arkay."
name: Arkay Mourning Shawl

title: Gaudy Baandari Budi Shawl
flavorText: Linen shawl with a bright floral print, typical of Baandari Pedlars, and labeled "Serious Stitchery, Redfur Trading Post."
name: Gaudy Baandari Budi Shawl

title: Parrot-Feather Shawl
flavorText: Light chamois shawl decorated with hundreds of parrot feathers woven in a floral design.
name: Parrot-Feather Shawl

title: House Tamrith Prayer Shawl
flavorText: Countess Tamrith's devotion to the Light inspired women throughout Rivenspire to acquire these Arkay prayer shawls.
name: House Tamrith Prayer Shawl

title: Dark Elf Rain Shawl
flavorText: Dark Elves who spend any time in Skyrim's colder climes utilize water-proof rain shawls to stay more or less comfy and dry.
name: Dark Elf Rain Shawl

title: Yokudan Prayer Shawl
flavorText: An ancient shawl that bears the image of sword-wielding figures. Collectors and academics would pay handsomely for it.
name: Yokudan Prayer Shawl

title: Mephala Spidersilk Prayer Shawl
flavorText: Spun from expensive spidersilk, this prayer shawl is used in rituals honoring the Spider God, Mephala.
name: Mephala Spidersilk Prayer Shawl

title: Bejeweled Eye-Patch Scraper
flavorText: A fancy, specialized tool to keep one's eye-patch clean. Perfect for the fashionable privateer on the go.
name: Bejeweled Eye-Patch Scraper

title: Red Rook Neckerchief
flavorText: A colorful cloth, worn around the neck, it can be pulled up to hide the features of a notorious Red Rook bandit.
name: Red Rook Neckerchief

title: Black Lace Kerchief
flavorText: This kerchief has the faint smell of wood smoke, as if from a pyre.
name: Black Lace Kerchief

title: High King's Nose Warmer
flavorText: A fur-rimmed nose cozy famously modeled after one favored by High King Emeric, it's all the rage among High Rock's elite.
name: High King's Nose Warmer

title: Collection of Colorful Ribbons
flavorText: A collection of ribbons of various widths and colors, used to decorate a Dark Elf's hair or clothing.
name: Collection of Colorful Ribbons

title: Trader's Levy Tassel
flavorText: A tassel hung from clothing to denote a merchant's good standing with the Queen's Collector of Taxes and Tariffs.
name: Trader's Levy Tassel

title: Merchant's Levy Tassel
flavorText: A tassel hung from clothing to denote a merchant's good standing with the Royal Tax-Collector of Daggerfall.
name: Merchant's Levy Tassel

title: Vizier's Golden Tassel
flavorText: A golden tassel traditionally attached to the robes of the king's viziers.
name: Vizier's Golden Tassel

title: Golden Braid Band
flavorText: A band of pure gold, designed to secure and decorate the hair braids or beard braids of stylish Nords.
name: Golden Braid Band

title: Copper Horn Caps
flavorText: While the "capping" fad has largely passed, there's still a market for horn adornments in Black Marsh.
name: Copper Horn Caps

title: Jeweled Elven Ear Cuffs
flavorText: Long ear cuffs of silver wire with small topaz accents.
name: Jeweled Elven Ear Cuffs

title: Banner of the Na-Totambu
flavorText: This is an archaic flag, carried by servants of the Na-Totambu when they first arrived on ships from old Yokuda.
name: Banner of the Na-Totambu

title: Tattered Flag
flavorText: A folded linen flag bearing the golden crest of the Aldmeri Dominion. This was likely taken from an alliance command vessel.
name: Tattered Flag

title: Royal Banner of Evermore
flavorText: After King Eamond's death, these valuable banners were taken down and replaced with black mourning banners.
name: Royal Banner of Evermore

title: Camoran Coronation Banner
flavorText: Carefully-folded royal banner with silversilk embroidered fringe, from Aeradan Camoran's coronation.
name: Camoran Coronation Banner

title: "Unforeseen Queen" Homecoming Banner
flavorText: Bright silk banner displaying the Altmeri eagle, prepared for Ayrenn's return to Summerset by way of Firsthold.
name: "Unforeseen Queen" Homecoming Banner

title: Dragonstar Caravan Banner
flavorText: A banner emblazoned with the Dragonstar Caravan emblem. It would be quite useful to a smuggler.
name: Dragonstar Caravan Banner

title: Camoran Banner
flavorText: A tall and tattered banner that's obviously seen battle. It still stands proudly, and could be useful to smugglers.
name: Camoran Banner

title: Aldmeri Dominion Banner
flavorText: A silk banner bearing the symbol of the Aldmeri Dominion. The gold embroidery indicates its owner's prominence.
name: Aldmeri Dominion Banner

title: Lion Guard Banner
flavorText: A neatly folded banner bearing the symbol of the Lion Guard and signed by a Lion Guard officer.
name: Lion Guard Banner

title: Hand-Stitched Flag
flavorText: A heavy woolen flag. A giant serpent with the head of an Orc is skillfully embroidered onto the cloth.
name: Hand-Stitched Flag

title: Antique Hallin's Stand Flag
flavorText: This flag flew over Hallin's Stand centuries ago when the city was part of the kingdom of Sentinel.
name: Antique Hallin's Stand Flag

title: House Redoran Victory Flag
flavorText: A flag bearing the symbol of House Redoran, commemorating one of the many victories they claim credit for achieving.
name: House Redoran Victory Flag

title: King Ranser Victory Flag
flavorText: A flag bearing the symbol of King Ranser, made to commemorate the victory of Wayrest but perhaps distributed too soon.
name: King Ranser Victory Flag

title: Orcthane's Victory Flag
flavorText: Some Stormfist Brigade supporter jumped the pig and created a limited number of flags proclaiming Fildgor's victory over Jorunn.
name: Orcthane's Victory Flag

title: Flayed Flag of Camlorn
flavorText: A fragment of the flag of Camlorn, said to have been carried into war during the Battle of Granden Tor.
name: Flayed Flag of Camlorn

title: Royal Hussar's Wing Sashimono
flavorText: Feathered back-banner shaped like a great eagle's wing, worn by the Royal Altmeri Hussars.
name: Royal Hussar's Wing Sashimono

title: Beachcomber's Basket
flavorText: A tightly woven basket filled with polished shells and seaglass, collected from the coast.
name: Beachcomber's Basket

title: Dragonstar Picnic Basket
flavorText: Burzgrag in Dragonstar packs and sells these picnic baskets for miners and others who work outdoors for long hours at a time.
name: Dragonstar Picnic Basket

title: Konunleikar Festival Basket
flavorText: Fertab in Windhelm packs and sells these festival baskets, full of everything necessary for a long day of celebrating.
name: Konunleikar Festival Basket

title: Gray Mire Angler's Creel
flavorText: Argonian-made croc-hide creel for stowing caught fish; includes stiffened safety-pocket for extra hook storage.
name: Gray Mire Angler's Creel

title: Lizard-Leather Fishing Creel
flavorText: Bag of waxed lizard-leather with shoulder strap for holding fresh-caught fish.
name: Lizard-Leather Fishing Creel

title: Intricate Fishing Basket
flavorText: An expertly coiled basket made from river cane and red wasso—popular with Argonian fishwives.
name: Intricate Fishing Basket

title: Arkay Meditation Beads
flavorText: These meditation beads are often used by Priests of Arkay when consecrating the dead.
name: Arkay Meditation Beads

title: Hall of Heroes Prayer Beads
flavorText: These ivory prayer beads came from the necropolis in Southern Bangkorai. The centerpiece is a crude likeness of Makela Leki.
name: Hall of Heroes Prayer Beads

title: Arzhela's Ivory Prayer Beads
flavorText: The queen has made a habit of handing out these valuable prayer beads to mourning mothers and wives in Evermore.
name: Arzhela's Ivory Prayer Beads

title: Mother Morrowind Meditation Beads
flavorText: Meditation beads used to contemplate the mysteries of the Tribunal, especially the blessings of Almalexia.
name: Mother Morrowind Meditation Beads

title: Precious Kynesgrove Prayer Beads
flavorText: Rare mother-of-pearl prayer beads, dedicated to Kyne and crafted by the keepers of Kynesgrove for wealthy patrons.
name: Precious Kynesgrove Prayer Beads

title: Zenithar Negotiation Beads
flavorText: Prayer beads used by followers of Zenithar to call forth good luck and success in all types of negotiations.
name: Zenithar Negotiation Beads

title: Do'Krin Prayer Beads
flavorText: Prayer beads carved at Do'Krin Temple. They are valued for their pleasant musk scent.
name: Do'Krin Prayer Beads

title: Hunding Prayer Beads
flavorText: The centerpiece of these prayer beads is a small crystal sword. The beads were crafted to pay homage to Divad Hunding.
name: Hunding Prayer Beads

title: Tava's Prayer Beads
flavorText: A string of pink pearls, accented by an olive-wood medallion carved to resemble a bird.
name: Tava's Prayer Beads

title: Silver Bell
flavorText: A small bell with a light and cheerful jingle.
name: Silver Bell

title: Jone and Jode Bell
flavorText: A silver bell engraved with an image of the big moon and the little moon. Khajiit ring it to ward off night spirits.
name: Jone and Jode Bell

title: Dark Moon Temple Bell
flavorText: Ancient bronze bell stolen from the Temple of the Dark Moon. It probably lacks the traditional theft-curse placed on such items.
name: Dark Moon Temple Bell

title: Golden Cow Bell
flavorText: A cow bell of solid gold. One of several created by Tuvor the Goldsmith for the finest of Lord Hannudra's prized cattle.
name: Golden Cow Bell

title: Fox-Bone Chime
flavorText: These hollow bone chimes sing a soothing song when blown by the wind.
name: Fox-Bone Chime

title: Wind Chimes
flavorText: The light wooden rods of these chimes have been hollowed out to produce deep tones when blown by the wind.
name: Wind Chimes

title: Seashell Wind Chimes
flavorText: When Iron-In-Blood takes a break from crafting weapons, he makes these delicate chimes from local seashells.
name: Seashell Wind Chimes

title: Bleakrock Docks Wind Chimes
flavorText: These wind chimes once hung at the Bleakrock docks, but the workers demanded they be removed because of the annoying noise.
name: Bleakrock Docks Wind Chimes

title: Bronze Crosswych Alarm Gong
flavorText: A bronze gong and hammer, small enough to fit on a bedside table, makes a noise loud enough to wake the soundest sleeper.
name: Bronze Crosswych Alarm Gong

title: Brown Bear Sleeping Furs
flavorText: Bear-fur sleeping blanket, lined with flannel in a floral print. A label reads "Snip and Stitch Outfitters, Skywatch."
name: Brown Bear Sleeping Furs

title: Imported Khenarthi's Wool Blanket
flavorText: Soft ivory-colored blanket of wool from Khenarthi's Roost. The label reads "Imported by The Handy Haversack."
name: Imported Khenarthi's Wool Blanket

title: Dhalmora Leather Snuggle
flavorText: Dhalmora Argonians find the feel of these thick, leather blankets oddly comforting on cold, lonely nights.
name: Dhalmora Leather Snuggle

title: Miner's Blanket
flavorText: A thin, light blanket is perfect for covering rocks or hard ground. It provides miners a clean place to sit.
name: Miner's Blanket

title: Mammoth-Hide Blanket
flavorText: Only the children of jarls, thanes, and wealthy merchants could afford an ostentatious blanket made from the hide of a mammoth.
name: Mammoth-Hide Blanket

title: Woolen Blanket
flavorText: A warm blanket, valuable to adventurers and travelers.
name: Woolen Blanket

title: Mammoth-Ear Suede Coverlet
flavorText: A suede blanket made from the finest chamois timber-mammoth ear. Embroidered script reads "Silver Moons Honeymoon."
name: Mammoth-Ear Suede Coverlet

title: Wolfskin Blanket
flavorText: A well-tanned wolfskin, complete with fur and lined with linen. It can serve as a blanket or a makeshift mantle.
name: Wolfskin Blanket

title: Plaid Cashmere Blanket
flavorText: A warm blanket of plaid cashmere from the goatherds of Hoarfrost Downs.
name: Plaid Cashmere Blanket

title: Silverhoof Horse Blanket
flavorText: An exquisitely crafted horse blanket from Silverhoof Vale, decorated with a pastural scene of frolicking horses.
name: Silverhoof Horse Blanket

title: Gerent's Quilted Sponge-Blanket
flavorText: Quilted sponge-blanket displaying the sigil of the vicecanons. It is best used for staying moist while sleeping.
name: Gerent's Quilted Sponge-Blanket

title: Lamb's Wool Blanket
flavorText: A high quality blanket made of lamb's wool.
name: Lamb's Wool Blanket

title: Woven Blanket
flavorText: This blanket is perfectly soft and not at all itchy.
name: Woven Blanket

title: Ash'abah Blanket
flavorText: This coarse, but finely woven blanket was crafted by the Ash'abah to keep them warm on cold nights in the desert.
name: Ash'abah Blanket

title: Woven Baandari Blanket
flavorText: This Baandari-style blanket has a colorful and exotic look.
name: Woven Baandari Blanket

title: Bearskin Blanket
flavorText: This large, thick bearskin was earned by a trophy hunter who ventured into Fallen Grotto.
name: Bearskin Blanket

title: Dark Elf Prayer Blanket
flavorText: A finely-woven prayer blanket featuring depictions of the "Living Gods" of the Tribunal.
name: Dark Elf Prayer Blanket

title: Lost Hope Quilt
flavorText: A Breton quilt of "lost hope" is crafted, usually by a mother and daughter, to work through past regrets and sorrows.
name: Lost Hope Quilt

title: High Rock Quilt
flavorText: This Breton quilt features an embroidered map of High Rock. Southern Bangkorai is included in Evermore's domain.
name: High Rock Quilt

title: Lovelorn Comforter
flavorText: A comforter quilted by the We Who Pine for Darien Gautier Quilting Circle. A number of chapters exist throughout Rivenspire.
name: Lovelorn Comforter

title: Lovelorn Quilt
flavorText: A quilt by the We Who Have Loved and Lost Darien Gautier Sewing Circle. A number of chapters exist throughout Glenumbra.
name: Lovelorn Quilt

title: Love-Lost Comforter
flavorText: A comforter quilted by We Who Lost Battle Maidens in the most-recent wars. Such sewing circles exist throughout Skyrim.
name: Love-Lost Comforter

title: Fine Woolen Bedroll
flavorText: A plush woolen bundle, dyed a deep blue.
name: Fine Woolen Bedroll

title: Wolf Pelt Sleeping Bag
flavorText: Lined with fur on the inside, this sleeping bag is both soft and warm. Water resistant lacquer has been painted on the outside.
name: Wolf Pelt Sleeping Bag

title: Velvet Bedroll
flavorText: A fine velvet bedroll lined with soft sheep's wool, suitable for camping in high style on chilly nights.
name: Velvet Bedroll

title: Orcish Ledger of Significant Grudges
flavorText: A record of all of the grievances and insults an Orc family has suffered, with dates, specifics, and planned responses.
name: Orcish Ledger of Significant Grudges

title: Blank Leatherbound Journal
flavorText: The pages of this well-bound book are stiff and empty.
name: Blank Leatherbound Journal

title: Cheaply Bound Journal
flavorText: This journal contains private thoughts and personal details. A fence may be able to resell it to a blackmailer.
name: Cheaply Bound Journal

title: Firebrand Prayer Book
flavorText: A small book of prayers collected by the Knights of the Flame and gifted to the head of their order.
name: Firebrand Prayer Book

title: Ruby-Studded Book Cover
flavorText: This fancy book cover was among several King Fahara'jad gifted to the scholars who supported his claim to the throne.
name: Ruby-Studded Book Cover

title: Visual Guide to Auridon Flora
flavorText: A handy guide to Auridon plants. Of interest to poisoners is the chapter "A Publication of Malefic Aldmer Essences, 2E 561."
name: Visual Guide to Auridon Flora

title: Guide to Approved Methods of Procreation
flavorText: Illustrated folio from the Thalmor depicting methods of coition "that properly reflect our Altmeri heritage."
name: Guide to Approved Methods of Procreation

title: High Elf Songbook
flavorText: The songs are written in Old Aldmeris, and would be of great value to historians.
name: High Elf Songbook

title: Book of Erotic Stories
flavorText: A collection of erotic fiction, featuring pairings of prominent Aldmeri Dominion figures, including Queen Ayrenn and Urcelmo.
name: Book of Erotic Stories

title: Argonian Desk Reference
flavorText: This text contains highly inaccurate translations of Nord and Dark Elf phrases into simple Argonian words.
name: Argonian Desk Reference

title: Handmaiden's Sketch Book
flavorText: The handmaiden to a prominent noble in Evermore filled this book with beautiful sketches before becoming a famous artist.
name: Handmaiden's Sketch Book

title: Bizarre Daedric Text
flavorText: Attempts to read this book leave the reader nauseous and disoriented. The runes constantly shift and change.
name: Bizarre Daedric Text

title: Yorran's Yarns of Cyrodiil, Illustrated Edition
flavorText: Amusing and often bawdy anecdotes detailing a Nord's adventures in the Imperial City, complete with explicit illustrations.
name: Yorran's Yarns of Cyrodiil, Illustrated Edition

title: Saint Veloth Prayer Book
flavorText: A small book of prayers gifted to the visitors to Saint Veloth's Shrine in exchange for voluntary contributions.
name: Saint Veloth Prayer Book

title: First Edition Fjokki
flavorText: A rare copy of the first edition of "The Art of Love and Swordplay" by Fjokki the Bard.
name: First Edition Fjokki

title: Cambray Hills Academy of Art Sketchbook
flavorText: A sketchbook bearing the mark of the famed art school in central Glenumbra, partially filled with nature drawings.
name: Cambray Hills Academy of Art Sketchbook

title: Untranslated Ayleid Book
flavorText: Rare book from the Reliquary of Stars, bound in mysterious leather, and written in untranslated Ayleidoon.
name: Untranslated Ayleid Book

title: Signed "Trees of Brackenleaf" Folio
flavorText: Signed folio of engravings depicting the leading trees of Brackenleaf, with their names and brief histories.
name: Signed "Trees of Brackenleaf" Folio

title: Camoran Throne-Tattoo Codex
flavorText: Gilt-edged hand-drawn folio depicting the Wood Elf tattoo patterns that may only be worn by members of House Camoran.
name: Camoran Throne-Tattoo Codex

title: Baandari Ledger
flavorText: This ledger contains evidence of illegal trading by the Baandari. It could be quite valuable to a rival.
name: Baandari Ledger

title: "Lusty Argonian Maid" Art Folio
flavorText: A well-worn book of stimulating images illustrating the popular tale of "The Lusty Argonian Maid."
name: "Lusty Argonian Maid" Art Folio

title: Nord-to-Dark Elf Concordance
flavorText: A list of common Nord words and sayings, translated into phrases more palatable to Dark Elf sensibilities.
name: Nord-to-Dark Elf Concordance

title: Nam-Li's Immodest Fables
flavorText: Amusing (and often bawdy) anecdotes and tall tales detailing an Argonian's adventures in Morrowind.
name: Nam-Li's Immodest Fables

title: "Sketches from Lukiul Uxith" Folio
flavorText: Folio by the popular artist Andrano Andraneth of his drawings of the "exotic" Argonian town; signed and numbered.
name: "Sketches from Lukiul Uxith" Folio

title: Indecipherable Metallic Book
flavorText: Book of strange, indecipherable runes printed on thin foil pages of an unknown metal, labeled "Found in Gandranen."
name: Indecipherable Metallic Book

title: Deluxe Dark Elf Pantomime Joke Book
flavorText: Leather-bound joke book of wordless cartoons all mocking Dark Elves, their customs and personal habits; "Stormhold, 2E 578."
name: Deluxe Dark Elf Pantomime Joke Book

title: Erotic Argonian Etchings
flavorText: A set of limited-edition etchings of Argonian erotica. It is impossible to discern the gender of the participants.
name: Erotic Argonian Etchings

title: Three-Temples Picture Book
flavorText: "Khenarthi's Roost: Isle of Three Temples," a folio of engravings depicting ancient sacred sites.
name: Three-Temples Picture Book

title: Blackcaster Mage's Spellbook
flavorText: A book with no markings identifying its owner. It contains component lists for spells, and is wrapped in Elinhiran leather.
name: Blackcaster Mage's Spellbook

title: Constellation Guide
flavorText: A handsome reference book about the constellations. The Star-Gazers issue these to senior members.
name: Constellation Guide

title: Common Wood Elf Insults
flavorText: It would be better not to repeat the insults contained in this book. The inside cover claims it is of a very rare edition.
name: Common Wood Elf Insults

title: Erotic Green Pact Drawings
flavorText: A collection of plant life drawings that are strangely suggestive.
name: Erotic Green Pact Drawings

title: The Wilderflowers of Elsweyr
flavorText: An illustrated guide to the various species of wildflowers found throughout Elsweyr, hand-painted by the artist Guta-dar.
name: The Wilderflowers of Elsweyr

title: First Era Illuminated Manuscript
flavorText: A gorgeous illuminated manuscript from the First Era, decorated with gold and silver leaf, containing prayers to the Divines.
name: First Era Illuminated Manuscript

title: Thulie's Five Card Wisp Master System
flavorText: This foolproof system for beating the Five Card Wisp dealers at Hadran's Caravan is enciphered. Code book sold separately!
name: Thulie's Five Card Wisp Master System

title: Drinks-Not Bookmark
flavorText: Drinks-Not-Investments, the bank in Dhalmora, distributed these stylish leather bookmarks to promote business.
name: Drinks-Not Bookmark

title: Ja'khajiit Picture Book
flavorText: A simple picture book with ten images of mischievous kittens. Each picture is composed of a single unbroken line.
name: Ja'khajiit Picture Book

title: Courtesan's Client List
flavorText: This small book belongs to one of Wayrest's courtesans. A blackmailer would pay well for this list of wealthy clients.
name: Courtesan's Client List

title: Veiled Heritance Codebook
flavorText: A codebook used by the Veiled Heritance to communicate in secret.
name: Veiled Heritance Codebook

title: Courtesan's Appointment Book
flavorText: This little book lists the clients of a popular courtesan in Hallin's Stand, making it almost priceless to a blackmailer.
name: Courtesan's Appointment Book

title: "Netch, Kwama, Netch" Game
flavorText: A travel-sized version of the Dark Elf drinking game played in corner-clubs throughout Morrowind.
name: "Netch, Kwama, Netch" Game

title: Courtesan's Notebook
flavorText: This small book belongs to one of Mournhold's courtesans. A blackmailer would pay well for this list of wealthy clients.
name: Courtesan's Notebook

title: Personal Record of Honor
flavorText: An ongoing chronicle of a prominent Nord's personal legend, including significant successes and failures.
name: Personal Record of Honor

title: Leather-Bound Sketchbook
flavorText: A small, tightly bound sketchbook. It is full of charming charcoal drawings of common woodland animals.
name: Leather-Bound Sketchbook

title: Magnificent Leatherbound Blank Oghma
flavorText: Blank life-journal of gilt-edged, bleached vellum pages. The hand-tooled gargoyle leather binding is from "Remarkable Leathers."
name: Magnificent Leatherbound Blank Oghma

title: Nocturnal Musings
flavorText: Other than a boldly written title within the front cover, the pages of this journal are empty.
name: Nocturnal Musings

title: Little Black Journal
flavorText: A book filled with the names and addresses of both men and women. There is a 1 to 5 star rating system.
name: Little Black Journal

title: Ayleid Alphabet Pocket Translations
flavorText: Although it touts itself as a guide, this small pamphlet only translates Ayleid letters into the common alphabet.
name: Ayleid Alphabet Pocket Translations

title: Dog Training Pamphlet
flavorText: Excessive barking? Running away? Chasing the cat? This pocket-sized pamphlet will help you train your problem dog!
name: Dog Training Pamphlet

title: Lady A's Amorous Articles
flavorText: Romantic pamphlets secreted away for a noble's lonely nights, written by the anonymous Lady "A."
name: Lady A's Amorous Articles

title: Llirala's Amorous Articles
flavorText: Romantic pamphlets secreted away for a Dark Elf noble's lonely nights.
name: Llirala's Amorous Articles

title: Pamphlet of Erotic Engravings
flavorText: Khajiiti pamphlet showing various forms of erotic dalliance, illustrated by stylized drawings of astoundingly lithe cat-people.
name: Pamphlet of Erotic Engravings

title: Illustrated "Vade Mecum of Love" Brochure
flavorText: "The Vade Mecum of Love," a wordless brochure on gilt-edged vellum illustrated with inspiring and instructive engravings.
name: Illustrated "Vade Mecum of Love" Brochure

title: Granite Wash Basin
flavorText: The cut and polish of this stone is impeccable ... but that doesn't make it any less heavy.
name: Granite Wash Basin

title: Alabaster Scrying Basin with Bug-Parade Brim
flavorText: Scrying basin carved from alabaster, brim carved with a line of marching caterpillars, engraved "KA" for Karthdar Artisans.
name: Alabaster Scrying Basin with Bug-Parade Brim

title: Fine Washbasin with Sload Soap
flavorText: Gilt-edged redware washbasin with bar of sload soap, unused and inscribed "Dhalmora Fine Goods, Davon's Watch."
name: Fine Washbasin with Sload Soap

title: Porcelain Bowl
flavorText: This porcelain bowl has a lovely irridescent color.
name: Porcelain Bowl

title: Royal Pudding Bowl
flavorText: This is one of a dozen ebony-inlaid pudding bowls that once graced the feasting hall in Wayrest.
name: Royal Pudding Bowl

title: Cherrywood Morsel Bowl
flavorText: A small, wooden bowl, usually filled with tiny nibbles and set beside the bed for late-night snacking.
name: Cherrywood Morsel Bowl

title: Festival of Blades Bowl
flavorText: This porcelain bowl depicts the events celebrated by the Festival of Blades: a Redguard fights against a race of giant Goblins.
name: Festival of Blades Bowl

title: Fancy Porridge Bowl
flavorText: An extravagant and finely decorated bowl that seems almost too fancy for serving simple porridge.
name: Fancy Porridge Bowl

title: Mosaic Glass Bowl
flavorText: The tiny stones that make up this colorful bowl take the shape of a redwort flower.
name: Mosaic Glass Bowl

title: Crystal Punch Bowl
flavorText: Complete with ladle, this crystal punch bowl can hold a lot of liquid.
name: Crystal Punch Bowl

title: Steel Sugar Bowl
flavorText: This elegant sugar bowl comes complete with a matching spoon.
name: Steel Sugar Bowl

title: Chitin Soup Bowl
flavorText: This finely crafted, large bowl holds enough soup to be shared between three to four people.
name: Chitin Soup Bowl

title: Olive Stoneware Bowl
flavorText: This dish was distributed to all the clan-wives to commemorate the marriage of Hearth-Wife Sholg to Chief Tazgol.
name: Olive Stoneware Bowl

title: Nix Hound Food Bowl
flavorText: A bowl crafted to hold food for a nix hound, most likely a beloved pet of a Dark Elf living in Bal Foyen.
name: Nix Hound Food Bowl

title: Gilded Soup Bowl
flavorText: A kingly bowl, perfect for expensive soups served at extravagant parties.
name: Gilded Soup Bowl

title: Herma-Mora Incense Burner
flavorText: The Primeval Seekers offered these Daedric bowls to scholars in Evermore who helped them find Halcyon Lake.
name: Herma-Mora Incense Burner

title: Moonstone Washbowl
flavorText: A polished basin, filled with fresh-smelling rosewater.
name: Moonstone Washbowl

title: Fancy Redoran Porridge Bowl
flavorText: This is one of a dozen silver-inlaid porridge bowls that once graced the Redoran feasting halls throughout Morrowind.
name: Fancy Redoran Porridge Bowl

title: Porcelain Stew Bowl
flavorText: A fine porcelain stew bowl, used to serve venison or rabbit stew.
name: Porcelain Stew Bowl

title: Gaudy Konunleikar Serving Bowl
flavorText: This is one of two dozen silver-plated serving bowls used at the Skald-King's banquets during the Konunleikar celebration.
name: Gaudy Konunleikar Serving Bowl

title: Small Aquarium
flavorText: This simple glass bowl would make a good home for a pet fish—or tomorrow's dinner.
name: Small Aquarium

title: Queen Donella Dinnerware
flavorText: A set of plates and bowls bearing the traditional pattern of Queen Donella of the middle Second Era.
name: Queen Donella Dinnerware

title: Casimir Porcelain Dessert Bowl
flavorText: A bowl specifically crafted for serving and consuming the elaborate cakes and confections that King Casimir loves.
name: Casimir Porcelain Dessert Bowl

title: Giblets' Particular Food Bowl
flavorText: An ornate bowl with the name "Giblets" stenciled on one side. Rumors claim that many such bowls are hidden around Daggerfall.
name: Giblets' Particular Food Bowl

title: Set of Four Guar-Egg-Poaching Ramekins
flavorText: Four star-shaped enameled ceramic ramekins for poaching bantam guar eggs, from the Southpoint Inn.
name: Set of Four Guar-Egg-Poaching Ramekins

title: Baandari Stoneware Bowl Calendar
flavorText: Baandari serving bowl and calendar, with two banded rim-rings where stones are placed representing Jone and Jode.
name: Baandari Stoneware Bowl Calendar

title: Fine Ceramic Wash Bowl
flavorText: Heirloom personal wash bowl painted with scenes from "The Naming Story of Y'ffre" around the rim.
name: Fine Ceramic Wash Bowl

title: Bedside Fertility Censer
flavorText: Silver bowl decorated with symbols of Mother Mara, for burning incense said to encourage conception.
name: Bedside Fertility Censer

title: Argonian Fruit Bowl
flavorText: A wooden bowl crafted by and popular with Argonians, some Dark Elves have begun to use these distinctive bowls to store fruit.
name: Argonian Fruit Bowl

title: Gobbet Bowl with Hackwing Picks
flavorText: Coral-rimmed bowl with bird-bone fang-picks. After meals, diners pick uneaten food from their fangs and place it in the bowl.
name: Gobbet Bowl with Hackwing Picks

title: Haj Mota Serving Bowl
flavorText: This large bowl was fashioned from the shell of a baby haj mota.
name: Haj Mota Serving Bowl

title: Marble Font of the White Kagouti
flavorText: Marble washbasin surmounted by a sculpture of the Legendary White Kagouti, rampant.
name: Marble Font of the White Kagouti

title: Scorpion Claw Bowl
flavorText: A bowl made out of a repurposed claw—one that once belonged to a massive scorpion.
name: Scorpion Claw Bowl

title: Gilded Terrarium
flavorText: A glass bowl with a shining, golden rim that could serve as a home for tiny animals or insects.
name: Gilded Terrarium

title: Gold Plated Bowl
flavorText: A bowl that looks like the noontime sun under full lighting. It's difficult to stare at until one fills it with food.
name: Gold Plated Bowl

title: Orcish Stoneware
flavorText: A set of stone bowls, made in the Orcish tradition, imported from Wrothgar.
name: Orcish Stoneware

title: Children's Wooden Bowls
flavorText: These small glass bowls are adorned with cute little monkeys playing in the trees.
name: Children's Wooden Bowls

title: Pinewood Nibble Bowl
flavorText: No prominent Nord household is complete without a set of pinewood nibble bowls—perfect for all-day snacking.
name: Pinewood Nibble Bowl

title: Kragenmoor Stew Bowls
flavorText: A set of distinctive square-shaped bowls, used to serve stews and soups, originally made popular at the Hissing Guar Inn.
name: Kragenmoor Stew Bowls

title: Hallin's Stand Spittoon
flavorText: A grandee from Hallin's Stand had dozens of these golden spittoons made for his friends.
name: Hallin's Stand Spittoon

title: Nord Helmet Serving Bowl
flavorText: This Nord helmet has been refashioned into a serving bowl, with the horns trimmed and shaved so the bowl sits level on a table.
name: Nord Helmet Serving Bowl

title: Cloisonne Thunderbug-Head Spittoon
flavorText: Enameled head-carapace of a thunderbug, with mandibular spout and leather anti-skid feet, labeled "Phynaster's Stride, Haven."
name: Cloisonne Thunderbug-Head Spittoon

title: Ivory Mixing Bowl
flavorText: A polished mixing bowl carved from a young mammoth's tusk.
name: Ivory Mixing Bowl

title: Reliquary with Ancient Prophet's Finger
flavorText: Holy reliquary, a small glass-covered box containing one of the fingerbones of the Prophet Ciroloth of Ancient Quendeluun.
name: Reliquary with Ancient Prophet's Finger

title: Sterling Silver Croc-In-The-Box
flavorText: The toy of a noble's child. When cranked, this box of sterling silver plays a simple melody until a stuffed crocodile pops out.
name: Sterling Silver Croc-In-The-Box

title: Mother-of-Pearl Incense Box
flavorText: Box of carved mother-of-pearl containing a selection of incenses: myrrh, sandalwood, and frankincense.
name: Mother-of-Pearl Incense Box

title: "Lay of Firsthold" Music Box
flavorText: Clockwork music box of brass and tin that plays the "Lay of Firsthold" while tiny swan ships sail in a circle.
name: "Lay of Firsthold" Music Box

title: "Summer Sun" Music Box
flavorText: Wind up this mechanical contraption and it plays "The Summer Sun Sets on Summerset."
name: "Summer Sun" Music Box

title: "King Camoran" Music Box
flavorText: A small wind-up device that plays the propaganda tavern song "King Camoran, It's You I'm Adorin'."
name: "King Camoran" Music Box

title: Box of Calligrapher's Pen Nibs
flavorText: Ivory box containing copper pen nibs of assorted widths, labeled "Property of the Altmeri Embassy Clerks' Office."
name: Box of Calligrapher's Pen Nibs

title: Desktop Nine-Holes Game
flavorText: Desktop nine-holes set, base made of thunderbug carapace, with finely-carved bone pieces.
name: Desktop Nine-Holes Game

title: Chitin Box with Toothpick Collection
flavorText: Box of thunderbug chitin containing a collection of 341 toothpicks: ivory, bugshell, bone, imported wood, and even flint.
name: Chitin Box with Toothpick Collection

title: Box of Y'ffre's Sacred Incense
flavorText: Meerschaum box containing twelve sticks (a year's supply) of the Verdant Incense of Y'ffre, one for each month's firstday.
name: Box of Y'ffre's Sacred Incense

title: Magnificent Grahtwood Beetle Collection
flavorText: Glass-covered box containing a collection of over a hundred mounted beetles, arranged in prismatic order from red to violet.
name: Magnificent Grahtwood Beetle Collection

title: Cache of Forbidden Fruits
flavorText: Jade box labeled "Jathsogur Smoking Powder" containing an assortment of taboo sweets: candied plums, cherries, and apricots.
name: Cache of Forbidden Fruits

title: "Ancestors" Music Box
flavorText: An Altmeri-styled music box that, when wound, plays a tinkly "Ancestors' Waltz."
name: "Ancestors" Music Box

title: Carved Bone Sand-Shaker
flavorText: A small bone box with pierced lid for sanding finished documents, carved with images of Imga.
name: Carved Bone Sand-Shaker

title: Soapstone Snuff Box
flavorText: Enameled box carved from soapstone, containing a quantity of aromatic powdered-insect snuff.
name: Soapstone Snuff Box

title: Assortment of Cosmetic Horns
flavorText: Cuir-bouilli box containing various prosthetic forehead-horns, with beetle-glue to affix them.
name: Assortment of Cosmetic Horns

title: Jeweled Dice Box
flavorText: This splendid gem-encrusted box is inscribed "Administrative Decision Makers" and contains two golden, gem-pipped dice.
name: Jeweled Dice Box

title: Dancing Mammoth Music Box
flavorText: Music box that, when wound, plays "Threnody for King Eplear" as three clockwork mammoths dance around Treehenge.
name: Dancing Mammoth Music Box

title: Concealed Alabaster Skooma Pipe
flavorText: An imported marlwood box labeled "Spatula Set (Extra)" holds an elaborately hand-carved alabaster skooma pipe.
name: Concealed Alabaster Skooma Pipe

title: Snuffbox with Montclair Crest
flavorText: Small rosewood box containing piquant, aromatic snuff. The box top is inlaid with the crest of House Montclair.
name: Snuffbox with Montclair Crest

title: Coffin-Shaped Plume Box
flavorText: Coffin-shaped coralwood box containing writing plumes, inscribed "Memento Mori: Othrenis."
name: Coffin-Shaped Plume Box

title: Portable Tribunal Shrine
flavorText: Diorama box that opens into a triptych for worship of the Tribunal; engraved "Personally Blessed by Disciple Sildras."
name: Portable Tribunal Shrine

title: Elegant Pearl "Veloth's Conundrum" Puzzle
flavorText: Exquisite traditional Dunmeri puzzle game, with an ebony board and pieces of Dwarven metal and nacreous pearl.
name: Elegant Pearl "Veloth's Conundrum" Puzzle

title: Tribal Elder's Shellback-Gammon Box
flavorText: Wood-and-shell box, folds open to become a board for the game of shellback-gammon, with deluxe kwama-carapace tiles.
name: Tribal Elder's Shellback-Gammon Box

title: Morrowind Spice Box
flavorText: A container for holding spices, crafted and sold by a friendly Dark Elf trader in the Rift's Ragged Hills.
name: Morrowind Spice Box

title: Canebrake Market Bamboo Fruit Box
flavorText: An empty bamboo box labeled "Canebrake Market," with partitions intended to hold candied pieces of fruit.
name: Canebrake Market Bamboo Fruit Box

title: Twelve Moons Sweet-Box
flavorText: This lacquered wooden box contains twelve separate partitions for different varieties of moon-sugar.
name: Twelve Moons Sweet-Box

title: Coffer of Light from the Dawn Era
flavorText: Sealed jade box, said to be lined with mirrors and containing an eternally-reflected gleam of light from the Dawn Era.
name: Coffer of Light from the Dawn Era

title: Ban Daar Puzzle Box
flavorText: An intricately-fashioned box, thought by the Khajiit to bestow good fortune upon anyone who can remove the luck charm inside.
name: Ban Daar Puzzle Box

title: Royal Guard Boot Shine Kit
flavorText: Brushes, sponges, buffers, and tins of polish in an elegant mahogany box with a footrest, bearing the symbol of the Royal Guard.
name: Royal Guard Boot Shine Kit

title: Silver Hoarvor Pipeworm Canister
flavorText: Noble's silver canister in the likeness of an engorged hoarvor, and filled with the finest Strid-Bottom Pipeworm.
name: Silver Hoarvor Pipeworm Canister

title: Tinderbox
flavorText: The battered box appears mostly full. The flint, firesteel, and straw are all supplied.
name: Tinderbox

title: Set of Mineral-Based Paints of Rare Colors
flavorText: Sectioned shellmold box containing eight bottles of bright mineral-based paints in rare colors, quite valuable.
name: Set of Mineral-Based Paints of Rare Colors

title: Master Painter's Set
flavorText: An ornate wooden box inlaid with ivory, containing a set of oil paints, fine brushes, a painting knife and a palette.
name: Master Painter's Set

title: Mammoth Tusk Jewelry Box
flavorText: An intricately-carved jewelry box crafted from an enormous mammoth tusk.
name: Mammoth Tusk Jewelry Box

title: Aldmeri Snuff Box
flavorText: Made specially for Aldmeri officers of high-breeding, this snuff box is lined with gold and covered in Dominion motifs.
name: Aldmeri Snuff Box

title: Iron Lizard Crate
flavorText: An iron cage designed to hold pet lizards and train them to empty their bladder outside.
name: Iron Lizard Crate

title: Delicate Brass Birdcage
flavorText: Fanciful birdcage of brass wire, with a chain and eyelet for hanging, labeled "Sabir's General Goods" underneath.
name: Delicate Brass Birdcage

title: Corimont Mouth-Plover Cage
flavorText: Sturdy birdcage for a Corimont Mouth-Plover, which high-status Argonians use to clean their fangs after dining.
name: Corimont Mouth-Plover Cage

title: Amber Bedside Grub-Cage
flavorText: Carved amber grub-cage with chrysoberyl stopper for containing live snack-larvae.
name: Amber Bedside Grub-Cage

title: Notched Candle
flavorText: The notches carved into the side of this candle indicate how much time has passed.
name: Notched Candle

title: Scented Candle
flavorText: When lit, the candle exudes the faintest scent of cardamom. A fence could resell it for certain necromantic rituals.
name: Scented Candle

title: Malevolent Cultist Candle
flavorText: A thick, dark candle, nestled atop a bone tray and engraved with Daedric runes. A fence will pay well to attain this.
name: Malevolent Cultist Candle

title: Candles of Mara
flavorText: Used to celebrate the passing of another year of marriage, these candles are a symbol of love and devotion.
name: Candles of Mara

title: Orcish Longevity Candle
flavorText: No one has ever confirmed it, but this massive red candle is said to be large enough to burn for an Orc's entire lifespan.
name: Orcish Longevity Candle

title: Dark Elf Life Candle
flavorText: These large, ornate candles are lit when a Dark Elf is born. As long as it burns, the Dark Elf will be blessed with a long life.
name: Dark Elf Life Candle

title: Nord's Night Candle
flavorText: A traditional night candle, rumored to repel draugr. Also provides a sense of security for Nords who are afraid of the dark.
name: Nord's Night Candle

title: "Xarxes' Memory" Worship Candle
flavorText: Leg-sized tallow candle, the kind used in the annual "Rites of Xarxes' Memory" at Southpoint Cathedral.
name: "Xarxes' Memory" Worship Candle

title: Ill-Gotten Daedric Candle
flavorText: A thick, red candle, nestled atop a bone tray. Covered with embossed Daedric runes and symbols of bats.
name: Ill-Gotten Daedric Candle

title: Proscribed Daedric Candle
flavorText: A thin, black candle, fastened onto a bone tray. Engraved with Daedric runes and symbols of Dragons.
name: Proscribed Daedric Candle

title: Dreugh Wax Crescent Candles
flavorText: Pair of disc-shaped candles, one pink, one blue; when burned they melt away to a crescent shape.
name: Dreugh Wax Crescent Candles

title: Everburning Spice Candle
flavorText: A candle enchanted to release the pleasant aroma of spices while burning "forever," according to the tiny label.
name: Everburning Spice Candle

title: Lion's Mane Candelabrum
flavorText: A weighty iron candle holder, bearing the shape of a lion's head.
name: Lion's Mane Candelabrum

title: Brass Candlestick Holder
flavorText: Shiny and functional, these candlestick holders are extremely versatile, able to hold both candles and candle-shaped things.
name: Brass Candlestick Holder

title: Crystal Candlestick Holder
flavorText: The crystal of these candlestick holders casts a brilliant pattern of light and shadow when the candles are lit.
name: Crystal Candlestick Holder

title: Dreugh-claw candle holder
flavorText: This exquisite candle holder comes from a set that was gifted to Lord Farangel of Menevia.
name: Dreugh-claw candle holder

title: Daedric Candlestick
flavorText: This candlestick, decorated with dancing Scamps and banekin frolicking in a Daedric circle, might be a novelty—or cult fetish.
name: Daedric Candlestick

title: Brass Candle Snuffer
flavorText: Although a little sooty inside, this polished candle snuffer is the perfect size for putting out small desk candles.
name: Brass Candle Snuffer

title: Brass Candelabra
flavorText: This candelabra stands empty, its three branches devoid of candles or any leftover wax residue.
name: Brass Candelabra

title: Silver Crown Candelabra
flavorText: Each of the eight candle holders in this candelabra are molded into a likeness of one of the Crowns' gods.
name: Silver Crown Candelabra

title: Yldunz Candleholder
flavorText: Fashioned from a Dwemer gear and other trinkets, this decorative candleholder is a popular gift in Sentinel.
name: Yldunz Candleholder

title: Silaseli Crystal Candelabra
flavorText: An ancient candelabra retrieved from the ruins of Silaseli. Quite fashionable to Evermore nobles.
name: Silaseli Crystal Candelabra

title: Haunted Wood Candlestick
flavorText: This candlestick, decorated with dancing spriggans frolicking in the Haunted Wood, was purchased at the Tree's Bounty.
name: Haunted Wood Candlestick

title: Sterling Silver Orc-Forged Candlestick
flavorText: Portable silver candlestick, with finger-ring and tallow candle, etched underneath "Shakul, Barkbite Forge."
name: Sterling Silver Orc-Forged Candlestick

title: Golden Candle Holder
flavorText: A family heirloom, no doubt. It is both light and well-polished.
name: Golden Candle Holder

title: Crystal Candleholder
flavorText: These candleholders are perfect for an elegant table setting.
name: Crystal Candleholder

title: Castle Rilis Brass Candelabra
flavorText: Antique three-armed brass candelabra, in the "Sinuous Serpent" style, recovered from the ruins of Castle Rilis.
name: Castle Rilis Brass Candelabra

title: King Donel Candle Tree
flavorText: A multi-stick candle holder from the time of King Donel, noted for having three sticks instead of the five of later eras.
name: King Donel Candle Tree

title: Imperial-Style Brass Candlestick
flavorText: Brass candlestick for holding a medium-sized candle, in the Nibenese style, possibly from Fort Zantonius
name: Imperial-Style Brass Candlestick

title: Mudcrab Shell Powder Case
flavorText: The women of the Alik'r desert often powder their noses before social engagements. They store their powder in mudcrab shells.
name: Mudcrab Shell Powder Case

title: Precious-Color Eye Shadow Maquillage Case
flavorText: Bright frogskin makeup case containing shiny "precious-color" eye shadow of crushed pearls and gold dust.
name: Precious-Color Eye Shadow Maquillage Case

title: His and Hers Makeup Case
flavorText: Hand-tooled leather makeup case containing matching maquillage tools for him and her.
name: His and Hers Makeup Case

title: Case of Fine Shaving Articles
flavorText: Leather shaving kit containing a boarbristle brush and a straight razor from The Fighting Edge in Shornhelm.
name: Case of Fine Shaving Articles

title: Nix-Hound Treat Cannister
flavorText: A decorated container that hold treats for a Dark Elf's beloved pet nix-hound.
name: Nix-Hound Treat Cannister

title: Antique Sewing Kit with Adamantium Needles
flavorText: Imported netch-leather case containing splendid antique sewing kit, with adamantium leather-needles.
name: Antique Sewing Kit with Adamantium Needles

title: Desktop Concentration Censer
flavorText: Bronze desktop censer for burning sandalwood incense, said to help sharpen concentration, in a package labeled Starfall Arcana.
name: Desktop Concentration Censer

title: Silver Censer
flavorText: This silver vessel is etched with maritime motifs and filled with rich Alik'ri incense.
name: Silver Censer

title: Silver Boar Censer
flavorText: A silver, boar-shaped censer used to burn animal fat in various Green Pact rituals.
name: Silver Boar Censer

title: Ebonheart Temple Priest's Thurible
flavorText: Electrum-clad censer for wafting ancestral ash incense during ceremonies in honor of the Tribunal.
name: Ebonheart Temple Priest's Thurible

title: Fish Ephemera Counter-Censer
flavorText: Nautilus-shaped silver incense burner, used on fishing parties by Thalmor Canonreeves to mitigate piscine odors.
name: Fish Ephemera Counter-Censer

title: Gold Censer
flavorText: A censer that gleams with a polished surface. It's fit for religious use or as an expensive paperweight.
name: Gold Censer

title: Bolt of Red Fabric
flavorText: Soft to the touch, only a small square has been cut from the corner of this bright red fabric.
name: Bolt of Red Fabric

title: Silken Tablecloth
flavorText: A fine silk cloth with lace trim, lovingly maintained.
name: Silken Tablecloth

title: Silk Sheets
flavorText: These sheets have been woven from the secretions of insects who make their cocoons on the mulberry tree.
name: Silk Sheets

title: Fancy Royal Tablecloth
flavorText: Most households don't usually fuss with such things, but when they use a tablecloth, one depicting favored royalty is preferred.
name: Fancy Royal Tablecloth

title: Tamriel Festival Ribbons
flavorText: Traditional Tamrielic ribbons for participating in festivals, balls, and other formal celebrations.
name: Tamriel Festival Ribbons

title: Pristine Mummy-Wrap Handkerchiefs
flavorText: Only the most exclusive shops sell these elegant handkerchiefs crafted from genuine mummy wrappings.
name: Pristine Mummy-Wrap Handkerchiefs

title: Unspoiled Butterfly-Wing Napkins
flavorText: Fancy and delicate, almost every wealthy household owns a set—but it's rare to find a set that hasn't been used.
name: Unspoiled Butterfly-Wing Napkins

title: High Priest's Ephod Keepsake
flavorText: A gold-embroidered cloth triangle from an ephod once worn by the High Priest of Satakalaam.
name: High Priest's Ephod Keepsake

title: Swan-Satin Bathing Thong
flavorText: Sleek and sensuous singing-swan style satin string sporting silver sequins, from Snip & Stitch, Skywatch.
name: Swan-Satin Bathing Thong

title: Linen Tablecloth
flavorText: A simple tablecloth, excellent for picnicking.
name: Linen Tablecloth

title: Bangkorai Garrison Towels
flavorText: These thick, warm towels were taken from the baths at Bangkorai Garrison.
name: Bangkorai Garrison Towels

title: Magus-General's Tablecloth
flavorText: This gold-embroidered tablecloth was designated for the dining table of Imperial Magus-General Septima Tharn.
name: Magus-General's Tablecloth

title: Lady Laurent's Silk Kerchief
flavorText: The renowned voyager employs these kerchiefs to keep her hands clean in old tombs. Stibbons has lost hundreds of them.
name: Lady Laurent's Silk Kerchief

title: Faux Fennec Flesh Handkerchief
flavorText: Yahiri the Tailor in Belkarth makes and sells these simulated Fennec hide kerchiefs—far less expensive than the real thing.
name: Faux Fennec Flesh Handkerchief

title: Kwama Miner Neckerchief
flavorText: A colorful cloth, worn around the neck, it can be pulled up to protect the nose and mouth of workers in kwama mines.
name: Kwama Miner Neckerchief

title: Pristine Netch-Hide Handkerchiefs
flavorText: Iirila Maleran of Mournhold produces these elegant handkerchiefs for the upper echelon of House Hlaalu and House Telvanni.
name: Pristine Netch-Hide Handkerchiefs

title: Fancy Skald-King Tablecloth
flavorText: Nords don't usually bother with such things, but when they decide to use a tablecloth, one depicting King Jorunn is a favorite.
name: Fancy Skald-King Tablecloth

title: Fancy Windhelm Pommel Cozy
flavorText: No one who's anyone walks the streets of Windhelm without a cozy to keep their weapon pommel warm and comfy.
name: Fancy Windhelm Pommel Cozy

title: Gold-Trimmed Dust Cloth
flavorText: The Merry Maids of Daggerfall use these distinctive dust cloths when cleaning the homes of wealthy nobles in the city.
name: Gold-Trimmed Dust Cloth

title: Lord Diel's Spidersilk Bib
flavorText: Fancy and delicate, Lord Diel popularized the use of these expensive bibs at extravagant dinner parties in Daggerfall.
name: Lord Diel's Spidersilk Bib

title: Royal Monogramed Towels
flavorText: A set of royal towels from the castle in Daggerfall, monogramed with the initials of King Casimir.
name: Royal Monogramed Towels

title: Bolt of Iridescent Spidersilk
flavorText: Bolt of iridescent spidersilk from the Scuttle Pit. It seems to be every color at once, or no color at all.
name: Bolt of Iridescent Spidersilk

title: Red Sateen Vestments of Z'en
flavorText: Red vestments of a Priest of Z'en, worn when declaring a Wood Elf Mourning War begun or ended.
name: Red Sateen Vestments of Z'en

title: Otter-Skin Cheese Strainer
flavorText: This finely stitched sling has seen a lot of use in the making of rodent cheeses.
name: Otter-Skin Cheese Strainer

title: Treethane's Splinted Thunderbug Sash
flavorText: Treethane's crimson sash of enameled thunderbug splints, traditionally worn for Y'ffre's Naming Day.
name: Treethane's Splinted Thunderbug Sash

title: Silk Sugar Dauber
flavorText: A square of folded silk used to daub moon-sugar onto Khajiiti tongues. Called a "hairball hankie" by ignorant foreigners.
name: Silk Sugar Dauber

title: Royal Monogramed Bed Sheets
flavorText: A set of royal bed sheets from Shornhelm, monogramed with the initials of the former ruler, King Ranser.
name: Royal Monogramed Bed Sheets

title: Hoarfrost Downs Sash of Office
flavorText: Only the mayor and town officials of Hoarfrost Downs can purchase and wear these stylish, pleated sashes.
name: Hoarfrost Downs Sash of Office

title: Experimental Magma-Suit, Damaged
flavorText: Silvery coveralls of an unknown material, partially burned through, labeled "Valdam Andoren, Davon's Watch Guildhall."
name: Experimental Magma-Suit, Damaged

title: Set of Chamois Hand-Cloths
flavorText: A set of four soft deer-chamois hand-cloths, stamped on the corners, "Riverside Inn, Nimalten."
name: Set of Chamois Hand-Cloths

title: Rabbit-Fur Ear Warmers
flavorText: A set of rabbit-fur muffs designed to protect the ears from the harsh and biting cold of the Rift.
name: Rabbit-Fur Ear Warmers

title: Jarl's Manor Monogramed Bed Sheets
flavorText: A set of luxurious bed sheets from Riften, monogramed with the initials of one of the local jarls.
name: Jarl's Manor Monogramed Bed Sheets

title: Embroidered Pot Holder
flavorText: A quilted pot holder with an intricate embroidered floral pattern.
name: Embroidered Pot Holder

title: Spidersilk Handkerchief
flavorText: A forest green handkerchief of fine spidersilk.
name: Spidersilk Handkerchief

title: Dancing Day Silk Veils
flavorText: Long veils of crimson, scarlet, and lemon yellow, for doing the sprightly Mistral Tarantella on Dancing Day.
name: Dancing Day Silk Veils

title: Bolt of Royal Cloth-of-Gold
flavorText: Bolt of glimmering cloth-of-gold, with a repeating embroidered pattern of the Seal of House Rilis.
name: Bolt of Royal Cloth-of-Gold

title: Silk Handkerchief
flavorText: Thankfully, this handkerchief does not appear to have been used.
name: Silk Handkerchief

title: Faux Fox Fur Handkerchief
flavorText: Josee Maviniele, the tailor in Windhelm, sells these simulated fox fur handkerchiefs—far less expensive than the real thing.
name: Faux Fox Fur Handkerchief

title: Burgundy Kerchief
flavorText: This fashionable pocket cloth is extremely soft and dyed a rich burgundy.
name: Burgundy Kerchief

title: Canonreeve's Silken Handkerchiefs
flavorText: Pair of off-white silken handkerchiefs, trimmed with lace and embroidered with the arms of the Dawnbreak Canonreeve.
name: Canonreeve's Silken Handkerchiefs

title: Ulath Ashlander Ceremonial Body Wrap
flavorText: Long gray fungus-linen wrap-shroud, draped many times around a wise-woman's torso during Holy Meditation.
name: Ulath Ashlander Ceremonial Body Wrap

title: Raw Silk Linens
flavorText: Rough-spun linens gathered from an Argonian caterpillar farm.
name: Raw Silk Linens

title: Unspoiled Spidersilk Napkins
flavorText: Fancy and delicate, almost every wealthy Nord household owns a set—but, being Nords, they never use them.
name: Unspoiled Spidersilk Napkins

title: Thalmor Authenticated Silk Sheets
flavorText: These sheets are fit for Queen Ayrenn herself to lie on.
name: Thalmor Authenticated Silk Sheets

title: Bolt of Silk Sarsenet
flavorText: Bolt of fine fabric, apricot-colored silk sarsenet, bound in a broad ribbon labeled "Northpoint Imports."
name: Bolt of Silk Sarsenet

title: Silverweave Small Clothes
flavorText: These silverweave small clothes appear quite comfortable. What they lack in style, they make up in volume.
name: Silverweave Small Clothes

title: Mournhold Ambassador's Doily
flavorText: A doily with the Tribunal heraldry, distributed during a rare public banquet held by the Dark Elf ambassador to Riften.
name: Mournhold Ambassador's Doily

title: Velvet Curtains
flavorText: These velvet curtains are so soft.
name: Velvet Curtains

title: Leather Laces
flavorText: These laces are just wide enough to see the Ayleid letters burnt into them.
name: Leather Laces

title: Embroidered Hand Towel
flavorText: Embroidered with an image of the Crimson Ship, this hand towel is a reminder to those in Hammerfell of the Day of Shame.
name: Embroidered Hand Towel

title: Silken Dueling Towel
flavorText: When Alik'r nobles engage in a duel, it is customary to bring a dueling towel to wipe sweat from one's brow.
name: Silken Dueling Towel

title: Duke's Edition Plush Towels
flavorText: Bits & Pieces in Aldcroft sells these luxurious bath towels featuring the Duke of Camlorn's crest woven into the design.
name: Duke's Edition Plush Towels

title: Set of Chamois Hand-Towels
flavorText: A set of four fine deer-chamois handtowels, stamped on the corners "Trader's Rest, Velyn Harbor."
name: Set of Chamois Hand-Towels

title: High King's Celebratory Token
flavorText: A large coin engraved with the image of High King Emeric, issued to commemorate his coronation and rise to the throne.
name: High King's Celebratory Token

title: Hammerdeath Arena Token
flavorText: A token once used by the nobles of Menevia when gambling in the Hammerdeath Arena.
name: Hammerdeath Arena Token

title: Ash'abah Friendship Coin
flavorText: The Ash'abah give these coins out to friends and allies to whom they owe a debt.
name: Ash'abah Friendship Coin

title: Ancient Ayleid Coin
flavorText: This was likely found near Carzog's Demise. After all these centuries, the metal still gleams in the light.
name: Ancient Ayleid Coin

title: Ancient Yokudan Coin
flavorText: A tarnished Yokudan coin. The profile of an ancient warrior is just barely visible on its worn surface.
name: Ancient Yokudan Coin

title: Oversized Souvenir Coin
flavorText: Oversized brass souvenir coin, with a jug of theilul engraved on the obverse, and "Coin Brothers Cornerclub" on the reverse.
name: Oversized Souvenir Coin

title: Commemorative Imperial Coins
flavorText: These coins depict the first emperors of Tamriel: from Alessia to Savirien-Chorak.
name: Commemorative Imperial Coins

title: Old Yokudan Coin Collection
flavorText: A scattering of ancient Yokudan coins, set and displayed as a collection.
name: Old Yokudan Coin Collection

title: Dwemer Coin Collection
flavorText: A scattering of what appear to be ancient Dwemer coins, set and displayed as a collection.
name: Dwemer Coin Collection

title: Broken-Toothed Ivory Comb
flavorText: A fancy comb of Redguard design, a few of its teeth have broken off and are missing.
name: Broken-Toothed Ivory Comb

title: Ivory Comb
flavorText: An ornate comb, carved from a horker tusk.
name: Ivory Comb

title: Deerbone Comb
flavorText: This simple comb is well-polished. None of the teeth are missing.
name: Deerbone Comb

title: Ornate Tortoiseshell Comb
flavorText: The teeth on this elegant comb are surprisingly strong.
name: Ornate Tortoiseshell Comb

title: Alik'r Royal Comb
flavorText: This is one of Duchess Lakana's precious grooming implements.
name: Alik'r Royal Comb

title: Diamond-Tooth Cat Comb
flavorText: This extravagant jeweled comb was one of several created for Queen Jezerei, also known as the "Strumpet Queen."
name: Diamond-Tooth Cat Comb

title: Werewolf Knot Rake
flavorText: A steel comb especially designed to untangle matted knots that accumulate in a werewolf's fur.
name: Werewolf Knot Rake

title: Dragonbone Comb
flavorText: This comb, seemingly made of dragonbone, is carved as a stylized Dragon head with the comb's teeth coming from its maw.
name: Dragonbone Comb

title: Timber Mammoth Ivory Comb
flavorText: A fine-toothed ivory comb carved with a relief showing King Aeradan accepting the Camoran crown.
name: Timber Mammoth Ivory Comb

title: Noble's Comb and Brush Set
flavorText: Jade comb, ivory-handled hair brush, and silver-plated scissors, in a lacquered box embossed with the arms of House Dothriel.
name: Noble's Comb and Brush Set

title: Queen's Mourning Barrette
flavorText: After the death of the king and her children, Queen Arzhela had several ebony barrettes made to wear while in mourning.
name: Queen's Mourning Barrette

title: Dragonshrine Chalice
flavorText: A sculpted Dragon claw grasps the stem. This one of several discovered in and around Skyshroud Barrows.
name: Dragonshrine Chalice

title: Ancient Dwarven Chalice
flavorText: An ornate grail thought to be used as a drinking vessel. It was recovered from the Dwemer ruins of Bthanual.
name: Ancient Dwarven Chalice

title: Clay Cup
flavorText: This simple clay cup is in perfect condition. There are no nicks or blemishes.
name: Clay Cup

title: Rajhin's Final Cups
flavorText: This is supposedly one of the clay cups used in the fabled drinking contest between the Khajiiti trickster god and Sanguine.
name: Rajhin's Final Cups

title: Porcelain Teacup
flavorText: This dainty teacup rests comfortably in the crook of one's finger.
name: Porcelain Teacup

title: Glass Cupping Set
flavorText: Typically used by doctors, these cups are coveted by vampires as a means of collecting and transporting meals.
name: Glass Cupping Set

title: Nedic Cup
flavorText: An ancient stone cup—still in use. Faded Nedic motifs are just barely visible on the base.
name: Nedic Cup

title: Chipped Imperial Tea Cup
flavorText: An exquisite tea cup from an Imperial tea service setting, marred by a tiny chip in the porcelain.
name: Chipped Imperial Tea Cup

title: Chipped Orsinium Tea Cup
flavorText: An exquisite and surprisingly delicate tea cup from an Orsinium tea service setting, marred by a tiny chip in the porcelain.
name: Chipped Orsinium Tea Cup

title: War Trophy of Kyne's Admiration
flavorText: For defeating twelve or more enemies while fighting to defend Skyrim's honor, a Nord warrior received this cup of distinction.
name: War Trophy of Kyne's Admiration

title: Moon-Sugar Sipping Cup
flavorText: Imported from Senchal, this tawny-clay, spill-proof cup allows young Khajiit cubs to discover the wonders of moon-sugar tea.
name: Moon-Sugar Sipping Cup

title: Sentinel Sipping Cup
flavorText: Imported from Alik'r, this cerulean-clay cup is designed to be spill-proof for the use of young children.
name: Sentinel Sipping Cup

title: Ash Drinking Cup
flavorText: A simple and elegant cup, carved from a single piece of heartwood.
name: Ash Drinking Cup

title: Thane Fjora's Winner's Cup
flavorText: A small trophy, awarded for winning the annual riddle contest sponsored by the Lady of Nimalten.
name: Thane Fjora's Winner's Cup

title: Leather Dice Cup
flavorText: A gambling dice cup, made from carefully stitched, cured leather.
name: Leather Dice Cup

title: Overlook Inn Royal Stirrup Cup
flavorText: Crystal-and-silver stirrup cup sporting the royal seal, traditionally presented at the Overlook Inn before a House Rilis hunt.
name: Overlook Inn Royal Stirrup Cup

title: Grandee Zizeen Teacups
flavorText: These expensive teacups were given to Crown loyalists who supported Zizzeen in his failed attempt to win the throne.
name: Grandee Zizeen Teacups

title: Nord Guessing Cups
flavorText: A set of three identical metal cups, Nords use them to play the popular game of "Chase the Pea." Which cup is the pea under?
name: Nord Guessing Cups

title: Kagouti Tusk Drinking Cups
flavorText: A set of sturdy drinking vessels carved from genuine kagouti tusks and engraved with House Redoran symbology.
name: Kagouti Tusk Drinking Cups

title: Argonian Sipping Cup
flavorText: Imported from Black Marsh, this crimson-wood cup is designed to be spill-proof for the use of young children.
name: Argonian Sipping Cup

title: "Daily Jagga Shot" Matching Glass Set
flavorText: Set of seven enameled mudcrab-chitin shot glasses, with gilded rims, one for each day of the week.
name: "Daily Jagga Shot" Matching Glass Set

title: Alik'ri Glassware
flavorText: A pair of wine glasses made from the finest desert crystal.
name: Alik'ri Glassware

title: Brandy Snifter
flavorText: A glass curved to trap the aroma of brandy. Alas, it is empty.
name: Brandy Snifter

title: Crystal Wine Glass
flavorText: This glass has a tiny maker's mark etched into the base.
name: Crystal Wine Glass

title: Set of Crystal Dram Glasses
flavorText: Set of six crystal shot glasses engraved with an image of the Overlook Inn.
name: Set of Crystal Dram Glasses

title: Ancient Dagoth Brandy Snifter
flavorText: A glass specifically designed to serve Ancient Dagoth Brandy in, it concentrates the bouquet and intensifies the flavor.
name: Ancient Dagoth Brandy Snifter

title: Celestite Drinking Glass
flavorText: A finely-wrought drinking glass made from a cool blue geode.
name: Celestite Drinking Glass

title: Set of Syrup Dram Glasses
flavorText: Set of seven cut-glass jigger cups, used for sipping fermented syrups, from the Vitriarch at Cat's Eye Quay.
name: Set of Syrup Dram Glasses

title: Crystalline Glass
flavorText: A glass that bears Altmeri writing in golden text across the bottom.
name: Crystalline Glass

title: Set of Gilt-Edged Mazte Glasses
flavorText: Set of six greenglass mazte glasses with gilded brims, from the Hissing Guar Cornerclub in Kragenmoor.
name: Set of Gilt-Edged Mazte Glasses

title: White Lion Tankard
flavorText: An iron-wood cup, carved to resemble a white lion's head. A maker's mark on the base indicates it was crafted in Lower Yorgrim.
name: White Lion Tankard

title: Fancy "I Hate Morndas" Kaveh Mug
flavorText: Insulated mug for hot beverages, made of turtle shell inlaid with a mother-of-pearl epigram.
name: Fancy "I Hate Morndas" Kaveh Mug

title: Jagga-Junga Nesting Mugs
flavorText: Set of eight jagga mugs, each larger than the last, for the progressive drinking game Jagga-Junga; the largest is for spew.
name: Jagga-Junga Nesting Mugs

title: Set of Tamrith Shot Glasses
flavorText: Set of four shot glasses etched with the crest of House Tamrith.
name: Set of Tamrith Shot Glasses

title: Sabre Cat Drinking Cups
flavorText: A set of sturdy drinking vessels carved from genuine sabre cat tusks and engraved with Breton symbology.
name: Sabre Cat Drinking Cups

title: Wasp-Head Balero with Chiming Ball
flavorText: Balero, or cup-and-ball, with a giant-wasp-head cup and a copper-mesh ball with a chiming silver bell inside.
name: Wasp-Head Balero with Chiming Ball

title: Alik'r Spice Decanters
flavorText: A pair of Redguard containers designed to hold rare and expensive Alik'r spices.
name: Alik'r Spice Decanters

title: Ceremonial Decanter
flavorText: A porcelain vessel emblazoned with the symbols of the Eight Divines.
name: Ceremonial Decanter

title: Pewter Decanter
flavorText: This pewter decanter smells faintly of spoiled milk.
name: Pewter Decanter

title: Etched Silver Decanter
flavorText: This is one of several extremely valuable decanters personalized for the merchant-lords of Tamriel.
name: Etched Silver Decanter

title: Metal Decanter
flavorText: The craftsmanship on this decanter is simple, but precise.
name: Metal Decanter

title: Fine Direnni Decanter
flavorText: This delicate vessel dates back to the Direnni Hegemony. Some kind of ancient glamour must be keeping it intact.
name: Fine Direnni Decanter

title: Viridian Decanter
flavorText: This tall decanter was used by the Viridian Sentinel to contain the sap of the forest's oldest trees.
name: Viridian Decanter

title: Desert Glass Decanter
flavorText: A beautifully crafted vessel. Iridescent red flecks can be seen in the glass.
name: Desert Glass Decanter

title: Earthenware Decanter
flavorText: A ceramic decanter, crafted in the stark style of the local Iron Orc tribes but sold by merchants in Belkarth and Dragonstar.
name: Earthenware Decanter

title: Engraved Silver Decanter
flavorText: This is one of several extremely valuable decanters personalized for the merchant-lords of House Hlaalu.
name: Engraved Silver Decanter

title: Earthenware Mead Decanter
flavorText: A ceramic decanter, crafted in the flamboyant style of the Eastmarch Nord clans and sold at Voljar's Meadery.
name: Earthenware Mead Decanter

title: Rosy Lion Decanter
flavorText: A lavish crystal decanter bearing the symbol of the Rosy Lion Inn in Daggerfall.
name: Rosy Lion Decanter

title: Wine Carafe
flavorText: The smooth lines of this carafe are very aesthetically pleasing.
name: Wine Carafe

title: Orsinium Pink Zinfandel Decanter
flavorText: A rare crystal decanter from Wrothgar, it shows that Orcs can create delicate and beautiful art when they want to.
name: Orsinium Pink Zinfandel Decanter

title: Decanter of Preserved Grom Globs
flavorText: Sealed cut-glass decanter containing six grom globs meffed by dreugh at Vivec's Antlers, and preserved in vinegar.
name: Decanter of Preserved Grom Globs

title: Narsis Crystal Greef Ewer
flavorText: A rare crystal decanter from Narsis in Deshaan, it demonstrates the delicate and beautiful artisanship of the Dark Elves.
name: Narsis Crystal Greef Ewer

title: Crystal Wine Decanter
flavorText: A stoppered wine decanter of fine crystal.
name: Crystal Wine Decanter

title: Charmed Crystal Decanter
flavorText: This crystal decanter is magically charmed to heat or cool liquor to its optimum drinking temperature, based on its type.
name: Charmed Crystal Decanter

title: Amberware Peacock Pitcher
flavorText: Delicate ceramic pitcher in the shape of a peacock, from Culinary Imports in Skywatch.
name: Amberware Peacock Pitcher

title: Morhwa's Milk Pitcher
flavorText: A fine ceramic milk pitcher with a painting of the four-armed teat god.
name: Morhwa's Milk Pitcher

title: Stamped Silver Pitcher
flavorText: An exquisite pitcher that bears the mark of Betony's late master smith, Hervic Fambure.
name: Stamped Silver Pitcher

title: Halcyon Water Pitcher
flavorText: This crystal pitcher was made by the Nereid of Halcyon Lake. Sapphires on the pitcher's handle make it extremely valuable.
name: Halcyon Water Pitcher

title: Ash-Slake Ale Pitcher
flavorText: A decorative glass pitcher, used to hold and dispense ash-slake ale and other tasty Dark Elf beverages.
name: Ash-Slake Ale Pitcher

title: Scorpion Shell Pig-Milk Pitcher
flavorText: A decorative pitcher made from a scorpion's shell, used to store and dispense milk produced by Wood Elf hogs.
name: Scorpion Shell Pig-Milk Pitcher

title: Porcelain Milk Pitcher
flavorText: A decorative porcelain pitcher, used to store and dispense milk produced by High Rock dairy cows.
name: Porcelain Milk Pitcher

title: Mudcrab-Chitin Rotmeth Pitcher
flavorText: Chitin rotmeth pitcher, with spout-strainer to keep in the chunks, etched "Phynaster's Stride, Haven."
name: Mudcrab-Chitin Rotmeth Pitcher

title: Fine Ceramic Leviathan Pitcher
flavorText: Enameled pitcher in the shape of the legendary leviathan Ithguleoir, said to haunt the seas beyond Northpoint.
name: Fine Ceramic Leviathan Pitcher

title: Fancy Mazte Pitcher
flavorText: A fancy pewter pitcher designed to hold a favorite Dark Elf beverage, such as mazte or sujamma.
name: Fancy Mazte Pitcher

title: Fine Crystal Pitcher
flavorText: Light striking this crystalline pitcher breaks into myriad directions and a spectrum of colors.
name: Fine Crystal Pitcher

title: Tusk-Carved Mammoth
flavorText: A stylized mammoth, carved from a single shard of mammoth tusk, it is obviously someone's prized possession.
name: Tusk-Carved Mammoth

title: Maormer Sea Captain's Ship Model
flavorText: Model of a Maormeri fast frigate fashioned from mother-of-pearl and other precious and exotic oceanic materials.
name: Maormer Sea Captain's Ship Model

title: Quicksilver Anchor
flavorText: This exquisite little anchor was designed to be ornamental. It features a depiction of Tava wrapped around the shank.
name: Quicksilver Anchor

title: "Stay Moist!" Brief-Axiom Wall Mosaic
flavorText: Flexible "Brief-Axiom" mosaic of colored stones embedded in crocodile hide, with turquoise chips spelling out "Stay Moist!"
name: "Stay Moist!" Brief-Axiom Wall Mosaic

title: Conjectural Diorama of Silyanorn
flavorText: Scale model in precious woods of the Barsaebic Ayleid city of Silyanorn, the predecessor of modern-day Stormhold.
name: Conjectural Diorama of Silyanorn

title: Emblazoned Arrowheads
flavorText: Forge-Wife Glesh created a series of these decorative arrowheads to commemorate the birth of Chief Tazgol's daughter, Lokra.
name: Emblazoned Arrowheads

title: Personalized Wooden Disc
flavorText: A Dark Elf name, carved into a decorative wooden disc. It's positioned so the owner never forgets what he or she is called.
name: Personalized Wooden Disc

title: "Field Guide to Lava" Pumice Cube
flavorText: Light stone cube, painted on all six sides, depicting the six most common kinds of lava in Stonefalls.
name: "Field Guide to Lava" Pumice Cube

title: Mudcrab Claw Memorial
flavorText: A serrated mudcrab claw, mounted to a decorative board beneath the inscription, "It Got My Toe, I Got Its Claw."
name: Mudcrab Claw Memorial

title: Mournhold Folding Altar
flavorText: A simple portable altar. Unfolding it reveals a scene of the Lord, the Mother, and the Wizard in all their glory.
name: Mournhold Folding Altar

title: Guar Sun Catcher
flavorText: Colorful pieces of transparent glass have been carefully shaped into a small guar.
name: Guar Sun Catcher

title: Frozen Man Folding Fan
flavorText: A decorative hand fan. Unfolding it reveals a scene depicting the legend of the Frozen Man who supposedly haunts Orkey's Hollow.
name: Frozen Man Folding Fan

title: Framed Butterfly Display
flavorText: A framed display of various butterflies, indigenous to the moors and meadows of Rivenspire.
name: Framed Butterfly Display

title: Lighthouse Centrepiece
flavorText: A scale replica of the Koeglin Lighthouse, cast in polished bronze.
name: Lighthouse Centrepiece

title: Matching Doomcrag Bookends
flavorText: These bookends, modeled after the nightmarish peak, so frightened customers that few sets survived the town square bonfires.
name: Matching Doomcrag Bookends

title: Glass Owl Curio
flavorText: This clear glass owl is small, but fine detail shows each feather and talon.
name: Glass Owl Curio

title: Gold-Plated Honeycomb
flavorText: Gold-plated sculptural honeycomb placed in the mouth of roast suckling wild boar during the Rain's Hand Revels.
name: Gold-Plated Honeycomb

title: Hist Bookends
flavorText: A pair of masterfully carved bookends that resemble a tangle of Hist roots.
name: Hist Bookends

title: Elaborate Model Swan Ship
flavorText: Model, in wood, fabric, and twine, of a Firsthold swan ship, detailed down to the tiny ballistas on the poop.
name: Elaborate Model Swan Ship

title: Aldmeri Ship Model
flavorText: A perfect scale model of one of the ships of the Aldmeri fleet.
name: Aldmeri Ship Model

title: Sea Glass Frippery
flavorText: A chunk of colored sea glass carved into the shape of a mudcrab and mounted to a small block for display.
name: Sea Glass Frippery

title: Ebony Treehenge Bookends
flavorText: A pair of heavy ebony bookends, each cast in the shape of the Green Lady Treestone from Treehenge.
name: Ebony Treehenge Bookends

title: Miniature Shornhelm Building
flavorText: Count Tamrith popularized the collecting of models fashioned after actual structures in Shornhelm among Rivenspire's elite.
name: Miniature Shornhelm Building

title: Driftwood Flummery
flavorText: A chunk of driftwood carved into the shape of a sweetroll and mounted to a small block for display.
name: Driftwood Flummery

title: Miniature Tavern
flavorText: Some wealthy citizens collect models fashioned after actual taverns and inns found throughout Tamriel.
name: Miniature Tavern

title: First Era Replica Tea Service
flavorText: A tea service modeled after one from the First Era, obviously a family heirloom.
name: First Era Replica Tea Service

title: First Era Rivenspire Tea Service
flavorText: An antique tea service from the First Era, obviously a Breton family heirloom.
name: First Era Rivenspire Tea Service

title: First Era Riften Warm Milk Service
flavorText: An antique service from the First Era for preparing and serving warm milk, obviously a Nord family heirloom.
name: First Era Riften Warm Milk Service

title: Ruby-Encrusted Tea Set
flavorText: An ancient tea set bearing a representation of the Imperial ruby on every piece.
name: Ruby-Encrusted Tea Set

title: Hist Tree Crystal Orb
flavorText: Crystal orb containing a tiny sculpture of the Percolating Mire Hist Tree; when inverted, small white flakes shower down.
name: Hist Tree Crystal Orb

title: Matching Troll Bookends
flavorText: These bookends, modeled after the nightmarish creatures known as trolls, so frightened customers that few sets still exist.
name: Matching Troll Bookends

title: Tabletop Coin Well
flavorText: This small, silver ornamental tub is designed to sit on a dining table where coins can be dropped in for good luck.
name: Tabletop Coin Well

title: Red Brittle Wamasu
