flavorText: A stylized wamasu, carved from a fragile chunk of red brittle, also known as nirncrux.
name: Red Brittle Wamasu

title: Replica Chid-Moska Xanmeer
flavorText: Small replica of a xanmeer carved in soapstone, engraved "Chid-Moska" underneath, with an "X" crudely carved at the apex.
name: Replica Chid-Moska Xanmeer

title: Colorful Pottery
flavorText: This colorfully painted pottery depicts the fall of the Reman Empire.
name: Colorful Pottery

title: Baandari Pottery
flavorText: Colorful, painted pottery in the Baandari style.
name: Baandari Pottery

title: Iron Citrus Juicer
flavorText: This sturdy iron juicer still has a faint lemon scent about it.
name: Iron Citrus Juicer

title: Copper Spice Grinder
flavorText: The teeth of this copper spice grinder are still sharp while a soft squeaking emanates from the turn handle.
name: Copper Spice Grinder

title: Hand-Crank Butter Churn
flavorText: Just add cream to this small wooden butter churn and turn the crank for a delicious buttery spread.
name: Hand-Crank Butter Churn

title: Fahara'jad's Nostril Spacers
flavorText: Snoring runs in Fahara'jad's family, so he had hundreds of these ebony nostril spacers made to use at night.
name: Fahara'jad's Nostril Spacers

title: Ayleid Carving
flavorText: This carving is not authentic, but it looks close enough to the real thing to be valuable nonetheless.
name: Ayleid Carving

title: Finds' Whiskey Distiller
flavorText: A device for making potent almost-a-poison whiskey in the comfort of your own home, it has Finds-Fine-Drinks' stamp of approval.
name: Finds' Whiskey Distiller

title: Dhalmora Scorpion Trap
flavorText: A Dhalmora Argonian invention, this contraption is placed near your sleeping area to attract and capture unwanted scorpions.
name: Dhalmora Scorpion Trap

title: Skeever Trap
flavorText: A trap designed to catch unwanted skeevers. A large chunk of cheese sits patiently in the center of the contraption.
name: Skeever Trap

title: Fig Slicer
flavorText: An unnecessarily complicated contraption. Almost certainly a wedding gift.
name: Fig Slicer

title: Crispy Frog Fryer
flavorText: A common outdoor cooking device, perfect for preparing one of the prime food sources available in Craglorn's wilderness.
name: Crispy Frog Fryer

title: Netch-Hide Quill Holder
flavorText: A stylish desk accessory that holds up to a dozen quills, crafted from genuine netch hide.
name: Netch-Hide Quill Holder

title: Commemorative Nail Clipper
flavorText: House Redoran nobles received this gift at the celebration on 3rd Last Seed honoring the founding of the house.
name: Commemorative Nail Clipper

title: Crispy Rabbit Fryer
flavorText: A specialized cooking device, perfect for preparing one of the prime food sources available in the Eastmarch wilderness.
name: Crispy Rabbit Fryer

title: Voljar's Corkscrew with Inlaid Handle
flavorText: This limited-edition corkscrew celebrates the famous meadery's one-hundredth anniversary.
name: Voljar's Corkscrew with Inlaid Handle

title: You-Know-What Distiller
flavorText: A distilling device for making potent You-Know-What whiskey (a favorite among the Wood Elves) in the comfort of your own home.
name: You-Know-What Distiller

title: Alik'r Spice Grinder
flavorText: Imported from Alik'r, this spice grinder can be set to produce the exact level of coarseness your recipe demands.
name: Alik'r Spice Grinder

title: Breton Cheese Grater
flavorText: A device for grating hard cheeses, crafted in a style made popular by the elite of Daggerfall.
name: Breton Cheese Grater

title: Original Aldcroft Meat Grinder
flavorText: An antique meat grinder, crafted in Aldcroft, is exceptionally large, with a wide auger and a polished wood handle.
name: Original Aldcroft Meat Grinder

title: Dagger Whiskey Distiller
flavorText: A distilling device for making tasty and potent Dagger whiskey (a favorite among the Covenant) in the comfort of your own home.
name: Dagger Whiskey Distiller

title: Imported Steel Desktop Book Stand
flavorText: Steel desktop stand for holding a book open for reading, inscribed "Imported by Orabess, Cormount."
name: Imported Steel Desktop Book Stand

title: Intricate Spring Trap
flavorText: This incredibly complex mouse-trap is of Khajiiti design, but features a great many Dwemer parts.
name: Intricate Spring Trap

title: Cricket Cage
flavorText: A small weasel-bone cage, lovingly crafted and occupied by a single cricket. It remains eerily quiet.
name: Cricket Cage

title: High Priest's Portable Auri-El Altar
flavorText: Elaborate tin folding altar to Auri-El, gilded and bejeweled, with a relief of Auri-El's Bow that emits a golden glow.
name: High Priest's Portable Auri-El Altar

title: Dominion Eagle-Head Peatfire Andiron
flavorText: Shovel-ended wrought iron peatfire andiron, with gilt Dominion eagle-headed handled, inscribed "Altmer Embassy."
name: Dominion Eagle-Head Peatfire Andiron

title: Pearl-Oyster Eternal Waterfall Sculpture
flavorText: Copper-tube eternal waterfall sculpture, with pearl-inset oyster basins and Dwemer everpump, from Greenwarden Forge.
name: Pearl-Oyster Eternal Waterfall Sculpture

title: Dwarven Puzzle Box
flavorText: Imported puzzle box of Dwarven metal, in a pouch made from the most exquisite mouse fur.
name: Dwarven Puzzle Box

title: Mystic Moons Torchbug Lanthorn
flavorText: Filigreed mesh torchbug cage with attached juice-dripper vial and embossed tag labeled "Mystic Moons Imports—Vulkwasten."
name: Mystic Moons Torchbug Lanthorn

title: Drublog Peat Hibachi
flavorText: Iron hibachi forged in Dra'bul for trade with the Bosmer, with bowl designed to contain burning peat bricks.
name: Drublog Peat Hibachi

title: Murkmire Spice Grinder
flavorText: A wooden device for grinding spices, this one was made by Argonian crafters and imported from Black Marsh.
name: Murkmire Spice Grinder

title: Heirloom Ebony Ash Yam Slow Cooker
flavorText: Antique pre-Four Score War ebony double-bottomed ash yam slow cooker, in the Old Ebonheart style.
name: Heirloom Ebony Ash Yam Slow Cooker

title: Small Copper Theilul Still
flavorText: Compact copper apparatus for distilling moon-sugar cane into theilul, the dark Argonian rum.
name: Small Copper Theilul Still

title: Alchemist's Scale
flavorText: A device for measuring the weight and volume of alchemical components, as used in Scent of Serenity in Riften.
name: Alchemist's Scale

title: Flat Brass Rotating Lunolabe
flavorText: Device with rotating brass rings for figuring the phases of the moons on any day of the year.
name: Flat Brass Rotating Lunolabe

title: Live-Catch Rodent Trap
flavorText: Portable wooden trap for live-catching rodents, made at the Old Sawdust Mill.
name: Live-Catch Rodent Trap

title: High Priest's Orison Orrery
flavorText: Jeweled rotating and counter-rotating orrery, used by Altmeri high priests to determine which Aedric planet to worship.
name: High Priest's Orison Orrery

title: Clockwork Brass Alarm Rooster
flavorText: Clockwork brass rooster that crows thrice at dawn, with three volume settings, from Swan's Grace Enchantments.
name: Clockwork Brass Alarm Rooster

title: Artificer's Hand Drill
flavorText: A miniature, hand-cranked mechanical drill used for extremely intricate work on clockwork mechanisms.
name: Artificer's Hand Drill

title: Perpetual Motion Gyroscope
flavorText: This remarkable toy will spin forever, with no apparent source of power. It bears the mark of Telenger the Artificer.
name: Perpetual Motion Gyroscope

title: Ebony Wood Musical Calliope
flavorText: A hand-cranked musical calliope of exquisite craftsmanship. Its construction is of a rare ebony wood.
name: Ebony Wood Musical Calliope

title: Alchemical Igniter
flavorText: This gold-plated device, designed to ignite a smoking pipe, was crafted by the great Telenger, and bears his mark.
name: Alchemical Igniter

title: Ooze-Blender with Spiral Spinner
flavorText: Fine ceramic ooze-blender jar with central rotating spiral spinner, engraved "Sundry Swills, Alten Corimont" on the bottom.
name: Ooze-Blender with Spiral Spinner

title: Ivory Egg Peeler
flavorText: This bizarre device peels eggs of every size and shape with the greatest of ease.
name: Ivory Egg Peeler

title: Depleted Enchanting Crystal
flavorText: Enchanting crystal, dull and depleted, mounted on a wrought-iron gem stand engraved "Stoneglow Enchantments."
name: Depleted Enchanting Crystal

title: Sotha Sil's Blessed Cogwheel
flavorText: A tiny cog, supposedly blessed by Sotha Sil. Every hour, on the hour, it pulses with a soft yellow light.
name: Sotha Sil's Blessed Cogwheel

title: Dwarven Cog Wrapped in a Note
flavorText: The note reads, "See? I told you! There's Dwarf stuff for the taking in the Armature! —Zendrinn"
name: Dwarven Cog Wrapped in a Note

title: Small Compass
flavorText: This pocket-sized compass fits in the palm of its user's hand and consistently points north.
name: Small Compass

title: Consistently Imprecise Compass
flavorText: This compass reliably points east-northeast. Carried by Khajiiti travelers who want future pickpockets to get lost.
name: Consistently Imprecise Compass

title: Gold-Filigreed Compass
flavorText: This compass fits neatly into a pocket or pouch, and gleams like a guiding star.
name: Gold-Filigreed Compass

title: Noble's Fancy Compass
flavorText: The previous owner of this ornate compass took good care of it, as evidenced by its glossy surface and glistening display.
name: Noble's Fancy Compass

title: Ayleid White-Gold Compass
flavorText: An antique compass of silver and gold that always points towards the White-Gold Tower in Cyrodiil.
name: Ayleid White-Gold Compass

title: Treethane's Ebony Baton of Office
flavorText: Treethane's symbol of office, a ceremonial ebony baton with a gold finial anchoring the Seven Gold Chains of Responsibility.
name: Treethane's Ebony Baton of Office

title: Inscrutable Dwarven Device with Blinking Gem
flavorText: Dwemer device, purpose unknown, with seven pistons and a blinking red gem, from the Inner Sea Armature.
name: Inscrutable Dwarven Device with Blinking Gem

title: Imperial Sceptre
flavorText: A rod made of solid gold and adorned with silver etches and jewels. It probably belonged to royalty.
name: Imperial Sceptre

title: Scale Model Dominion Catapult
flavorText: A small working model of a siege catapult. Miniature meatbags sold separately!
name: Scale Model Dominion Catapult

title: Dowsing Femur
flavorText: This expertly carved divining rod is a popular tool for luckless hunters.
name: Dowsing Femur

title: Miniature Abacus
flavorText: A small wooden counting frame, used to make simple mathematical calculations.
name: Miniature Abacus

title: Simple Abacus
flavorText: This wooden abacus features white and black beads. Merchants who have difficulty tallying might find this tool useful.
name: Simple Abacus

title: Kothringi Abacus from Zuuk
flavorText: Portable Kothringi abacus employing varnished sphere-scarabs as slide-beads. The four bottom central beads are marked Z-U-U-K.
name: Kothringi Abacus from Zuuk

title: Pomegranate Distiller
flavorText: An implement used to ferment pomegranate juice and distill it into Alik'r's most popular variety of wine.
name: Pomegranate Distiller

title: Crystal Flin Distiller
flavorText: A crystal distilling device for making tasty and potent flin whiskey in the comfort of your own home.
name: Crystal Flin Distiller

title: Large Rotmeth Fermentation Alembic
flavorText: Sizeable double-glass alembic for fermenting meat juices to make rotmeth; etched "Made by Enthoras, Master Alchemist."
name: Large Rotmeth Fermentation Alembic

title: Blessed Astrolabe
flavorText: After its blessing by a priest of Tava, it is bad luck for this silver astrolabe to be touched by any but royal naval officers.
name: Blessed Astrolabe

title: Gold Astrolabe
flavorText: This instrument is worth its weight in gold to the merchants of Tamriel. Also of use to astronomers or mages.
name: Gold Astrolabe

title: Miniature Bronze Mead Cask
flavorText: A limited-edition bronze cask, once filled with Voljar's Special Recipe. Produced for the meadery's two-hundredth anniversary.
name: Miniature Bronze Mead Cask

title: Brass Windup Clockwork Frog
flavorText: Windup clockwork amphibian that croaks and shoots out its tongue at the sound of a certain tone.
name: Brass Windup Clockwork Frog

title: Kwama Mine Lantern Cover
flavorText: A cover that fits over a kwama mine lantern, it focuses and directs the light or completely blocks, depending on your needs.
name: Kwama Mine Lantern Cover

title: Scamp-Head Camp Alarm
flavorText: Enchanted Scamp head mounted on a staff that squawks whenever a creature approaches the outskirts of a camp.
name: Scamp-Head Camp Alarm

title: Sea Drake Sextant
flavorText: This finely tuned sextant bears the mark of the Sea Drakes and was likely owned by one of Captain Helane's midshipmen.
name: Sea Drake Sextant

title: Brass Ship's Sextant
flavorText: A finely made nautical sextant of polished brass.
name: Brass Ship's Sextant

title: Dwemer Bauble
flavorText: A small spherical device of Dwemer origin that whirs and hisses. Its intended use is a mystery.
name: Dwemer Bauble

title: Windup Flying Nightingale
flavorText: Delicate clockwork nightingale that, when wound up, can fly across the room, singing; labeled "Galarniel, Firsthold Artisan."
name: Windup Flying Nightingale

title: Wisp Light Globe
flavorText: A small glass globe containing a tiny captured wisp, intended to be used as a nightlight.
name: Wisp Light Globe

title: Kerbol's Hollow Mouthguard
flavorText: This small wooden device resembles a horse bit, but actually helps prevent teeth-grinding at night.
name: Kerbol's Hollow Mouthguard

title: Over-Sized Tavern Dice
flavorText: A pair of over-sized dice from a tavern somewhere in Tamriel.
name: Over-Sized Tavern Dice

title: Set of Brass Dice
flavorText: These dice are quite heavy. The gleaming brass offsets the dots carved on each side.
name: Set of Brass Dice

title: Hadoon's Fateful Dice
flavorText: A set of loaded ebony dice that always roll 1.
name: Hadoon's Fateful Dice

title: Bone Dice
flavorText: A set of dice made from bones and fashioned in a tradition that honors the Yokudan god of souls.
name: Bone Dice

title: Commemorative Skywatch Festival Dice
flavorText: A pair of brass dice, whose poor construction tends to favor one side. Gamblers would pay a fair price for these.
name: Commemorative Skywatch Festival Dice

title: Crossroads Tavern Dice
flavorText: A pair of dice from the Crossroads Tavern in Belkarth.
name: Crossroads Tavern Dice

title: Sotha Sil Erudition Dice
flavorText: Oddly sided dice. Of a design attributed to Sotha Sil for educational purposes, but mostly used in games of chance.
name: Sotha Sil Erudition Dice

title: Cold-Moon Inn Dice
flavorText: A pair of loaded dice from the Cold-Moon Inn in Windhelm.
name: Cold-Moon Inn Dice

title: Y'ffre's Bones Prayer Dice
flavorText: Odd dice designed to aid in prayers to Y'ffre, though few besides Wood Elves know how to interpret them.
name: Y'ffre's Bones Prayer Dice

title: Rosy Lion Tavern Dice
flavorText: A pair of marble dice from the Rosy Lion Inn in Daggerfall.
name: Rosy Lion Tavern Dice

title: Forebears Prayer Dice
flavorText: Odd dice designed to aid in prayers to the Eight of the Forebears, but mostly used in games of chance in Glenumbra.
name: Forebears Prayer Dice

title: Baandari Trick Dice
flavorText: A pair of Baandari dice. They seem unevenly weighted to favor one side.
name: Baandari Trick Dice

title: Suede Pouch with Fine Bone Dice
flavorText: Six dice carved from Wood Elf knuckles in a variety of polyhedral shapes, in a pouch of violet suede with a golden drawstring.
name: Suede Pouch with Fine Bone Dice

title: Watch House Tavern Dice
flavorText: A pair of dice from the Watch House Tavern in Davon's Watch.
name: Watch House Tavern Dice

title: Bag of Imitation Finger-Bone Dice
flavorText: Waxed Hissmir bloat-sac containing 16 "Dunmeri finger-bone" betting-dice—probably imitation. (Probably.)
name: Bag of Imitation Finger-Bone Dice

title: Draugr Dice
flavorText: A set of dice carved from mammoth tusk ivory, used for the popular game "Draugr, Draugr, Lich."
name: Draugr Dice

title: Croc-Tooth Dice and Dice Cup
flavorText: Hardwood dice cup containing a set of dice made from crocodile teeth, from Fishcatcher's Inn.
name: Croc-Tooth Dice and Dice Cup

title: Creepy Monkey Puppet
flavorText: This hideous grimacing puppet is likely used to scold misbehaving children. The brass castanets could be resold.
name: Creepy Monkey Puppet

title: Smuggler's Doll
flavorText: This ratty, stained bear doll has a hidden pocket that smells faintly of skooma.
name: Smuggler's Doll

title: Child's Ambiguous Doll
flavorText: It isn't clear if this tiny burlap monstrosity represents a frost troll or Clivia Tharn. Its steel button eyes could be resold.
name: Child's Ambiguous Doll

title: Ivory Doll
flavorText: A doll dressed in a handmade floral dress, with yarn for hair.
name: Ivory Doll

title: Wooden Marionette
flavorText: The marionette wears a blank expression. Its maker's symbol is burned into the bottom of its left foot.
name: Wooden Marionette

title: Dremora Ragamuffin Doll
flavorText: It seems someone thought this scary, raggedy doll would be popular with children.
name: Dremora Ragamuffin Doll

title: Wicker Effigy
flavorText: A traditional wicker statue, used as a stand-in for the owner in dark rituals no longer sanctioned by most religions.
name: Wicker Effigy

title: Battlereeve Urcelmo Doll
flavorText: This surprisingly accurate wooden doll faithfully captures Battlereeve Urcelmo's likeness.
name: Battlereeve Urcelmo Doll

title: Breton Flogging Doll
flavorText: A traditional Orcish children's doll. This one strongly resembles Peverel Stemuseph and appears well-worn.
name: Breton Flogging Doll

title: Sap-Speaker Moppet Doll
flavorText: A doll modeled after an Argonian Sap-Speaker, albeit with a large head and smaller body, rarely seen this far from Murkmire.
name: Sap-Speaker Moppet Doll

title: Captain Rana Jinx Doll
flavorText: A stuffed doll made of rags, crudely modeled to represent Captain Rana. Multiple needles skewer its head and torso.
name: Captain Rana Jinx Doll

title: Queen Arzhela Doll
flavorText: Ever a favorite of the people, this doll likeness of Queen Arzhela is very popular among young girls in Northern Bangkorai.
name: Queen Arzhela Doll

title: Iron Orc Ragamuffin Doll
flavorText: Someone in Dragonstar thought this creepy, poorly-stitched doll would be adored by children. They were quite wrong.
name: Iron Orc Ragamuffin Doll

title: Nix-Guar Thing
flavorText: Why anyone would attach the head of a nix to the body of a guar is anyone's guess, but somebody will probably pay gold for it.
name: Nix-Guar Thing

title: Skald-King Moppet Doll
flavorText: A silk doll fashioned after Jorunn the Skald-King, albeit with an enlarged head and disproportionately smaller body.
name: Skald-King Moppet Doll

title: Thane Icehammer Doll
flavorText: Only the children of opulence own a Thane Icehammer doll—complete with oozing side wound and extra-sharp battle-axe!
name: Thane Icehammer Doll

title: Wilderking Doll
flavorText: Myth or reality? This child's doll depicts the legendary Wilderking as an enormous Elf with antlers.
name: Wilderking Doll

title: Y'ffre Camp Guardian
flavorText: Wood Elves construct these tiny effigies of sticks and twigs, bless them to Y'ffre, and place them to protect their camps.
name: Y'ffre Camp Guardian

title: Savage Werewolf Marionette
flavorText: A string-operated puppet in the shape of a savage werewolf, now considered somewhat in bad taste due to events in Camlorn.
name: Savage Werewolf Marionette

title: Magnus Cult Wicker Effigy
flavorText: A traditional statue made of wicker, used as a stand-in for the owner in certain rituals performed by followers of Magnus.
name: Magnus Cult Wicker Effigy

title: Spinner's Ivory Silvenar Puppet
flavorText: A painted ivory marionette in the image of the Silvenar, with jointed limbs for simulated bowing and blessing.
name: Spinner's Ivory Silvenar Puppet

title: Sailor's "Dancing Maiden" Statuette
flavorText: Jadeite statuette of a lissome dancer that gyrates when spun like a top, inscribed "Fuller's Break Ale" around the base.
name: Sailor's "Dancing Maiden" Statuette

title: Dancing Duo Silvenar Bone Marionette
flavorText: Marionette of monkey bones dressed in the traditional cloth-of-silver robes of the Silvenar, used in the Memorial Duo Dance.
name: Dancing Duo Silvenar Bone Marionette

title: Dancing Duo Green Lady Bone Marionette
flavorText: Marionette of monkey bones dressed in the traditional iridescent green garb of the Green Lady, used in the Memorial Duo Dance.
name: Dancing Duo Green Lady Bone Marionette

title: Baby Ape Dress-Up Doll, with Clothing
flavorText: Mummified baby ape with painted-on Elven features and a varied wardrobe of rich and exotic doll garments.
name: Baby Ape Dress-Up Doll, with Clothing

title: King Kurog Doll
flavorText: A doll modeled after the Orc King Kurog. The ferocious and monstrous look indicates it was probably crafted by a Breton.
name: King Kurog Doll

title: Xeech'ki Doll
flavorText: A small "seed doll" carved by a talented Wasseek'haleel artisan.
name: Xeech'ki Doll

title: Skald-King Jinx Doll
flavorText: A stuffed doll made of rags, crudely modeled to represent Jorunn the Skald-King. Multiple needles skewer its head and torso.
name: Skald-King Jinx Doll

title: The Brief Queen Porcelain Doll
flavorText: Only a handful of these haunting figurines were crafted and sold before the Skald-King took offense and outlawed the dolls.
name: The Brief Queen Porcelain Doll

title: Handmade Green Lady Doll
flavorText: A handmade child's doll with intricate embroidery and beading, fashioned to look like the Green Lady.
name: Handmade Green Lady Doll

title: Nightmare Nuzzle
flavorText: A rag doll in the shape of a stylized ghost, Wood Elves take the nuzzle to bed when they want to experience bad dreams.
name: Nightmare Nuzzle

title: Stuffed Pony Guar
flavorText: Is it a lifelike doll or an actual stuffed pony guar? And does it really matter anyway?
name: Stuffed Pony Guar

title: Stuffed Bantam Guar
flavorText: A lifelike bantam guar doll intended for Dark Elf children. Either that, or an actual stuffed bantam guar.
name: Stuffed Bantam Guar

title: Plush Hagraven Doll
flavorText: This doll is in near-perfect condition because children found it difficult to love.
name: Plush Hagraven Doll

title: Warhorse Porcelain Doll
flavorText: A delicate and beautiful representation of a warhorse, displaying the creature's majesty and grace.
name: Warhorse Porcelain Doll

title: Brave Little Scrib Doll
flavorText: A doll modeled after the beloved baby kwama hero of Dark Elf children's stories, the Brave Little Scrib.
name: Brave Little Scrib Doll

title: Stuffed Monkey
flavorText: A lifelike doll intended for Wood Elf children. This is definitely an actual stuffed monkey.
name: Stuffed Monkey

title: Dancing Spriggan Thumb Puppet
flavorText: Ingenious spriggan puppet carved from articulated bone by Menthorn of Haven; pressure on the base makes the puppet "dance."
name: Dancing Spriggan Thumb Puppet

title: Stuffed Rabbit
flavorText: This lifelike doll intended for Breton children couldn't be an actual stuffed rabbit. Could it?
name: Stuffed Rabbit

title: Kinlord Rilis Nesting Dolls
flavorText: Thirteen nesting dolls of painted bamboo, representing Kinlord Rilis the First through Thirteenth.
name: Kinlord Rilis Nesting Dolls

title: Frost Troll Ragamuffin Doll
flavorText: Someone in Windhelm thought these scary, raggedy dolls would be popular with children.
name: Frost Troll Ragamuffin Doll

title: Ansei's Meditation Stone
flavorText: These massive egg-shaped crystals were used  by the Ansei centuries ago and were passed down to their descendants.
name: Ansei's Meditation Stone

title: Fanisea Kwama Egg
flavorText: A kwama egg of porcelain and gem stones, crafted by the artist Fanisea. Not one of her fancy works, but beautiful all the same.
name: Fanisea Kwama Egg

title: Farziseh's Harpy Egg
flavorText: A harpy egg of porcelain and gem stones, crafted by the artist Farziseh. Not one of her fancy works, but beautiful all the same.
name: Farziseh's Harpy Egg

title: Ivory Three-Hole Spine Sharpener
flavorText: Hollow ivory paperweight with three tapered sharpening-holes of different diameters.
name: Ivory Three-Hole Spine Sharpener

title: Ornamental Box of Family Egg-Shards
flavorText: Thornwood box with mother-of-pearl inlay containing a selection of family egg-shards going back several generations.
name: Ornamental Box of Family Egg-Shards

title: Kwama Egg Armillary Sphere
flavorText: Armillary sphere showing the orbits of the Aurbis' celestial objects, etched on an Onkobra Mines kwama egg.
name: Kwama Egg Armillary Sphere

title: Jeweled Lensatic Egg-Sculpture
flavorText: Strange heartwood sculpture of a lens-shaped egg inlaid with veins of copper and stones of orange chalcedony.
name: Jeweled Lensatic Egg-Sculpture

title: Lamia Singing Stone
flavorText: A small, egg-shaped stone that is smooth to the touch. A faint glow hints at some magical potency locked within.
name: Lamia Singing Stone

title: Golden Spikeball
flavorText: This solid-gold decorative spikeball is awarded annually to the most valuable spikeball player at Hadran's Caravan.
name: Golden Spikeball

title: Packet of Envelopes
flavorText: Untarnished envelopes perfect for keeping prying eyes at bay when secured with sealing wax.
name: Packet of Envelopes

title: Official Lion Guard Envelopes
flavorText: Envelopes bearing the official seal of the Lion Guard, suitable for sending important correspondence.
name: Official Lion Guard Envelopes

title: Cargo Manifest for Shad Astula
flavorText: Though the academy only caters to the Pact, they purchase from the lowest bidder. Rival schools would pay highly for this.
name: Cargo Manifest for Shad Astula

title: Edrald's Extravagant Party Allurement
flavorText: Nobles throughout Rivenspire often save the lavish invitations to the annual costume party held at Edrald Estate.
name: Edrald's Extravagant Party Allurement

title: Invitation: Drinks with the Jarls
flavorText: An invitation to attend a casual gathering with the jarls of the Rift. It appears drinks will be consumed in large quantities.
name: Invitation: Drinks with the Jarls

title: Invitation to the Thane's Feast
flavorText: An embossed and elegant invitation to the Thane's exclusive annual Riften dinner festival.
name: Invitation to the Thane's Feast

title: Royal Masquerade Invitation
flavorText: A gold-filigreed invitation to the Grand Masquerade of Alinor, a High Elven event that only takes place every 150 years.
name: Royal Masquerade Invitation

title: Bjoulsae Racing Oar
flavorText: Racing rowboats up and down the Bjoulsae River has been a popular pastime for centuries. This oar was made for this purpose.
name: Bjoulsae Racing Oar

title: Galatite Manacles
flavorText: A sturdy pair of High Elf manacles. The key appears to be missing.
name: Galatite Manacles

title: Prismatic Quill Pen
flavorText: A well-maintained quill, plucked from a particularly colorful cardinal.
name: Prismatic Quill Pen

title: Plumed Quill
flavorText: A quill made from a colorful feather. It's hardly been used.
name: Plumed Quill

title: Silver-Wrapped Quill
flavorText: King Emeric gifted several of these writing implements to the monks at Pariah Abbey.
name: Silver-Wrapped Quill

title: Rare Owl-Feather Quill
flavorText: Quill crafted from the feathers of the rare burrowing pixie owl of western Tamriel.
name: Rare Owl-Feather Quill

title: Kozanset Feather Quill
flavorText: This long feather quill appears to have been plucked from an adolescent harpy.
name: Kozanset Feather Quill

title: Hoonding's Golden Quill
flavorText: This quill pen is wrapped in gold and inscribed with a Frandar Hunding quote: "The pen is like the sword, but weaker."
name: Hoonding's Golden Quill

title: Eagle Feather Quill
flavorText: This fine feather would be of great value to collectors.
name: Eagle Feather Quill

title: Albatross Feather Pen
flavorText: A popular writing implement, especially among Redguard sailors.
name: Albatross Feather Pen

title: Crow Feather Quill
flavorText: This quill is made from the large feather of a crow.
name: Crow Feather Quill

title: Grand Fellrunner Quill
flavorText: A lavish writing tool, barely used.
name: Grand Fellrunner Quill

title: Guzzard-Feather Quill
flavorText: A common writing instrument, crafted from the feather of a Craglorn guzzard.
name: Guzzard-Feather Quill

title: Clerk's Gull-Feather Quill
flavorText: A common but well-made quill, crafted using a seagull feather, can be found atop desks throughout Eastmarch.
name: Clerk's Gull-Feather Quill

title: Cardinal-Feather Quill
flavorText: A common writing instrument, crafted from the feather of an Eastmarch cardinal.
name: Cardinal-Feather Quill

title: Thane's Owl-Feather Quill
flavorText: Quills crafted from the feathers of snow-owls are for the exclusive use of the Thanes of Skyrim.
name: Thane's Owl-Feather Quill

title: Exquisite Harpy Feather Quill
flavorText: Lord Diel of Daggerfall gifts a limited number of these rare writing instruments every year to colleagues and associates.
name: Exquisite Harpy Feather Quill

title: Auri-El Priestess Worship Wings
flavorText: Wide shoulder-mounted worship wings constructed from the many-colored flight feathers of thousands of jungle birds.
name: Auri-El Priestess Worship Wings

title: Peacock Plume Writing Quill
flavorText: This exquisite writing quill has a gold-chased adamantine nib that never blots or needs sharpening.
name: Peacock Plume Writing Quill

title: Harpy Feather-Duster
flavorText: Horn-handled furniture duster of feathers said to come from the harpies of Silverhoof Vale.
name: Harpy Feather-Duster

title: House Dorell Golden Quill
flavorText: A gold-plated writing instrument bearing the crest of House Dorell of Northpoint.
name: House Dorell Golden Quill

title: Crow Mother Cursed Quill Pen
flavorText: Writing plume from Crow's Wood that will write only curses, blasphemies, and vile oaths.
name: Crow Mother Cursed Quill Pen

title: Bird-of-Paradise Writing Quill
flavorText: Elaborately-plumed quill with silver nib and tooled-hide hip-belt quill-holster.
name: Bird-of-Paradise Writing Quill

title: Thick Quill Pen
flavorText: This quill was drawn from the corpse of a mighty Hack-Wing.
name: Thick Quill Pen

title: Keeper's Everfount Inkplume
flavorText: Writing plume of endless ink used by Hatching Pool Keepers to keep records of eggs and their hatchlings.
name: Keeper's Everfount Inkplume

title: Thane's Falcon Feather Quill
flavorText: A writing instrument made from the majestic feather of a falcon, most often used by the thanes and jarls of the Rift.
name: Thane's Falcon Feather Quill

title: Falcon Feather Stylus
flavorText: A writing stylus made from the sharpened plume of a falcon feather.
name: Falcon Feather Stylus

title: Imported Feather Dangle Stick
flavorText: Inlaid wood dangle stick with a rare Craglorn fellrunner feather on the end of its string.
name: Imported Feather Dangle Stick

title: Ivory Quill
flavorText: The shaft of this quill has been encased in ivory mammoth tusk, the colorful plumage sticking out of the top.
name: Ivory Quill

title: Kozanset Ornate Feather Quill
flavorText: This long feather quill appears to have been plucked from a mature harpy.
name: Kozanset Ornate Feather Quill

title: Ceramic Dibella Figurine
flavorText: Fingerprints cover this well-worn but masterfully crafted statue.
name: Ceramic Dibella Figurine

title: Azurite Figurine
flavorText: This valuable figurine was among several made by the monks at Pariah Abbey to honor Azura.
name: Azurite Figurine

title: Dragon Paperweight
flavorText: A small, heavy Dragon of shaped glass, used to keep papers and other documents from scattering in a strong breeze.
name: Dragon Paperweight

title: Ayleid House Idol
flavorText: An antique-looking statue, about the size of a wine glass, modeled after idols discovered within Ayleid ruins.
name: Ayleid House Idol

title: Trunk Guardian
flavorText: A tiny trunk guardian statue, guaranteed to protect your stored goods from fire, mold, and greedy thieves.
name: Trunk Guardian

title: Makela Leki Figurine
flavorText: This small, silver figurine was made by students of the school at Leki's Blade.
name: Makela Leki Figurine

title: Moonstone Cabinet Guardian
flavorText: A small warrior figurine made of moonstone and placed by superstitious homeowners inside their cabinets to ward off thieves.
name: Moonstone Cabinet Guardian

title: Golden Monkey Statuette
flavorText: Legend says hundreds of baby monkeys were turned to gold in Bergama by an evil Orc sorcerer. This may be one of them.
name: Golden Monkey Statuette

title: Statuette of Trinimac
flavorText: Statuette of Trinimac the Warrior carved from rose quartz, from the abandoned temple vaults of Bewan.
name: Statuette of Trinimac

title: "Imperial" Lawn Statue
flavorText: Small painted statue of a Cyrodilic knight standing with one arm outstretched, holding a ring to tie to a mount's reins.
name: "Imperial" Lawn Statue

title: Queen's Eye Toy Figures
flavorText: A complete set of figurines for children to act out the adventures of the Queen's Eye.
name: Queen's Eye Toy Figures

title: Mauloch Centrepiece
flavorText: A heavy wrought-iron statue depicting Mauloch in battle. The Seamount clan must have very sturdy tables.
name: Mauloch Centrepiece

title: Argonian Seed Toys
flavorText: These tiny figurines of animals and Argonians carved from gorapple seeds fit within a simple leather pouch.
name: Argonian Seed Toys

title: Ancient Yokudan Relic
flavorText: All that remains of this once proud statue is the head. Its stone face, eroded by time, still bears a scowl.
name: Ancient Yokudan Relic

title: Saint Pelin Figurine
flavorText: This porcelain model depicts the humble beadle kneeling in prayer to Julianos.
name: Saint Pelin Figurine

title: Abstract Silver Centerpiece
flavorText: The sculptor may have begun molding this centerpiece with a specific likeness in mind, but he must have later abandoned it.
name: Abstract Silver Centerpiece

title: Eamond and Arzhela Spice Shakers
flavorText: These rare porcelain spice shakers are painted to look like the king and queen. They were given out at the couple's wedding.
name: Eamond and Arzhela Spice Shakers

title: Nedic Snake Fetish
flavorText: This aged figurine depicts a coiled snake in the Nedic style. It is in remarkably good condition.
name: Nedic Snake Fetish

title: Strange Nereid Centerpiece
flavorText: An expertly crafted pewter centerpiece depicting the legendary Nereid, Shada. Something about the eyes is profoundly unsettling.
name: Strange Nereid Centerpiece

title: Celestial Spice Shakers
flavorText: Spice shakers depicting the Warrior, Thief, and Serpent, crafted before the true extent of the Celestial situation was known.
name: Celestial Spice Shakers

title: Nord Trunk Guardian
flavorText: A Skyrim tradition comes to Morrowind in the form of this tiny trunk guardian statue, guaranteed to protect your stored goods.
name: Nord Trunk Guardian

title: Nord House God
flavorText: An antique-looking statue, about the size of a wine glass. It depicts one of the "testing gods" the Nords try to keep appeased.
name: Nord House God

title: High Elf Lineage Toys
flavorText: Tiny, wood-carved High Elf aristocratic figures that fit within a silk pouch and help teach the complexities of heritage theory.
name: High Elf Lineage Toys

title: Sea Glass Knickknack
flavorText: A chunk of colored sea glass carved into the shape of a lion and mounted to a small block for display, just because.
name: Sea Glass Knickknack

title: Orc Trunk Guardian
flavorText: A Wrothgar tradition, this tiny trunk guardian statue is guaranteed to protect your stored goods.
name: Orc Trunk Guardian

title: Wyrd Sister Door Stops
flavorText: Carved from the wood of dead trees by the wyresses of Daenia, they resemble friendly spriggans happy to guard your home.
name: Wyrd Sister Door Stops

title: High King Emeric Porcelain Doll
flavorText: Only a handful of these unflattering figurines were crafted and sold before the High King took offense and outlawed the dolls.
name: High King Emeric Porcelain Doll

title: Ivory Hircine Totem
flavorText: A small white figurine, carved to resemble Hircine, flanked by a stylized wolf.
name: Ivory Hircine Totem

title: Green Lady Fertility Fetish
flavorText: An exaggerated jade statuette from the Green Lady Shrine in Deepwoods.
name: Green Lady Fertility Fetish

title: Champion of Silvenar Figurine with Gold Spontoon
flavorText: Late-First-Era ceramic figurine of a Champion of Silvenar, gilded and bearing a solid-gold spontoon.
name: Champion of Silvenar Figurine with Gold Spontoon

title: Rajhin Desk Idol
flavorText: A hand-carved idol of the trickster god. Said to ward away thieves when its belly is regularly rubbed.
name: Rajhin Desk Idol

title: Rajhin's Shadow Pocket Idol
flavorText: A small figurine carved to depict one of Rajhin's shadows. When carried, the owner is said to be safe from pickpockets.
name: Rajhin's Shadow Pocket Idol

title: House Tamrith Winner's Cup
flavorText: A small trophy, awarded for winning the annual riddle contest sponsored by House Tamrith.
name: House Tamrith Winner's Cup

title: Noble House Triangle Chess Set
flavorText: Three-sided board for Triangle Chess, with pieces representing Houses Montclair, Tamrith, and Dorell.
name: Noble House Triangle Chess Set

title: Bard Hjalif Snow-Song Porcelain Doll
flavorText: When High King Emeric took offense and outlawed dolls with his likeness, an enterprising merchant in Northpoint made a change.
name: Bard Hjalif Snow-Song Porcelain Doll

title: Hlaalu Ancestral Ash Statuette
flavorText: Traditional closed-fist statuette of a House Hlaalu ancestor, containing yellow volcanic ash from Ash Mountain.
name: Hlaalu Ancestral Ash Statuette

title: Triple Bust of the Good Daedra
flavorText: Small sculpture of the heads of Azura, Mephala, and Boethiah carved from basalt, labeled "From Stonefang Temple."
name: Triple Bust of the Good Daedra

title: Saint Veloth Nutcracker
flavorText: A nutcracker in the shape of Saint Veloth, usually only used during Dark Elf holidays.
name: Saint Veloth Nutcracker

title: Red Indoril Ash Statuette
flavorText: Red ash statuette of a great Indoril ancestor; may have come from the Indoril Crypt in Davon's Watch.
name: Red Indoril Ash Statuette

title: Ebony Sithis Idol
flavorText: This small ebony statue depicts Sithis as a bare-skulled figure clutching an Argonian egg.
name: Ebony Sithis Idol

title: Mara Fertility Fetish
flavorText: Flower-spouting fertility statuette, usually found on shrines dedicated to Mara throughout the Skyrim territory.
name: Mara Fertility Fetish

title: Yokudan Warrior Statuette
flavorText: A miniature statue shaped to represent a Yokudan Sword Saint performing an ancient sword technique.
name: Yokudan Warrior Statuette

title: Jade Serpent Figurine
flavorText: A serpent-shaped statuette covered in a light dusting of red-orange specks.
name: Jade Serpent Figurine

title: Golden Rid-Thar-ri'Datta Idol
flavorText: A golden idol fashioned in the likeness of Rid-Thar-ri'Datta, the first Mane of the Khajiit.
name: Golden Rid-Thar-ri'Datta Idol

title: Brass Senche-Tiger
flavorText: A skillfully-crafted brass model of a crouching senche-tiger. Its sharp teeth and fully articulated jaw can crack walnuts.
name: Brass Senche-Tiger

title: Onyx Serpent Carving
flavorText: A carving that's dark as the night, and cool to the touch.
name: Onyx Serpent Carving

title: Sea Serpent Carving
flavorText: A coral figurine skillfully crafted to resemble the terrifying Pyandonean sea monsters commanded by the Maormer.
name: Sea Serpent Carving

title: Clan Murtag War Canteen
flavorText: This rugged canteen was crafted from Dwarven steel and emblazoned with the Murtag clan crest.
name: Clan Murtag War Canteen

title: Garrison Commander's Canteen
flavorText: This bejeweled canteen is engraved with the royal symbol of Evermore.
name: Garrison Commander's Canteen

title: "Skooma Surprise" Canteen
flavorText: A simple tin canteen. When the spigot is twisted three times, it connects to a secondary, much smaller reservoir.
name: "Skooma Surprise" Canteen

title: Shornhelm Guard Officer's Canteen
flavorText: An ornate and rather ostentatious drinking vessel awarded to officers in good standing with the Shornhelm Guard.
name: Shornhelm Guard Officer's Canteen

title: Ebonheart Guard Canteen
flavorText: A standard-issue drinking container provided to guards serving the Ebonheart Pact.
name: Ebonheart Guard Canteen

title: Engraved Redguard Flask
flavorText: A rare flask engraved with an ouroboros and distributed to members of the elite 1st Redguard Horse Brigade.
name: Engraved Redguard Flask

title: Silver Hip Flask
flavorText: A lovingly polished flask that still smells of Wayrest brandy.
name: Silver Hip Flask

title: Brewer's Flask
flavorText: This sturdy glass flask is used to mix yeast when brewing.
name: Brewer's Flask

title: Engraved Golden Flask
flavorText: This is one of several extremely valuable flasks personalized for the merchant-lords of Stormhaven.
name: Engraved Golden Flask

title: Corundum Drinking Flask
flavorText: A strangely shaped flask made from corundum.
name: Corundum Drinking Flask

title: Engraved Pewter Flask
flavorText: This well-worn drinking flask features Seamount clan motifs etched into the pewter.
name: Engraved Pewter Flask

title: Banner-Torn's Everfull Flask
flavorText: Sjarla Banner-Torn, Bleakrock's brewer, distributes these flasks with the promise to fill them whenever you have gold to pay.
name: Banner-Torn's Everfull Flask

title: Sea Drake Flask
flavorText: This silver flask was given to every member of Captain Helane's crew before their maiden voyage. Only a few remain.
name: Sea Drake Flask

title: Rain Disciple's Flask
flavorText: This flask was given to a Rain Disciple at Halcyon Lake. It's believed to purify any water held within.
name: Rain Disciple's Flask

title: Apex Tower Silver Flask
flavorText: A silver drinking flask bearing the symbol of the Apex Tower in Elinhir.
name: Apex Tower Silver Flask

title: Flask from the Flaming Nix
flavorText: The famous corner-club in Mournhold distributes these souvenir flasks to all their best customers.
name: Flask from the Flaming Nix

title: Stormfist Brigade Silver Flask
flavorText: A silver drinking flask bearing the symbol of the Stormfist Brigade from western Skyrim.
name: Stormfist Brigade Silver Flask

title: Dark Elf Aphrodisiac Flask
flavorText: An imported Dark Elf alchemical concoction in a silver flask, believed to aid older Nords with their nocturnal responsibilities.
name: Dark Elf Aphrodisiac Flask

title: Redguard Swordmaster's Flask
flavorText: A silver flask engraved with the crossed scimitars of a Redguard Master of the Swirling Blades.
name: Redguard Swordmaster's Flask

title: Tall Trunk Rotmeth Flask
flavorText: Silver-chased leather flask embossed with an image of the Tall Trunk Tavern and the words "Galithor's Tall Trunk Rotmeth."
name: Tall Trunk Rotmeth Flask

title: Flask from the Dead Wolf Inn
flavorText: The famous tavern in Shornhelm distributes these souvenir flasks featuring an engraving of a dead wolf to their best customers.
name: Flask from the Dead Wolf Inn

title: Silver Drinking Flask
flavorText: A screw-top flask of fine silver engraved with a scrollwork pattern.
name: Silver Drinking Flask

title: Mourning Springs Crystal Flagon
flavorText: Etched-glass flagon once used for "taking the waters" at the Temple of the Mourning Springs.
name: Mourning Springs Crystal Flagon

title: Leather Flask
flavorText: The leather surrounding this flask is supple to the touch, and enscribed with intricate Bosmeri writing.
name: Leather Flask

title: Magnifico's Flask
flavorText: Made from valuable quicksilver and decorated with jewels, this flask was a gift from King Fahara'jad to a Forebear Magnifico.
name: Magnifico's Flask

title: Emerald-Infused Salts
flavorText: The finest of Wayrest have recently embraced the practice of pouring packets of this expensive powder into their baths.
name: Emerald-Infused Salts

title: Solid Oak Armor Stand
flavorText: A sturdy armor stand made from solid oak.
name: Solid Oak Armor Stand

title: Fancy Waving Octopus Jewelry Stand
flavorText: Jewelry and ring stand, a taxidermied octopus waving all eight tentacles aloft, with jeweled eyes and silver beak.
name: Fancy Waving Octopus Jewelry Stand

title: Brass Pen and Ink Stand
flavorText: Brass stand for holding writing plumes and an inkwell, engraved "Sabiru's General Goods, Fell's Run" on the bottom.
name: Brass Pen and Ink Stand

title: Bear Skull Stand
flavorText: A bear's skull mounted on an oak stand for display. Its teeth still cracked and stained from its last gruesome battle.
name: Bear Skull Stand

title: Dressmaker's Sewing Mannequin
flavorText: An adjustable lady's mannequin dress form bearing the insignia of Queen Ayrenn's Royal Dressmaker.
name: Dressmaker's Sewing Mannequin

title: Glazed Chiminea
flavorText: Beautiful Argonian motifs cover this small cooking oven.
name: Glazed Chiminea

title: Lucky Senche-Tiger Claw
flavorText: A claw with three naturally occurring, parallel streaks on one side. Said to impart good fortune upon the owner.
name: Lucky Senche-Tiger Claw

title: Curtain of Claws
flavorText: A room-dividing curtain consisting of row upon row of oversized claws, said to have been crafted by a hagraven in the Rift.
name: Curtain of Claws

title: Curtain of Crocodile Teeth
flavorText: A room-dividing curtain crafted with rows of giant crocodile teeth, said to have been crafted by the hags of Hag Fen.
name: Curtain of Crocodile Teeth

title: Meat Strip Drying Rack
flavorText: When the wealthy brave the wilderness, they bring along a drying rack to make their own jerky in the wild.
name: Meat Strip Drying Rack

title: Bacon Jerky Drying Rack
flavorText: When the rich and famous brave the wilderness, they bring along Swineherd Wickton's patented drying rack for a taste of home.
name: Bacon Jerky Drying Rack

title: Four-Jar Spice Rack
flavorText: Wire rack holding four empty glass jars, each labeled a different mineral spice: sea salt, kindlepitch, verdigris, and rust.
name: Four-Jar Spice Rack

title: Venison Jerky Drying Rack
flavorText: When the wealthy brave the wilderness, they bring along Chef Alskar's patented venison drying rack for a taste of home.
name: Venison Jerky Drying Rack

title: Argonian Alchemist Rack
flavorText: Stands-In-Thought crafts these fine, wooden racks to hold and organize jars full of alchemy components.
name: Argonian Alchemist Rack

title: Argonian Darkwood Tabletop
flavorText: The top of an Argonian-crafted table, probably made in Murkmire and shipped to Dhalmora along with a parcel of slaves.
name: Argonian Darkwood Tabletop

title: Argonian Affirmation Board
flavorText: A board of heavy, inlaid wood, set in a series of octagonal patterns. Used for various Argonian meditative exercises.
name: Argonian Affirmation Board

title: Spice Rack
flavorText: Tiny tins of spices fit in a simple wooden rack.
name: Spice Rack

title: Three Banners War Game
flavorText: A triangular board and carved wooden pieces make up this three-player game that recreates battles between the three alliances.
name: Three Banners War Game

title: Incomprehensible Argonian Game
flavorText: A game, you think, of ancient Argonian design. The rules are incomprehensible, but the carved monster pieces are nice.
name: Incomprehensible Argonian Game

title: Ivory Wood Noddy Peg Board
flavorText: A carved peg board of rare pink ivory wood, bearing the signature of the woodworker Yana, used to play the card game "Noddy."
name: Ivory Wood Noddy Peg Board

title: Silver Nine-Shells Set
flavorText: An antique board game, complete with a lacquered pine board and polished silver pieces.
name: Silver Nine-Shells Set

title: Bosmer/Khajiit Gemstone Chess Set
flavorText: Chess set of 16 malachite Bosmeri pieces and 16 tiger's-eye Khajiiti pieces, with turtle-shell board that folds into a box.
name: Bosmer/Khajiit Gemstone Chess Set

title: Five Claws Cards
flavorText: An ornate set of Khajiiti playing cards, used in a variety of games in which the highest hand is a Five Claw Flush.
name: Five Claws Cards

title: Shenanigans Card Game
flavorText: A specialized deck of cards used to play the Dark Elf game known as "Shenanigans."
name: Shenanigans Card Game

title: Pranks & Pleasures Card Game
flavorText: A specialized deck of cards used to play the game known as "Pranks & Pleasures," popular in Daggerfall and other cities.
name: Pranks & Pleasures Card Game

title: Deck of Commemorative Playing Cards
flavorText: Stiff parchment playing cards with an image of the Green Lady and Silvenar on the backs to commemorate the Handfasting.
name: Deck of Commemorative Playing Cards

title: Ravenwatch Tarot Deck
flavorText: Deck of 78 colorful pasteboard cards, known as the Ravenwatch Tarot, decorated with weird symbols and imagery.
name: Ravenwatch Tarot Deck

title: Imperial Strife Board
flavorText: A board of heavy, inlaid wood, set in a series of triangular patterns, used to play the Imperial game, "Strife."
name: Imperial Strife Board

title: Perplexing Ancient Nord Game
flavorText: A game (maybe?) of Nord design, discovered near Skyshroud Barrows. There are no instructions, but the board is nice.
name: Perplexing Ancient Nord Game

title: Snips and Tails Game
flavorText: A travel-sized and much less deadly version of the Iron Orc game, "Cut It Until It Dies."
name: Snips and Tails Game

title: Silver "Perchance Acorn" Puzzle Game
flavorText: Classic Wood Elf acorn-hiding puzzle game, with acorn, cups, and board of silver, engraved "Silversmith Menthorn, Haven."
name: Silver "Perchance Acorn" Puzzle Game

title: "Deceiver's Dice" Game
flavorText: A travel-sized version of the Nord drinking game played in taverns and inns throughout Skyrim.
name: "Deceiver's Dice" Game

title: "Sheep, Sheep, Goat" Game
flavorText: A travel-sized and much less rowdy version of the Nord drinking game, made popular at the Sober Nord Inn.
name: "Sheep, Sheep, Goat" Game

title: Altmer Heritage Stacking Puzzle
flavorText: Stacking puzzle or game in which pieces representing ancestors are stacked in pairs. Breeding mismatches result in tumbles.
name: Altmer Heritage Stacking Puzzle

title: Trinket of Queen Freydis
flavorText: A small, topaz bead said to have fallen from Queen Freydis' battle cloak during her bid to conquer Cyrodiil.
name: Trinket of Queen Freydis

title: The Egg of the World
flavorText: Crystal replica of the fist-sized gem Kinlady Entila Errinorne was searching for in the mine now called Entila's Folly.
name: The Egg of the World

title: Akatosh Dragon Eye
flavorText: "By the eyes of Akatosh" takes on new meaning when you have one of these expensive Dragon eye gems blessed to the god.
name: Akatosh Dragon Eye

title: Unique Rotating Prismatic Window Chimes
flavorText: Etched-Glass rotating prisms that throw rainbows and chime on the nonatonic scale, made by Kragenmoor Khajiiti slave-artisans.
name: Unique Rotating Prismatic Window Chimes

title: Eye of Sithis See-All
flavorText: Some Dhalmora Argonians believe this serpent-eye gem, when placed beside their beds, will watch over them during the night.
name: Eye of Sithis See-All

title: Yokeda's Emerald Helm-Jewel
flavorText: A large emerald attached to a small gold plate, designed to be the front piece of a First Era Yokeda's Helm.
name: Yokeda's Emerald Helm-Jewel

title: Onsi's Diamond Grindstone
flavorText: Made from hard stone and gems mined from Onsi's Breath, this grindstone can sharpen a blade for the finest cut in Bangkorai.
name: Onsi's Diamond Grindstone

title: Flawless Black Pearl
flavorText: A large and well-polished swamp pearl from the heart of Black Marsh.
name: Flawless Black Pearl

title: Golden Goblet
flavorText: The perfect cup for someone with too much gold and not enough places to pour their wine.
name: Golden Goblet

title: "Ancient" Clay Goblet
flavorText: A simple grail thought to be used as a drinking vessel. Any claims it was found in ancient ruins are probably just that.
name: "Ancient" Clay Goblet

title: Ancient Yokudan Chalice
flavorText: This centuries-old golden cup is in near pristine condition and as such can be sold for a great deal of gold.
name: Ancient Yokudan Chalice

title: Dark Elf Travel Goblet
flavorText: A sturdy drinking vessel designed to withstand the rigors of travel, made of pewter or wood, and decorated with Dark Elf runes.
name: Dark Elf Travel Goblet

title: Ancient Pa'alatiin Chalice
flavorText: An ornate grail thought to be used as a drinking vessel, it is believed to be from the time of the Khajiiti state of Pa'alatiin.
name: Ancient Pa'alatiin Chalice

title: Ancient Direnni Chalice
flavorText: An ornate grail thought to be used as a drinking vessel, it is believed to be from the time of the Direnni Hegemony.
name: Ancient Direnni Chalice

title: Pair of Crystal Jagga Chalices
flavorText: Jagga chalices, used for traditional wedding toasts, inscribed "Congratulations Thalrinel & Dardir."
name: Pair of Crystal Jagga Chalices

title: Set of Four Gilane Goblets
flavorText: Four fine glass goblets with gilt brims, imported from Gilane in southern Hammerfell.
name: Set of Four Gilane Goblets

title: House Redoran Goblet
flavorText: A redware goblet bearing the sigil of House Redoran. A stamp on the bottom reads "Ebonheart Unified Metalworks."
name: House Redoran Goblet

title: Ancient House Dagoth Goblet
flavorText: Rare goblet displaying the sigil of House Dagoth, the Chimer clan destroyed in the War of the First Council.
name: Ancient House Dagoth Goblet

title: Wooden Drinking Goblet
flavorText: A drinking goblet carved from a single piece of Smokefrost Rosewood.
name: Wooden Drinking Goblet

title: Maormer Goblet
flavorText: This elaborate mother-of-pearl goblet has intricate designs of sea snakes worked into its sides.
name: Maormer Goblet

title: Miniature Chalice of Mara
flavorText: These tiny, bejewelled facsimiles of the famous relic were given out as prizes for winners of the Mid-Year Festival Games.
name: Miniature Chalice of Mara

title: Jeweled Goblet
flavorText: Made from silver, this goblet has a handful of small red jewels attached to the cup.
name: Jeweled Goblet

title: Wooden Hangers
flavorText: These sturdy wooden hangers look strong enough to hold the heaviest winter coat yet smooth enough to display silk lingerie.
name: Wooden Hangers

title: Beetle-Leg Clothes Hanger
flavorText: A sturdy clothes hanger fashioned from the leg of an assassin beetle.
name: Beetle-Leg Clothes Hanger

title: Spider-Leg Clothes Hanger
flavorText: A frame and hook fashioned from the leg of a giant spider and used to drape a garment upon when not in use.
name: Spider-Leg Clothes Hanger

title: Spinner's Ceremonial Portage Harness
flavorText: Hand-tooled timber-mammoth-leather harness for carrying a Spinner between two porters.
name: Spinner's Ceremonial Portage Harness

title: Air Plant Shoulder Harness
flavorText: Leather harness supporting four small ceramic pots for sacred epiphytes, air plants collected from Treehenge.
name: Air Plant Shoulder Harness

title: Senche-Tiger Training Harness
flavorText: A training harness, only slightly gnawed.
name: Senche-Tiger Training Harness

title: Falconer's Harness
flavorText: A high-quality leather harness designed to fit over the head of a trained falcon.
name: Falconer's Harness

title: Etched Steel Bridle
flavorText: A sturdy and well-crafted harness.
name: Etched Steel Bridle

title: Silver-Trimmed Bridle
flavorText: Silver buttons and buckles decorate this fancy horse bridle.
name: Silver-Trimmed Bridle

title: Black Horse Courier Bridle
flavorText: This black leather bridle has silver buckles and the insignia of the Black Horse Couriers etched into the leather.
name: Black Horse Courier Bridle

title: Kerbol's Golden Bridle
flavorText: Mayor Kerbol had several reinforced golden bridles made to ensure she could control her horse even if it got spooked.
name: Kerbol's Golden Bridle

title: Silverhoof Hackamore
flavorText: Bit-less bridle of topgrain cowhide in the style used by the Horsemen of Silverhoof Vale.
name: Silverhoof Hackamore

title: Clan Tumnosh Drinking Horn
flavorText: An ornately carved drinking horn, decorated in the tradition of the Orc clan Tumnosh of Wrothgar.
name: Clan Tumnosh Drinking Horn

title: Morihaus' Sled Horn
flavorText: An ancient Atmoran sled horn, rumored to have been blown by Morihaus-Breath-of-Kyne during his taking of the White-Gold Tower.
name: Morihaus' Sled Horn

title: Ornamental War Horn
flavorText: This ornate war horn was given as a gift to a retiring general.
name: Ornamental War Horn

title: Duneripper Drinking Horn
flavorText: This is a nearly indestructible drinking horn made from the spine of a Duneripper.
name: Duneripper Drinking Horn

title: King Makala's Ear Piece
flavorText: One of several small golden ear pieces once used to augment the hearing of Hammerfell's infamous ruler.
name: King Makala's Ear Piece

title: Ancient Brass Sackbut
flavorText: Antique brass trombone engraved with flowing floral motifs, said to have been found in Torinaan.
name: Ancient Brass Sackbut

title: Orcish Drinking Horn
flavorText: The solid craftsmanship of this silver drinking horn is unmistakable. In a pinch, it could cap an echatere's broken tooth.
name: Orcish Drinking Horn

title: Heavy Warcaller's Horn
flavorText: An ancient horn fashioned from an echatere tusk and likely carried into battle by one of Warcaller Targoth's lieutenants.
name: Heavy Warcaller's Horn

title: Horker Tusk Drinking Horn
flavorText: A sturdy Nord drinking cup. Perfect for beer, mead, or ... well, it's mostly for mead.
name: Horker Tusk Drinking Horn

title: Skald-King's Drinking Horn
flavorText: King Jorunn gifted each Tribunal leader with an ornate drinking horn, which was duplicated and sold to Mournhold's elite.
name: Skald-King's Drinking Horn

title: Brass "Heen-Hoon" Hunter's Horn
flavorText: Alit-hunter's engraved brass mating-call horn; a blast of "Heen-hoon" is said to attract the amorous male Alit.
name: Brass "Heen-Hoon" Hunter's Horn

title: Riften "Hunting Horn"
flavorText: A horn made from a mammoth tusk. Silver filigree lines the rim. The hidden compartment within smells faintly of skooma.
name: Riften "Hunting Horn"

title: Antique Rilis VIII Hunting Horn
flavorText: Antique gold-filigreed minotaur hunting horn dating from the reign of Kinlord Rilis VIII.
name: Antique Rilis VIII Hunting Horn

title: Horseshoe from the Hot Iron
flavorText: A lucky horseshoe, crafted at the Hot Iron in Bleakrock, it appears to be well made.
name: Horseshoe from the Hot Iron

title: King Gardner's Golden Horseshoes
flavorText: The former king of Wayrest so loved his horses that he had golden horseshoes forged to protect their hooves.
name: King Gardner's Golden Horseshoes

title: Aswala Lucky Horseshoe
flavorText: Visitors to the famous Aswala Stables once purchased horseshoes such as these. They were thought to bring good fortune.
name: Aswala Lucky Horseshoe

title: Seventh Legion Horseshoes
flavorText: These steel-plated horseshoes were forged by Imperial smiths for members of the Seventh Legion.
name: Seventh Legion Horseshoes

title: Girvu's Lucky Horseshoe
flavorText: This decorative, gold-painted horseshoe bears the brand of Girvu's Stables in Mournhold and supposedly brings luck to the owner.
name: Girvu's Lucky Horseshoe

title: Nimare's Lucky Horseshoe
flavorText: This decorative, crimson horseshoe bears the brand of Nimare's Noble Steeds in Marbruk and supposedly brings luck to the owner.
name: Nimare's Lucky Horseshoe

title: Bazgara's Lucky Horseshoe
flavorText: This decorative, silver horseshoe bears the brand of Bazgara's Horses in Daggerfall and supposedly brings luck to the owner.
name: Bazgara's Lucky Horseshoe

title: Silver Horseshoe
flavorText: Serves little function, but worth its weight in silver and it's studded with jewels that mark it as property of Camoran royalty.
name: Silver Horseshoe

title: Fast-Running Hourglass
flavorText: A common time-keeping device. This one's sand runs a bit fast.
name: Fast-Running Hourglass

title: Antique Breton Hourglass
flavorText: Crystal-clear glass reveals that this impeccably crafted hourglass somehow survived the Seamount invasion of Betony.
name: Antique Breton Hourglass

title: Maritime Hourglass
flavorText: This small brass hourglass was likely taken from the Maiden's Breath. Its fine gray sand counts thirty minutes before expiring.
name: Maritime Hourglass

title: King's Time Hourglass
flavorText: King Eamond of Evermore believed punctuality was a virtue and was known to give valuable hourglasses to his honored guests.
name: King's Time Hourglass

title: Slow-Running Hourglass
flavorText: A common time-keeping device. This one's sand runs a bit slow.
name: Slow-Running Hourglass

title: Arch-Mage's Hourglass
flavorText: A timepiece given to students who complete their master exams by the Arch-Mage of the Shad Astula Academy of Magic.
name: Arch-Mage's Hourglass

title: Antique Dragon Hourglass
flavorText: An ornate hourglass held within the claws of a curled Dragon with ruby eyes. It dates back to the time of King Anton I.
name: Antique Dragon Hourglass

title: Secunda's Minute Clock
flavorText: The glass bulbs of this hourglass are encased in a gold stand. The sand within is a grayish white and measures a minute's time.
name: Secunda's Minute Clock

title: Masser's Hour Clock
flavorText: The glass bulbs of this hourglass are encased in a silver stand. The sand within is a dark red, and measures an hour's time.
name: Masser's Hour Clock

title: Brass Hourglass Alarm
flavorText: A brass hourglass with a pressure-sensitive plate inside that triggers a wind-up bell when a certain amount of sand falls on it.
name: Brass Hourglass Alarm

title: Conch Shell Inkwell
flavorText: This small conch shell, taken from the beach at Stros M'kai, was turned into a fetching inkwell.
name: Conch Shell Inkwell

title: Decorative Ink Well
flavorText: This finely etched vessel is full of fresh ink.
name: Decorative Ink Well

title: Invisible Ink
flavorText: The label says "invisible ink." The bottle looks empty.
name: Invisible Ink

title: Banker's Everfull Double Inkwell
flavorText: Bronze pen-stand, engraved "Skywatch Coinhouse," with two auto-replenishing inkwells, one black, one red.
name: Banker's Everfull Double Inkwell

title: River Stone Inkwell
flavorText: This inkwell was made by hollowing out a stone found in the Bjoulsae River.
name: River Stone Inkwell

title: Dragonstar Caravan Company Inkwell
flavorText: A bottle of ink bearing the seal of the Dragonstar Caravan Company, distributed as a promotional item.
name: Dragonstar Caravan Company Inkwell

title: Ink of a Different Color
flavorText: An unusual ink, crafted by the alchemists of the Uncanny Alembic in Fort Amol, great for writing letters of distinction.
name: Ink of a Different Color

title: Stinkbug Ink
flavorText: A rare Bosmer ink. When exposed to heat, the shimmering of the ink almost makes up for the horrid smell.
name: Stinkbug Ink

title: "Shalk Blue" Tattoo Ink
flavorText: Tattoo ink obtained by milking bloated shalks. Slightly more blue than common tattoo ink.
name: "Shalk Blue" Tattoo Ink

title: Green "Official Decree" Inkwell
flavorText: Jade inkwell containing the green iridescent ink used for writing official decrees from the Silvenar.
name: Green "Official Decree" Inkwell

title: Gold-Flecked Ink
flavorText: The flecks of gold in this ink make it valuable to those looking to make an impression. Or forgers, pretending to be them.
name: Gold-Flecked Ink

title: Inkwell of Dreugh Ink
flavorText: Glass inkwell containing bright blue ink made from dreugh ichor, brewed and bottled in Davon's Watch.
name: Inkwell of Dreugh Ink

title: Temple Clerk's Triple Inkwell Stand
flavorText: Golden stand for holding the three bottles of differently-colored ink used by Temple clerks; presented for 75 years of service.
name: Temple Clerk's Triple Inkwell Stand

title: Tabletop Ink-Squid Swimabout
flavorText: Crystal water bowl intended as a "live inkwell." It holds a single black marsh-squid as a living source of ink.
name: Tabletop Ink-Squid Swimabout

title: Maormer Embassy Inkwell
flavorText: Inkwell with bottle of benthic squid double-black ink, labeled "Property of the Maormer Embassy."
name: Maormer Embassy Inkwell

title: Kinlord's Pearlescent Inkwell
flavorText: Bottle of rare pearlescent ink, as used by Altmeri Kinlords to calligraph official decrees on blue silk.
name: Kinlord's Pearlescent Inkwell

title: Two Moons Disappearing Ink
flavorText: This small jar of ink vanishes when it dries, and can only be seen under the light of the two full moons.
name: Two Moons Disappearing Ink

title: Platinum Calligraphy Set
flavorText: An exquisite calligraphy set containing platinum nibs, graht-oak nib holders, and a crystal ink vial.
name: Platinum Calligraphy Set

title: Burnished Steel Jaw-Harp
flavorText: The Seamount clan has a very weak musical tradition. It's unlikely that anyone will miss this lovely instrument.
name: Burnished Steel Jaw-Harp

title: Ancient Yokudan Flute
flavorText: Though it's similar to the modern instrument, no one living knows exactly how to play this antique golden flute.
name: Ancient Yokudan Flute

title: Maormer Snake-Charmer's Pungi
flavorText: Double reedpipe used by Maormeri serpent-mages to charm snakes of all sizes. Quite rare in the Summerset Isles.
name: Maormer Snake-Charmer's Pungi

title: Seventeen Songbird Warble-Fife
flavorText: Small flute that can be played seventeen different ways to imitate and attract every species of songbird native to Auridon.
name: Seventeen Songbird Warble-Fife

title: Pactbreaker's Arm-Flute
flavorText: A flute carved from the arm-bone of someone who broke the Green Pact. Now quite illegal, but still valued by collectors.
name: Pactbreaker's Arm-Flute

title: Ceremonial Shawm for Royal Feast Days
flavorText: Double-reed bass shawm, of highly-ornamented alit bone, as played during fetes by the Royal Elden Root Consort.
name: Ceremonial Shawm for Royal Feast Days

title: Stormhold-Style Silver Slide-Flute
flavorText: Slide-flute, silver, of the type used for playing the traditional jig "Dancing on Eggs" in the Stormhold Fredas Night Stingaree.
name: Stormhold-Style Silver Slide-Flute

title: Sterling Silver Fife
flavorText: A small high-pitched flute with six finger holes, fashioned from the finest sterling silver.
name: Sterling Silver Fife

title: Child's Drum
flavorText: Though incredibly common, simple drums such as this one are still in high demand among bandits in need of inexpensive signals.
name: Child's Drum

title: Hircine's Honor Drum
flavorText: This beautiful drum is made from the wood of a rare tree that only grows in Bangkorai's Fallen Grotto.
name: Hircine's Honor Drum

title: Iron Orc Executioner's Drum
flavorText: An executioner's instrument, in both respects. Clumps of dried blood still cling to the rugged iron counterhoop.
name: Iron Orc Executioner's Drum

title: Spinner's Skin Drum
flavorText: Upon the death of a revered spinner, a skin drum is occasionally commissioned to celebrate the spinner's life.
name: Spinner's Skin Drum

title: Bloodgutter Tattooed Tambourine
flavorText: Tambourine with silver zils. The tanned skin drumhead sports a tattoo of a pirate ship and the words "Bloodgutter Bosun."
name: Bloodgutter Tattooed Tambourine

title: Snakeskin-Head Conga Drum
flavorText: Dark wooden conga. The giant snakeskin drumhead is held on by a shiny brass tension-ring.
name: Snakeskin-Head Conga Drum

title: Yokudan War Drum
flavorText: A large drum that features several different Yokudan sword designs carved in its side.
name: Yokudan War Drum

title: Guarskin Conga Drums
flavorText: Pair of conga drums with guarskin heads, made by Ebonheart Argonians but in Dunmeri style for sale to the Dark Elves.
name: Guarskin Conga Drums

title: Lion Guard Bugle
flavorText: A masterfully crafted instrument, nicked and tarnished from years of campaigning.
name: Lion Guard Bugle

title: Ornate Ink Blotter
flavorText: A fine oaken blotter, capped by a brass lion handle.
name: Ornate Ink Blotter

title: Hoarvor-Sac Bagpipes
flavorText: Musical instrument, fine bagpipes made from a hoarvor's bloat-sac and probosces, decorated with parrot feathers.
name: Hoarvor-Sac Bagpipes

title: Hoarvor-Skin Tambourine
flavorText: The chimes on this instrument have a bright and cheerful jingle. It almost makes you forget that it's made of giant tick's skin.
name: Hoarvor-Skin Tambourine

title: Elaborate Clockwork Hurdy-Gurdy
flavorText: Fine string instrument that can be played with a bow, or cranked to automatically play the Camoran March.
name: Elaborate Clockwork Hurdy-Gurdy

title: Woodhearth Nose Flute
flavorText: "Woodhearth" style three-finger-hole nose flute with flaring mouth.
name: Woodhearth Nose Flute

title: Out-of-Tune Theorbo
flavorText: 14-string bass theorbo with ivory pegs and soundboard, badly out of tune.
name: Out-of-Tune Theorbo

title: Silver-Tined Senie Kalimba
flavorText: Coralwood thumb piano with nonatonic silver tines made by the famous artisan Llamela of Senie.
name: Silver-Tined Senie Kalimba

title: Hissmir Cypress-Wood Lute
flavorText: Ten-stringed lute of resonant swamp-cypress wood, made by the famous Hissmir luthier Sings-Backward.
name: Hissmir Cypress-Wood Lute

title: Snakeskin Concertina
flavorText: This attractive instrument is masterfully crafted using the skin of a Hooped Tree Viper. The sound it makes is ... interesting.
name: Snakeskin Concertina

title: Monsoon Celebrant's Helical Foont-Pipe
flavorText: A hollow spiral blowpipe, made of the horn of an unknown sea creature, used for foonting to welcome the annual monsoon.
name: Monsoon Celebrant's Helical Foont-Pipe

title: Alit Hunter's Silver Whistle
flavorText: Large silver-plated slide whistle, etched with "Bolga's Guaranteed Never-Fail Alit Caller."
name: Alit Hunter's Silver Whistle

title: Gold Finger Cymbals
flavorText: A pair of decorated cymbals emblazoned with Dwemer runes. As valuable to scholars as the gold from which they're made.
name: Gold Finger Cymbals

title: Arenthian Squeeze Box
flavorText: A hand-held musical reed instrument played by squeezing it in and out, like a bellows. Popular with Colovian travelers.
name: Arenthian Squeeze Box

title: Rosewood Lute
flavorText: Though quite old, this lute is still in excellent condition. There are no noticeable scratches in the lacquered wood.
name: Rosewood Lute

title: Gilded Conch
flavorText: A prodigious shell trumpet, polished and lined with gold leaf.
name: Gilded Conch

title: Bal Foyen Netch-Hide Sackpipes
flavorText: Sackpipes made from flexible Bal Foyen netch hide, with coralwood drones.
name: Bal Foyen Netch-Hide Sackpipes

title: Finely-Crafted Violin
flavorText: Crafted from the finest spruce and maple and stained to a luxuriant reddish-brown, this is a fine instrument.
name: Finely-Crafted Violin

title: Torchbug Lantern
flavorText: A simple glass lantern with holes built into the cap. Perfect for catching torchbugs.
name: Torchbug Lantern

title: Earthenware Jar
flavorText: This earthenware jar is surprisingly sturdy.
name: Earthenware Jar

title: Oil Paints
flavorText: These small tins contain the medium of an aspiring artist, mixed with care.
name: Oil Paints

title: Opulent Family Funerary Jar
flavorText: This expensive container, which harkens back to a style popularized in the First Era, can be found in many affluent households.
name: Opulent Family Funerary Jar

title: Jar of Scrib
flavorText: Why someone would collect a jar full of dead scrib is unknown, but the untarnished glass might be worth something.
name: Jar of Scrib

title: Abecean Whale Buckle Wax
flavorText: This lacquered wooden jar is filled with pale buckle wax, likely harvested from a local Abecean whale.
name: Abecean Whale Buckle Wax

title: Porcelain Snake Sweat Jar
flavorText: A decorative porcelain jar, used to store and dispense a favorite beverage of Dhalmora Argonians: tasty snake sweat.
name: Porcelain Snake Sweat Jar

title: Ranic's Leather Oil
flavorText: A jar of oil intended for use on leather. Many Dhalmora Argonians use it to keep their scales smooth and shiny.
name: Ranic's Leather Oil

title: Alchemist's Measuring Jar
flavorText: A jar with marks on the inside for measuring alchemical powders and liquids, as used at Linnea's Liniments in Bleakrock.
name: Alchemist's Measuring Jar

title: Jar of Sun Cream
flavorText: A jar of thick white paste. According to alchemists, daily application can lessen the effects of Aetherial exposure.
name: Jar of Sun Cream

title: Troll Musk
flavorText: A jar of acrid black liquid used by troll hunters.
name: Troll Musk

title: Umeen's Uplifting Unguent
flavorText: A popular ointment said to treat numerous bodily ailments, sold exclusively by Umeen at the Gem & Flask in Belkarth.
name: Umeen's Uplifting Unguent

title: Ashlander Spice Jar
flavorText: An empty spice jar, crafted and sold by a friendly Ashlander tribe from eastern Deshaan.
name: Ashlander Spice Jar

title: Opulent Dunmer Funerary Jar
flavorText: This expensive container, which harkens back to a style popularized by the Chimer, can be found in many affluent households.
name: Opulent Dunmer Funerary Jar

title: Faralel's Night Cream
flavorText: Imported from distant Alik'r, this expensive moisturizing cream is believed to keep Dark Elves looking young and beautiful.
name: Faralel's Night Cream

title: Helga's Actual Polish
flavorText: A jar of polish, specifically formulated for use on refined metal objects. "The shine is literally spectacular!"
name: Helga's Actual Polish

title: Ramina's Table Topping
flavorText: An alchemist in Daggerfall produces jars of this expensive wood cleaner, which uses the same bottle as a popular salad dressing.
name: Ramina's Table Topping

title: Beldama Foot Rub
flavorText: One of Glenumbra's wandering merchants sells this soothing foot ointment, said to be made by the wyrd sisters of Daenia.
name: Beldama Foot Rub

title: Glass Pickling Jar
flavorText: A blown glass jar used for pickling ... something.
name: Glass Pickling Jar

title: Jar of Pretty Seashells
flavorText: A glass jar filled with pink and orange shells, labeled "Strident Coast."
name: Jar of Pretty Seashells

title: Jar of Live Centipedes
flavorText: A green glass jar containing four large live centipedes with a bow around it.
name: Jar of Live Centipedes

title: Alik'r Spice Jar
flavorText: A container for holding spices, crafted and sold by a friendly Redguard trader in western Rivenspire.
name: Alik'r Spice Jar

title: Vireche's Breath Purifier
flavorText: Alchemist Vireche Kel in Hoarfrost crafts this refreshing concoction that freshens bad breath and tastes great on black bread.
name: Vireche's Breath Purifier

title: Fruit Jar full of Goblin Teeth
flavorText: Jar for preserving fruit containing a collection of several hundred Goblin teeth.
name: Fruit Jar full of Goblin Teeth

title: Shornhelm Triumvirate Swear Jar
flavorText: One of the crystal jars Baron Dorell filled for every swear word he let slip during public sessions. Sadly, this one is empty.
name: Shornhelm Triumvirate Swear Jar

title: Seafood Allspice Preserving Jar
flavorText: An empty redware jar that smells of mushrooms and peat. Used to preserve the Davon's Watch seasoning known as "seafood allspice."
name: Seafood Allspice Preserving Jar

title: Jar of Fungal Grotto Mushroom Unguent
flavorText: Ornamental limeware jar of fungal emollient; exudes a heady fragrance redolent of deep grottos.
name: Jar of Fungal Grotto Mushroom Unguent

title: Lizard-Eye Marbles
flavorText: Small, round balls made of agate, used in the Dark Elf children's game, "Keepers," stored in a clear, glass jar.
name: Lizard-Eye Marbles

title: Sing's Serene Salve
flavorText: A popular ointment said to treat numerous bodily ailments, sold exclusively by the alchemist Sings-with-Frogs in Ebonheart.
name: Sing's Serene Salve

title: Jar of Frog Ink
flavorText: A glazed clay jar filled with frog ink. How the ink was extracted remains a mystery.
name: Jar of Frog Ink

title: Fin Polish
flavorText: A lacquered wooden jar filled with a smooth, waxy substance. Guaranteed to enhance the appearance and health of Argonian fins.
name: Fin Polish

title: Shadowfen Mud Collection
flavorText: Collection of eight sealed glass jars, each containing a sample of mud from a different region of Shadowfen.
name: Shadowfen Mud Collection

title: Balynor's Worm Repellent
flavorText: Wandering merchant Balynor's odiferous ointment, applied liberally, keeps a lot more than just Worm Cultists away.
name: Balynor's Worm Repellent

title: Wax Ear Pellets
flavorText: A sealed jar of soft wax pellets intended to be used as earplugs while sleeping.
name: Wax Ear Pellets

title: Nobles' Soil-Repelling Dreugh Wax
flavorText: Jar of expensive mildly-enchanted soil-repelling boot polish, made from rare dreugh wax by Starfall Arcana.
name: Nobles' Soil-Repelling Dreugh Wax

title: Nord Gold-Plated Snow Jars
flavorText: Wealthy Nord households take the tradition of saving snow from each year's Wintertide Festival in sealed jars very seriously.
name: Nord Gold-Plated Snow Jars

title: Glazed Jug
flavorText: This glazed jug has a thick sheep's bladder stopper that can keep its contents sealed.
name: Glazed Jug

title: Fermenting Jug
flavorText: A jug used to ferment homemade alcohol, usually decorated with animals native to specific parts of Tamriel.
name: Fermenting Jug

title: Polished Harvest Jug
flavorText: A heavy, but lovingly polished ceramic jug. It smells like a mix of fine whiskey and cheap jagga.
name: Polished Harvest Jug

title: Kerbol's Blood Jug
flavorText: This ornate silver jug is labeled with ancient runes that can be translated as "For Emergencies Only."
name: Kerbol's Blood Jug

title: Sheepskin-Covered Jug
flavorText: Sheepskin covers this porcelain jug to keep its contents from spoiling.
name: Sheepskin-Covered Jug

title: Nord Fermenting Jug
flavorText: A jug used to ferment homemade alcohol, usually decorated with animals native to Skyrim or scenes of famous Nord battles.
name: Nord Fermenting Jug

title: Reaper's Milk Jug
flavorText: A thick glass jug with "Reaper's Milk" embossed upon the side.
name: Reaper's Milk Jug

title: Suction-Sealed Water Jug
flavorText: A heavy clay water jug with a well-designed rubber seal. Clever thieves remove the seal and use it as clandestine climbing gear.
name: Suction-Sealed Water Jug

title: The Key to Velyn Harbor
flavorText: Large hollow brass key that can be played like a fife, engraved "First Seed Presentation: The Key to Velyn Harbor."
name: The Key to Velyn Harbor

title: Two Moons Key
flavorText: An ornamental key from Two Moons temple. Con artists could convince a mark that it opens something valuable.
name: Two Moons Key

title: Broken Crystal Key to Silyanorn
flavorText: Key carved from some kind of blue crystal, with one tooth broken off, engraved with the Ayleidoon "S" for Silyanorn.
name: Broken Crystal Key to Silyanorn

title: "Key" to Sanguine's Demesne
flavorText: Carnelian cut into the shape of a key, engraved "The Key to Sanguine's Demesne, Where Fantasy is Reality."
name: "Key" to Sanguine's Demesne
