title: Seeker's Onyx Key
flavorText: The bits on this ornamental onyx key are jagged, long, and irregular.
name: Seeker's Onyx Key

title: Brass Oil Lamp
flavorText: This simple brass oil lamp can provide light for hours. With a little polishing, it would be as good as new.
name: Brass Oil Lamp

title: Obsidian Orc Lamp
flavorText: A polished obsidian lamp, carved to resemble a snarling Orc.
name: Obsidian Orc Lamp

title: Red Heavens Lamp
flavorText: When this oil lamp is lit, the hundreds of embedded rubies produce a mesmerizing depiction of the constellations.
name: Red Heavens Lamp

title: Gilded Eagle Lamp
flavorText: A brass lamp with gold accents, shaped to resemble a screaming eagle in flight.
name: Gilded Eagle Lamp

title: Velyn Harbor Leviathan Oil Lamp
flavorText: Lamp for burning leviathan oil. Inscribed on bottom: "Another Fine Product from Trader's Crescent."
name: Velyn Harbor Leviathan Oil Lamp

title: Welkynd Stone Night Lamp
flavorText: Small night lamp illuminated by a dimly glowing welkynd stone from Erokii.
name: Welkynd Stone Night Lamp

title: Firebrand Lantern
flavorText: A wrought iron lantern bearing the heraldry of the Knights of the Flame.
name: Firebrand Lantern

title: Steel Lantern
flavorText: Panes of glass keep the flame safe from wind. The filigree pattern on the metal causes wild shadows to dance on the walls.
name: Steel Lantern

title: Looted Brass Lantern
flavorText: This sturdy brass lantern was pried off the deck of the Maiden's Breath. Even damaged, this lantern is quite lovely.
name: Looted Brass Lantern

title: Arkay's Blessed Lantern
flavorText: A lantern used by gravediggers at Pelin's Graveyard. The light is said to turn back the undead—primarily by crooked merchants.
name: Arkay's Blessed Lantern

title: Local Troll Lantern
flavorText: A lantern made from the ribs of a troll. The label insists the troll was hunted locally in Bangkorai.
name: Local Troll Lantern

title: Nereid's Wisp Lantern
flavorText: This lantern was created by the Nereid of Halcyon Lake. It glows with magical light.
name: Nereid's Wisp Lantern

title: Seventh Legion Lantern
flavorText: This lantern is forged from Dwarven Steel and engraved with the words: "For your loyalty to the Empire, from Septima Tharn."
name: Seventh Legion Lantern

title: Barkbite Ever-Burning Dark Lanthorn
flavorText: Exquisitely-forged lantern with painted, sliding shutters, containing a firebowl of ever-burning "Nirnpith Kindlepitch."
name: Barkbite Ever-Burning Dark Lanthorn

title: Terrapin-Shell Lantern
flavorText: A fine lantern, fashioned from a polished turtle shell and lined with copper leaf.
name: Terrapin-Shell Lantern

title: Tortoiseshell Monocle
flavorText: This monocle's lens is now missing, but the frame made of tortoiseshell gleams like new.
name: Tortoiseshell Monocle

title: Viridian Sentinel's Monocle
flavorText: Though Viridian Sentinels are known for their longevity, their eyes age at a normal rate, and they require monocles for reading.
name: Viridian Sentinel's Monocle

title: Shimmerene Magnifying Glass
flavorText: Magnifying lens of imported Shimmerene glass in a brass setting with a carved tigerbone handle.
name: Shimmerene Magnifying Glass

title: Tinted Spectacles in Gemstone Frames
flavorText: Pair of blue-tinted spectacles in silver frames, set with turquoise accents, in a fine tortoise-shell carrying case.
name: Tinted Spectacles in Gemstone Frames

title: Crystal Quizzing Glass
flavorText: Crystal magnifying lens mounted on a long brass handle, microscopically inscribed "Davynu's Workshop."
name: Crystal Quizzing Glass

title: Magnifying Spectacles
flavorText: An experimental pair of magnifying spectacles, just like the ones created for Baron Dorell's tired eyes in Northpoint.
name: Magnifying Spectacles

title: Argonian Reading Glass
flavorText: A polished and shaped piece of glass attached to a bone handle.
name: Argonian Reading Glass

title: Obsidian Night-Spectacles
flavorText: Broad pince-snout spectacles of thin but dark obsidian, worn for the Argonian practice of "Walking with Sithis."
name: Obsidian Night-Spectacles

title: Magnifying Monocle
flavorText: A single round of magnifying glass, just like the one used to aid Thane Unnvald's tired eyes in Riften.
name: Magnifying Monocle

title: Artificer's Loupe
flavorText: A finely made type of jeweler's loupe, this magnifying device can clearly reveal small details.
name: Artificer's Loupe

title: Eagle's Gaze Monocle
flavorText: A corrective lens used to enhance the vision in only one eye, enchanted to increase its magnification a dozen-fold.
name: Eagle's Gaze Monocle

title: Ivory-Handled Reading Glass
flavorText: A well-maintained glass lens with an ivory handle.
name: Ivory-Handled Reading Glass

title: Reading Glass
flavorText: The craftsmanship on this reading glass makes it of great value to bibliophiles.
name: Reading Glass

title: Velyn Harbor Mages Guild Stationery
flavorText: Two-score sheets of fine stationery, blank except for the symbol of the Mages Guild and script reading "Velyn Harbor Guildhall."
name: Velyn Harbor Mages Guild Stationery

title: Lion Guard Regrets
flavorText: A personal letter from a Lion Guard officer, informing of the loss of a loved one in service to the High King.
name: Lion Guard Regrets

title: Wayrest Love Letter
flavorText: An intimate letter revealing details of an illicit affair involving members of the Virane and Branck families in Wayrest.
name: Wayrest Love Letter

title: Outdated Military Documents
flavorText: While these documents are no longer useful for military strategies, a historian might find the papers intriguing.
name: Outdated Military Documents

title: Invitation: Drinks with the Neighbors
flavorText: An invitation to attend a casual gathering with neighboring nobles. It appears drinks and small bites will be served.
name: Invitation: Drinks with the Neighbors

title: Signed Coat of Arms Document
flavorText: These blank documents bearing the coat of arms of a noble house and signed by a house officer would be worth a lot to a forger.
name: Signed Coat of Arms Document

title: Disreputable Correspondence
flavorText: A collection of scandalous correspondence between rival merchants attempting to defraud their Alliance.
name: Disreputable Correspondence

title: Magistrate's Certificate
flavorText: This certificate verifies the credentials and authority of the local magistrate. It would be valuable to a forger.
name: Magistrate's Certificate

title: Sentinel Guard Patrol Schedule
flavorText: This document contains details about patrol routes and shift schedules for the Sentinel Guard.
name: Sentinel Guard Patrol Schedule

title: Letter of Marque
flavorText: This letter authorizes a ship captain to attack and loot Dominion ships in support of the Sentinel Navy.
name: Letter of Marque

title: College of Aldmeri Propriety Acceptance Letter
flavorText: A letter of acceptance into the Thalmor training program at the College of Aldmeri Propriety.
name: College of Aldmeri Propriety Acceptance Letter

title: Ancient Breton Deed
flavorText: This document is very old and nearly illegible. The varying ages of the inscriptions imply a rich history of lies and forgery.
name: Ancient Breton Deed

title: Foyen Docks Bill of Lading
flavorText: A bill of lading for cargo delivered to the Foyen Docks, it appears the cargo hasn't been picked up as yet.
name: Foyen Docks Bill of Lading

title: Writ of Bal Foyen Freedom
flavorText: When the Dark Elves freed the Argonian slaves and granted them land in Bal Foyen, these official documents were presented.
name: Writ of Bal Foyen Freedom

title: Invitation from Mayor Kerbol
flavorText: This invitation was sent to a sick nobleman's daughter, inviting her to come find healing in Kerbol's Hollow.
name: Invitation from Mayor Kerbol

title: Imperial Writ of Loyalty
flavorText: This writ says the bearer is loyal to the Empire and must be treated accordingly. It's signed by Magus-General Septima Tharn.
name: Imperial Writ of Loyalty

title: Inspirational Adages of the Three
flavorText: Every Dark Elf desk has a list of inspirational quotes attributed to the Tribunal.
name: Inspirational Adages of the Three

title: Narsis Guard Patrol Schedule
flavorText: An unauthorized list of guard patrols and schedules for the Hlaalu Guard in Narsis during the Llodos plague crisis.
name: Narsis Guard Patrol Schedule

title: Ordinator's Indulgence
flavorText: A discharge of obligations awarded by an Ordinator for certain favors discreetly performed for the Tribunal.
name: Ordinator's Indulgence

title: Illicit Letters from Daggerfall
flavorText: Steamy correspondences from a Darien Gautier of Camlorn. The frequent references to bread-eating must be some form of code.
name: Illicit Letters from Daggerfall

title: Queen's Tour Schedule
flavorText: An unauthorized list of stops and schedules for Queen Ayrenn's tour of the Dominion. Worth much to the Veiled Heritance.
name: Queen's Tour Schedule

title: Exoneration Writ
flavorText: A discharge of obligations awarded by a Dragon Knight for certain favors discreetly performed for the Daggerfall Crown.
name: Exoneration Writ

title: Perfumed Letter from Lady Laurent
flavorText: Famed explorer Lady Clarisse Laurent wrote and signed this letter, seeking funding for her latest dungeon-delving expedition.
name: Perfumed Letter from Lady Laurent

title: Duke Sebastien's Distinguished Decree
flavorText: The Duke of Camlorn continues a long-held tradition by presenting special certificates to deserving citizens every season.
name: Duke Sebastien's Distinguished Decree

title: Scandalous Letters
flavorText: A collection of unseemly letters between two members of rivalrous noble families that would be embarrassing if brought to light.
name: Scandalous Letters

title: Illicit Letters from Windhelm
flavorText: Romantic correspondence from an anonymous author, directed to one Darien Gautier. There is frequent reference to swordplay.
name: Illicit Letters from Windhelm

title: Chriane's Mulled Wine Companion
flavorText: One of Gerrald Chriane's much-sought-after goat-bladder waterskins, recommended for enjoying Saturalia Bitter Mulled Wine.
name: Chriane's Mulled Wine Companion

title: Covert Shornhelm Correspondence
flavorText: This message details supply routes between Shornhelm and Northpoint. Bandits would pay dearly for this information.
name: Covert Shornhelm Correspondence

title: House Tamrith's Profound Proclamation
flavorText: The Count of Tamrith continues a long-standing tradition by presenting special certificates to deserving citizens every season.
name: House Tamrith's Profound Proclamation

title: Invitation to the High King's Ball
flavorText: An embossed and elegant invitation to the High King's annual Rivenspire ball.
name: Invitation to the High King's Ball

title: Disreputable Memorandums
flavorText: A collection of memorandums detailing a merchant's attempt to cheat a rival merchant out of a price-fixing scheme.
name: Disreputable Memorandums

title: Impassioned Messages from Auridon
flavorText: Romantic letters exchanged between star-crossed paramours in opposing alliances. Either that, or coded messages from spies.
name: Impassioned Messages from Auridon

title: Thane Unnvald's Potent Proclamation
flavorText: The Thane of Riften continues a long-standing tradition by presenting special certificates to deserving citizens every season.
name: Thane Unnvald's Potent Proclamation

title: Disreputable Dispatches
flavorText: A collection of dispatches revealing two competing merchants and their conspiracy to fix prices.
name: Disreputable Dispatches

title: Illicit Letters from Northpoint
flavorText: Romantic correspondence between a foreign dignitary and a wealthy jarl in the Rift. Blackmailers would pay dearly for this.
name: Illicit Letters from Northpoint

title: Blank Marbruk Builder's Permit
flavorText: A permit to build in the city of Marbruk. It could be worth a lot to a forger.
name: Blank Marbruk Builder's Permit

title: Trollfight Arena Certificate of Merit
flavorText: A certificate given to the trainer of trolls who have survived ten or more fights at Hadran's Caravan.
name: Trollfight Arena Certificate of Merit

title: Counterfeit Dominion Passport
flavorText: A high quality forgery of a passport bearing the Thalmor Inner Council's seal. Smugglers would pay dearly for this.
name: Counterfeit Dominion Passport

title: Gold Counter's Promissory
flavorText: Drinks-with-Toes distributes these tokens of obligation to remind bank customers of their dealings with Drinks-Not-Investments.
name: Gold Counter's Promissory

title: Tomorrow's Obligations
flavorText: A list of the tasks to be performed the next day, peculiar to the author. Of some value to burglars.
name: Tomorrow's Obligations

title: Bleakrock Trading Hall Shopping List
flavorText: A list of supplies someone plans to pick up at the Bleakrock Trading Hall.
name: Bleakrock Trading Hall Shopping List

title: Captain Rana's Patrol Schedule
flavorText: An unauthorized record of Captain Rana's personal patrol schedule. It appears the people of Bleakrock like to keep track of her.
name: Captain Rana's Patrol Schedule

title: Piece of a Dwemer Construct
flavorText: The broken piece of a Dwemer construct is large enough to mount on a wall, but is probably permanently broken.
name: Piece of a Dwemer Construct

title: Winged Ink Pen
flavorText: A golden pen adorned with wings. When out of ink, the wings flutter frantically.
name: Winged Ink Pen

title: Today's Tasks
flavorText: A list of the day's chores, peculiar to the author.
name: Today's Tasks

title: Covert Daggerfall Correspondence
flavorText: This message details supply routes between Stormhaven and Glenumbra. Bandits would pay dearly for this information.
name: Covert Daggerfall Correspondence

title: Caravan Schedule
flavorText: These simple maps and notes appear to reveal a future caravan's route and schedule. A fence could resell these to bandits.
name: Caravan Schedule

title: Outdated Map of Tamriel
flavorText: This map of Tamriel was drawn before the Alliance War began. However, it still accurately depicts geography and distance.
name: Outdated Map of Tamriel

title: Ancient Map of High Rock
flavorText: This ancient map is as notable for its geographical inaccuracies as it is for its age.
name: Ancient Map of High Rock

title: Directions to Clockwork City
flavorText: Scouting reports, collected rumors, and suppositions on the true location of Sotha Sil's Clockwork City.
name: Directions to Clockwork City

title: Black Marsh Transportation Guide
flavorText: A hand-drawn map of the various underground expressways formed by the roots of the Hist trees and the common routes for traders.
name: Black Marsh Transportation Guide

title: Ancient Map of Unknown Land
flavorText: This antique map clearly shows a land currently unknown by modern cartographers and explorers.
name: Ancient Map of Unknown Land

title: Secret Roads Map
flavorText: This map locates several hidden passes and caves that run through the mountains between Hallin's Stand and Satakalaam.
name: Secret Roads Map

title: Silk Map of Summerset Isles
flavorText: Sailors and collectors alike would covet this delicately woven map of the Summerset Isles.
name: Silk Map of Summerset Isles

title: Ancient Map of Evermore
flavorText: This antique map shows how the city was arranged when it was first built centuries ago.
name: Ancient Map of Evermore

title: Ancient Map of Morrowind
flavorText: This antique map is as notable for its geographical inaccuracies as it is for its age.
name: Ancient Map of Morrowind

title: Map of Eastern Skyrim
flavorText: A map showing the current borders of Eastern Skyrim, though it appears to have a number of errors and inconsistencies.
name: Map of Eastern Skyrim

title: Ancient Map of Eastern Skyrim
flavorText: This antique map from the time of Queen Freydis is as notable for its geographical inaccuracies as it is for its age.
name: Ancient Map of Eastern Skyrim

title: Woodhearth Sewer Map
flavorText: A smugglers' map of the Woodhearth sewers.
name: Woodhearth Sewer Map

title: Antique Map of High Rock
flavorText: An antique map from the time of the Direnni Hegemony. Though inconsistent with modern maps, the calligraphy is beautiful.
name: Antique Map of High Rock

title: Inaccurate Rivenspire Map
flavorText: A map of Rivenspire containing glaring mistakes. Supposedly commissioned on King Ranser's orders to confuse High King Emeric.
name: Inaccurate Rivenspire Map

title: Rivenspire Map Desk Blotter
flavorText: Desk blotter printed with a map of Rivenspire, with an inkblot half-covering Sanguine Barrows.
name: Rivenspire Map Desk Blotter

title: Fanciful Map of Rivenspire
flavorText: This map from the time of King Ranser is notable for its extended borders, displaying Ranser's intentions at the time.
name: Fanciful Map of Rivenspire

title: Inaccurate Riften Map
flavorText: This map of Riften contains glaring mistakes and was supposedly commissioned on Thane Unnvald's orders to confuse the Worm Cult.
name: Inaccurate Riften Map

title: Covert Riften Correspondence
flavorText: This message details supply routes between Windhelm and Riften. Bandits would pay dearly for this information.
name: Covert Riften Correspondence

title: Fanciful Map of the Rift
flavorText: This map from the time of King Einar is notable for its depiction of fantastic creatures along the edges of the parchment.
name: Fanciful Map of the Rift

title: Greenshade Tunnel Map
flavorText: An extremely detailed map of the cave networks under Greenshade. It would be useful to anyone traveling in secret.
name: Greenshade Tunnel Map

title: Summerset Isles Nautical Depth Chart
flavorText: A highly detailed nautical chart of ocean depths and hazards in the strait separating Auridon and Summerset.
name: Summerset Isles Nautical Depth Chart

title: Summerset Isles Map Scroll
flavorText: A wooden scroll case containing a beautifully hand-painted cloth map of the Summerset Isles.
name: Summerset Isles Map Scroll

title: Star Map
flavorText: A detailed map of the Tamrielic sky, prepared by members of the Star-Gazer Order.
name: Star Map

title: Dhalmora Sleeping Mat
flavorText: A rolled sleeping mat in the Dhalmora style, built for comfort and portability. No backpack should be without one.
name: Dhalmora Sleeping Mat

title: Mystical Mysteries Table Mat
flavorText: A woven placemat crafted by Skyrim artisans and bearing the distinctive symbols associated with Saerdor the Mystic.
name: Mystical Mysteries Table Mat

title: Mabrigash Woven Mat
flavorText: A woven placemat crafted by the Mabrigash and bearing the distinctive pattern of the Ashlander tribe.
name: Mabrigash Woven Mat

title: Moonhenge Meditation Mat
flavorText: A colorful mat used by devout Wood Elves to meditate at the mystical spot known as Moonhenge.
name: Moonhenge Meditation Mat

title: Ornate Place Setting
flavorText: The embroidery on this place setting is extraordinary. It appears to use a mix of fine gold and silver thread.
name: Ornate Place Setting

title: Dragonshrine Woven Mat
flavorText: A woven placemat crafted by Riften artisans and bearing the distinctive landscape of a dragonshrine grotto.
name: Dragonshrine Woven Mat

title: Eagle's Strand Welcome Mat
flavorText: Tawny welcome mat woven of saltrice straw, with a pattern depicting Eagle's Strand.
name: Eagle's Strand Welcome Mat

title: Dragonstar Caravan Company Placemats
flavorText: Woven placemats bearing the seal of the Dragonstar Caravan Company and distributed as a promotional item.
name: Dragonstar Caravan Company Placemats

title: Sovngarde Woven Place Settings
flavorText: Woven placemats decorated with idyllic scenes of Sovngarde. They are too beautiful for common Nord feasts.
name: Sovngarde Woven Place Settings

title: Silver Hoof Woven Mat
flavorText: A woven placemat crafted by the Silver Hoof tribe and bearing the distinctive horse motif they favor.
name: Silver Hoof Woven Mat

title: Bear Skin Rug
flavorText: The bear's head is remarkably preserved. There can be no mistake: this rug is looking at you with its beady glass eyes.
name: Bear Skin Rug

title: Area Rug
flavorText: Dark red with an intricate navy pattern sewn into the border, this medium rug is soft to the touch.
name: Area Rug

title: Nord Bath Rug
flavorText: A fine bath rug, imported from a small boutique in Eastmarch, features an attractive yet simple Nord design.
name: Nord Bath Rug

title: Dunmeri Throw Rug
flavorText: A quality throw rug, imported from a small boutique in Deshaan, features an attractive yet simple Dark Elf design.
name: Dunmeri Throw Rug

title: Beetle-Scale Throw Rug
flavorText: A small rug used to cover a portion of a bare floor. The spongy nature of the beetle scales makes it particularly comfortable.
name: Beetle-Scale Throw Rug

title: White Senche-Tiger Rug
flavorText: A tiger-skin rug made from a large and very rare white senche-tiger.
name: White Senche-Tiger Rug

title: Mauloch's Meditation Mirror
flavorText: A silver mirror of Orcish design, featuring Mauloch's Hammer on the non-reflective side and used in daily affirmation rituals.
name: Mauloch's Meditation Mirror

title: Soldier's Shaving Mirror
flavorText: Your reflection peers back at you from within the mirror.
name: Soldier's Shaving Mirror

title: Manteau Family Handmirror
flavorText: This handmirror once belonged to the wealthy Manteau family from Wind Keep.
name: Manteau Family Handmirror

title: Sentinel Guard Signaling Mirror
flavorText: This small hand mirror was made so the Sentinel Guard can communicate across long distances.
name: Sentinel Guard Signaling Mirror

title: Grandeya's Diamond Hand Mirror
flavorText: A small but extremely valuable mirror decorated with gold and diamonds.
name: Grandeya's Diamond Hand Mirror

title: Caravan Minder's Mirror
flavorText: This is a small mirror carried by caravan guards and used to keep an eye out for any ambushes coming from the rear.
name: Caravan Minder's Mirror

title: Ordinator Signal Mirror
flavorText: A mirror bearing the symbol of the Ordinators. It is used to send simple signals and messages from a distance.
name: Ordinator Signal Mirror

title: Feast of Dibella Centerpiece
flavorText: Many Nord families display this silver mirror in the shape of a moth for the annual Feast of Dibella celebration.
name: Feast of Dibella Centerpiece

title: King's Observer Signal Mirror
flavorText: A mirror bearing the seal of King Casimir and used to send simple messages between agents of the king's intelligence network.
name: King's Observer Signal Mirror

title: "Watching Silvenar" Hand Mirror
flavorText: Ivory-handled hand mirror in which the viewer always sees the beatific face of the Silvenar over her shoulder.
name: "Watching Silvenar" Hand Mirror

title: Moon Pool Hand Mirror
flavorText: This mirror is actually a shallow, shimmering pool of water magically contained within its oval, opalescent frame.
name: Moon Pool Hand Mirror

title: Tamrith Crystal Hand Mirror
flavorText: The handle of this mirror was carved to match a House Tamrith stiletto hilt.
name: Tamrith Crystal Hand Mirror

title: Rosewood Hand Mirror
flavorText: A small silver mirror with an ornate frame of polished rosewood.
name: Rosewood Hand Mirror

title: Errinorne Valet's Two-Way Hand Mirror
flavorText: Silver-chased hand-mirror, devised so a valet can see from its back what it's reflecting in the front, for proper holding.
name: Errinorne Valet's Two-Way Hand Mirror

title: Celestial Mirror
flavorText: This ancient mirror is framed by images carved into its surface resembling the celestial constellations.
name: Celestial Mirror

title: Silver-Handled Mirror
flavorText: The polished silver engraved onto the handle is almost as reflective as the mirror itself.
name: Silver-Handled Mirror

title: Ornate Shaving Mirror
flavorText: An ornate hand-held shaving mirror crafted from fine silver and inscribed the names of Aldmeri deities.
name: Ornate Shaving Mirror

title: Mirror of Youth
flavorText: This ornately-framed mirror is magically charmed to show a more youthful image of the person peering into it.
name: Mirror of Youth

title: Khajiit Windowsill Sun Reflector
flavorText: A mirrored plaque placed on a windowsill, reflecting sunlight into a dot that senche-tigers (and some Khajiit) love to chase.
name: Khajiit Windowsill Sun Reflector

title: King Emeric's Golden Toothpick
flavorText: Shaped specifically to fit in the narrow gaps between his teeth, Emeric had several such toothpicks made when he became king.
name: King Emeric's Golden Toothpick

title: Silvermere's Road Nail
flavorText: A nail thought to be from the horseshoe of Silvermere, ridden by Emperor Reman during his campaign against the Akaviri invaders.
name: Silvermere's Road Nail

title: Metal Meat Skewers
flavorText: Long, thin skewers of steel and brass, designed to impale chunks of meat and vegetables to cook over an open fire.
name: Metal Meat Skewers

title: Clip of Fine Hair
flavorText: A clump of fine hair wrapped in a silk ribbon, intended to accent hair without being too ostentatious.
name: Clip of Fine Hair

title: Silver Kabob Sticks
flavorText: A valuable set of kabob sticks often used by Crown nobles when eating goat.
name: Silver Kabob Sticks

title: Bronze Hair Disc
flavorText: This old Breton hair disc is still in excellent condition. It was almost certainly worn by a member of King Renwic's house.
name: Bronze Hair Disc

title: Whale-Bone Toothpick
flavorText: Mighty Orc tusks require an equally mighty toothpick. This one is larger than most—likely used by a Seamount clan chief.
name: Whale-Bone Toothpick

title: Heavy Knitting Needles
flavorText: These needles are composed of Stonetooth steel and are larger than most. A good fit for strong Orcish hands.
name: Heavy Knitting Needles

title: Steel Marlinspike
flavorText: A flawless steel pin used to mend rope. It was likely given as a gift to Captain Kaleen's most talented seamen.
name: Steel Marlinspike

title: Ivory Lamb Skewers
flavorText: A pair of long steel skewers used to prepare kabobs. The handles are made of genuine horker tusk, carved to resemble sheep.
name: Ivory Lamb Skewers

title: Hircine-Blessed Skewers
flavorText: Though they were made by a Dark Witness briarheart, these ebony meat skewers are much prized by hunters everywhere.
name: Hircine-Blessed Skewers

title: Diamond Knitting Needle
flavorText: When her children were young, Queen Arzhela liked to personally knit all their clothes. The king gave her many of these needles.
name: Diamond Knitting Needle

title: Engraved Mammoth Tusk Hair Pins
flavorText: Intricately carved hair pins, made from expensive mammoth ivory, depict highlights of the Skald-King's life in minute detail.
name: Engraved Mammoth Tusk Hair Pins

title: Bone Knitting Needles
flavorText: These knitting needles are sturdy and exquisitely-carved.
name: Bone Knitting Needles

title: Ugduk's Meat Skewers
flavorText: A general good merchant in Aldcroft sells these traditional Orc meat skewers, perfect for roasting over a fire.
name: Ugduk's Meat Skewers

title: Gem-Studded Triquetra Hat Pin
flavorText: An exquisite hat-pin, shaped like a three-sided knot and studded with fine gems, is the perfect accompaniment to any bonnet.
name: Gem-Studded Triquetra Hat Pin

title: Set of Six Frog-Kabob Skewers
flavorText: Set of fancy frog-kabob skewers of twisted wrought iron, from the Greenwarden Forge in Elden Root.
name: Set of Six Frog-Kabob Skewers

title: Exquisite Bone Stylus
flavorText: An antique writing tool carved from a wolf's mandible.
name: Exquisite Bone Stylus

title: Eagle-Bone Chopsticks
flavorText: A set of polished eating utensils, made from carved eagle bones.
name: Eagle-Bone Chopsticks

title: House Montclair Celebratory Sparkle Stick
flavorText: Stoneglow Enchantments crafted these party favors for Baron Montclair's fortieth birthday, leading to the Great Fire of 1E 580.
name: House Montclair Celebratory Sparkle Stick

title: Dark Elf Sewing Needles in Pin Cushion
flavorText: Distinctive bone sewing needles traditionally utilized by Dark Elf crafters, stuck into a mudcrab-shaped pin cushion.
name: Dark Elf Sewing Needles in Pin Cushion

title: Folio-Binding Kit with Head-Needle
flavorText: Fine snakeskin sewing kit for binding folios of parchment, with an Argonian head-spine needle.
name: Folio-Binding Kit with Head-Needle

title: Stormhold "Stingaree" Tail Prosthesis
flavorText: Fancy lacquered giant-wasp thorax with flexible bands for tail attachment, worn in the "Fredas Night Stingaree."
name: Stormhold "Stingaree" Tail Prosthesis

title: Nord's Hammer Hair Pins
flavorText: Fancy hair pins with a hammer head and pointed handle, a popular Nord symbol, found in homes throughout the Rift and beyond.
name: Nord's Hammer Hair Pins

title: Collection of Belaying Pins
flavorText: Curious collection of sailing ship belaying pins, each one labeled with the name of a shipwreck.
name: Collection of Belaying Pins

title: Sload Pustule Lancet
flavorText: A rare item of Sload manufacture, left behind after their long occupation of Errinorne Isle.
name: Sload Pustule Lancet

title: Handheld Loom
flavorText: This loom's small size makes it easily transportable, and the needle is constructed of a valuable ebony.
name: Handheld Loom

title: Silver Skewers
flavorText: Skewers that would be valuable to a werewolf hunter—if they weren't made of orichalcum, and painted silver to look less valuable.
name: Silver Skewers

title: Set of Monkeybone Bug Tweezers
flavorText: Case of six fine tweezer utensils used for eating live bugs, carved from flexible monkeybone and inscribed "Silvenar Supplies."
name: Set of Monkeybone Bug Tweezers

title: Goat-Hair Butterfly Net
flavorText: A net, woven from the finest goat hair, designed to catch butterflies.
name: Goat-Hair Butterfly Net

title: Nocturnal Nord Hair Net
flavorText: The only way to protect Nord braids from pillow hair is by using one of these silver mesh hair nets while sleeping.
name: Nocturnal Nord Hair Net

title: Royal Wasp Wrangler's Capture Net
flavorText: Collapsible net of strong Scuttle Pit spidersilk for live capture of giant wasps by the Camoran Royal Wasp Wrangler.
name: Royal Wasp Wrangler's Capture Net

title: Cloth-of-Gold Torchbug Hair-Cage
flavorText: Glittering cloth-of-gold net with flexible band; it is snugged over one's hair, and then filled with a dozen winking torchbugs.
name: Cloth-of-Gold Torchbug Hair-Cage

title: Long-Handled Bat-Catcher's Net
flavorText: Wide-mouthed net with extensible handle, as used by the famous Crestshade Bat-Catchers.
name: Long-Handled Bat-Catcher's Net

title: Wasp Netting
flavorText: A mesh made from ogre sinew. Some Wood Elves swear it provides unmatched protection from the giant wasps of Green's Marrow.
name: Wasp Netting

title: Decorative Nord Netting
flavorText: A common net decorated in the Nord style, with sea shells, feathers, beads, and other trinkets, creating a hanging work of art.
name: Decorative Nord Netting

title: Spidersilk Food Net
flavorText: Travelers often use these nets when camping to suspend their food above the reach of any bears.
name: Spidersilk Food Net

title: Pewter Portrait Frame
flavorText: This small pewter frame can hold a miniature portrait or drawing.
name: Pewter Portrait Frame

title: Risque Etching
flavorText: This revealing etching of a masked courtesan was deemed too provocative to display in mixed company.
name: Risque Etching

title: "Cavorting Dremora Among the Ruins"
flavorText: This whimsical painting depicts what wealthy citizens must imagine Dremora are like: All smiling and dancing in an unnamed ruin.
name: "Cavorting Dremora Among the Ruins"

title: Curious Family Portrait
flavorText: A painting of an unnamed ancestor of a wealthy family. The eyes seem to follow you wherever you go.
name: Curious Family Portrait

title: Fahara'jad Coronation Portrait
flavorText: This rare painting depicts the coronation of King Fahara'jad. Its frame is made of orichalcum.
name: Fahara'jad Coronation Portrait

title: "Ancient Ezduiin" Painting
flavorText: Framed painting of the site of Ezduiin, depicting it as it appeared before it was ruined in the Mallari-Mora incident.
name: "Ancient Ezduiin" Painting

title: Painting of King Hidellith
flavorText: Framed oil portrait of Queen Ayrenn's father, the late King Hidellith.
name: Painting of King Hidellith

title: Forged Painting
flavorText: A very good forgery of a very famous Aldmeri painting.
name: Forged Painting

title: Bleakrock Isle Scenery Painting
flavorText: A small painting in a frame that sits on a nightstand, it shows a distinct piece of Bleakrock scenery by the artist Oro.
name: Bleakrock Isle Scenery Painting

title: Giraud Family Portrait
flavorText: This large portrait features all the members of a large family who were once prominent farmers in Northglen.
name: Giraud Family Portrait

title: "Frolicking Trolls of Eastmarch"
flavorText: A copy of this whimsical painting depicts how Bretons imagine the frost trolls of Skyrim: smiling and dancing in the snow.
name: "Frolicking Trolls of Eastmarch"

title: Curious Royal Painting
flavorText: A painting of an unnamed ancestor of King Casimir. The eyes seem to follow you wherever you go.
name: Curious Royal Painting

title: Skywatch Festival Advertisement
flavorText: A hand-drawn advertisement for the celebration in Skywatch.
name: Skywatch Festival Advertisement

title: Defaced Tribunal Reredos
flavorText: Magnificent carved three-panel mahogany screen depicting the Tribunal, defaced by claw-marks.
name: Defaced Tribunal Reredos

title: Toad Muffin Pan
flavorText: This pan bakes exactly seven toad muffins—a number that is generally considered good luck.
name: Toad Muffin Pan

title: Steel Warming Pan
flavorText: A steel bed warmer, cool to the touch but full of fine charcoal ash.
name: Steel Warming Pan

title: Bed Warmer
flavorText: A round metal contraption for warming the bed with hot coals on frigid winter nights.
name: Bed Warmer

title: Beetle Puffs Pastry Pan
flavorText: This pastry pan makes a dozen sweet beetle puffs, a Dhalmora delicacy favored by Argonians and other adventurous eaters.
name: Beetle Puffs Pastry Pan

title: Rabbit Roasting Pan
flavorText: A favorite meal throughout Bleakrock Isle, this deep porcelain casserole is the perfect size to hold a stuffed rabbit.
name: Rabbit Roasting Pan

title: Deerskin Dustpan
flavorText: This dustpan was made using multiple layers of deerskin so that it's both flexible and sturdy.
name: Deerskin Dustpan

title: Olive-Wood Pipe
flavorText: A lacquered wooden pipe, cut from a Craglorn olive tree.
name: Olive-Wood Pipe

title: Gorapple Muffin Pan
flavorText: This tin pan has enough cups to make exactly three gorapple muffins—a lucky number associated with the Tribunal.
name: Gorapple Muffin Pan

title: Sweetroll Pastry Pan
flavorText: This pastry pan has enough cups to make exactly nine sweetrolls—one for each of the Eight with a bonus pastry for good luck.
name: Sweetroll Pastry Pan

title: Rabbit Meatball Frying Pan
flavorText: A frying pan that features multiple ball-shaped indentations for preparing perfect rabbit meatballs for hungry Nords.
name: Rabbit Meatball Frying Pan

title: Jagga Tart Fluted Ring Pans
flavorText: Fluted ring pans for making jagga tarts, a Wood Elf delicacy consisting of fermented pig's milk and squirrel preserves.
name: Jagga Tart Fluted Ring Pans

title: Khajiit Travel Skillet
flavorText: No Khajiit journeys into the wild without sticking one of these cooking vessels in her pack. Perfect for making fried sweetcake.
name: Khajiit Travel Skillet

title: Cast Iron Skillet
flavorText: This cast iron skillet is practical and well-made—a must-have for any chef.
name: Cast Iron Skillet

title: Miniature Mundus Stone Model
flavorText: A wandering merchant who visits Craglorn once every season sells these small, stone paperweights in the shape of Mundus Stones.
name: Miniature Mundus Stone Model

title: Diminutive Mundus Stone
flavorText: A wandering merchant who visits Eastmarch once every season sells these small, stone paperweights in the shape of Mundus Stones.
name: Diminutive Mundus Stone

title: Mammoth Paperweight
flavorText: A small, heavy mammoth of shaped glass, used to keep papers and other documents from scattering in a cold wind.
name: Mammoth Paperweight

title: Pewter Paperweight
flavorText: It's heavy and it just sits there—the perfect paperweight.
name: Pewter Paperweight

title: Ayleid Paperweight
flavorText: Retrieved from the ruins at Salas En. No one knows its original purpose, but it makes a great paperweight.
name: Ayleid Paperweight

title: Guar Paperweight
flavorText: A small, heavy guar of shaped clay, it is a popular desk accessory in Dhalmora and the surrounding countryside.
name: Guar Paperweight

title: Iliath Temple Paperweight
flavorText: Heavy basalt paperweight carved in the likeness of the Iliath Temple.
name: Iliath Temple Paperweight

title: Quartz Crystal Tower Paperweight
flavorText: Quartz paperweight in the shape of a miniature Crystal Tower; glows faintly in the dark, gradually changing colors.
name: Quartz Crystal Tower Paperweight

title: Welkynd Chip Paperweight
flavorText: Taken from a keystone outside the great Ayleid ruin of Betnikh. It still glows a faint blue and emits a low hum.
name: Welkynd Chip Paperweight

title: Crude Tooth Paperweight
flavorText: This grisly paperweight features a molar taken from a Dogeater Goblin perched atop a resin block.
name: Crude Tooth Paperweight

title: Ash Mountain Paperweight
flavorText: A heavy stone from the volcano in Stonefalls, perfect for keeping papers from scattering in a strong breeze.
name: Ash Mountain Paperweight

title: Amber-Encased Torchbug
flavorText: This unfortunate torchbug was caught in a flood of sap a long time ago. Polished to a shine, it is now an amber paperweight.
name: Amber-Encased Torchbug

title: Tower Paperweight
flavorText: A small, heavy stone tower in the High Breton style, with gemstone windows. Used to keep papers from scattering in the wind.
name: Tower Paperweight

title: Narsis Mushroom Parasol
flavorText: A parasol in the Narsis style, shaped to resemble a Morrowind mushroom and carried to repel rain or sun.
name: Narsis Mushroom Parasol

title: Daggerfall Carrying Canopy
flavorText: A distinctive parasol with dangles and frills, made popular by wealthy matrons during the first Daggerfall Covenant.
name: Daggerfall Carrying Canopy

title: Betty Netch Parasol
flavorText: A rare parasol imported from Morrowind, shaped to resemble a betty netch and carried to repel rain or sun.
name: Betty Netch Parasol

title: Baandari Trading Post Parasol
flavorText: Khajiiti reed-and-papyrus folding parasol, with "Compliments of the Baandari Trading Post" on the handle.
name: Baandari Trading Post Parasol

title: Camoran Bat-Wing Bumbershoot
flavorText: Ivory-handled black folding umbrella fashioned from the waxed wings of giant bats, with the red Camoran Royal Seal.
name: Camoran Bat-Wing Bumbershoot

title: Wamasu Hide Frilly Parasol
flavorText: Imported from Craglorn at great expense, this covering provides protection from sun and rain, and features a bone-grip handle.
name: Wamasu Hide Frilly Parasol

title: House Indoril Shoulder-Mounted Parasol
flavorText: Folding shoulder-mounted parasol of blue-dyed premium netch-hide displaying the symbol of House Indoril.
name: House Indoril Shoulder-Mounted Parasol

title: Canonreeve's Silken Parasol
flavorText: Silk-paneled sun umbrella displaying the symbol of the Thalmor, from Island Woodworks in Skywatch.
name: Canonreeve's Silken Parasol

title: Spidersilk Parasol
flavorText: A brightly colored collapsible parasol of fine-spun spidersilk with an intricately-carved mahogany handle.
name: Spidersilk Parasol

title: Monkey-Hide Parasol
flavorText: An umbrella used in the Alik'r to protect exposed skin from the sun. It is no longer used exclusively by nobles.
name: Monkey-Hide Parasol

title: Clement Climate Picnic Parasol
flavorText: Minor-magical parasol that, when opened, protects the area beneath and nearby from bad weather; from The Eldritch Seal.
name: Clement Climate Picnic Parasol

title: Evermore Parasol
flavorText: Citizens of Evermore traveling into Southern Bangkorai often carry these parasols to protect themselves from the desert sun.
name: Evermore Parasol

title: Princess Elara's Parasol
flavorText: Knowing her daughter enjoyed long walks outside the castle walls, Queen Arzhela had dozens of these fancy parasols made.
name: Princess Elara's Parasol

title: Snakeskin Umbrella
flavorText: A clever Wood Elf invention, designed to keep travelers dry during rainstorms.
name: Snakeskin Umbrella

title: Wax Paper
flavorText: Wax paper for composing letters.
name: Wax Paper

title: Quire of Official Thalmor Stationery
flavorText: 24 sheets of highest-quality vellum, each bearing the distinctive eagle watermark of the Thalmor.
name: Quire of Official Thalmor Stationery

title: Transferable Promissory Note
flavorText: I.O.U. drawn on the general funds of the Treasury of the Tree, made out to "Bearer."
name: Transferable Promissory Note

title: Burial Mound Etchings
flavorText: Etchings from the ancient crypts at the base of Cath Bedraud.
name: Burial Mound Etchings

title: Fresh Vellum
flavorText: The pages are fresh-cut and smooth to the touch.
name: Fresh Vellum

title: Sheaf of Blank Parchment
flavorText: Each piece of parchment is unstained, unmarred, and unfolded.
name: Sheaf of Blank Parchment

title: Faded Wanted Poster
flavorText: A wanted poster from a distant city with exceptional artwork. A fence may purchase this as decoration for an Outlaws Refuge.
name: Faded Wanted Poster

title: Sheet Music Folio
flavorText: Contains sheet music for such classics as "Lusty  Argonian Maid" and "No Way Am I Going to Eat this Stew."
name: Sheet Music Folio

title: Pristine Durzog-Hide Napkins
flavorText: King Kurog of Orsinium presented these napkins as a gift to one of the noble houses of Wayrest.
name: Pristine Durzog-Hide Napkins

title: Compilation of First Concerns
flavorText: A list of the day's priorities, in order of importance. The reverse is blank, and could be reused.
name: Compilation of First Concerns

title: Echatare Vellum
flavorText: Imported by boat from Orsinium. This vellum still smells of woodchips and the sea.
name: Echatare Vellum

title: Star-Gazers' Observatory Stationery
flavorText: Common parchment sheets bearing the embossed seal of the observatory in Belkarth.
name: Star-Gazers' Observatory Stationery

title: Konunleikar Certificate of Merit
flavorText: Participants in any of the Konunleikar games received a Certificate of Merit. Signed by Thane Mera, it is suitable for framing.
name: Konunleikar Certificate of Merit

title: Signed Konunleikar Event Schedule
flavorText: A broadsheet featuring the daily schedule of events for the Konunleikar festival. This one was signed by King Jorunn.
name: Signed Konunleikar Event Schedule

title: Three Banners War Pact Propaganda
flavorText: A broadsheet trumpeting the Ebonheart Pact's claim to the Imperial throne, written in flowery, adjective-laden language.
name: Three Banners War Pact Propaganda

title: Voljar Gift Certificate
flavorText: A certificate that can be redeemed at Voljar's Meadery in Eastmarch for bottles or casks of mead.
name: Voljar Gift Certificate

title: The Bastard's Last Will and Testament
flavorText: Many versions of the last will and testament of Yoregg the Bastard have turned up, but none have been deemed authentic. Yet.
name: The Bastard's Last Will and Testament

title: Lion Guard Enlistment Form
flavorText: Official enlistment form for the Lion Guard, signed and stamped but with the enlistee's name still waiting to be filled in.
name: Lion Guard Enlistment Form

title: Curious Parchment
flavorText: This parchment bears a disturbing resemblance to human skin. It's probably just calf-skin. Right?
name: Curious Parchment

title: Quire of Fine Vellum
flavorText: Twenty-four sheets of smooth ivory-colored kidskin parchment.
name: Quire of Fine Vellum

title: Shornhelm Triumvirate Official Parchment
flavorText: Expensive parchment embossed with the Seal of Shornhelm and used by the ruling Triumvirate for official correspondence.
name: Shornhelm Triumvirate Official Parchment

title: Provisioner's List
flavorText: A list of groceries that need to be picked up at Mendyn Indrano's shop in Ebonheart.
name: Provisioner's List

title: Davon's Watch Banker's Note
flavorText: The Bank of Davon's Watch provides every client with one of these receipts for items deposited in their vaults.
name: Davon's Watch Banker's Note

title: Davon's Watch Herald's Notes
flavorText: Notes for tomorrow, used by the town criers who announce the news in the squares of Davon's Watch.
name: Davon's Watch Herald's Notes

title: Fish-Skin Parchment
flavorText: The pages of this catfish-skin parchment are remarkably wide. The beast must have been massive.
name: Fish-Skin Parchment

title: Gold Leaf Stationery
flavorText: A mere glint of light turns this gilded stationery into a shining parchment.
name: Gold Leaf Stationery

title: Ornate Vellum Stationery
flavorText: This gold-flecked stationery is smooth to the touch, and would serve as a fine writing surface.
name: Ornate Vellum Stationery

title: Embossed Lion Guard Stationery
flavorText: Special parchment with an embossed Lion Guard symbol, used for official correspondence and documentation.
name: Embossed Lion Guard Stationery

title: Royal Wedding Invitation
flavorText: This is an invitation to Duke Nathaniel's wedding to Princess Lakana at Alcaire Castle.
name: Royal Wedding Invitation

title: At-Tura Stationery
flavorText: Count Hosni at-Tura had his insignia stamped onto these papers to be used for his personal correspondences.
name: At-Tura Stationery

title: Daggerfall Covenant Correspondence Sheets
flavorText: A stack of stationery featuring the embossed seal of the Daggerfall Covenant. What it was doing in Eastmarch is anyone's guess.
name: Daggerfall Covenant Correspondence Sheets

title: Konunleikar Invitation
flavorText: An invitation to an exclusive Konunleikar party limited to Windhelm's most important movers and shakers.
name: Konunleikar Invitation

title: Official Dominion Stationery
flavorText: A forger could use this stationery to make a tidy sum of money.
name: Official Dominion Stationery

title: Feather Pillow
flavorText: This long, fluffy pillow looks brand new, like no head ever rested upon it.
name: Feather Pillow

title: Canary Down Neck-Pillow
flavorText: A small, soft pillow that makes sleeping out in the wilds almost feel like home.
name: Canary Down Neck-Pillow

title: Gold-Embroidered Pillow Case
flavorText: King Fahara'jad invites many young ladyfriends to the palace. They receive a valuable pillow case when they depart.
name: Gold-Embroidered Pillow Case

title: Lusty Argonian Keepsake Pillow
flavorText: The bawdy Lusty Argonian traveling tents of Bal Foyen gift these plush pillows to guests to remember each visit.
name: Lusty Argonian Keepsake Pillow

title: Crawling Night Pillow
flavorText: Dhalmora Argonians fill their pillows with live centipedes—they love the sensation of wriggling creatures against their heads.
name: Crawling Night Pillow

title: Dark Den Remembrance Pillow
flavorText: The infamous Dark Den fest hall and brothel gifts these plush pillows to discerning guests upon the conclusion of their visit.
name: Dark Den Remembrance Pillow

title: Raven-Feather Pillow
flavorText: A small head pillow filled with fluffy raven feathers and featuring a traditional Nord design of clinking, overflowing tankards.
name: Raven-Feather Pillow

title: Wool-Filled Pillow
flavorText: Eastmarch sheep produce a soft, fluffy wool—perfect as a filling for these comfortable travel pillows.
name: Wool-Filled Pillow

title: Baandari Horse Pillow
flavorText: This padded pillow filled with seagull feathers and butterflies keeps a Baandari trader comfortable on long journeys.
name: Baandari Horse Pillow

title: Chaste Harpy Keepsake Pillow
flavorText: The infamous Chaste Harpy fest hall gifts these plush pillows to discerning guests upon the conclusion of their visit.
name: Chaste Harpy Keepsake Pillow

title: Elder Down Pillow
flavorText: This supple leather pillow is filled with the downy feathers of an aged duck.
name: Elder Down Pillow

title: Embroidered Silken Baandari Pillow
flavorText: Silken pillow embroidered to depict the Great Gate of Corinthe, labeled "Property of Silver Moons Inn."
name: Embroidered Silken Baandari Pillow

title: Embroidered Silk Silvenar Pillow
flavorText: Silk-covered throw-pillow with embroidered scene showing a procession of Spinners being carried through Silvenar.
name: Embroidered Silk Silvenar Pillow

title: Downy Pillow
flavorText: This pillow is made of high quality duck down.
name: Downy Pillow

title: Embroidered Tavern Pillow
flavorText: Pillow or seat-cushion embroidered with an image of the Dusklight Inn of Hoarfrost Downs.
name: Embroidered Tavern Pillow

title: Embroidered Vivec's Antlers Pillow
flavorText: Silken pillow with an embroidered image of Vivec drowning the Akaviri invaders at Vivec's Antlers.
name: Embroidered Vivec's Antlers Pillow

title: Tasseled Pillow
flavorText: A large pillow emblazoned with the Imperial ruby. Created from a lavish, finely-spun material, it is soft to the touch.
name: Tasseled Pillow

title: Fusozay Cushion
flavorText: A Khajiit novelty cushion that, when placed on a chair and sat upon, produces an embarrassing flatulence sound.
name: Fusozay Cushion

title: Meerschaum Sweetgnat Kiseru
flavorText: Long-shanked, small-bowled pipe carved from meerschaum, used in Karthdar for smoking small dried bugs like sweetgnats.
name: Meerschaum Sweetgnat Kiseru

title: Curious Khajiiti Pipe
flavorText: This stylish glass pipe smells faintly of moon-sugar, and has a thin blue residue on the rim of the bowl.
name: Curious Khajiiti Pipe

title: Thunderbug-Shell Pipe
flavorText: An enameled bug-smoking pipe with a capacious bowl formed from a thunderbug's carapace.
name: Thunderbug-Shell Pipe

title: Skooma Pipe
flavorText: This skooma pipe would sell well on the black market.
name: Skooma Pipe

title: Enameled Clay Catnip Pipe
flavorText: Catnip pipe painted with images from the tale "How Khenarthi Taught the Clouds to Dance."
name: Enameled Clay Catnip Pipe

title: Bramblebreach Pipe
flavorText: A long and heavy pipe, constructed of smooth wood. The skilled craftsmanship sets it apart from others of its kind.
name: Bramblebreach Pipe

title: Festive Fingerbone Mouth Harp
flavorText: Musical instrument, a set of reeded pipes of varying lengths carved from fingerbones and painted with bright festival hues.
name: Festive Fingerbone Mouth Harp

title: Xal Thak Dental Marimba
flavorText: Small marimba, with mallets, made of carefully-selected resonant reptile teeth on a nonatonic scale.
name: Xal Thak Dental Marimba

title: Ever-Blooming Bonsai Tree
flavorText: Rectangular pot containing a living bonsai, a miniature Auridon Gorapple perpetually blossoming pink blooms.
name: Ever-Blooming Bonsai Tree

title: Cut-Glass Slug Terrarium with Elden Tree
flavorText: Delicate terrarium for pet slugs with three cut-glass sides and a ceramic Elden Tree sculpture for the slugs to climb on.
name: Cut-Glass Slug Terrarium with Elden Tree

title: Branch of Falinesti
flavorText: One of many counterfeit branches of the legendary moving tree of Falinesti.
name: Branch of Falinesti

title: Vivec's Antlers Land Coral Bonsai
flavorText: Living sprig of land coral from Vivec's Antlers, in a redware pot depicting Vivec's drowning of the Akaviri.
name: Vivec's Antlers Land Coral Bonsai

title: Elaborate Hist Centerpiece
flavorText: An imposing willow wood sculpture. Small polished jades have been inset between the roots to represent eggs.
name: Elaborate Hist Centerpiece

title: Living Model of Elden Root
flavorText: This painstakingly accurate model of the city of Elden Root was created using an actual, still-living miniature tree.
name: Living Model of Elden Root

title: Potted Valenwood Flytrap
flavorText: A rare carnivorous plant found only in the deepest forests of Valenwood. Its leaves are a powerful aphrodisiac.
name: Potted Valenwood Flytrap

title: Satin Roses
flavorText: These delicate flowers were made by hand out of red satin. The long green stems look to be made of wood.
name: Satin Roses

title: Dried Royal Bouquet
flavorText: This bouquet of desiccated flowers was carried by one of the bridesmaids at King Emeric's wedding to Queen Maraya.
name: Dried Royal Bouquet

title: Angof's Angry Vines
flavorText: Despite the probable danger, some citizens have begun collecting clippings of Angof's vines to display in their homes.
name: Angof's Angry Vines

title: Rare Flowering Violet
flavorText: A well-nurtured violet plant. Its purple flowers are quite lovely.
name: Rare Flowering Violet

title: Glass Pedestal Cake Stand
flavorText: Complete with a glass dome to keep unwanted pests away, this pedestal cake stand is perfect for displaying fresh cakes or pies.
name: Glass Pedestal Cake Stand

title: Memorial Covenant Plate
flavorText: A gold-tinged plate commemorating the formation of the Daggerfall Covenant, issued for the tenth anniversary of the alliance.
name: Memorial Covenant Plate

title: Covenant Commemorative Saucer
flavorText: This saucer was decorated with the royal crest to commemorate the 5th anniversary of the Daggerfall Covenant.
name: Covenant Commemorative Saucer

title: Beetle Shell Cheese Plate
flavorText: A plate designed to serve cheese, made from the shell of a giant beetle.
name: Beetle Shell Cheese Plate

title: Bountiful Silver Plate
flavorText: This large, silver plate is engraved with an image of Morwha, the Yokudan goddess of fertility.
name: Bountiful Silver Plate

title: Snow-Bourne Plate
flavorText: An elegant crystal dinner plate bearing the crest of the Snow-Bourne clan, probably brought all the way from Windhelm.
name: Snow-Bourne Plate

title: Argonian Scale Beetle Cheese Plate
flavorText: A plate designed to serve scuttle beetle cheese, made from Argonian scales (presumably prior to the formation of the Pact).
name: Argonian Scale Beetle Cheese Plate

title: Ebonheart Commemorative Plate
flavorText: This plate, decorated with the seals of Morrowind, Skyrim, and Black Marsh, commemorates the formation of the Ebonheart Pact.
name: Ebonheart Commemorative Plate

title: Silver-Plated Souvenir Execution Plate
flavorText: Plate embossed with an image of a Wood Orc hanging from a gallows, inscribed "The Hanging of Chief Orhg, Vulkwasten, 2E 578."
name: Silver-Plated Souvenir Execution Plate

title: Skald-King Commemorative Plate
flavorText: A hand-painted souvenir plate commemorating the coronation of Jorunn, the Skald-King.
name: Skald-King Commemorative Plate

title: Antique Silver Flatware
flavorText: Four place settings of antique silver flatware set into a velvet-lined wooden box.
name: Antique Silver Flatware

title: Fine Altmer Dishware
flavorText: These extravagant porcelain plates look very out of place in Stros M'Kai.
name: Fine Altmer Dishware

title: Hallin's Stand Resistance Plates
flavorText: Nobles in Hallin's Stand use these silver plates, engraved with the insignia of Sentinel, to show their true loyalties.
name: Hallin's Stand Resistance Plates

title: Bone Dishware
flavorText: Bosmer dishes, carved from the bones of large game.
name: Bone Dishware

title: Mudcrab Shell Dinner Plates
flavorText: A set of sturdy dinner plates fashioned from genuine mudcrab shells and engraved with Wood Elf symbology.
name: Mudcrab Shell Dinner Plates

title: Engraved Copper Plates
flavorText: A set of burnished copper flatware. Each piece has been stamped with the mark of the famous Argonian smith, Haj-Ja.
name: Engraved Copper Plates

title: Silver Etched Cake Platter
flavorText: The floral design etched into this cake platter is very elegant. You would not serve just any cake on this platter.
name: Silver Etched Cake Platter

title: Silver Carving Platter
flavorText: Heirloom silver carving platter, it bears the crest of a specific family of wealth and means.
name: Silver Carving Platter

title: Swamp Eel Serving Platter
flavorText: A large, ornate platter, traditionally used to present and serve roasted swamp eel at Argonian feasts.
name: Swamp Eel Serving Platter

title: Pejureel's Party Platter
flavorText: Chef Pejureel in Dhalmora sells a surprising number of these turtle-shell platters. Perfect for any party.
name: Pejureel's Party Platter

title: Bleakrock Crow Trio Platter
flavorText: A platter designed to serve crow three ways: stuffed, roasted, and boiled. Crafted by the artisans of Thonarcal's Timberworks.
name: Bleakrock Crow Trio Platter

title: Hallin's Stand Silver Platter
flavorText: This large silver platter is engraved with an image of the majestic city in Southern Bangkorai.
name: Hallin's Stand Silver Platter

title: Mudcrab Serving Platter
flavorText: This broad silver platter has several indentations for propping up steamed mudcrabs.
name: Mudcrab Serving Platter

title: Kerbol's Serving Platter
flavorText: The town of Kerbol's Hollow is known for its communal feasts, for which the mayor purchased many golden serving platters.
name: Kerbol's Serving Platter

title: Silver Serving Platter
flavorText: A grand silver platter with an etched rendering of Elinhir on the face.
name: Silver Serving Platter

title: Red Brittle Serving Platter
flavorText: A beautiful platter crafted from red brittle, probably from before the dangers of unstable nirncrux were fully documented.
name: Red Brittle Serving Platter

title: Guar Roast Serving Platter
flavorText: A large, ornate platter, traditionally used to present and serve roast guar meat at Dark Elf dinner festivals.
name: Guar Roast Serving Platter

title: Pinewood Party Platter
flavorText: A large, rectangular platter of pinewood, perfect for piling high with Nord delicacies for the next Konunleikar.
name: Pinewood Party Platter

title: Jarl's Silver Carving Platter
flavorText: Commemorative silver carving platters, bearing the crest of a specific jarl, are crafted on his or her coronation day.
name: Jarl's Silver Carving Platter

title: Roast Peacock Serving Platter
flavorText: A large, ornate platter, traditionally used to present and serve peacock roasts prepared for High Elf festivals and banquets.
name: Roast Peacock Serving Platter

title: Spiced Brewet Serving Platter
flavorText: A large, ornate platter, traditionally used to present and serve beef roasts prepared in wine and spices for Breton holidays.
name: Spiced Brewet Serving Platter

title: Antique "Fort Zantonius" Serving Platter
flavorText: Antique Imperial brass serving platter, with wooden handles, engraved with an image of (now-ruined) Fort Zantonius in its prime.
name: Antique "Fort Zantonius" Serving Platter

title: Deepwoods Thunderbug Serving Platter
flavorText: Serving platter of lacquered thunderbug carapace, painted to depict the Green Lady Shrine in Deepwoods.
name: Deepwoods Thunderbug Serving Platter

title: Mahogany "Dancing Duo" Serving Platter
flavorText: Serving platter of imported mahogany, painted with a stylized depiction of Silvenar and Green Lady dancing a sarabande.
name: Mahogany "Dancing Duo" Serving Platter

title: Two Moons Platter
flavorText: A silver-plated platter embossed with the images of Jone and Jode.
name: Two Moons Platter

title: Redguard Salted Mutton Platter
flavorText: A platter designed to serve salted mutton, made in the distinctive style of the crafters of Sentinel.
name: Redguard Salted Mutton Platter

title: Ash Mountain Serving Platter
flavorText: Silverware platter with decorative engraving, inscribed "View of Ash Mountain from Senie, with Windmill."
name: Ash Mountain Serving Platter

title: "Eel-Strangler" Serving Platter
flavorText: Traditional platter depicting a triumphant Lord Zuthorix the Eel-Strangler, who slew his enemies with conger-eel garrottes.
name: "Eel-Strangler" Serving Platter

title: Nord Salted Mutton Platter
flavorText: A platter designed to serve salted mutton, made in the distinctive style of the crafters of Riften.
name: Nord Salted Mutton Platter

title: Framed Duchess Portrait
flavorText: This painting features the late Duchess of Wind Keep—a beautiful woman with eyes that betray a quiet grief.
name: Framed Duchess Portrait

title: Wax Portrait Card
flavorText: This wax portrait card depicts simple but compelling artwork. A fence could resell this to collectors.
name: Wax Portrait Card

title: Small Canvas Portrait
flavorText: The man in this portrait has eyes that follow you. Luckily, it is small enough to be shoved in a bag before becoming too creepy.
name: Small Canvas Portrait

title: Firsthold Painting
flavorText: A richly textured oil painting of the first settlement of Auridon.
name: Firsthold Painting

title: Vulkhel Guard Harbor Painting
flavorText: The detail of this painting is so vivid, one can practically hear the waves lapping against the docks.
name: Vulkhel Guard Harbor Painting

title: Saint Pelin's Portrait
flavorText: This striking portrait of Saint Pelin is one of several that formerly lined the halls of Bangkorai Garrison.
name: Saint Pelin's Portrait

title: Disquieting Family Portrait
flavorText: A somewhat disturbing portrait. Perhaps it's the way their eyes follow you. Or the rictus grins. Or the additional tail.
name: Disquieting Family Portrait

title: Narsis Dren Portrait
flavorText: This signed, limited-edition portrait of the famed Dark Elf dungeon-delver can be found in the nightstands of ardent admirers.
name: Narsis Dren Portrait

title: Risque Boudoir Portrait
flavorText: A portrait of a buxom young Nord wearing nothing but a horned helmet and a provocative smile.
name: Risque Boudoir Portrait

title: The Brief Queen in Profile
flavorText: A portrait of Queen Nurnhilde, dressed in full battle regalia, depicting her calm reflection before the siege of Windhelm.
name: The Brief Queen in Profile

title: Queen Mabjaarn's Risque Etching
flavorText: Wild and carefree before taking up the crown, this revealing etching of Mabjaarn Flame-Hair is credited to Fjokki the Bard.
name: Queen Mabjaarn's Risque Etching

title: Hectahame Sketch
flavorText: An artist's rendering of the mysterious ruin of Hectahame.
name: Hectahame Sketch

title: "Cheesemaker of Goldfolly" Engraving
flavorText: Framed engraving of the famous scene showing the making of bat-cheese from the long-lost giant dairy bats of Goldfolly.
name: "Cheesemaker of Goldfolly" Engraving

title: Portrait of the Mane
flavorText: The great spiritual leader of the Khajiit is here captured in simple artistic style.
name: Portrait of the Mane

title: Painting of the Westwind Lighthouse
flavorText: Framed oil painting of the famous Westwind Lighthouse, signed by the artist, Romain Jurard.
name: Painting of the Westwind Lighthouse

title: Painting of the Unknown Queen
flavorText: A hauntingly beautiful woman stares out from this painting, known only as the Unknown Queen. Every wealthy household has a copy.
name: Painting of the Unknown Queen

title: Disturbing Argonian Portrait
flavorText: An Argonian family portrait, you find something mildly disquieting about the way the eyes follow you as you move.
name: Disturbing Argonian Portrait

title: Telvanni Wizard-Painting of Heimlyn Keep
flavorText: Magical three-dimensional painting of Heimlyn Keep, quite old, signed "Keeper Vildras Telvanni."
name: Telvanni Wizard-Painting of Heimlyn Keep

title: Painting of "The Slave-Coffles of Thorn"
flavorText: Small reproduction of the popular and heartbreaking silhouette-painting of the infamous House Dres slave-raid on Thorn.
name: Painting of "The Slave-Coffles of Thorn"

title: Painting of the Brief Queen
flavorText: A hauntingly beautiful Queen Nurnhilde stares out from this painting. Every wealthy household owns a copy of the Brief Queen.
name: Painting of the Brief Queen

title: Gold-Framed "Two Beacons" Diptych
flavorText: Diptych, two oil paintings in a dual gilded frame, one of the South Beacon at dawn, the other of the North Beacon at night.
name: Gold-Framed "Two Beacons" Diptych

title: Painting of the First Altmeri Landfall
flavorText: Gilded sunwood framing an oil painting depicting the ships from Aldmeris at Nine Prow Landing, with Torinaan stepping ashore.
name: Painting of the First Altmeri Landfall

title: Wilderking Sketch
flavorText: A rare sketch of the legendary Wilderking, and worth a great deal to collectors and myth-hunters.
name: Wilderking Sketch

title: Miniature Portrait of Queen Ayrenn
flavorText: The queen has never looked more stunning in two dimensions than in this locket-sized portrait.
name: Miniature Portrait of Queen Ayrenn

title: Framed Snowflake Display
flavorText: A framed display of various snowflakes, lovingly mounted and catalogued by a diligent Nord—before they melted.
name: Framed Snowflake Display

title: Decorative Cheese Crock
flavorText: A heavy, earthenware crock tinged with gold, designed to store strong and pungent cheeses for later consumption.
name: Decorative Cheese Crock

title: Gold-Tinged Nord Cheese Crock
flavorText: A heavy earthenware crock tinged with gold, designed to store strong and pungent Nordic cheeses—without stinking up the house.
name: Gold-Tinged Nord Cheese Crock

title: Fine Porcelain Chamber Pot
flavorText: A prime example of High Elf craftsmanship, this pot appears to have been recently cleaned. The only scent you detect is roses.
name: Fine Porcelain Chamber Pot

title: Saint Pelin's Chamber Pot
flavorText: This silver chamber pot was made by the Knights of Saint Pelin as a gift for wealthy donors among Evermore's nobility.
name: Saint Pelin's Chamber Pot

title: Covenant Chamber Pot
flavorText: This silver plated chamber pot is engraved with the symbol of the Daggerfall Covenant. Fortunately, it has never been used.
name: Covenant Chamber Pot

title: Ceramic Dark Elf Chamber Pot
flavorText: A lavishly decorated chamber pot of rich Morrowind earthenware, only slightly used.
name: Ceramic Dark Elf Chamber Pot

title: Royal Camoran Travel Teapot
flavorText: Self-heating brass travel pot for boiling beetle-tea, bearing the sigil of the Royal House of Camoran.
name: Royal Camoran Travel Teapot

title: Ceramic Shornhelm Chamber Pot
flavorText: A lavishly decorated chamber pot of rich Breton earthenware, only slightly used.
name: Ceramic Shornhelm Chamber Pot

title: Copper Saltrice Steamer
flavorText: Copper-bottomed double-boiler steamer, engraved with the motto "The Finest Saltrice comes from Sathram!"
name: Copper Saltrice Steamer

title: Khajiiti Cast-Iron Baking Pot
flavorText: Cast-iron casserole pot with cover for slow-baking sweet pastries, labeled "Property of Sathram Slave Quarters."
name: Khajiiti Cast-Iron Baking Pot

title: Kragenmoor Cook Pot
flavorText: A distinctive cooking vessel with a square opening and a round base, it appeals to the aesthetics of the Elves of House Dres.
name: Kragenmoor Cook Pot

title: Earthenware Riften Chamber Pot
flavorText: A lavishly decorated chamber pot of rich earthenware in the Nordic design, never used. You think.
name: Earthenware Riften Chamber Pot

title: Nord Fondue Pot
flavorText: A small copper pot used to serve melted cheese, and eaten by dipping bread into it with long-stemmed forks.
name: Nord Fondue Pot

title: First Era Dunmeri Tea Service
flavorText: An antique tea service from the First Era, obviously a Dark Elf family heirloom.
name: First Era Dunmeri Tea Service

title: Tamrith's Favorite Tea Pot
flavorText: House Tamrith uses only imported Alik'r tea pots such as this one, sold exclusively at Broken-Yoke Mercantile in Shornhelm.
name: Tamrith's Favorite Tea Pot

title: Marcy's Kawala Tea
flavorText: This packet of tea comes with its own tea strainer, because the Kawala Tea of Marcy is not strained.
name: Marcy's Kawala Tea

title: Porcelain Teapot
flavorText: A unique mixture of clay was heated until it became smooth and translucent and then meticulously painted to create this teapot.
name: Porcelain Teapot

title: Antique Khajiiti Teapot
flavorText: This finely polished teapot is covered in Khajiiti motifs and smells faintly of sweet grass.
name: Antique Khajiiti Teapot

title: Pouch of Bronzed Acorns
flavorText: While it's not clear what purpose they served, this handful of acorns is secured by the drawstring of this satin pouch.
name: Pouch of Bronzed Acorns

title: Concealed Valuables Pouch
flavorText: A black silk pouch with attached hooks and wires, allowing it to be hidden within a variety of furniture.
name: Concealed Valuables Pouch

title: Redguard Messenger Pouch
flavorText: A large messenger pouch bearing the water symbol of Ra'Gada, the Warrior Wave. Used to carry letters and other correspondence.
name: Redguard Messenger Pouch

title: Embroidered Purse
flavorText: A supple leather pouch with a fish embroidery stitched in fine blue thread.
name: Embroidered Purse

title: Pouch of Candied Gorapples
flavorText: The contents of this pouch are pungent and inedible. Some thieves use them to throw off the scent of pursuing animals.
name: Pouch of Candied Gorapples

title: First Teeth Pouch
flavorText: A satin draw-string "First Teeth" pouch, in the Imperial tradition. It could be resold once the teeth inside are discarded.
name: First Teeth Pouch

title: Royal Correspondence Pouch
flavorText: King Emeric and Duke Nathaniel often exchange their correspondences in fancy leather pouches.
name: Royal Correspondence Pouch

title: Leather Pouch
flavorText: Typically used to hold coins, this pouch has already been relieved of its contents. The fine leather might be worth something.
name: Leather Pouch

title: Undead Expulsion Pouch
flavorText: A small pouch containing blessed items. It is said to ward off some types of undead creatures.
name: Undead Expulsion Pouch

title: Lamia-Scale Moon-Sugar Pouch
flavorText: A pouch used for keeping moon-sugar safe and dry. Its Lamia-scale construction is illegal throughout most of Tamriel.
name: Lamia-Scale Moon-Sugar Pouch

title: Satakalaam Love Pouch
flavorText: Satakalaam nobles anonymously place scintillating notes in each others' love pouches as part of a bizarre adult game.
name: Satakalaam Love Pouch

title: Kindlepitch Powder Pouch
flavorText: A pouch made specifically to carry kindlepitch powder, the quartermasters of Fort Zeren designed it to be fire resistant.
name: Kindlepitch Powder Pouch

title: Linnea's Wolf's Blight
flavorText: The Bleakrock alchemist makes extra gold selling pouches filled with various herbs that supposedly ward off wolves.
name: Linnea's Wolf's Blight

title: Pouch of Parrot Food
flavorText: Captain Lerisa's love of pets is well-known. This mixture of exotic seeds and nuts was made special for her prized parrots.
name: Pouch of Parrot Food

title: Troll-Hair Kindling Pouch
flavorText: The troll hair in this pouch makes it much easier to start a fire in the wilds.
name: Troll-Hair Kindling Pouch

title: Pact Correspondence Pouch
flavorText: The leaders of the Ebonheart Pact often exchange important correspondences in fancy leather pouches.
name: Pact Correspondence Pouch

title: Kindlepitch Pouch
flavorText: A pouch of kindlepitch, for igniting fires when you don't feel like using steel and flint.
name: Kindlepitch Pouch

title: Dragonscale Purse
flavorText: This small purse, purported to be made of real Dragon scale, features a silver clasp in the form of a stylized Dragon.
name: Dragonscale Purse

title: Giantskin Pouch
flavorText: Nord clerics who follow the older traditions use these bags to hold ritual components for religious ceremonies.
name: Giantskin Pouch

title: Bag of Gemstones
flavorText: These gemstones should sell nicely on the black market.
name: Bag of Gemstones

title: Deerskin Gold Pouch
flavorText: A small pouch made of embroidered deerskin, designed to hold gold or other valuables.
name: Deerskin Gold Pouch

title: Dominion Envoy's Official Security Pouch
flavorText: Sealable message pouch of waterproof leviathan hide displaying the golden eagle of the Dominion, for envoy's correspondence.
name: Dominion Envoy's Official Security Pouch

title: Camoran Dynasty Private Stock Bugsmoke
flavorText: Pouch containing a double-handful of the special bugsmoke mix prepared exclusively for the royal family.
name: Camoran Dynasty Private Stock Bugsmoke

title: "Where's Falinesti?" Boardgame
flavorText: Folding boiled-leather board with pouch of turquoise game pieces for the "Where's Falinesti?" casual boardgame.
name: "Where's Falinesti?" Boardgame

title: Bosmeri Noble's Omnium-Gatherum
flavorText: Combination folding corkscrew, pipe-cleaner, and crystal quizzing glass, with the crest of House Caerllin, in a chamois pouch.
name: Bosmeri Noble's Omnium-Gatherum

title: "Traitor's Tor" Game
flavorText: A travel-sized version of the strategy game that recreates the last battle in Ranser's War.
name: "Traitor's Tor" Game

title: Secreted Valuables Pouch
flavorText: A cleverly designed pouch designed to be hidden within clothing so as to avoid the attention of pickpockets.
name: Secreted Valuables Pouch

title: Firestarter Kit in Waterproof Pouch
flavorText: Waterproof pig-bladder pouch labeled "Oldgate Meat Hut" containing flint, steel, and a quantity of tinder.
name: Firestarter Kit in Waterproof Pouch

title: Orkey's Undead Ouster
flavorText: A small pouch containing items blessed by a priest of Orkey, it is said to ward off all sorts of undead creatures.
name: Orkey's Undead Ouster

title: Fine Leather Coin Purse
flavorText: Someone spent a great deal of gold here. Judging by the state of the linens, it's best not to think about what they spent it on.
name: Fine Leather Coin Purse

title: Argonian Tail Stocking
flavorText: A specialty item with strategically placed pouches to hold warmed stones. Some Argonians just can't abide a cold tail.
name: Argonian Tail Stocking

title: Mantikora Teeth
flavorText: A fine leather pouch filled with the massive molars of a full-grown mantikora.
name: Mantikora Teeth

title: Pouch of Thumb Tacks
flavorText: This pouch of thumb tacks can be used to post handbills, keep maps in place, or cause great amounts of posterior distress.
name: Pouch of Thumb Tacks

title: Lizardskin Wallet
flavorText: A wallet crafted from soft, fine lizardskin.
name: Lizardskin Wallet

title: Gargoyle-Skin Wallet
flavorText: Fashioned from the hardened skin of a gargoyle, this wallet could stop an arrow from piercing one's heart.
name: Gargoyle-Skin Wallet

title: Errinorne Impskin Wallet
flavorText: Pouch-wallet of finest lavender impskin, embossed with the sigil of House Errinorne of Skywatch.
name: Errinorne Impskin Wallet

title: Antique Riding Crop
flavorText: A polished, well-made riding crop, from early in the Second Era. Many are stored away as heirlooms by Dark Elf families.
name: Antique Riding Crop

title: Red Asp Riding Crop
flavorText: When he wants to make an impression, Ufa the Red Asp wields an ornate leather riding crop decorated with rubies and silver trim.
name: Red Asp Riding Crop

title: Suthay-raht Riding Crop
flavorText: Riding crop made of a tanned and cured Khajiit's tail, ending in six short knotted leather strips.
name: Suthay-raht Riding Crop

title: Riding Crop Heirloom
flavorText: An elaborate riding crop, at least a century old. The suggestive patterning implies it never saw the inside of a stable.
name: Riding Crop Heirloom

title: Guar-Mount Riding Crop
flavorText: Jointed shalk-leg riding crop made for steering a guar by flicking its cheeks, inscribed "Sulfur Pools Farm."
name: Guar-Mount Riding Crop

title: Knotted-Rope Frame
flavorText: The pieces of knotted rope set in this small frame depicts various types of nautical knots.
name: Knotted-Rope Frame

title: Silk Rope
flavorText: A strong and lightweight coil of rope.
name: Silk Rope

title: Cyrodiil Battle Tassel
flavorText: The distinctive tassel is often worn for luck by warriors preparing to enter battle in war-torn Cyrodiil.
name: Cyrodiil Battle Tassel

title: Rock-Climbing Gear
flavorText: Explorers and adventurers could find great use for this gear.
name: Rock-Climbing Gear

title: Kinhouse Tassel
flavorText: A tassel hung from clothing to denote a Dark Elf's rank in his or her particular kinhouse.
name: Kinhouse Tassel

title: Sheep's Gut Rope
flavorText: Rope woven from sheep's gut, extra strong.
name: Sheep's Gut Rope

title: Crosswych Knotted Rope
flavorText: A length of rope featuring Crosswych knots tied off at regular intervals, making it excellent for climbing.
name: Crosswych Knotted Rope

title: Spelunking Tools
flavorText: Valuable to any adventurer or cave delver, these spelunking tools are in excellent condition.
name: Spelunking Tools

title: Stout Grass Rope
flavorText: A coil of strong, fibrous rope. This sturdy weave is an old Argonian secret.
name: Stout Grass Rope

title: Spool of Twine
flavorText: This tightly wound spool of twine has many uses, although its original owner probably used it to tie packets of letters.
name: Spool of Twine

title: Spidersilk Twine
flavorText: A coil of rope braided from a thousand strands of silk meticulously gathered from spiders' webs.
name: Spidersilk Twine

title: Senche-Skin Overnight Bag
flavorText: This fancy luggage item is made from the skin of a senche-tiger. The tiger's claws and teeth are used as fasteners.
name: Senche-Skin Overnight Bag

title: Ruby-Studded Book Bag
flavorText: A lavishly decorated sack for carrying around books or other personal objects. It bears the symbol of House Hlaalu.
name: Ruby-Studded Book Bag

title: White Crocodile Hide Valise
flavorText: A medium-sized travel bag fashioned from the hide of an extremely rare white crocodile.
name: White Crocodile Hide Valise

title: Sabre-Skin Caddy Sack
flavorText: A small sack made of oiled sabre-cat skin, perfect for holding and organizing personal items.
name: Sabre-Skin Caddy Sack

title: Amethyst-Studded Correspondence Bag
flavorText: A lavishly decorated sack for carrying letters and other correspondence, it bears the symbol of the Aldmeri Dominion.
name: Amethyst-Studded Correspondence Bag

title: Sapphire-Studded Book Bag
flavorText: A lavishly decorated sack for carrying around books or other personal objects. It bears the symbol of the Daggerfall Covenant.
name: Sapphire-Studded Book Bag

title: Aswala Grandee's Saddle
flavorText: To promote their horse-breeds, the Aswala family gifted these bejeweled saddles to several prominent nobles.
name: Aswala Grandee's Saddle

title: Knights of Saint Pelin Saddle
flavorText: This weathered saddle was made for the Knights of Saint Pelin.
name: Knights of Saint Pelin Saddle

title: Magus-General's Saddle
flavorText: This fancy Imperial saddle is made from fine leather and ebony adornments. It's also shaped to fit Septima Tharn's arse.
name: Magus-General's Saddle

title: Gem-Encrusted Guar Saddle
flavorText: This saddle, studded with precious gems and bearing the scales of House Hlaalu, is one of a select few gifted to master traders.
name: Gem-Encrusted Guar Saddle

title: Shornhelm Cavalry Saddle
flavorText: A saddle bearing the mark of the once-famous Shornhelm Cavalry that used to patrol the Rivenspire roads.
name: Shornhelm Cavalry Saddle

title: Dres Guar Saddle and Caparison
flavorText: Fancy silver-chased saddle and caparison for a riding guar, displaying the Kragenmoor Dres crest.
name: Dres Guar Saddle and Caparison

title: Riften Cavalry Saddle
flavorText: A saddle bearing the mark of the once-famous Riften Cavalry that used to patrol roads throughout the Rift.
