name: Riften Cavalry Saddle

title: Longhaven Saddle
flavorText: A master-crafted saddle that is as comfortable to sit on as its gold embroidery is valuable.
name: Longhaven Saddle

title: Red Rooks Missive
flavorText: This sealed scroll, emblazoned with the Red Rooks bandits' symbol, only retains its value to a fence if it remains unopened.
name: Red Rooks Missive

title: Polished Leather Scroll Case
flavorText: This scroll case still smells of ancient vellum and ink.
name: Polished Leather Scroll Case

title: Dwemer Grocery List
flavorText: This old list contains various ingredients that can no longer be found in Tamriel but may still be of interest to a historian.
name: Dwemer Grocery List

title: Perfumed Letter
flavorText: This heavily perfumed scroll contains a very suggestive missive from one noble to another. It is signed with a kiss.
name: Perfumed Letter

title: Scroll of the Lonely Traveler
flavorText: This parchment, neatly rolled and tied with leather, keeps adventurers company during long, lonely nights on the road.
name: Scroll of the Lonely Traveler

title: Fahara'jad Decree of Mercy
flavorText: Signed by King Fahara'jad, this document can get a criminal released from jail.
name: Fahara'jad Decree of Mercy

title: Elaborate Blueprints
flavorText: These sketches are the handiwork of the scholar, Neramo. The images depict the inner workings of a Dwemer automaton.
name: Elaborate Blueprints

title: Saint Pelin's Scroll Case
flavorText: The Knights of Saint Pelin maintain a library of obscure historical scrolls at Bangkorai Garrison.
name: Saint Pelin's Scroll Case

title: Tharn Family Scroll Case
flavorText: This ostentatious scroll case is used by members of the Empire's ruling family to exchange correspondences.
name: Tharn Family Scroll Case

title: Belkarth Broadsheet
flavorText: A broadsheet featuring news of Craglorn and the Three Banners War, published irregularly and often woefully out of date.
name: Belkarth Broadsheet

title: House Hlaalu Marque of Trade
flavorText: A House Hlaalu contract granting a merchant the right to conduct business throughout Deshaan until 31st Evening Star.
name: House Hlaalu Marque of Trade

title: House Redoran Commendation
flavorText: Scroll emblazoned with the House Redoran crest that bears a heartfelt commendation for an important service to the house.
name: House Redoran Commendation

title: Skald-King's Sonnet
flavorText: Jorunn rarely gets to flex his bardic muscles any more, but he sometimes pens a poem as an acknowledgment for a personal favor.
name: Skald-King's Sonnet

title: Seaside Sanctuary Harbor Rights
flavorText: A forger or a smuggler could make some coin selling these docking rights to Woodhearth's harbor.
name: Seaside Sanctuary Harbor Rights

title: Treaty Documents
flavorText: A copy of Dominion treaty documents, valuable to forgers.
name: Treaty Documents

title: Lion Guard List of Outrageous Offenses
flavorText: A list of personages currently out of favor with the Lion Guard.
name: Lion Guard List of Outrageous Offenses

title: Daggerfall Guard Patrol Schedule
flavorText: An unauthorized list of guard patrols and schedules for the Daggerfall Guard during the Bloodthorn crisis.
name: Daggerfall Guard Patrol Schedule

title: Royal Lineage Papers
flavorText: These official papers detail a distant claim to the Daggerfall throne. A clever fence could easily ransom these documents.
name: Royal Lineage Papers

title: Signed Heraldic Papers
flavorText: These blank heraldic papers are signed by the Daggerfall Court. They would be worth a fortune to a forger.
name: Signed Heraldic Papers

title: Inspirational Illuminations of the Light
flavorText: Every Breton's desk in Shornhelm has a list of inspirational quotes meaningful to the followers of the Light.
name: Inspirational Illuminations of the Light

title: Lineage of House Ranser
flavorText: These official papers detail a claim to the Shornhelm throne by a surviving yet distant relative of King Ranser.
name: Lineage of House Ranser

title: Dunmeri Travel Writing Instruments
flavorText: A case containing quills, inks, and parchment. Popularized by Morrowind natives, it is perfect for literate travelers on the go.
name: Dunmeri Travel Writing Instruments

title: Lineage of Clan Ironhand
flavorText: Official papers that detail a claim to the Skyrim throne by Clan Ironhand. Is someone trying to promote Thane Unnvald?
name: Lineage of Clan Ironhand

title: Signed Heraldic Document
flavorText: These blank heraldic documents are signed by Thane Unnvald of Riften. They would be worth a small fortune to a forger.
name: Signed Heraldic Document

title: Hand-Drawn Constellation Map
flavorText: A meticulously detailed map of the stars. The Warrior, Mage, and Thief are the most prominent constellations.
name: Hand-Drawn Constellation Map

title: Dragonstar Caravan Company Bill of Lading
flavorText: Transportation charges with a summary of cargo and weight for a single delivery. It could be valuable to smugglers.
name: Dragonstar Caravan Company Bill of Lading

title: Pewter Seal
flavorText: The owner of this seal probably feels very important when he uses it to stamp his initials into the wax that seals his letters.
name: Pewter Seal

title: Gold Coast Ink Stamp
flavorText: A stamp used by the Gold Coast Mercenaries to seal their correspondences.
name: Gold Coast Ink Stamp

title: Crown Seal
flavorText: This seal is used to mark correspondences between high-ranking Crown nobles.
name: Crown Seal

title: Garrison Commander's Seal
flavorText: A copy of the seal used by the Bangkorai Garrison's commander to correspond with Evermore.
name: Garrison Commander's Seal

title: King Eamond's Seal
flavorText: This seal was affixed to all of King Eamond's personal correspondences. It is extremely valuable to a forger.
name: King Eamond's Seal

title: Corporate Seal
flavorText: This heavy brass seal bears the mark of the Dragonstar Caravan Company.
name: Corporate Seal

title: Gladiator's Brand
flavorText: A strange Daedric seal. Rumor has it that gladiators of Dragonstar Arena all bear this mark.
name: Gladiator's Brand

title: Maulborn Plague Seal
flavorText: An engraved seal bearing the official stamp of the Maulborn, used to mark those afflicted with the Llodos plague.
name: Maulborn Plague Seal

title: Tribunal Temple Seal
flavorText: An official seal bearing the mark of the Tribunal Temple and used to identify temple correspondence.
name: Tribunal Temple Seal

title: Daggerfall Royal Stamp
flavorText: This official stamp belongs to Daggerfall's royal family. It could be extremely valuable to a forger.
name: Daggerfall Royal Stamp

title: Polished Woodblock Stamp
flavorText: This hand-carved stamp produces an ornate Khajiiti design when inked and pressed to paper.
name: Polished Woodblock Stamp

title: Dominion Customs Inspector's Tags
flavorText: A half-dozen Customs Inspector's cargo tags, marked "Pre-Inspected—Do Not Delay." A smuggler would pay a premium for these.
name: Dominion Customs Inspector's Tags

title: "Fists of Thalmor" Seal Stamp
flavorText: A bronze seal stamp embossed on its face with a "Fists of Thalmor" symbol.
name: "Fists of Thalmor" Seal Stamp

title: Great Seal of Silvenar
flavorText: Heavy, fist-sized silver stamp embossed with the Municipal Seal of Silvenar, which still shows traces of green wax from use.
name: Great Seal of Silvenar

title: Shornhelm Royal Stamp
flavorText: An official stamp used by the Triumvirate of Shornhelm. A forger would pay much for this.
name: Shornhelm Royal Stamp

title: Riften Jarl's Stamp
flavorText: An official stamp created especially for the jarls of Riften. Forgers would find this extremely valuable.
name: Riften Jarl's Stamp

title: Fallowstone Hall Signet Stamp
flavorText: A metal sealing wax stamp bearing the official seal of Fallowstone Hall.
name: Fallowstone Hall Signet Stamp

title: Blackcaster Mage Insignia
flavorText: A small seal that bears the image of one of the Apex Towers in Elinhir.
name: Blackcaster Mage Insignia

title: First Era Imperial Seal
flavorText: An ancient seal bearing the image of Saint Alessia. She's depicted cradling the mythical Amulet of Kings.
name: First Era Imperial Seal

title: Thalmor Signet Set
flavorText: A small gold case containing a set of official Thalmor signet stamps and a parcel of sealing wax.
name: Thalmor Signet Set

title: Sealing Wax
flavorText: A partially-melted stick of red wax, used for sealing letters.
name: Sealing Wax

title: Firebrand Sealing Wax
flavorText: The Knights of the Flame use this specific type of wax to seal their correspondences.
name: Firebrand Sealing Wax

title: House Hlaalu Sealing Wax
flavorText: A stick of sealing wax sold by the merchants of House Hlaalu and used throughout Deshaan and beyond.
name: House Hlaalu Sealing Wax

title: Leather Armor Wax
flavorText: Resplendent Protection in Aldcroft guarantees this wax will keep your leather smooth and supple.
name: Leather Armor Wax

title: Crimson Sealing Wax
flavorText: A stick of cherished Grahtwood beeswax, dyed a deep red.
name: Crimson Sealing Wax

title: Musk-Scented Sealing Wax
flavorText: A stick of pink insect wax with a pronounced musky aroma.
name: Musk-Scented Sealing Wax

title: Northpoint Sealing Wax
flavorText: A stick of sealing wax sold by the merchants of Northpoint and used throughout Rivenspire and beyond.
name: Northpoint Sealing Wax

title: Ritual Daedra Skull
flavorText: A Scamp skull, carved with strange glyphs and arcane symbols, most likely for unlawful ritualistic purposes.
name: Ritual Daedra Skull

title: Memento Mori
flavorText: A collection of personal mementos: a lock of hair, a small chip of bone, a scale fragment, and other sentimental items.
name: Memento Mori

title: Ornate Skull Goblet
flavorText: This was fashioned from the skull of a fallen Bloodthorn Cultist. At least they're good for something.
name: Ornate Skull Goblet

title: Troll Skull Slumgullion Serving Bowl
flavorText: Serving bowl made from a troll skull, with jawbone ladle, for serving Jaqspur's Slumgullion, i.e., Whatever-We-Caught-Soup.
name: Troll Skull Slumgullion Serving Bowl

title: Giant Bat Skull Paperweight
flavorText: Exotic paperweight made from the skull of a giant bat from Shadowfate Cavern.
name: Giant Bat Skull Paperweight

title: Decorative Goblin Skull with Ruby Eyes
flavorText: Painted ornamental Goblin skull, with ruby eyes, mounted on a plaque that reads, "Former Defiler of Hightide Hollow."
name: Decorative Goblin Skull with Ruby Eyes

title: Shrew-Skull Jar-Top Opener
flavorText: Fancy jar-top opener that uses the open-mouthed skull of a giant shrew, labeled "Courtesy of Beleth's Swamp Food."
name: Shrew-Skull Jar-Top Opener

title: Ornamental Crocodile Skull
flavorText: Superb decorated crocodile skull, ornamented with golden fangs, amethyst-geode eyes, and bird-of-paradise feathers.
name: Ornamental Crocodile Skull

title: Silken Arm-Sling
flavorText: This sling was crafted to help a wounded soldier care for a broken arm.
name: Silken Arm-Sling

title: Dunmeri Battle Sling
flavorText: A guar-hide sling designed to support injured arms while still allowing enough mobility to return a wounded Dark Elf to battle.
name: Dunmeri Battle Sling

title: Khajiit Tail Sling
flavorText: A snake-skin sling that supports the proud Khajiit tail. It protects tails from injury or cradles injured tails while they heal.
name: Khajiit Tail Sling

title: Orcish Battle Sling
flavorText: A crocodile-hide sling designed to support injured arms while still allowing enough mobility to return a wounded Orc to battle.
name: Orcish Battle Sling

title: Lion Guard Spyglass
flavorText: This spyglass, engraved with the Lion Guard crest, contains a secret compartment for carrying important items or documents.
name: Lion Guard Spyglass

title: Burnished Spyglass
flavorText: A finely polished collapsible telescope.
name: Burnished Spyglass

title: Gold Coast Spyglass
flavorText: This spyglass was originally intended for nautical use. The symbol of the Gold Coast Trading Company is stamped onto the side.
name: Gold Coast Spyglass

title: Commemorative Spyglass
flavorText: An expensive spyglass, handed out at a noble's party as a gift to favored guests.
name: Commemorative Spyglass

title: Brass Spyglass
flavorText: There's hardly a dent in this beautiful spyglass.
name: Brass Spyglass

title: Heavy Wooden Spyglass
flavorText: A gift from Bhosek to his most trusted lieutenants. While the wood is beautifully carved, the optics are far from precise.
name: Heavy Wooden Spyglass

title: Murcien's Spyglass
flavorText: Military officers stationed in Murcien's hamlet use these spyglasses to watch for signs from across the river in Evermore.
name: Murcien's Spyglass

title: Star-Gazer's Optical Instrument
flavorText: A spyglass specifically designed to gaze into the night sky and chart the movement of the stars.
name: Star-Gazer's Optical Instrument

title: Jaqspur Captain's Arboreal Spotting Scope
flavorText: Brass folding telescope with wristband, used by arboreal archers for spotting targets; made by Greenwarden Forge.
name: Jaqspur Captain's Arboreal Spotting Scope

title: Northpoint Commemorative Spyglass
flavorText: An expensive spyglass, sold in Northpoint and bearing the name and seal of the seafaring city on its polished wood casing.
name: Northpoint Commemorative Spyglass

title: Renrijra Captain's Perspective Glass
flavorText: Fine brass folding telescope of Khajiiti manufacture, marred slightly by salt-water corrosion.
name: Renrijra Captain's Perspective Glass

title: Jeweled Kaleidoscope
flavorText: A beautifully ornate kaleidoscope, trimmed in gold and encrusted with multicolored gems.
name: Jeweled Kaleidoscope

title: Colovian Cipher Device
flavorText: A brass cylinder of rotating disks, engraved with letters and connected by a central axle, used to decipher Colovian messages.
name: Colovian Cipher Device

title: Fahara'jad's Rod Replica
flavorText: A replica of the royal staff carried by King Fahara'jad, this rod is often given as a gift by Forebear nobles to their children.
name: Fahara'jad's Rod Replica

title: Carved Mahogany Walking Stick
flavorText: An elegant walking stick. Perfect for a low-impact Sundas stroll—or for making an impression at parties.
name: Carved Mahogany Walking Stick

title: Engraved Alik'r Walking Stick
flavorText: This is one of a handful of walking sticks King Fahara'jad gave as gifts to the nobles of Wayrest at his daughter's wedding.
name: Engraved Alik'r Walking Stick

title: Velothi Expedition-Staff
flavorText: A distinctive walking staff used by the Chimer during their migration to Morrowind following the prophet Veloth in antiquity.
name: Velothi Expedition-Staff

title: Tribunal Walking Stick
flavorText: Vivec gifted Jorunn and his thanes with ornate walking sticks, which were duplicated and sold to Windhelm's elite.
name: Tribunal Walking Stick

title: Troll Bone Measuring Stick
flavorText: This long, perfectly straight troll bone has been notched to help measure short lengths.
name: Troll Bone Measuring Stick

title: Star-Gazer's Walking Stick
flavorText: Sings-to-Stumps, a Belkarth carpenter, crafts these simple walking sticks for Star-Gazers and anyone who does a lot of walking.
name: Star-Gazer's Walking Stick

title: Mabrigash Walking Stick
flavorText: One of several walking sticks with carved symbols of the Ghost Snake. Provided as gifts by the Farseer Bodani.
name: Mabrigash Walking Stick

title: Measuring Wand
flavorText: A small length of tapered wood featuring incremental slashes used for determining the measure of things.
name: Measuring Wand

title: Dragon Cult Walking Stick
flavorText: This walking stick features a coiled Dragon wrapped around the shaft and probably belonged to an illegal worshiper of Alduin.
name: Dragon Cult Walking Stick

title: Crafter's Ruler
flavorText: Cuts-with-the-Grain swears by this measuring stick, which is engraved with the words "measure twice, cut once."
name: Crafter's Ruler

title: Sabre Cat Walking Stick
flavorText: A finely-crafted wooden walking stick with a silver tip and a handle carved in the appearance of a sabre cat's head.
name: Sabre Cat Walking Stick

title: Marble Bust of Prince Naemon
flavorText: Bust of Queen Ayrenn's younger brother sculpted from white marble by Aurelenya of Firsthold.
name: Marble Bust of Prince Naemon

title: Deadwood Knickknack
flavorText: A chunk of deadwood carved to resemble a monkey and mounted to a block for display, most likely by a Khajiit, just because.
name: Deadwood Knickknack

title: Ancient Saxhleel Statue
flavorText: Likely taken from one of the Argonian ruins near Hissmir, this statue depicts a crouching Argonian holding a stylized turtle.
name: Ancient Saxhleel Statue

title: Ebony Kwama Scrib
flavorText: This exquisite ebony statue, depicting the hero of the Dark Elf fairy tale, is part of a limited series by the sculptor Nerile.
name: Ebony Kwama Scrib

title: Volcanic Rock Kwama Scrib
flavorText: This exquisite statue, depicting the hero of the Dark Elf fairy tale, is part of a limited series by the sculptor Nerile.
name: Volcanic Rock Kwama Scrib

title: Brazen Minatory Ordinator Bust
flavorText: Brass bust of a disapproving ordinator; its eyes seem to follow one around the room.
name: Brazen Minatory Ordinator Bust

title: Yokudan House Idol
flavorText: An antique-looking statue, about the size of a wine glass, modeled after the house idols popular with the Yokudan people.
name: Yokudan House Idol

title: Indistinct Marble Bust
flavorText: This marble bust appears to be of a bald Elf. The features are too generic to make out who it is.
name: Indistinct Marble Bust

title: Sotha Sil Statuette of Dwarven Metal
flavorText: Dwarven-metal statuette of Sotha Sil as a Dwarven Centurion, inscribed "Crafted by Zephalas at Armature's Upheaval."
name: Sotha Sil Statuette of Dwarven Metal

title: Brothers of Strife Sculpture
flavorText: Sculpture depicting the Brothers of Strife, carved from a single large feldspar crystal.
name: Brothers of Strife Sculpture

title: Mother Morrowind Fertility Fetish
flavorText: Iridescent green-gold glassite statuette of a beatific Almalexia, arms crossed over her pregnant belly.
name: Mother Morrowind Fertility Fetish

title: Dibella's Bosom Night Favor
flavorText: A bust of the god of beauty and erotic instruction, kept in Nord bedchambers to make nightly activities more ... invigorating.
name: Dibella's Bosom Night Favor

title: Ever-Dipping Cliff Racer Statuette
flavorText: Exquisite hand-carved cliff-racer statuette that pivots on a hip-hinge, forever dipping its beak and then straightening up.
name: Ever-Dipping Cliff Racer Statuette

title: Whittled Cat Head
flavorText: A knob of wood whittled into the shape of a cat's head.
name: Whittled Cat Head

title: Golden Sword-Singer Bust
flavorText: This golden bust was modeled after the head of one of the most notable Sword-Singers in the history of the Alik'r.
name: Golden Sword-Singer Bust

title: Marble Bust of Queen Ayrenn
flavorText: Bust of the Queen of Alinor sculpted from white marble by Aurelenya of Firsthold.
name: Marble Bust of Queen Ayrenn

title: Thane Jeggi's Drinking Tankard
flavorText: A large, ornate flagon bearing the mark of Thane Jeggi Gap-Tooth. It is said he has these hidden throughout the Nine Holds.
name: Thane Jeggi's Drinking Tankard

title: Breton Travel Mug
flavorText: A sturdy pewter mug designed to withstand the rigors of travel. Decorated with symbols familiar to anyone from High Rock.
name: Breton Travel Mug

title: Antler-Fur's Choice Drinking Mug
flavorText: The select ale brewed at Fort Amol's Deldwine's Inn is only served in these mugs. They are decorated with tiny antlers.
name: Antler-Fur's Choice Drinking Mug

title: Double-Sided Nightcap Toasting Mug
flavorText: Rare double-sided amberware mug, used by kinlords and kinladies for toasting each other with a nightcap at bedtime.
name: Double-Sided Nightcap Toasting Mug

title: Rustic Wooden Mead Mugs
flavorText: Crafted by woodworkers at Sand and Dust, these oversized drinking vessels were popularized by Thane Unnvald at his inauguration.
name: Rustic Wooden Mead Mugs

title: House Baelborn Ornate Stein
flavorText: An ornate drinking vessel that bears the crest of House Baelborn of Glenumbra.
name: House Baelborn Ornate Stein

title: Engraved Stein
flavorText: A polished steel stein featuring an elaborate engraving of a man fighting a bear.
name: Engraved Stein

title: Pewter Beer Stein
flavorText: This stein could hold a substantial amount of refreshing liquid.
name: Pewter Beer Stein

title: Konunleikar Drinking Helm
flavorText: The Royal Crafters only made a handful of these commemorative helmets that feature four mugs of ale and a straw to drink from.
name: Konunleikar Drinking Helm

title: Altmer Travel Mug
flavorText: A sturdy drinking cup designed to withstand the rigors of travel, made of pewter or wood, and decorated with High Elf symbols.
name: Altmer Travel Mug

title: "Hearty Hoarvor" Jagga Tankard
flavorText: Tankard made of alit cuir bouilli infused with the distinctive aroma of jagga; displays the crest of the "Hearty Hoarvor."
name: "Hearty Hoarvor" Jagga Tankard

title: Ornate Dead Wolf Tankard
flavorText: The Dead Wolf Inn in Shornhelm uses specially crafted tankards engraved with the famous dead wolf with lolling tongue symbol.
name: Ornate Dead Wolf Tankard

title: Jester's Day Dribble Tankard
flavorText: Hilarious joke tankard with a dribble-hole below the brim, bearing the crest of The Sloshing Tankard Inn.
name: Jester's Day Dribble Tankard

title: Fell's Run Champion Mug
flavorText: A pewter tankard awarded to the weekly winner of the Fell's Run Drinking Competition.
name: Fell's Run Champion Mug

title: "Ebony Flask" Shein Stein
flavorText: Black-enameled limeware tankard with pewter lid, showing the sigil of the Ebony Flask in Ebonheart.
name: "Ebony Flask" Shein Stein

title: Flagon from the Withered Tree
flavorText: The famous tavern in Riften distributes these souvenir flagons featuring an engraving of a withered tree to favored customers.
name: Flagon from the Withered Tree

title: Ornate Tapped Vein Tankard
flavorText: The Tapped Vein Tavern in Shor's Stone uses specially crafted tankards engraved with the famous motto: Drink, Die, Drink Again.
name: Ornate Tapped Vein Tankard

title: Dragonstar Arena Tankard
flavorText: A gaudy drinking vessel bearing the symbols of the recently opened Dragonstar Arena, sold to audience members as souvenirs.
name: Dragonstar Arena Tankard

title: Nilata Crystal Shard
flavorText: This is a lifeless shard broken off an Ayleid crystal in the Nilata Ruins.
name: Nilata Crystal Shard

title: Glowing Shard
flavorText: A sharp glowing shard of arcane energy collected outside of Spellscar.
name: Glowing Shard

title: Slaughterfish Cooking Rock
flavorText: A wide, flat, well-oiled rock that makes a perfect cooking vessel for splayed slaughterfish, a Bleakrock delicacy.
name: Slaughterfish Cooking Rock

title: Piece of Fallen Sky
flavorText: This jagged chunk of cold, blue rock apparently fell out of the lights in the sky—along with other unusual objects.
name: Piece of Fallen Sky

title: Rare Fossil
flavorText: This well-preserved shell was likely found on the beaches outside Haven.
name: Rare Fossil

title: Carved Pumice Stone
flavorText: This block of abrasive rock has been carved to fit the hand, making it easier to erase ink from parchment.
name: Carved Pumice Stone

title: Ebony Whetstone
flavorText: This valuable whetstone once belonged to General Godrun.
name: Ebony Whetstone

title: Aldmeri Nautical Waystone
flavorText: A magical stone used to guide Aldmeri ships to their destinations in ancient times.
name: Aldmeri Nautical Waystone

title: Hoonding's Prayer Stone
flavorText: A smooth stone engraved with a quote: "Be resolute, fear no sacrifice, and surmount every difficulty to win victory."
name: Hoonding's Prayer Stone

title: Green Clay Eyepads
flavorText: Eyepads placed over the eyes at night to help prevent wrinkles. Less expensive than the magicka-infused variety used by nobles.
name: Green Clay Eyepads

title: Brightly Glowing Malondo Stone
flavorText: Nearly-depleted Malondo Stone emits a brilliant golden glow; engraved "Souvenir of Quendeluun."
name: Brightly Glowing Malondo Stone

title: Seamount Clan Law-Stone
flavorText: A lovingly polished stone that was engraved with all the laws of Clan Seamount. Use and age have rendered it illegible.
name: Seamount Clan Law-Stone

title: Chipped Stone from Skyshroud Barrow
flavorText: This piece of cracked masonry contains etchings that identify it as originating at Skyshroud Barrow in Bleakrock.
name: Chipped Stone from Skyshroud Barrow

title: Majolrun's Warming Bath Stones
flavorText: Majolrun of Bleakrock makes a nice side business by providing stones enchanted to keep bath water and bedsheets warm and comfy.
name: Majolrun's Warming Bath Stones

title: Cracked Yokudan Memory Stone
flavorText: Unstable images and vague, distant voices swirl and flicker around this broken relic.
name: Cracked Yokudan Memory Stone

title: Piece of the Palace of Ysgramor
flavorText: A chunk of stone from the damaged Palace of Ysgramor. A number of these have illegally found their way into Nord homes.
name: Piece of the Palace of Ysgramor

title: Lorkrata Hills Keepsake
flavorText: A small stone, possibly Ayleid in origin, found in the Lorkrata Hills and kept as a memento.
name: Lorkrata Hills Keepsake

title: Unusual Stone from the Lorkrata Hills
flavorText: This stone might be an Ayleid relic … or not. Stones of this kind are highly sought after for their colorful striations.
name: Unusual Stone from the Lorkrata Hills

title: Brothers of Strife Gemstone Bookends
flavorText: Sculptural bookends carved from chrysolite to look like the Brothers of Strife, leaning into a row of books from each end.
name: Brothers of Strife Gemstone Bookends

title: Unusual Stone from Northwind Mine
flavorText: This stone might be an ancient Dwemer relic … or not. Its strange glowing specks make it quite valuable.
name: Unusual Stone from Northwind Mine

title: Khenarthi's Roost Paperweight
flavorText: Chunk of rose quartz cut into the shape of the island, inscribed "Compliments of Mistral Treasury" on the bottom.
name: Khenarthi's Roost Paperweight

title: Corner of Bewan's Fabled Trinimac Altar
flavorText: Broken chunk of sculpted marble, glowing slightly, said to have come from Bewan's long-lost altar to Trinimac.
name: Corner of Bewan's Fabled Trinimac Altar

title: Orc Challenge Stone
flavorText: According to legend, an Orc would place this stone on his shoulder and dare an opponent to knock it off to accept a duel.
name: Orc Challenge Stone

title: Guardian Stone
flavorText: A greywacke stone depicting one of the three guardian constellations.
name: Guardian Stone

title: Depleted Welkynd Stone
flavorText: Dull welkynd stone, depleted of the ancient magicka that once made it glow, engraved with the Ayleidoon "L" for Loriasel.
name: Depleted Welkynd Stone

title: Signaling Sun Dial
flavorText: This sun dial serves two purposes: it tells time but also doubles as a heliograph to send messages across the battlefield.
name: Signaling Sun Dial

title: Kozanset Window Sundial
flavorText: This small sundial is designed to sit in a window and help the chefs at the Kozanset ovens monitor their cook-times.
name: Kozanset Window Sundial

title: Evermore Officer's Sundial
flavorText: This small sundial has diamonds on the gnomon. King Eamond required his generals carry these to ensure their punctuality.
name: Evermore Officer's Sundial

title: Silver Moondial
flavorText: This small silver tool is covered in stylized constellations that glow in the dark. It provides direction on moonless nights.
name: Silver Moondial

title: Shalk-Resin Window Sundial
flavorText: A sundial made of shalk resin, small enough to sit on a windowsill, used to track cooking times in complex Dunmeri recipes.
name: Shalk-Resin Window Sundial

title: Bronze Windowsill Sundial
flavorText: A sundial made of bronze, small enough to sit on a windowsill, used to track cooking times in complex Breton recipes.
name: Bronze Windowsill Sundial

title: Ebony Mephala Idol
flavorText: This priceless little idol is shaped like a spider and used in the secret worship of the Daedric Prince, Mephala.
name: Ebony Mephala Idol

title: Falinesti Idol
flavorText: A small carving of the mysterious moving tree of Falinesti.
name: Falinesti Idol

title: Golden Anvil of Zenithar
flavorText: A small, golden anvil, awarded to members in good standing of the Daggerfall Merchants Guild.
name: Golden Anvil of Zenithar

title: Carved Dragon Figurine
flavorText: A devotional carving representing the Dragon-god Akatosh.
name: Carved Dragon Figurine

title: Unknown Holy Symbol
flavorText: A religious icon from an earlier age, the god it represents has been long forgotten.
name: Unknown Holy Symbol

title: Oaken Fertility Totem
flavorText: This finely crafted icon was carved for Hunt-Wife Lurgush. It depicts a pregnant Orc holding a large acorn.
name: Oaken Fertility Totem

title: Star-Gazer's Lapel Pin
flavorText: An ornate pin, traditionally worn on the right side of the chest, that identifies the wearer as a member of the Star-Gazers.
name: Star-Gazer's Lapel Pin

title: Shad Astula Graduation Pin
flavorText: A pin given to students who complete their studies at the Shad Astula Academy of Magic.
name: Shad Astula Graduation Pin

title: Jarl's Best Sleeve Pin
flavorText: An ornate pin, traditionally worn on the right sleeve. It identifies the wearer as a favored servant of a jarl.
name: Jarl's Best Sleeve Pin

title: Gem-Studded Snowflake Hat Pin
flavorText: An exquisite hat-pin, shaped like a snowflake and studded with fine gems, is the perfect accompaniment to any bonnet.
name: Gem-Studded Snowflake Hat Pin

title: Treethane's Seal
flavorText: A replica of Treethane Fariel's official seal. A forger would find this quite valuable.
name: Treethane's Seal

title: Daggerfall Adventurers Club Lapel Pin
flavorText: An ornate pin, traditionally worn on the left collar, it identifies the wearer as a member of Daggerfall's Adventurers Club.
name: Daggerfall Adventurers Club Lapel Pin

title: One Lion Tooth Earring
flavorText: A single lion tooth earring, fashioned from semi-precious stones. Its mate appears to have been lost somewhere along the way.
name: One Lion Tooth Earring

title: Camoran Chamberlain Badge
flavorText: Platinum lapel badge displaying the sigil of the Camoran Dynasty, as worn by the royal chamberlains.
name: Camoran Chamberlain Badge

title: Thalmor Canonreeve's Sigil Pendant
flavorText: Jeweled eagle pendant worn as a symbol of office by a Canonreeve of the Thalmor.
name: Thalmor Canonreeve's Sigil Pendant

title: Treethane's Ceremonial Gorget
flavorText: Symbol of office, a Treethane's neckpiece, sporting an avian design picked out in iridescent feathers of green and turquoise.
name: Treethane's Ceremonial Gorget

title: Daggerfall Covenant Hair Pins
flavorText: Fancy hair pins bearing a lion, the symbol of the Daggerfall Covenant, found in homes throughout Rivenspire and beyond.
name: Daggerfall Covenant Hair Pins

title: House Tamrith Holy Symbol
flavorText: A religious icon bearing the crest of House Tamrith and the Light of Arkay symbol, sparingly distributed to house members.
name: House Tamrith Holy Symbol

title: Diamond-Studded Julianos Lapel Pin
flavorText: An exquisite lapel-pin, in the shape of Julianos' triangle and studded with diamonds, is a favorite accessory for any mage.
name: Diamond-Studded Julianos Lapel Pin

title: Hlaalu "Golden Scales" Paperweight
flavorText: Small gold paperweight in the form of a pair of scales, the symbol of House Hlaalu.
name: Hlaalu "Golden Scales" Paperweight

title: Ulathi Silver Spiderweb Armlet
flavorText: Jewelry of the Ulath Ashlanders, a fine silver armlet worked in the semblance of a spiderweb to honor Mephala.
name: Ulathi Silver Spiderweb Armlet

title: White Rose Warden's Knout Brooch
flavorText: White Rose Prison Warden's symbol of office, a platinum brooch in the shape of a truncheon ending in a short three-lashed whip.
name: White Rose Warden's Knout Brooch

title: First Era Rank Insignia
flavorText: A rank insignia bar from the First Era, when a now-forgotten king tried to fancify and standardize Nord military wear.
name: First Era Rank Insignia

title: Holy Symbol of Jhunal
flavorText: A religious icon bearing an owl, the symbol of the god of knowledge, it's rare to find one of these among the warlike Nords.
name: Holy Symbol of Jhunal

title: Diamond-Studded Kyne Lapel Pin
flavorText: An exquisite lapel-pin, in the shape of Kyne's soaring hawk and studded with diamonds, is a favorite accessory for any Nord.
name: Diamond-Studded Kyne Lapel Pin

title: Golden Azurah Icon
flavorText: Golden icon depicting Azurah as a Khajiit with eight-pointed pupils in her wide, oversized eyes.
name: Golden Azurah Icon

title: Royal Progress Commemorative Brooch
flavorText: Silver and diamond brooch worn to celebrate Queen Ayrenn's current Royal Progress through Auridon.
name: Royal Progress Commemorative Brooch

title: Royal Battlereeve's Command Baton
flavorText: This symbol of command for a Royal Battlereeve is fashioned of yellow sunwood and capped with a glowing Malondo Stone.
name: Royal Battlereeve's Command Baton

title: Gilt Star-Gazer Sigil
flavorText: A shining seal worn by senior members of the academic order known as the Star-Gazers.
name: Gilt Star-Gazer Sigil

title: Holy Symbol of Y'ffre
flavorText: This elaborately painted clay symbol molded into the shape of Y'ffre, the Forest God, was sparingly distributed to his priests, the "Spinners."
name: Holy Symbol of Y'ffre

title: Resolutes of Stendarr Pin
flavorText: A silver pin identifying its wearer as a member of the group "The Resolutes of Stendarr." A thief or a conman would prize this.
name: Resolutes of Stendarr Pin

title: Etched Troll Tooth
flavorText: A large tooth taken from the mouth of a troll. An unknown scrimshander etched Kyne's War Prayer into the enamel.
name: Etched Troll Tooth

title: Wooden Serpent Totem
flavorText: A rough-hewn totem shaped to resemble the Serpent constellation.
name: Wooden Serpent Totem

title: Bramble-Band of Brackenleaf's Briars
flavorText: Armband of living, interwoven bramble-vines. It symbolizes those brave enough to qualify as one of Brackenleaf's Briars.
name: Bramble-Band of Brackenleaf's Briars

title: Dibella Napkin Holders
flavorText: Each of these fashionable napkin holders was molded into a voluptuous depiction of the goddess of beauty.
name: Dibella Napkin Holders

title: Glass Spice Shakers
flavorText: A pair of spherical glass shakers painted to resemble the Tamrielic moons. They appear to be of Khajiiti origin.
name: Glass Spice Shakers

title: Exotic Bosmer Spice Shakers
flavorText: Something smells ... off ... about these spice shakers, but they should fetch a good price from gourmets.
name: Exotic Bosmer Spice Shakers

title: Matching Silver Spice Shakers
flavorText: A set of silver spice shakers, in stylized shapes of Knights of the Dragon. Made exclusively by Metalworks of Daggerfall.
name: Matching Silver Spice Shakers

title: Matching Ivory Spice Shakers
flavorText: A set of ivory spice shakers, in stylized shapes of bat-winged men. Considered to be in poor taste by certain Rivenspire nobles.
name: Matching Ivory Spice Shakers

title: Brothers of Strife Spice Shakers
flavorText: A set of matching spice containers fashioned to look like the Brothers of Strife statues in Stonefalls.
name: Brothers of Strife Spice Shakers

title: Matching Mammoth Tusk Spice Shakers
flavorText: Mammoth tusk spice shakers, in the stylized shapes of a fox and a bear. Made exclusively at the Ringing Anvil in Riften.
name: Matching Mammoth Tusk Spice Shakers

title: Argonian Spice Shaker
flavorText: A ceramic container with shaker holes in its lid, designed to hold spice and dispense small amounts.
name: Argonian Spice Shaker

title: Spider-Shaped Trivet
flavorText: A small metal plate, shaped like a spider, with short legs designed to protect a tabletop. This design is popular in Stonefalls.
name: Spider-Shaped Trivet

title: Carved Shell Dish
flavorText: This intricately carved seashell can be used as a tray to hold jewelry.
name: Carved Shell Dish

title: Porcelain Sheep Tureen
flavorText: The top of this well-crafted porcelain sheep can be removed to reveal its use as an elaborate serving dish.
name: Porcelain Sheep Tureen

title: Pewter Gravy Boat
flavorText: This gravy boat is shaped like an actual boat.
name: Pewter Gravy Boat

title: Glazed-Clay Nix-Hound Tureen
flavorText: The top of this well-crafted clay nix-hound can be removed to reveal its use as an elaborate serving dish.
name: Glazed-Clay Nix-Hound Tureen

title: Crocodile Gravy Boat
flavorText: A gravy boat in the shape of a crocodile, crafted by artisans from central Tamriel.
name: Crocodile Gravy Boat

title: Wasso-Leaf Napkins
flavorText: A roll of light and aromatic napkins fashioned from the leaves of a prized wasso plant.
name: Wasso-Leaf Napkins

title: Matching Imperial Spice Shakers
flavorText: A set of ivory spice shakers, in stylized shapes of Imperial Knights, made exclusively by crafters in Cyrodiil.
name: Matching Imperial Spice Shakers

title: Morrowind Fungus Grater
flavorText: Captain Rana had a number of these graters sent to Bleakrock so its residents would never be without perfect fungus shavings.
name: Morrowind Fungus Grater

title: Porcelain Beetle Tureen
flavorText: The top of this well-crafted porcelain beetle can be removed to reveal its use as an elaborate Wood Elf serving dish.
name: Porcelain Beetle Tureen

title: Silver Gravy Boat
flavorText: The craftsmanship of this vessel is exquisite. It appears to be the work of a Skywatch silversmith.
name: Silver Gravy Boat

title: Gargoyle Head Spice Shakers
flavorText: These gargoyle heads from southern Bangkorai were hollowed out to hold spices. The spice can be poured out from the eye sockets.
name: Gargoyle Head Spice Shakers

title: Eagle-Shaped Gravy Boat
flavorText: A simple, themed gravy boat. Useful and aesthetically pleasing.
name: Eagle-Shaped Gravy Boat

title: Dragon Gravy Boat
flavorText: A gravy boat in the shape of a Dragon, crafted by Ceramic Masterpieces of Skyrim.
name: Dragon Gravy Boat

title: Warped Oaken Flatware
flavorText: These plates appear to have been "sung" into existence using Wood Elf magic.
name: Warped Oaken Flatware

title: Three-Tier Serving Tower
flavorText: Made of clear glass, each tier of this serving tower is smaller than the preceding one.
name: Three-Tier Serving Tower

title: Glass Serving Tray
flavorText: This tray is carefully placed and bears a thin layer of dust.
name: Glass Serving Tray

title: Silver Tea Tray
flavorText: This tea tray has been polished so well you can see your reflection in it.
name: Silver Tea Tray

title: Cutting board
flavorText: A solid cutting board with only a few knife nicks in the wood.
name: Cutting board

title: Shellbug Jewelry Tray
flavorText: Polished to a smooth shine, this piece of Shellbug Chitin could be used to hold jewelry or coins.
name: Shellbug Jewelry Tray

title: Stoneware Serving Tray
flavorText: Perfect for bringing food to the table, this stoneware serving tray has a handle on each side for easy transportation.
name: Stoneware Serving Tray

title: Commemorative Pact Mudcrab Claw
flavorText: A mudcrab claw inscribed with the dragonhead of the Ebonheart Pact, Fetches-Glitter distributes these to honor the alliance.
name: Commemorative Pact Mudcrab Claw

title: Shrunken Hagraven Head
flavorText: An ancient, shrunken head of a Hagraven, thought by Reachmen to be a powerful talisman of good luck.
name: Shrunken Hagraven Head

title: Stonefire Molag Bal Effigy
flavorText: A likeness of Molag Bal, intricately carved from solid obsidian with ruby eyes. Used by Stonefire Cultists in dark ceremonies.
name: Stonefire Molag Bal Effigy

title: Lucky Wolf's Foot
flavorText: A huge wolf paw affixed to a sturdy iron chain. It would be worth much to bandits and other tacky dressers.
name: Lucky Wolf's Foot

title: Mummified Monkey Paw
flavorText: Considered an item of good fortune by the Wood Elves, this mummified monkey paw is nevertheless kind of creepy.
name: Mummified Monkey Paw

title: Ranser's Lucky Skeever's Foot
flavorText: One of the lucky charms enchanted by the court magician Reezal-Jul, this was likely carried into battle by King Ranser himself.
name: Ranser's Lucky Skeever's Foot

title: Red Squirrel Paw
flavorText: The preserved paw of a rare red squirrel, considered by many Khajiit to be a good luck charm.
name: Red Squirrel Paw

title: Temple Location Talisman
flavorText: A small charm, imbued with an enchantment that always points it toward the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
name: Temple Location Talisman

title: Hunter's Golden Charm
flavorText: This small golden bear figurine is said to have been blessed by Hircine himself.
name: Hunter's Golden Charm

title: Crocodile Charm
flavorText: A charm made from the skin and teeth of a crocodile. They are distributed to the Dro-Dara Plantation's most esteemed visitors.
name: Crocodile Charm

title: Iron Orc Arrow Head
flavorText: A souvenir from a battle or a lucky charm found in the wilderness, this arrowhead is clearly in the rough Iron Orc style.
name: Iron Orc Arrow Head

title: Deathclaw Ordure
flavorText: A hunter in Bleakrock sells these petrified piles produced by the giant bat as good luck charms of a sort.
name: Deathclaw Ordure

title: Breton Love Charm
flavorText: A charm believed to improve the love life, especially popular among Breton nobles and merchant lords.
name: Breton Love Charm

title: Blood-Curse Talisman
flavorText: A talisman sold in all of Rivenspire's cities, they began appearing shortly after the start of the so-called blood-curse.
name: Blood-Curse Talisman

title: Talisman of Saint Octavien
flavorText: Bronze talisman depicting the Breton Saint Octavien, a Priest of Arkay slain with a scythe by Daedra-worshipers.
name: Talisman of Saint Octavien

title: Blood-Curse Charm
flavorText: A talisman sold in the alley behind Occult Obsession in Shornhelm, it is said to ward off the blood-curse ravaging Rivenspire.
name: Blood-Curse Charm

title: Riften Location Talisman
flavorText: A small charm, imbued with an enchantment that always points it toward the city of Riften.
name: Riften Location Talisman

title: Giant's Lucky Thumb
flavorText: A petrified thumb, taken from an unlucky giant and now considered a good luck charm by some superstitious Nord.
name: Giant's Lucky Thumb

title: Viridian Tree Charm
flavorText: This charm is carved from soft wood and shaped like a tree. The tree's leaves are emeralds, making the charm extremely valuable.
name: Viridian Tree Charm

title: Mammoth's Tusk Lucky Charm
flavorText: The tip of a mammoth's tusk carved by Jorven Oldhammer, studded with nine bluesnow diamonds—one for each of the Nine Holds.
name: Mammoth's Tusk Lucky Charm

title: Amber Wyrd Charm
flavorText: A good luck charm crafted and blessed by the wyrd sisters. It is rare to find such a charm outside the forests of Daenia.
name: Amber Wyrd Charm

title: Charm of Ill Omens
flavorText: A small charm, reportedly found in Hozzin's Folly, it is said to bring dark thoughts and ill fortune to whoever possesses it.
name: Charm of Ill Omens

title: Deepcrag Kwama Charm
flavorText: This charm made from the chitin of a kwama warrior is one of several given to esteemed visitors to the Deepcrag Den kwama mine.
name: Deepcrag Kwama Charm

title: Oldgate Location Talisman
flavorText: A small charm, imbued with an enchantment that always points it toward Oldgate in Rivenspire.
name: Oldgate Location Talisman

title: Wyrd Sisters' Wolf Charm
flavorText: This hand-carved wooden wolf charm is sacred to the wyrd sisters of Viridian Wood.
name: Wyrd Sisters' Wolf Charm

title: Hunter's Hircine Good-Luck Talisman
flavorText: Small brass totem of an antlered Wood Elf, with a green gem pendant on its chest.
name: Hunter's Hircine Good-Luck Talisman

title: Winter Warding Talisman
flavorText: A talisman sold in back alleys, it supposedly keeps Argonians warm despite the cold of the Rift, but keep a blanket handy.
name: Winter Warding Talisman

title: Colorful Tapestry
flavorText: An elaborate woven tapestry depicting scenes of knights and mages doing battle with mudcrabs.
name: Colorful Tapestry

title: Tall Papa's Starry Tapestry
flavorText: This tapestry was fashioned by a Crown artisan to depict the starry sky over the desert.
name: Tall Papa's Starry Tapestry

title: Phaer Tapestry
flavorText: This tapestry is elegantly woven, depicting an idyllic scene in the village of Phaer.
name: Phaer Tapestry

title: Lighthouse Tapestry
flavorText: A finely woven tapestry depicting the Saintsport Lighthouse at dusk.
name: Lighthouse Tapestry

title: Saint Pelin's Fall Tapestry
flavorText: This tapestry depicts the heroic sacrifice made by Saint Pelin when an army of vampires sieged Bangkorai Garrison.
name: Saint Pelin's Fall Tapestry

title: Alik'r Bath Rug
flavorText: A fine bath rug, imported from a small boutique in Sentinel. It features an attractive yet simple Redguard design.
name: Alik'r Bath Rug

title: Oldgate Lancers Tapestry
flavorText: Rolled-up tapestry depicting the Oldgate Lancers in the Charge of the Shornhelm Knights at the Battle of Glenumbria Moors.
name: Oldgate Lancers Tapestry

title: Spidersilk Kragenmoor Tapestry
flavorText: Rolled-up tapestry of woven spidersilk depicting a street scene in Kragenmoor, with Dark Elves, guar, and Argonian slaves.
name: Spidersilk Kragenmoor Tapestry

title: White Rose Prison Tapestry
flavorText: Rolled-up Imperial tapestry depicting a fortification in a teeming swamp, embroidered "Souvenir of White Rose Prison."
name: White Rose Prison Tapestry

title: Errinorne Ancestry Tapestry
flavorText: Rolled-up tapestry depicting the noble ancestry of House Errinorne, dating back to the Late Merethic Era.
name: Errinorne Ancestry Tapestry

title: Royal Rilis Galliard Carpet
flavorText: Hand-knotted wool carpet used for dancing the Royal Rilis Galliard, with footprints indicating proper foot placement.
name: Royal Rilis Galliard Carpet

title: Woven Yokudan Rug
flavorText: A finely woven rug that depicts multiple images of warriors assuming bladed and unarmed fighting stances.
name: Woven Yokudan Rug

title: Do'Krin Monastary Tapestry
flavorText: A finely-woven tapestry depicting Alkosh, the First Cat, and the creation myth of the ja-Kha'jay, or Lunar Lattice.
name: Do'Krin Monastary Tapestry

title: Folding Lean-To
flavorText: A small, portable shelter with three cloth walls and a roof, used to create a quick camp in the wilderness.
name: Folding Lean-To

title: Folding Leather Tent
flavorText: This leather tent has been folded carefully to make it easy to transport.
name: Folding Leather Tent

title: Fort Zeren Tent
flavorText: A small, portable tent bearing the symbol of Fort Zeren.
name: Fort Zeren Tent

title: Fort Morvunskar Tent
flavorText: A small, portable tent bearing the symbol of Fort Morvunskar.
name: Fort Morvunskar Tent

title: Vinedusk Rangers Tent
flavorText: A small collapsible tent bearing the symbol of the Vinedusk Rangers.
name: Vinedusk Rangers Tent

title: Midnight Boot Polish
flavorText: This tin of boot polish was custom-made from exotic ingredients for Count Hosni at-Tura.
name: Midnight Boot Polish

title: Good Body's Unsightly Unguent
flavorText: A popular ointment that treats numerous bodily ailments, sold exclusively by a traveling merchant who arrives once every season.
name: Good Body's Unsightly Unguent

title: Golden Pill Tin
flavorText: A pill tin plated with solid gold, it must belong to a very wealthy sick person.
name: Golden Pill Tin

title: Seamount Clan Warpaint
flavorText: This dark green paint is thick and remarkably smooth. Perfect for decorating the craggy face of a Seamount warrior.
name: Seamount Clan Warpaint

title: Mystic's Majestic Face Cream
flavorText: No one knows what Bar-Beekus originally intended as the purpose of this emulsion, but Dark Elves love it as a moisturizer.
name: Mystic's Majestic Face Cream

title: Linnea's Luscious Foot Polish
flavorText: A popular foot ointment made and sold exclusively at Linnea's Liniments, it can even be found in homes as far away as Windhelm.
name: Linnea's Luscious Foot Polish

title: Bosmer Wood Polish
flavorText: An aromatic lacquer used to polish wooden tables and chairs.
name: Bosmer Wood Polish

title: Dark Witness Skulker's Paste
flavorText: A tin filled with a thick, black-blue paste. Used by the Dark Witness clan, primarily during night-time raids.
name: Dark Witness Skulker's Paste

title: Glenmoril Wyrd Leg Cologne
flavorText: The sisters of the Glenmoril Wyrd mix a pungent concoction of herbs and apply it to their legs for the pleasure of their wolves.
name: Glenmoril Wyrd Leg Cologne

title: Dark Witness War Paint
flavorText: This tin of deep blue war paint is a favorite among Reachmen from the Dark Witness clan.
name: Dark Witness War Paint

title: Aleeto's Soothing Lip Balm
flavorText: A salve that helps seal in moisture to protect lips from the drying effect of cold wind, concocted by Aleeto of Fort Amol.
name: Aleeto's Soothing Lip Balm

title: Untamed Elixirs Silvered Pill Tin
flavorText: A pill tin bearing the mark of the Untamed Elixirs alchemy shop in Shornhelm, provided to its most exclusive customers.
name: Untamed Elixirs Silvered Pill Tin

title: Scent of Serenity Silvered Pill Tin
flavorText: A pill tin bearing the mark of the Scent of Serenity alchemy shop in Riften, provided to its most exclusive customers.
name: Scent of Serenity Silvered Pill Tin

title: Jungle Camouflage
flavorText: Skin paint. Perfect for blending in with heavily foliaged terrain. It would be highly useful to an adventurer or mercenary.
name: Jungle Camouflage

title: Zuttag's Alchemical Kindlesticks
flavorText: A silver container of fire-lighting sticks tipped with kindlepitch, manufactured by the incomparable Zuttag the Alchemist.
name: Zuttag's Alchemical Kindlesticks

title: Vibrant Paint Set
flavorText: Three small tins tied together with a bit of string. Each cup contains one of the three primary colors: red, blue, or yellow.
name: Vibrant Paint Set

title: Prettifying Night Cream
flavorText: Imported from distant lands, this expensive moisturizing cream is believed to keep nobles looking young and beautiful.
name: Prettifying Night Cream

title: Motalion Reverence Token
flavorText: This valuable golden token was stolen from a crypt in the Motalion Necropolis.
name: Motalion Reverence Token

title: Malacath's Promise Token
flavorText: Orc clans in the Dragontail Mountains often leave these ebony tokens in places where they've sworn to return for revenge.
name: Malacath's Promise Token

title: Token of the Red Asp
flavorText: The Red Asp of Hallin's Stand gives tokens to those whom he feels he owes a personal favor.
name: Token of the Red Asp

title: Dragonstar Arena Token
flavorText: This token was used for betting at the Dragonstar Arena—until they stopped accepting tokens. Now it's a collectors item.
name: Dragonstar Arena Token

title: Dragonstar Caravan Company Obligation
flavorText: A token bearing the seal of the Dragonstar Caravan Company that identifies the bearer as owing a debt to the organization.
name: Dragonstar Caravan Company Obligation

title: Sober Nord Obligation
flavorText: A token bearing the mark of the Sober Nord in Windhelm. It identifies the bearer as carrying a tab at the tavern.
name: Sober Nord Obligation

title: Usurer's Obligation
flavorText: Esiree of Aldcroft distributes these tokens of obligation to remind customers of the debts they owe her.
name: Usurer's Obligation

title: Shor's Stones Tokens
flavorText: A collection of Shor's Stones tokens, obviously important to their owner, such as gaudy cloth patches and other nostalgic items.
name: Shor's Stones Tokens

title: Hadran's High Roller Chips
flavorText: The highest denomination of gambling chips from Hadran's Caravan, worth a great deal at the betting tables.
name: Hadran's High Roller Chips

title: Argonian Scale Scraper
flavorText: A metal blade especially designed to groom an Argonian's scaly body by removing mites, dirt, and residual build-up.
name: Argonian Scale Scraper

title: Great House Body Razor
flavorText: A sharp blade designed to maintain a Dark Elf's preferred smooth and hairless physique.
name: Great House Body Razor

title: Gorapple Peeler
flavorText: A double-bladed tool for peeling the skin from a gorapple or other fruits with hard skins.
name: Gorapple Peeler

title: Tooth Sharpener
flavorText: A tooth sharpener, employed by those who eat a great deal of meat.
name: Tooth Sharpener

title: Corkscrew-Handle Nail Knife
flavorText: A small, curved blade with a corkscrew handle, designed to keep an Orc's nails neat and trim.
name: Corkscrew-Handle Nail Knife

title: Claw Sharpeners
flavorText: These are very fine claw sharpeners, useful especially to Khajiit.
name: Claw Sharpeners

title: Clam-Shell File
flavorText: An attractive file used to dull (or sharpen) an Argonian's claws.
name: Clam-Shell File

title: Moon-Sugarcane Machete
flavorText: Broad-bladed steel tool for harvesting moon-sugarcane. "Windcatcher Plantation" is burned onto the haft.
name: Moon-Sugarcane Machete

title: Chrysamere Letter Opener
flavorText: This solid gold letter opener is a miniature replica of the ancient Paladin's Blade "Chrysamere."
name: Chrysamere Letter Opener

title: Elaborate Feather Lure
flavorText: This huge fishing lure looks far too large and ungainly to use. It's covered in beads, feathers, mirrors, and large steel hooks.
name: Elaborate Feather Lure

title: Sword Master's Letter Opener
flavorText: This letter opener, shaped like a scimitar with a ruby hilt, is presented to Redguard officers to open official correspondence.
name: Sword Master's Letter Opener

title: Do'Krin Monastary Candle Snuffer
flavorText: A sterling silver instrument bearing the imprint of the Do'Krin Monastary, used to safely extinguish candles.
name: Do'Krin Monastary Candle Snuffer

title: Blessed Spade
flavorText: This digging spade is decorated with semi-precious stones and was blessed by a priest of Zeht.
name: Blessed Spade

title: Lucky Foyen Dock Spike
flavorText: This heavy iron dock spike, engraved with the words "Foyen Docks" on one side, is considered to bring good luck to the bearer.
name: Lucky Foyen Dock Spike

title: Set of Kwama Scrib Dining Spikes
flavorText: Six quartz-handled spikes. Good for impaling kwama scribs to wooden plates so they may be eaten alive—as is tradition.
name: Set of Kwama Scrib Dining Spikes

title: Lead Sieve
flavorText: This lead sieve is used to strain liquids when cooking. A fence could resell it to skooma brewers.
name: Lead Sieve

title: King Emeric's Nosehair Trimmers
flavorText: Emeric's mother had several pairs of these small, Orichalcum scissors made to ensure her son was well-groomed.
name: King Emeric's Nosehair Trimmers

title: Silver Herb-Scissors
flavorText: These valuable scissors include multiple sets of blades to better shred herbs for cooking.
name: Silver Herb-Scissors

title: Nord Ear-Hair Clipper
flavorText: A set of tiny shears designed to keep a Nord's thick ear hairs neat and trim.
name: Nord Ear-Hair Clipper

title: Fur Grooming Kit
flavorText: The perfect kit for dapper cats and feline dandies.
name: Fur Grooming Kit

title: Left-handed Pincer-Crab Claw Scissors
flavorText: Scissors made from the howdy-claw of a Striped Pincer Crab, left-handed, with child-safe tips.
name: Left-handed Pincer-Crab Claw Scissors

title: Steel Farming Shears
flavorText: A critical tool in any farmer's arsenal, these shears are designed specifically to cut invasive vines.
name: Steel Farming Shears

title: Fish-Bone Shears
flavorText: This pair of fish-bone shears are remarkably light and very, very sharp.
name: Fish-Bone Shears

title: Ivory Shoehorn
flavorText: An expertly carved mammoth-tusk shoehorn.
name: Ivory Shoehorn

title: Giant Wasp Thorax Shoehorn
flavorText: Fancy and flexible shoehorn fashioned from the thorax of a giant wasp, with a long wasp-leg handle set with a blue zircon.
name: Giant Wasp Thorax Shoehorn

title: Saltrice Paddy Muck Shovel
flavorText: Muck shovel with a solid Nord-forged blade, and coralwood haft with "Hrogar's Hold" burned into the wood.
name: Saltrice Paddy Muck Shovel

title: Mud-House Dedicatory Shovel
flavorText: Ceremonial shovel used to add a final pat of muck to a mud-house, with "Forsaken Hamlet" crudely scrawled on the blade.
name: Mud-House Dedicatory Shovel

title: Ornamental Bone Saw
flavorText: A bone saw with an imported blade and an elaborate ivory handle inscribed "In Loving Memory."
name: Ornamental Bone Saw

title: Carpenter's Folding Saw
flavorText: Portable, folding wood-saw, with "Hammer and Saw, Shornhelm" etched on the handle.
name: Carpenter's Folding Saw

title: Glass Bone Saw
flavorText: Because sometimes amputation is the only option.
name: Glass Bone Saw

title: Copper Measures
flavorText: This set of fine copper measures is often used by merchants to charge by weight.
name: Copper Measures

title: Caravan Master's Scale
flavorText: Merchants claim this type of scale features a degree of accuracy that lesser instruments do not.
name: Caravan Master's Scale

title: Polished Dragon-Scale Writing Tablet
flavorText: The polished scale of some huge creature (probably a Dragon), used as a portable writing surface by some scholarly Nord.
name: Polished Dragon-Scale Writing Tablet

title: Oiled Straight-Razor
flavorText: This razor has been well-maintained. The wood appears imported, but the blade is clearly the work of Forge-Wife Glesh.
name: Oiled Straight-Razor

title: Scrib Pestle and Mortar
flavorText: A Dark Elf stone bowl and grinding tool, used to crush kwama scrib into a paste for cooking and alchemical preparations.
name: Scrib Pestle and Mortar

title: Marble Mortar and Pestle
flavorText: This tool is hewn from marble and very well-maintained. It still smells vaguely of mint and coriander.
name: Marble Mortar and Pestle

title: Torchbug Pestle and Mortar
flavorText: A stone bowl and grinding tool, used to crush torchbugs into a paste for cooking and alchemical preparations.
name: Torchbug Pestle and Mortar

title: Pearl-Handled Mudcrab Cracker
flavorText: This rare, jeweled mudcrab cracker is from a set used in the kitchen at the palace in Sentinel.
name: Pearl-Handled Mudcrab Cracker

title: Mudcrab Shell Cracker
flavorText: This essential Argonian tool for obtaining the succulent meat inside a steamed mudcrab can be found throughout Bal Foyen.
name: Mudcrab Shell Cracker

title: Centipede-Leg Writing Instrument
flavorText: A common but well-made pen, crafted using the leg of a centipede, can be found atop desks throughout Dhalmora and Bal Foyen.
name: Centipede-Leg Writing Instrument

title: Golden Writing Pen
flavorText: A gift from Sotha Sil to acolytes serving in the Tribunal Temple.
name: Golden Writing Pen

title: Explorer's Pick
flavorText: This sturdy pick was given to all of Headman Bhosek's engineers. It probably saw ample use outside the Bthzark ruins.
name: Explorer's Pick

title: Jade Fish Hook
flavorText: Despite its beauty, this fish hook has definitely seen some action.
name: Jade Fish Hook

title: Antique Sewing Kit
flavorText: Spools of fine thread and an array of steel needles rest inside this polished cherrywood kit.
name: Antique Sewing Kit

title: Burnished Steel Mess Kit
flavorText: This well-maintained kit bears Forge-Wife Glesh's mark. Its weight and sturdy construction are astonishing.
name: Burnished Steel Mess Kit

title: Orichalcum Work-Hammer
flavorText: A worker's hammer crafted from Orichalcum for extra durability.
name: Orichalcum Work-Hammer

title: Metal Back Scratcher
flavorText: A back scratcher for taking care of those hard-to-reach itches.
name: Metal Back Scratcher

title: Dra'bul Nail File with Turquoise Handle
flavorText: Turquoise-handled steel file forged in Dra'bul for smoothing nails or sharpening tusks.
name: Dra'bul Nail File with Turquoise Handle

title: Wrought-Iron Claw File
flavorText: A double-sided claw file. One side is coarse, the other fine. Engraving on the handle says "Moonfire Forge."
name: Wrought-Iron Claw File

title: Spool of Fishing Line
flavorText: This long spool of fishing line needs only to be attached to a rod in order to haul in a delicious meal.
name: Spool of Fishing Line

title: Bosmer Fishing Rod
flavorText: An ingenious mechanical fishing rod carved from bone.
name: Bosmer Fishing Rod

title: Extensible "Strangler Teaser" Pole
flavorText: Seven-part extensible rod of horn and antler, used by the youth of Karthdar in their charming game of "Strangler Teaser."
name: Extensible "Strangler Teaser" Pole

title: Boarbristle Brush
flavorText: This simple brush is surprisingly stiff. It could just as easily be used to brush a mount.
name: Boarbristle Brush

title: Wolf-Hair Ink Brush
flavorText: A fine brush with midnight black bristles. Supposedly the bristles are taken from pelts of Carved Hill wolves.
name: Wolf-Hair Ink Brush

title: Halcyon Hairbrush
flavorText: This hairbrush has a handle made of pearls from Halcyon Caverns.
name: Halcyon Hairbrush

title: Pearl-Handled Princess Hairbrush
flavorText: King Eamond gave Princess Elara a set of these beautiful hairbrushes for each of her birthdays.
name: Pearl-Handled Princess Hairbrush

title: Bone Carved Handbroom
flavorText: A Wood Elf's handbroom, carved from the bone of a small animal. Its bristles are hair.
name: Bone Carved Handbroom

title: Senche Whisker Brush
flavorText: The head of this beautifully carved ink brush is composed of hundreds of genuine Senche whiskers.
name: Senche Whisker Brush

title: Grooming Brush
flavorText: This bronzed Khajiiti hand-brush is perfect for grooming both fur and manes.
name: Grooming Brush

title: Senche-Jaw Hairbrush
flavorText: A hairbrush made from the jawbone of a senche-tiger.
name: Senche-Jaw Hairbrush

title: Pearl-Handled Hairbrush
flavorText: A fine quality hairbrush with a pearl handle. Upon closer inspection, the bristles appear to be made from giant whiskers.
name: Pearl-Handled Hairbrush

title: Cliff Darter Basting Bulb
flavorText: A cooking tool shaped like a cliff darter, it distributes liquid to moisten and flavor food during the cooking process.
name: Cliff Darter Basting Bulb

title: Tanglehaven Scalp-on-a-Stick
flavorText: Scalp dangling from an arm-bone, used for playing the traditional Tanglehaven game "Which Head, Whose Head?"
name: Tanglehaven Scalp-on-a-Stick

title: Rolling Bone Back Massager
flavorText: Bear-bone back massager made of six polished and clear-lacquered vertebrae in rolling sockets.
name: Rolling Bone Back Massager

title: Lizard-Fist Stormhold Auctioneer's Gavel
flavorText: Auctioneer's gavel made from an Argonian's fused-together fist bones, formerly used for officiating at House Dres slave sales.
name: Lizard-Fist Stormhold Auctioneer's Gavel

title: Brass Calipers
flavorText: These simple handheld calipers can be used to measure, grip, or hold down loose papers.
name: Brass Calipers

title: Asha'abah Roasting Tongs
flavorText: King Fahara'jad gifted several of these gold tongs to Ash'abah tribal leaders after they slew the infamous necromancer, Suturah.
name: Asha'abah Roasting Tongs

title: Orichalcum Milking Pail
flavorText: When the Orichalcum mines were showering gold on Wayrest, the king gifted pails like this to the region's prominent farmers.
name: Orichalcum Milking Pail

title: Bleakrock Snow Bucket
flavorText: A metal bucket with a lid, residents of Bleakrock fill it with anything they want to keep cold and then shove it into the snow.
name: Bleakrock Snow Bucket

title: Nord Scrimshander's Tools
flavorText: A set of tools used to carve large mammoth tusks, made in the Nordic style.
name: Nord Scrimshander's Tools

title: Scorpion Shell Peeler
flavorText: A double-bladed Wood Elf tool for peeling the carapace from a scorpion to get to the succulent meat inside.
name: Scorpion Shell Peeler

title: Blood-Orange Peeler
flavorText: A double-bladed tool for peeling the skin from a blood-orange or other fruits with hard rinds.
name: Blood-Orange Peeler

title: Brass Navigator's Quadrant
flavorText: Brass device used by a ship's navigator to help determine its location; engraved with the name "Albatross."
name: Brass Navigator's Quadrant

title: Corundum Tooth File
flavorText: A popular Wood Elf luxury item. Perfect for achieving a clean, predatory smile.
name: Corundum Tooth File

title: Crimson Cove Torrid Tango Scrimshaw
flavorText: Scrimshaw leviathan tooth, carved to depict two Bosmer dancing the Torrid Tango, signed "Cap'n Kathner."
name: Crimson Cove Torrid Tango Scrimshaw

title: Silver Crab Cracker
flavorText: A hinged tool of silver, used for cracking mudcrab shells.
name: Silver Crab Cracker

title: Polished Pickaxe
flavorText: Though its function may not be glamorous, the pickaxe's gleam and polished handle were clearly constructed by a master smith.
name: Polished Pickaxe

title: Orichalum Pitons
flavorText: These sturdy pitons are masterfully crafted. Climbing the sheer cliffs of Betnikh requires tools of this quality.
name: Orichalum Pitons

title: Bone Carving Tools
flavorText: A Wood Elf's tools for carving implements out of bone.
name: Bone Carving Tools

title: Werewolf Claw Clippers
flavorText: A set of silver claw clippers used to trim a werewolf's fast-growing, jagged claws.
name: Werewolf Claw Clippers

title: Luxurious Pony Guar Grooming Set
flavorText: Splendid ivory-handled set of implements for grooming a pet pony guar, including scale picks and chamois buffing spoon.
name: Luxurious Pony Guar Grooming Set

title: Skooma Refinement Tools
flavorText: Tools for the refinement of skooma. Valuable to both criminals and law enforcement.
name: Skooma Refinement Tools

title: Fang Polishing Kit
flavorText: A kit of specialized tools for cleaning, sharpening, and polishing vampire fangs.
name: Fang Polishing Kit

title: Decorative Manicure Set
flavorText: Leather case containing nail clippers, file, and scissors, all in fanciful bird shapes, from Hammer and Saw.
name: Decorative Manicure Set

title: Toad Cleaning Kit
flavorText: An array of precise cutting tools used in the preparation of Aojee-Sakka—a popular, albeit extremely dangerous culinary dish.
name: Toad Cleaning Kit

title: Traveler's Shaving Kit
flavorText: A high-quality shaving kit in a leather case, consisting of a folding straight razor, a horse hair brush, and a shaving bowl.
name: Traveler's Shaving Kit

title: Red Asp Head Potion Opener
flavorText: This petrified red asp head has the fangs exposed to help pry corks from potion bottles.
name: Red Asp Head Potion Opener

title: Lady Laurent's Trowel
flavorText: This ornate but rugged trowel is made of Dwarven steel. It's one of several made for Lady Laurent.
name: Lady Laurent's Trowel

title: Seventh Legion Trowel
flavorText: This silver trowel is used by Imperial archaeologists working as part of the Seventh Legion.
name: Seventh Legion Trowel

title: Banned Orc Tusk Letter Opener
flavorText: This fine yet highly illegal letter opener carved from genuine Orc tusk was probably made before the formation of the Covenant.
name: Banned Orc Tusk Letter Opener

title: Silver Tweezers
flavorText: The elegance of these tweezers suggest they are used for plucking only the finest hairs from noble heads.
name: Silver Tweezers

title: Silver-Plated Tweezers
flavorText: A pair of gleaming tweezers marked by the Imperial ruby. It's possible they once belonged to an Imperial surgeon.
name: Silver-Plated Tweezers

title: Hoops & Holes Mallet Set
flavorText: A custom set of long-handled wooden mallets in a fine deerskin bag, used to play the noble's game "Hoops & Holes."
name: Hoops & Holes Mallet Set

title: Wooden Toy Sword
flavorText: This toy sword was carved to match an Imperial gladius. A fence could resell it to bandits in need of training swords.
name: Wooden Toy Sword

title: Stuffed Bergama Lizard
flavorText: Stuffed lizards are a common gift for children in the Alik'r. They sometimes even wear tailored clothes.
name: Stuffed Bergama Lizard

title: Play Sword
flavorText: This wooden saber is remarkably well-made. Perfect for the young and aspiring warrior, waiting for the call of Rahni'Za.
name: Play Sword

title: Wooden Horse and Cart
flavorText: A toy favored by the children of traveling merchants, the cart features moving wheels while the horse attaches to the front.
name: Wooden Horse and Cart

title: Wooden Building Blocks
flavorText: Children spend hours stacking these painted wooden building blocks. They spend minutes knocking them over.
name: Wooden Building Blocks

title: Leather Vosh Ball
flavorText: A leather ball used in the Orc sport, Vosh, which translates as "Courage." It is rarely played outside Orcish strongholds.
name: Leather Vosh Ball

title: Warrior Wave
flavorText: A small, carved ball of polished topaz, designed to represent Ra'Gada, the Warrior Wave.
name: Warrior Wave

title: Leather Bouncing Ball
flavorText: This large leather ball is inflated with air so that it bounces. It's a popular toy for children.
name: Leather Bouncing Ball

title: Tattooed Mammoth-Ball Trophy
flavorText: Grapefruit-sized leather ball, hairy, tattooed with "Silvenar Rangers, Mammoth-Ball Champions, 2E 565."
name: Tattooed Mammoth-Ball Trophy

title: Mahogany Lawn Bowling Set
flavorText: Leather case containing balls of imported mahogany for lawn bowling, with a note reading "Game next week at the Run Inn."
name: Mahogany Lawn Bowling Set

title: Teeba-Hatsei Ball
flavorText: This remarkably heavy ball is used in the popular Argonian sport of Teeba-Hatsei, or "Hip and Tail Ball."
name: Teeba-Hatsei Ball

title: Bilboquet
flavorText: This wooden children's toy consists of a wooden cup on a handle and a ball attached by a string.
name: Bilboquet

title: Stuffed Giant Centipede with Googly Eyes
flavorText: An arm's-length centipede stuffed with pinfeathers. The painted quail's-egg eyes seem to follow you.
name: Stuffed Giant Centipede with Googly Eyes

title: Pink and Green Finger-Trap
flavorText: A children's novelty toy made from multicolored twine.
name: Pink and Green Finger-Trap

title: Baandari Finger Puzzle
flavorText: A popular children's toy with a sinister history. Its ability to tangle up hands has made it a popular tool for thieves.
name: Baandari Finger Puzzle

title: Stuffed Mouse Toy
flavorText: A favorite among playful Khajiit, crafted by stuffing a dead mouse with cotton and sewing a small bell to its tail.
name: Stuffed Mouse Toy

title: Wooden Guar Pull-Toy
flavorText: A child's wooden pull-toy with round wheels and a pull-string.
name: Wooden Guar Pull-Toy

title: Lion Guard Wind-Up Doll
flavorText: A toy Lion Guard soldier, its clockwork gears allow it to march into battle by winding the mechanism with a key.
name: Lion Guard Wind-Up Doll

title: Lion Guard Figurine of Action
flavorText: Since Buttlebye's Toys closed its doors, these lifelike figurines have become quite collectible among Glenumbra's wealthy.
name: Lion Guard Figurine of Action

title: Clockwork Toy Soldier
flavorText: This wind-up clockwork toy was crafted by Telenger the Artificer himself, and was probably gifted to the child of a noble.
name: Clockwork Toy Soldier

title: Aldmeri War Toys
flavorText: These tiny Aldmeri soldiers and siege engines are molded brass. They fit within a simple silk pouch.
name: Aldmeri War Toys

title: Glenumbra Moors War Toys
flavorText: Tiny soldiers and siege engines, carved from ivory and modeled after the Battle of Glenumbra Moors, held in a fox-fur pouch.
name: Glenumbra Moors War Toys

title: Daggerfall War Toys
flavorText: These tiny Daggerfall soldiers and siege engines carved from wood fit within a simple wool pouch.
name: Daggerfall War Toys

title: Ebonheart War Toys
flavorText: These tiny Ebonheart soldiers and siege engines are carved from ivory. They fit within a simple mammoth-fur pouch.
name: Ebonheart War Toys

title: Crystal Sweetroll
flavorText: Whomever carved this trinket clearly had a deep love and appreciation for sweetrolls.
name: Crystal Sweetroll

title: Polished Iron Hand
flavorText: A gift from Chief Tazgol to a mutilated would-be usurper. "Better luck next time" is engraved on the palm.
name: Polished Iron Hand

title: Stone Warrior's Hand
flavorText: This life-like stone hand was broken off a statue in Southern Bangkorai. It's hard to imagine that it was sculpted.
name: Stone Warrior's Hand

title: Mummified Hand
flavorText: A dried-up Anka'Ra hand taken as a trophy. It didn't just move ... did it?
name: Mummified Hand

title: Divad Hunding's Petrified Finger
flavorText: This petrified finger allegedly belonged to the legendary Sword-Singer Divad Hunding.
name: Divad Hunding's Petrified Finger

title: Mummified Finger
flavorText: A finger gnarled in a way to suggest the hand it belonged to was gripping something.
name: Mummified Finger

title: False Eye
flavorText: Made of roughly carved glass, this garishly painted eye could never be mistaken for the real thing.
name: False Eye

title: Exquisite False Eye
flavorText: A polished marble eye with an emerald inset. A kingly gift from Chief Tazgol to a wounded lieutenant.
name: Exquisite False Eye

title: Seeker's Meditation Stone
flavorText: This black meditation stone has been molded by the Primeval Seekers into a likeness of Hermaeus Mora.
name: Seeker's Meditation Stone

title: Glass Eye of Distinction
flavorText: A glass eye stored in a fine wooden box. The color of the iris changes based on the mood of the possessor.
name: Glass Eye of Distinction

title: "Authentic" Dragon Claw
flavorText: This curved object is dark black and has a very sharp point. Rumored to be a Dragon claw, its authenticity has not been verified.
name: "Authentic" Dragon Claw

title: Good Luck Charm
flavorText: A talisman sold in back alleys and shadowy stalls. It is said to protect the possessor from ill fortune and bad luck.
name: Good Luck Charm

title: Saint Veloth Charm
flavorText: A common religious charm, this one is devoted to Saint Veloth, patron of outcasts and spiritual seekers.
name: Saint Veloth Charm

title: Ysgramor's Palace Talisman
flavorText: A small charm, imbued with an enchantment that always points it toward Ysgramor's Palace in Windhelm.
name: Ysgramor's Palace Talisman

title: Silken Dream Catcher
flavorText: The monks of Pariah Abbey crafted several of these charms to offer as gifts to the children of Stormhaven's nobility.
name: Silken Dream Catcher

title: Kothringi Dream Catcher
flavorText: Small bits of string and beads are woven together into a small circle. There is a single black feather attached at the bottom.
name: Kothringi Dream Catcher

title: Multicolored Sea Glass
flavorText: A fair-sized piece of colorful sea glass set on a small stand and displayed as a household ornament.
name: Multicolored Sea Glass

title: Dark Elf Wicker Effigy
flavorText: A traditional statue made of wicker, used as a stand-in for the owner in certain rituals no longer sanctioned by the Tribunal.
name: Dark Elf Wicker Effigy

title: Argonian Nightmare Trap
flavorText: Sold exclusively by a Hlaalu trading agent in Black Marsh, this Argonian effigy wards off bad dreams and night terrors.
name: Argonian Nightmare Trap

title: Twig-of-Falinesti Compass
flavorText: A twig hangs from a silken strand. Supposedly from Falinesti; said to always point to the Walking City, it spins uncertainly.
name: Twig-of-Falinesti Compass

title: Treehenge Compass Twig
flavorText: Gilded graht-oak twig; suspended from a short cord, it turns slowly and stops, always pointing toward Treehenge.
name: Treehenge Compass Twig

title: Spinner's Ceremonial Gilding
flavorText: Gilded accessories attached to a Spinner's ceremonial portage. Often provided as gifts on festival days.
name: Spinner's Ceremonial Gilding

title: "Stillrise Stagger" Timer Top
flavorText: Elaborate tortoise-shell top spun while playing "Stillrise Stagger" to determine how long a player must hop without falling.
name: "Stillrise Stagger" Timer Top

title: Ayleid Ritual Fetish
flavorText: A rare fetish usually found in Ayleid ruins. It would be valuable to scholars studying the ancient Elves.
name: Ayleid Ritual Fetish

title: Breton Funeral Urn
flavorText: An urn containing the ashes of a beloved member of a Breton family.
name: Breton Funeral Urn

title: Ceramic Urn
flavorText: An urn painted with idyllic scenes of farm life in Tamriel. It should resell nicely once the ashes are dumped out.
name: Ceramic Urn

title: Saarthal Burial Urn
flavorText: A relic from the first city built by Atmoran settlers in Skyrim, destroyed by the Snow Elves in the Merethic Era.
name: Saarthal Burial Urn

title: Portable Chamber Pot
flavorText: A chamber pot of rich earthenware, designed for use in the great outdoors when a tree just isn't good enough.
name: Portable Chamber Pot

title: Ancient Ayleid Amphora
flavorText: Blue-glazed pointed-bottom urn with two handles, inscribed with the Ayleidoon "E" for Erokii.
name: Ancient Ayleid Amphora

title: Filigreed Ash Urn with Portable Altar
flavorText: Ancestral ash urn, pewter with gold filigree, with folding altar stand to enable worship on one's travels.
name: Filigreed Ash Urn with Portable Altar

title: Silver-Chased Three-Tea Samovar
flavorText: A three-bellied copper samovar. Each silver-chased urn has its own spigot for serving the Three Respectful Teas.
name: Silver-Chased Three-Tea Samovar

title: Silver Ladle
flavorText: A polished spoon with a date skillfully engraved on the handle.
name: Silver Ladle

title: Filigreed Serving Spoon
flavorText: A spoon for serving very fancy puddings, stews, soups, or casseroles.
name: Filigreed Serving Spoon

title: Wooden Serving Spoon
flavorText: This large wooden spoon features a small guar on the bowl, perfect for when one is making Guar Quiche.
name: Wooden Serving Spoon

title: Princely Soup Spoon
flavorText: When Prince Azah was a child, he liked to use different spoons to taste each bowl of soup on the table before choosing one.
name: Princely Soup Spoon

title: Gilded Souvenir Spoon
flavorText: This gold-trimmed spoon was purchased as a souvenir from the city of Elinhir.
name: Gilded Souvenir Spoon

title: Ceremonial Cauldron-Stirring Hand-Spoon
flavorText: Ceremonial long-handled cauldron-stirring spoon shaped from a skeletal forearm and hand encased in beetle-amber.
name: Ceremonial Cauldron-Stirring Hand-Spoon

title: Tormented Spire Lava Spoon
flavorText: Basalt spoon that, when stirred in a liquid withershins, heats up and warms the liquid, even to boiling.
name: Tormented Spire Lava Spoon

title: Dreugh-Shell Sithis Spoon
flavorText: Open-bottomed "Sithis Spoon" of Bogmother dreugh-shell, used in the ritual of the Empty Feast of Nullity.
name: Dreugh-Shell Sithis Spoon

title: Imported Bosmeri Eye-Spoons
flavorText: Incomplete set of 5 copperplate Bosmeri pointed eye-spoons, in display case labeled "Ottaesa's Imports."
name: Imported Bosmeri Eye-Spoons

title: Polished Wooden Spoon
flavorText: A stained and polished Saxhleel ladle, highly sought after by many Imperial chefs.
name: Polished Wooden Spoon

title: Jarl's Favorite Silver Soup Spoon
flavorText: Some jarl, his name lost to time, proclaimed he would only eat soup with a silver spoon. Now, many Nords follow the tradition.
name: Jarl's Favorite Silver Soup Spoon

title: Copper Soup Ladle
