flavorText: A copper ladle for serving soups and sauces.
name: Copper Soup Ladle

title: Ingenious Clockwork Saw-Spoon
flavorText: Antique brass spoon with retractable sawtooth arms. Hucksters in Mistral claim they are of Dwemeric design.
name: Ingenious Clockwork Saw-Spoon

title: Set of Silvenar Marrow Spoons
flavorText: Set of six heirloom silver-plated marrow spoons, each stamped with the Great Seal of Silvenar in its bowl.
name: Set of Silvenar Marrow Spoons

title: Elsweyr Serving Ladle
flavorText: This fine wooden serving ladle is painted with a pattern that resembles a senche-tiger's stripes.
name: Elsweyr Serving Ladle

title: Windhelm Salad Tongs
flavorText: It is now common practice for Nord households to stock a set of salad tongs for use when unexpected Dark Elf visitors drop by.
name: Windhelm Salad Tongs

title: Mudcrab-Shaped Dustpan
flavorText: A short-handled shovellike utensil used to remove dust and dirt, shaped like a mudcrab and crafted by Sanabi the Carpenter.
name: Mudcrab-Shaped Dustpan

title: Chef Xavier's Better Spatula
flavorText: An improved version of the essential cooking utensil, crafted and sold by Chef Xavier of Daggerfall.
name: Chef Xavier's Better Spatula

title: Long-Handled Mudcrab Flipper
flavorText: Broad wooden spatula with long bamboo handle; used by Roost beachcombers to flip mudcrabs onto their backs.
name: Long-Handled Mudcrab Flipper

title: Graht-Oak Rolling Pin
flavorText: This heavy rolling pin crafted from the trees of Valenwood has some heft, perfect for flattening dough.
name: Graht-Oak Rolling Pin

title: Polished Marble Rolling Pin
flavorText: This otherwise pristine rolling pin bears a large crack. If rumors are true, Hearth-Wife Sholg occasionally uses them as clubs.
name: Polished Marble Rolling Pin

title: Etched Iron Tenderizer
flavorText: A heavy kitchen tool used to prepare meat. The handle features a stylized wolf skull engraving.
name: Etched Iron Tenderizer

title: Bjoulsae River Ladle
flavorText: This long-armed ladle was designed for drawing water from the deepest part of the Bjoulsae River.
name: Bjoulsae River Ladle

title: Commemorative Corkscrew
flavorText: After King Ranser's defeat, Emeric threw a party for the nobles of High Rock and handed out these as party favors.
name: Commemorative Corkscrew

title: Dishonored Potion Opener
flavorText: This potion opener is decorated with a crude depiction of Satakal as a serpent, with fangs exposed.
name: Dishonored Potion Opener

title: Green Lady Corkscrew
flavorText: A brass corkscrew with a jade handle shaped in a stylized representation of a reclining Green Lady.
name: Green Lady Corkscrew

title: Stormfist Style Flatware
flavorText: Cutlery produced by Stormfist clan artisans, most likely dating back to before the reign of Jorunn the Skald-King.
name: Stormfist Style Flatware

title: Lion Guard Meal Kit
flavorText: Compact eating and cooking utensils for use while camping or participating in military campaigns, popularized by the Lion Guard.
name: Lion Guard Meal Kit

title: Rustic Wooden Serving Utensils
flavorText: Crafted by woodworkers of Deleyn's Mill, these oversized utensils were popularized by King Casimir at the Feast of Five Days.
name: Rustic Wooden Serving Utensils

title: Two-Tined Carving Fork
flavorText: A large carving fork with a stout handle and two sturdy metal tines.
name: Two-Tined Carving Fork

title: Willow Branch Toasting Fork
flavorText: Iron toasting fork wrought into the shape of a delicate willow branch, from the Guard's Forge.
name: Willow Branch Toasting Fork

title: Redoran Carving Fork
flavorText: A large carving fork bearing the symbol of House Redoran upon its stout handle. The matching knife is nowhere to be found.
name: Redoran Carving Fork

title: Imported Cheese-Toasting Fork
flavorText: Steel two-tined fork with a long haft and a mahogany handle, metal blackened at the end.
name: Imported Cheese-Toasting Fork

title: House Dorell Carving Fork
flavorText: A large carving fork bearing the symbol of House Dorell upon its stout handle. The matching knife must have been lost.
name: House Dorell Carving Fork

title: Frog Gig with Folding Haft
flavorText: Xal Ithix-style barbed four-tined frog gig, with double-hinged folding haft made of Mud Tree bamboo.
name: Frog Gig with Folding Haft

title: Redoran Carving Knife
flavorText: A large carving knife bearing the symbol of House Redoran upon its stout handle. The matching fork must have been lost.
name: Redoran Carving Knife

title: Top Quality Clamming Fork
flavorText: Short-handled steel spade fork for digging up clams, with non-warping mangrove handle, from Moonfire Forge.
name: Top Quality Clamming Fork

title: Pyandonean Fork
flavorText: This exquisitely designed jade serving fork appears to be a striking sea serpent, with its two fangs serving as its tines.
name: Pyandonean Fork

title: Silver-Plated Juggling Forks
flavorText: Set of three long silver-plated forks for the juggling game "Forks Akimbo," popular at Redfur Trading Post.
name: Silver-Plated Juggling Forks

title: Yokudan Cutlery
flavorText: This set of ancient forks, knives, and spoons was finely crafted, but is now valued for its age rather than its usefulness.
name: Yokudan Cutlery

title: Aldmeri Cutlery
flavorText: This Aldmeri cutlery is finely filigreed and fit for the Queen herself.
name: Aldmeri Cutlery

title: Yokudan Style Flatware
flavorText: Cutlery modeled after Yokudan silverware and sold by Thalia the Blacksmith in Belkarth.
name: Yokudan Style Flatware

title: 36-Sermon Tableware Set
flavorText: A 36-piece silverplate tableware set with one spoon, knife, or fork for each of Vivec's Thirty-Six Sermons.
name: 36-Sermon Tableware Set

title: Solid Gold Cutlery
flavorText: A set of shining eating utensils composed entirely of gold. It's fit for use by a royal family.
name: Solid Gold Cutlery

title: Red Oak Cutting Board
flavorText: A freshly sanded and well-oiled cutting surface.
name: Red Oak Cutting Board

title: Trader's Rest Silver Dining Utensils
flavorText: Three meat-forks, two knives—a partial set of silver-plated dining utensils, each engraved with "Property of Trader's Rest."
name: Trader's Rest Silver Dining Utensils

title: Dwarven-Metal Serving Utensils
flavorText: Set of serving utensils of iridescent Dwarven metal, engraved "Crafted at Armature's Upheaval by Dalotha."
name: Dwarven-Metal Serving Utensils

title: Wyrd Sisters' Whisk
flavorText: An oak whisk, carved out of a single piece of wood and used to prepare eggs for cooking.
name: Wyrd Sisters' Whisk

title: Ivory-Handled Whisk
flavorText: A staple of every Nord kitchen, this gravy whisk features a polished ivory handle decorated with Nordic patterns.
name: Ivory-Handled Whisk

title: Porcelain Vase
flavorText: A fragile vessel—almost certainly antique.
name: Porcelain Vase

title: Floral Vase
flavorText: Form follows function. This vase is used to hold flowers and it has flowers painted on it.
name: Floral Vase

title: Jade Vase
flavorText: This wide vase is delicately carved with small flowers. It  has a distinct green coloring to it.
name: Jade Vase

title: Delicate Ceramic Bud Vase
flavorText: White and rose pink bud vase of subtle floral curves, from Skywatch Mercantile.
name: Delicate Ceramic Bud Vase

title: Malachite Tower Vase
flavorText: This tall, thin vase is made from malachite and shaped like a Breton Watchtower.
name: Malachite Tower Vase

title: Mara's Floral Star Vase
flavorText: A traditional Nord wedding gift, the four-pointed floral star is a popular symbol associated with Mara, the goddess of love.
name: Mara's Floral Star Vase

title: Mara's Hands Vase
flavorText: This porcelain vase was molded to look like a pair of clasped hands nurturing the flowers within.
name: Mara's Hands Vase

title: Volcanic Glass Vase
flavorText: A decorative vase. Crafted from volcanic glass that was harvested from the mountains of Stonefalls.
name: Volcanic Glass Vase

title: Ebony Vessel of the Abyss
flavorText: Conical black vase used for meditation; a look into its interior is like peering into an endlessly-deepening black nothingness.
name: Ebony Vessel of the Abyss

title: Silver Vial of Alit Horn Powder
flavorText: A small, delicate silver vial filled with powdered alit horn, used by Orc shamans in fertility rituals.
name: Silver Vial of Alit Horn Powder

title: Bloodthorn Ampoule
flavorText: A stoppered vial wrapped in thorny vines that bears the symbol of the Bloodthorn cult. It probably contains something dangerous.
name: Bloodthorn Ampoule

title: Phial of Lamp Oil
flavorText: A ceramic cask filled with pure oil.
name: Phial of Lamp Oil

title: Phial of Leovic's Blood
flavorText: This tiny phial contains blood of the former Emperor Leovic, supposedly collected at his regicide.
name: Phial of Leovic's Blood

title: King Donel's Beard Shavings
flavorText: A vial of beard hairs from Donel of Deleyn.
name: King Donel's Beard Shavings

title: Vial of Soil from Hrol's Hillock
flavorText: This vial of soil is purportedly from the hillock King Hrol fertilized before his death.
name: Vial of Soil from Hrol's Hillock

title: Ash'abah Moon Salve
flavorText: The Ash'abah use a secret formula to create this mixture. When smeared on exposed skin, it protects one from sun blush.
name: Ash'abah Moon Salve

title: Vial of Comet Dust
flavorText: A small vial of dust that allegedly fell from the sky when the starry comet streaked over the Iliac Bay.
name: Vial of Comet Dust

title: Vial of Sand from the Far Shores
flavorText: This small vial of sand allegedly came from the Aetherial realm the Redguards call the "Far Shores."
name: Vial of Sand from the Far Shores

title: Smelling Salts
flavorText: Plain smelling salts, for awakening the faint of heart.
name: Smelling Salts

title: Argonian Scale Softener
flavorText: A batch of exotic moisturizing lotion made for Lord Ernil Dres by his Argonian slaves and stored in small vials.
name: Argonian Scale Softener

title: Hlaalu Merchant's Flin Barometer
flavorText: Hlaalu traveling merchant's combination barometer and whiskey-flask, a portable storm glass filled with flin.
name: Hlaalu Merchant's Flin Barometer

title: Unopened Vial of Glue
flavorText: An unopened vial of adhesive made from rendered Skeever skins.
name: Unopened Vial of Glue

title: Vial of Stardust
flavorText: A vial full of a gleaming dust. It serves no function, but a Star-Gazer or similar scholar pays well for such curiosities.
name: Vial of Stardust

title: Vial of Vampire Blood
flavorText: A small vile of dark, viscous blood. This would be quite valuable to a necromancer, or a desperate alchemist.
name: Vial of Vampire Blood

title: Strange Shornhelm Keepsakes
flavorText: A collection of Shornhelm keepsakes, obviously important to their owner, including vials of blood and other bizarre items.
name: Strange Shornhelm Keepsakes

title: Fine Leather Waterskin
flavorText: An empty waterskin made of supple leather and stoppered with a cork.
name: Fine Leather Waterskin

title: Rabbit-Hide Waterskin
flavorText: A well-made drinking container, bearing the crafter's mark of Arma Derone of Eagle's Brook in Glenumbra.
name: Rabbit-Hide Waterskin

title: Sturdy Wood Elf Waterskin
flavorText: This supple waterskin was fashioned from a wild boar's stomach.
name: Sturdy Wood Elf Waterskin

title: Elegant Waterskin
flavorText: A supple leather pouch that boasts silver engravings. It can hang at your side, fit in your pack, and quench your thirst.
name: Elegant Waterskin

title: Scorpion Shell Whistle
flavorText: A loud whistle fashioned from the shell of a dead scorpion.
name: Scorpion Shell Whistle

title: Polished Sandlewood Birdcall
flavorText: This masterfully crafted birdcall is one of a select few used by Hunt-Wife Lurgush and her companions.
name: Polished Sandlewood Birdcall

title: Guar Call Whistle
flavorText: A tiny whistle bearing the mark of Esqoo the herder. He commissioned many, since he's always losing his guar—and his whistles.
name: Guar Call Whistle

title: Alabaster Bandit Whistle
flavorText: Since bandits began appearing in Bleakrock, many citizens have begun to carry around whistles to sound when they require aid.
name: Alabaster Bandit Whistle

title: Hand-Carved Abecean Whistle
flavorText: A small whale-bone whistle, carved to resemble a reclining mermaid. A popular item in Saintsport.
name: Hand-Carved Abecean Whistle

title: Brass Warning Whistle
flavorText: A simple aerophone bearing the mark of a particular Dark Elf house, travelers carry these to call for help or send warnings.
name: Brass Warning Whistle

title: Bat-Bone Whistle
flavorText: A light and delicate bone from a giant bat, carved into a harmonious whistle by a Wood Elf crafter.
name: Bat-Bone Whistle

title: Khajiit Monkey Call
flavorText: A simple aerophone bearing the mark of a Khajiiti hunter, it produces an amazingly lifelike monkey call.
name: Khajiit Monkey Call

title: Daggerfall Guard Captain's Whistle
flavorText: A silver whistle engraved with the Daggerfall crest. Many citizens have cheap brass replicas to alert the Guard in an emergency.
name: Daggerfall Guard Captain's Whistle

title: Bird Call Whistle
flavorText: A simple aerophone bearing the mark of the Beldama Wyrd Sisters, many foresters carry these to attract birds and fowl.
name: Bird Call Whistle

title: Houndsman Wolf Whistle
flavorText: Brass whistle on a gold chain, engraved with a howling wolf and full moons. It seems to make no sound when winded.
name: Houndsman Wolf Whistle

title: Marine Officer's Platinum Whistle
flavorText: Platinum three-note officer's whistle, engraved with the seal of the First Auridon Marines.
name: Marine Officer's Platinum Whistle

title: Tall Wooden Stilts
flavorText: These stilts make for fun entertainment. They also allow one to reach high objects—such as second story windows.
name: Tall Wooden Stilts

title: Goblin-Wood Cutting Board
flavorText: A carpenter in Davon's Watch crafts these hardwood cutting boards used by chefs and cooks throughout Morrowind.
name: Goblin-Wood Cutting Board

title: Bone Lots
flavorText: A handful of graven welwa knuckle bones, thrown to aid in divination.
name: Bone Lots

title: Mages Guildmaster's Bookmark
flavorText: Bookmark of platinum foil, an image of Arch-Mage Shalidor on one side, and "Return to Davon's Watch Guildhall" on the other.
name: Mages Guildmaster's Bookmark

title: Pirate Grappling Hook
flavorText: The metal hook is so heavy that dislodging it from a ship's wall is a significant challenge.
name: Pirate Grappling Hook

title: Boar-Bladder Hand Warmer
flavorText: An enchanted triple-sealed bladder. When squeezed, the fist-sized bulb warms rapidly.
name: Boar-Bladder Hand Warmer

title: Dwarven Steel Griddle
flavorText: A griddle purportedly found in an ancient Dwemer ruin. According to an inscription on the handle, the Dwemer enjoyed pancakes.
name: Dwarven Steel Griddle

title: Dining Table Dung Beetle House
flavorText: Small pearl- and agate-studded pod-house used to contain the large dung beetle released to clean up the table between courses.
name: Dining Table Dung Beetle House

title: "Amorous Giantess" Royal Ensemble
flavorText: Set of bedroom stilts and large furry mittens for enacting the erotic charade "The King and the Amorous Giantess."
name: "Amorous Giantess" Royal Ensemble

title: Canonreeve's Ruby-Throated Nonesuch
flavorText: Moonstone-fretted silversilk ruby-throated nonesuch. The amber tail-label reads "Property of the Thalmor."
name: Canonreeve's Ruby-Throated Nonesuch

title: Blue Satin and Velvet Caul
flavorText: Patterned hair-snood of bright blue satin and darker blue velvet, with a light crespine to hold it on.
name: Blue Satin and Velvet Caul

title: House Ravenwatch Doily
flavorText: A doily with the Ravenwatch heraldry, distributed during a rare public banquet held at the secluded castle.
name: House Ravenwatch Doily

title: Holgunn's Unexpurgated Beetle-Shot Proclamation
flavorText: A rare proclamation of Fish Stink Tavern's Beetle-Shot cocktail as the official drink of the Pact—rescinded the next day.
name: Holgunn's Unexpurgated Beetle-Shot Proclamation

title: Fine Fishbone Head-Spine Snood
flavorText: Semi-rigid snood worn while sleeping to prevent disarrangement of an Argonian's head-spines.
name: Fine Fishbone Head-Spine Snood

title: Brass Khajiiti Finger-Pen
flavorText: Brass nib that fits over a Khajiit's index fingernail, converting it into a fountain pen.
name: Brass Khajiiti Finger-Pen

title: White-Gold Wax Tablet
flavorText: A tablet that functions as a portable writing surface. Markings across the top indicate it came from the Imperial Palace.
name: White-Gold Wax Tablet

title: Jeweled Toothbrush
flavorText: A gaudy toothbrush, encrusted with valuable jewels, commissioned by foreign royalty.
name: Jeweled Toothbrush

title: Ancient Yokudan Arrowhead
flavorText: This antique arrowhead may have aged, but the quality craftsmanship of the fletchers from Old Yokuda is still clear.
name: Ancient Yokudan Arrowhead

title: Oiled-Leather Portmanteau
flavorText: Waterproof luggage of tooled horsehide, made for sea travel, with inner tag reading "Sourt's Sacks, Shornhelm."
name: Oiled-Leather Portmanteau

title: Baandari Moon-Sugar Basters
flavorText: These basters are sold by the Baandari for the express purpose of basting roasted meats repeatedly with moon-sugar syrup.
name: Baandari Moon-Sugar Basters

title: Akaviri Lord-Marshal's Baton
flavorText: Ivory baton capped with the carved head of a snow bear. The carving indicates a Kamal Akaviri Lord-Marshal's symbol of command.
name: Akaviri Lord-Marshal's Baton

title: Savage Nord False Beard and Mustache
flavorText: Comically hirsute false beard and mustache, worn when playing the "Strapping Skyrim Skald" game.
name: Savage Nord False Beard and Mustache

title: Exile's Bedroll
flavorText: This Redguard bedroll was used by the exiles who fled from Hallin's Stand and sought safe harbor from the King of Evermore.
name: Exile's Bedroll

title: Nordic Rabbit Fur Bedroll
flavorText: A compact bedroll, accented with rabbit fur in the Nord style. No backpack should be without one.
name: Nordic Rabbit Fur Bedroll

title: Bronze Blue Bunting Perch
flavorText: Broad-based bronze bird perch for a blue bunting, with a slim brass chain and anklet, engraved "Brightsteel Armory" underneath.
name: Bronze Blue Bunting Perch

title: Dwemer Tonal Diagram
flavorText: A schematic utilizing the principles of tonal architecture, indecipherable by any but the lost Dwemer people.
name: Dwemer Tonal Diagram

title: Seal-Skin Buoy
flavorText: A tightly stitched inflatable bladder. "Maiden's Breath" has been branded onto the side.
name: Seal-Skin Buoy

title: Fancy Desk Blotter
flavorText: A fancy version of a common desk blotter, perfect for absorbing excess or spilled ink. The ivory handle is made from whalebone.
name: Fancy Desk Blotter

title: Deluxe Desk Blotter
flavorText: A deluxe version of a common desk blotter for the desk of a wealthy patron, perfect for absorbing excess or spilled ink.
name: Deluxe Desk Blotter

title: Naga-skin Bandit Blotter
flavorText: Felt-lined absorbent blotter made from the soft-scaled underbelly of a condemned Naga bandit.
name: Naga-skin Bandit Blotter

title: Mammoth-Rib Nord-Striders
flavorText: A pair of curiously straightened stilts, taken from the ribcage of a living timber mammoth—an odd gift of the Green.
name: Mammoth-Rib Nord-Striders

title: Antique Clyster with Platinum Filigree
flavorText: Antique Bosmeri First-Era tin clyster with platinum filigree, reinforced croc-leather spout, and ivory pump handle.
name: Antique Clyster with Platinum Filigree

title: Pouch of Amber Buttons
flavorText: A handful of buttons, fashioned from ancient graht-oak resin.
name: Pouch of Amber Buttons

title: Supernal Dreamers Omen Cards
flavorText: An ornate set of cards, supposedly used by Supernal Dreamers cultists to aid in calling forth Daedric spirits known as Omens.
name: Supernal Dreamers Omen Cards

title: Daedric Tarot Cards
flavorText: A set of hand-painted Tarot cards featuring depictions of the various Daedric Princes.
name: Daedric Tarot Cards

title: Tribunal Prayer Cards
flavorText: A set of hand-painted prayer cards based on the Homilies of Blessed Almalexia.
name: Tribunal Prayer Cards

title: Constellation Coaster Tiles
flavorText: Set of twelve glazed ceramic drink coasters based on the Ayleid constellation tiles of Veawend Ede.
name: Constellation Coaster Tiles

title: Spider-Web Cocoon
flavorText: This fist-sized spider-web cocoon from northeast Bleakrock appears to be intact. An alchemist would pay well for this.
name: Spider-Web Cocoon

title: Banner-Torn Brews Decorative Stopper
flavorText: The topper on this empty jug is extraordinary—a porcelain pig with a barrel of Aera's Ale around its neck.
name: Banner-Torn Brews Decorative Stopper

title: Kwama Cuttle Earplugs
flavorText: A pair of kwama cuttle earplugs, used to muffle snores and other nocturnal noises of Dark Elf sleeping companions.
name: Kwama Cuttle Earplugs

title: Kwama Cuttle Nose Plugs
flavorText: A pair of nose plugs fashioned from kwama cuttle, Dark Elves wear them to keep insects from crawling in while they sleep.
name: Kwama Cuttle Nose Plugs

title: Burnished Silver Handle
flavorText: Does a wardrobe really need a handle? Not when a fence can resell it for silver scrap.
name: Burnished Silver Handle

title: Drublog Lotion Warmer, with Cruet
flavorText: Drublog-forged iron lotion warmer stand, with candle holder beneath a circular eyelet to hold the ceramic lotion cruet.
name: Drublog Lotion Warmer, with Cruet

title: Glow Worm Farm
flavorText: A display case filled with loam, which serves as a habitat for a Dark Elf youngster's pet glow worms.
name: Glow Worm Farm

title: Aldmeri Tea Cozy
flavorText: This tea cozy is patterned with the golden eagle of the Aldmeri Dominion.
name: Aldmeri Tea Cozy

title: Lucky Pig's Ear
flavorText: A dried pig's ear, believed by some to bring good luck—to everyone other than the pig.
name: Lucky Pig's Ear

title: Royal Beeswax Earplugs
flavorText: A pair of ear plugs, purportedly infused with the royal jelly of a hive's queen. Not for use in regions with a bee population.
name: Royal Beeswax Earplugs

title: Seafoam Earplugs
flavorText: Made from hardened seafoam, some Redguards use these to keep bugs from crawling into their ears while they sleep.
name: Seafoam Earplugs

title: Senche-Stalked Earplugs
flavorText: A pair of earplugs which hiss softly when senche-tigers approach within thirty paces. Indispensable for light outdoor sleepers.
name: Senche-Stalked Earplugs

title: Teahouse Comfort Fan
flavorText: This simple silk fan is imprinted with an ancient Khajiiti rune, quite fashionable at the tea parlors of Dune.
name: Teahouse Comfort Fan

title: Lucky Nereid's Foot
flavorText: Blue-skinned and web-toed Nereid's foot, expertly taxidermied, reputed to bring its owner good luck.
name: Lucky Nereid's Foot

title: Giant Bat Kite
flavorText: A kite shaped and decorated to resemble a giant bat, perfect for flying on the breeze on warm, sunny days.
name: Giant Bat Kite

title: Golden Gorapple Replica
flavorText: An exact replica of the rare specimen of fruit, sculpted with the utmost care.
name: Golden Gorapple Replica

title: Beeswax Heart
flavorText: This beeswax heart details the long life of a loving couple. A fence could melt it down and resell the fine wax to forgers.
name: Beeswax Heart

title: Hoarvor-Proboscis Mud Snorkel
flavorText: Night-snorkel to enable breathing when sleeping immersed in mud, a hoarvor proboscis engraved with paeans to Padhome.
name: Hoarvor-Proboscis Mud Snorkel

title: Antique Hookah
flavorText: This elaborate waterpipe is unique to Craglorn. Stylized Nedic motifs have been etched into the silver trim.
name: Antique Hookah

title: Spry Spriggan Twirling Hoop
flavorText: This large wooden hoop is spun overhead as part of the popular children's game known as "Spry Spriggan."
name: Spry Spriggan Twirling Hoop

title: Bronzed Baby Teeth
flavorText: A jar containing the bronzed teeth of young children, saved as remembrances in the Breton tradition.
name: Bronzed Baby Teeth

title: Orichalcum Incense Burner
flavorText: This Orichalcum incense burner was crafted recently in Wayrest and then shipped up the Bjoulsae River to be sold in Bangkorai.
name: Orichalcum Incense Burner

title: Intense Incense of Mara
flavorText: A more powerful and extremely prohibited version of the common calm-inducing scent that permeates most Nord bedchambers.
name: Intense Incense of Mara

title: Dark Elf Incense Burner
flavorText: An incense burner engraved with an image of Almalexia and the words "Mother Morrowind."
name: Dark Elf Incense Burner

title: Natural Hand Soap
flavorText: A bar of sweet-smelling soap, used throughout Tamriel to wash hands and other particularly grubby body parts.
name: Natural Hand Soap

title: Butterfly Kite
flavorText: An expertly crafted kite shaped like the blue butterflies of Skyrim—quite popular with homesick Nords visiting Auridon.
name: Butterfly Kite

title: Uveran Promotional Kagouti Bank
flavorText: Ceramic coin-bank in the shape of a painted kagouti, with a coin slot on its back, engraved "Compliments of Uveran Bank."
name: Uveran Promotional Kagouti Bank

title: Harpy-Wing Kite
flavorText: Modeled after the harpies of Shrieking Scar, these playful kites can often be seen flying atop the Daggerfall highlands.
name: Harpy-Wing Kite

title: Spidersilk Box Kite
flavorText: A high-performance box kite made with light wooden struts and multicolored spidersilk.
name: Spidersilk Box Kite

title: Kwama Scrib-Head Bugsmoke Ashtray
flavorText: With the failure of the Burroot Kwama Mine, the owners tried to recoup by fashioning items from kwama carapaces.
name: Kwama Scrib-Head Bugsmoke Ashtray

title: Nix-Hound Leash
flavorText: A sturdy leather leash used in the training of nix-hounds.
name: Nix-Hound Leash

title: Luminescent Bookbinding
flavorText: This netch-skin bookbinding was obviously imported and still retains a cool blue glow.
name: Luminescent Bookbinding

title: Wamasu-Hide Tarpaulin
flavorText: This sturdy tarp is tightly stitched and extremely durable.
name: Wamasu-Hide Tarpaulin

title: Derali Lizard Leash
flavorText: This leash was used by one of the most prominent lizard-racing families in all of the Alik'r.
name: Derali Lizard Leash

title: Miniature Lighthouse
flavorText: A miniature of one of the beacons of Auridon.
name: Miniature Lighthouse

title: Almalexia's Lock
flavorText: This lock of hair was supposedly given as a sign of Almalexia's favor. Why the color has faded is anyone's guess.
name: Almalexia's Lock

title: Bleakrock Braid Memento
flavorText: A lock of thick, auburn hair, tied in the distinctive Bleakrock Braid and saved in remembrance of someone dear.
name: Bleakrock Braid Memento

title: Queen Freydis' Curly Ringlets
flavorText: A lock of curly red hair sealed in a jar, proclaimed to be from the head of Queen Freydis of Eastern Skyrim.
name: Queen Freydis' Curly Ringlets

title: Horrible Mummified Banekin
flavorText: Grotesque mummified body of a small humanoid Daedra; a label around its ankle reads "Proof of the existence of Broken Tusk!"
name: Horrible Mummified Banekin

title: Bronzed Egg Tooth
flavorText: A prized childhood keepsake, coated in bronze.
name: Bronzed Egg Tooth

title: Rubber Squeeze Mouse
flavorText: Realistic squeaking mouse, twice life-size, fashioned from cooked gray rubber at The Hissing Phial.
name: Rubber Squeeze Mouse

title: Morrowind House Fungus
flavorText: A smaller variety of the large, glowing mushrooms that dot the Morrowind countryside, set in a pot and used to beautify a home.
name: Morrowind House Fungus

title: Filigreed Falinesti Acorn
flavorText: A fist-sized acorn preserved with a coat of dark lacquer and trimmed with gilt edging around the cap.
name: Filigreed Falinesti Acorn

title: Mara's Bosom Aromatic Oil
flavorText: A sweet-smelling oil, burned at night to make a Breton's bedchamber soothing and fragrant.
name: Mara's Bosom Aromatic Oil

title: Snow-Owl Kite
flavorText: A kite shaped and decorated to resemble a snow owl, perfect for flying on crisp, clear winter days.
name: Snow-Owl Kite

title: Green Pact Prayer Card
flavorText: Several prayers to the Green are inscribed on this card, which is made from very finely-cut bone.
name: Green Pact Prayer Card

title: Buca's Tasty Tooth Polish
flavorText: Paste made from torchbugs and other natural ingredients, formulated to clean and polish teeth. Available at The Subtle Philter!
name: Buca's Tasty Tooth Polish

title: Four Imp-Repelling Pinwheels
flavorText: When placed in the cardinal directions around a camp, these elaborate pinwheels are said to repel imps from the area within.
name: Four Imp-Repelling Pinwheels

title: Gold-Blink Torchbug-Dance Pinwheel
flavorText: Silver pinwheel with blinking gold-glow finial that attracts dozens of torchbugs, enchanting them into a circling dance.
name: Gold-Blink Torchbug-Dance Pinwheel

title: Bloodsport Pass
flavorText: A small stone plaque, bearing the symbol of the Hammerdeath Arena, provides entry to the bloodsport events.
name: Bloodsport Pass

title: Fahara'jad Lineage Plaque
flavorText: This golden plaque is engraved with the names of King Fahara'jad's ancestors.
name: Fahara'jad Lineage Plaque

title: Vivec's Ivory Plaque
flavorText: This small, ivory rectangle contains a verse attributed to the Warrior-Poet and is a common gift among the wealthy of Morrowind.
name: Vivec's Ivory Plaque

title: All Flags Navy Campaign Ribbon
flavorText: Rare vintage officer's campaign ribbon for participation in the naval assault on Thras in 1E 2260.
name: All Flags Navy Campaign Ribbon

title: Silver Dowsing Rods
flavorText: If you can't use magic to find water, you can use these rods. Or is this magic, too?
name: Silver Dowsing Rods

title: Spinner's Ruched Silken Furbelow
flavorText: A Spinner's ruched and flounced furbelow of turquoise silk and golden chamois, with gilt edging.
name: Spinner's Ruched Silken Furbelow

title: Bjoulsae River Sand Scrub
flavorText: The fine grains of sand gathered from the bottom of the Bjoulsae River are excellent for keeping one's face looking young.
name: Bjoulsae River Sand Scrub

title: Eyes of the Queen Disguise Kit
flavorText: A kit of false beards, mustaches, noses and other prosthetics. A small marking indicates it was made for the Eyes of the Queen.
name: Eyes of the Queen Disguise Kit

title: Hollow Scorpion Carapace
flavorText: Wood Elves make a game of trying to hollow out a scorpion carapace without damaging the shell. This one survived intact.
name: Hollow Scorpion Carapace

title: Scorpion-Tail Bookmark
flavorText: This dried scorpion tail has been flattened to act as a bookmark.
name: Scorpion-Tail Bookmark

title: Packet Of Moon Ripened Squash Seeds
flavorText: A packet of enchanted squash seeds. When planted under moonlight, they will grow fully by the next day's dusk.
name: Packet Of Moon Ripened Squash Seeds

title: Imported Bronze Grit Sieve
flavorText: Bronze sifter for removing lumps from a grit-box, engraved "Imported from Senchal by Ranabi" on the handle.
name: Imported Bronze Grit Sieve

title: Goblin-Sized Weighted Shackles
flavorText: Heavy leg-irons for restraining Goblin slaves who are flight risks. Etched with the symbol of The Watcher's Forge, Skywatch.
name: Goblin-Sized Weighted Shackles

title: Dres Slaver Shackles
flavorText: A set of House Dres slaver shackles, slightly used.
name: Dres Slaver Shackles

title: Bone Ship Carving
flavorText: The details of this ship are as pointed as the jagged bone that forms it. It was probably created by a skilled craftsman.
name: Bone Ship Carving

title: Pristine Writing Slate
flavorText: This smooth writing surface has yet to be touched by chalk or charcoal.
name: Pristine Writing Slate

title: Velyn Hill Crabshell Mudsled
flavorText: Personal mudcrab-shell mudsled, with leather harness and "Velyn Hill Mud-Luge" inscribed on the seat.
name: Velyn Hill Crabshell Mudsled

title: Swim Flippers and Coral Snorkel
flavorText: Swim flippers of flexible netch-hide, with a snorkel made of land-coral from Vivec's Antlers.
name: Swim Flippers and Coral Snorkel

title: Mammoth Snout Surprise Snorkel
flavorText: A rubber-lined mammoth snout snorkel. A label reads, "Delight your friends with Doubts-the-Moon's submerged mammoth surprise!"
name: Mammoth Snout Surprise Snorkel

title: Nilyne's Natural Hand Sanitizer
flavorText: Nilyne Hlor of the Serk sells a lot of this hand soap, marketing it as a way to limit the spread of Llodos and other plagues.
name: Nilyne's Natural Hand Sanitizer

title: Silver Sandal Spikes
flavorText: Footracing is a common sport in parts of the Alik'r and some runners use these sandal spikes to get a competitive edge.
name: Silver Sandal Spikes

title: High Kinlady's Diamond-Tipped Spurs
flavorText: Diamond-tipped silver spurs for the riding boots of a High Kinlady, in the style worn in Skywatch and Firsthold.
name: High Kinlady's Diamond-Tipped Spurs

title: Silver Spurs
flavorText: Polished to a glimmering sheen and marked with engravings that identify them as belonging to the house of King Eamond.
name: Silver Spurs

title: Chicken-Mudcrab Thing
flavorText: Why anyone would attach the head of a chicken to the body of a mudcrab is anyone's guess, but somebody will probably buy it.
name: Chicken-Mudcrab Thing

title: Chieftain's Heirloom Toad-Atlatl
flavorText: Enameled flinging-stick ending in a shallow cup, used in the traditional Murkwater game "The Toad Flies at Dusk."
name: Chieftain's Heirloom Toad-Atlatl

title: Keeper's Licorice Worm Dowsing Rod
flavorText: Orichalc dowsing rod used for finding the underground teeming-holes of licorice worms, which Keepers feed to hatchlings.
name: Keeper's Licorice Worm Dowsing Rod

title: Elegant Velvet-Lined Tail Lifter
flavorText: Elegant folding tail lifter made of flexible spry-wood inlaid with red cedar, with a velvet-lined lift-cuff.
name: Elegant Velvet-Lined Tail Lifter

title: Jeweled Treethane Castanets
flavorText: Gem-studded carapace castanets, two pair, used by treethanes in a glittering staccato flurry to call a meeting to order.
name: Jeweled Treethane Castanets

title: Konunleikar Bookmark Keepsake
flavorText: The Mages Guild distributed these stylish leather bookmarks in honor of the Skald-King's Konunleikar celebration.
name: Konunleikar Bookmark Keepsake

title: Supple Redguard Blade Polisher
flavorText: An exquisitely worked strip of lion hide, treated with an oil of snake venom and ground beetle carapace. Worth every gold piece.
name: Supple Redguard Blade Polisher

title: Supple Nord Blade Polisher
flavorText: An exquisitely worked strip of tiger hide, treated with an oil of giant blood and ground chicken wings. Worth every gold piece.
name: Supple Nord Blade Polisher

title: Foxtail Book Marker
flavorText: A thin sliver of fine wood used to mark one's place in a book, this one also has a fox-tail attached at the top.
name: Foxtail Book Marker

title: Gold Tassels
flavorText: These tassels would look good in any room. They would sell well to the right buyer.
name: Gold Tassels

title: Ivory Teeth
flavorText: Someone is missing their false teeth.
name: Ivory Teeth

title: Malachite Needle
flavorText: Using malachite to make needles is popular among Bretons in Eastern High Rock.
name: Malachite Needle

title: Crimson Ship Ticket
flavorText: A ticket for passage on the Crimson Ship, never used by its owner.
name: Crimson Ship Ticket

title: Shornhelm Players Performance Tickets
flavorText: A pair of tickets for the annual performance of the play, "Ranser! You Madman!" at the Dead Wolf Inn.
name: Shornhelm Players Performance Tickets

title: Caravan Scrip
flavorText: A promise of payment that identifies itself as issued by the Dragonstar Caravan Company.
name: Caravan Scrip

title: Aetheric Lodestone
flavorText: This extremely rare, perfectly round orb is highly magnetic and threaded with veins of glowing blue aetherium.
name: Aetheric Lodestone

title: Collectors' Sload-Carved Leviathan Tooth
flavorText: Rare Eltheric leviathan tooth, even more sought-after due to it being carved with looping, untranslatable Sload script.
name: Collectors' Sload-Carved Leviathan Tooth

title: Jade Finchbone Toothpick
flavorText: A jade toothpick carved to look like a finchbone. Perfect for picking meat from between one's teeth.
name: Jade Finchbone Toothpick

title: Trained Torchbug in a Bottle
flavorText: When you shake the container, the torchbug inside this bottle flies in a pattern depicting five of the constellations.
name: Trained Torchbug in a Bottle

title: Garden Troll Varmint Defender
flavorText: Carved from ironwood by the Matrons of Shor's Stone, these friendly trolls are happy to protect your garden from unwanted pests.
name: Garden Troll Varmint Defender

title: Tuft of Hair
flavorText: These wispy blond strands are tied with a purple ribbon. The ribbon is high enough quality to resell.
name: Tuft of Hair

title: Blessed Horker Tusk on Gilt Plaque
flavorText: Horker tusk carved with spiraling prayers to Y'ffre with three blessings from the Silvenar, mounted on a gilt wall plaque.
name: Blessed Horker Tusk on Gilt Plaque

title: Greymist Falls Scrimshaw Tusk
flavorText: Delicate scrimshaw carving on imported horker tusk depicting a couple picnicking at Greymist Falls.
name: Greymist Falls Scrimshaw Tusk

title: Culanda Reading-Wand
flavorText: Ivory wand surmounted with a glowing culanda stone, labeled "Property of Stormhold Mages Guild."
name: Culanda Reading-Wand

title: Sword-Singer's Finger-Weights
flavorText: These small weights help strengthen the fingers of students at Leki's Blade.
name: Sword-Singer's Finger-Weights

title: Pair of Elden Tree Scroll Weights
flavorText: Smooth marble weights, oval, for holding a scroll open on a desk, each engraved with an image of the Elden Tree.
name: Pair of Elden Tree Scroll Weights

title: Camel Whip
flavorText: A finely woven leather whip, made for directing Craglorn camels.
name: Camel Whip

title: Wasp-Wing Betrothal Veil
flavorText: Heirloom Argonian betrothal veil woven of the wings of Shadowfen wasps, both ordinary and giant.
name: Wasp-Wing Betrothal Veil

title: Nord Battle Wraps
flavorText: These leather wrappings bind and encase wounded body parts so a Nord or like-thinking warrior can rush back into battle.
name: Nord Battle Wraps

title: Gem-Studded Copper "Bedroom Yam"
flavorText: A strangely-elongated copper ash yam, studded with peridot "eyes," discreetly engraved "Avani's Forge, Ebonheart."
name: Gem-Studded Copper "Bedroom Yam"

title: Canteen Cozy
flavorText: Used by travelers and soldiers alike, this simple cozy will keep a canteen's contents warm for hours.
name: Canteen Cozy

title: Ball of Royal Ochre Mohair Yarn
flavorText: Ball of top-quality mohair yarn, dyed with the rare and valuable Torval Royal Ochre pigment.
name: Ball of Royal Ochre Mohair Yarn

title: Fragrant Perfume Bottle
flavorText: The bottle says this scent is called "Brooding." It smells like rotting crabapples.
name: Fragrant Perfume Bottle

title: Cologne of Cumberland
flavorText: This bottle of sweet smelling oil is an exquisite cologne mixed by the royal alchemist for the noble families of Cumberland.
name: Cologne of Cumberland

title: Werewolf Musk Oil
flavorText: Perfume distilled from the musk of a werewolf. Some use it as a fragrance, others as a way to avoid prowling werewolves.
name: Werewolf Musk Oil

title: Torchbug Hair Tonic
flavorText: A clear jar full of glowing liquid distilled from torchbugs, some young men and women apply it to try to make their hair glow.
name: Torchbug Hair Tonic

title: Scent of Magicka Cologne
flavorText: A bottle of flowery perfume. The label promises to make anyone smell like a powerful magic-user.
name: Scent of Magicka Cologne

title: Miniature Crystal Wine Bottle
flavorText: A limited-edition tiny wine bottle produced for a local winery's hundredth anniversary.
name: Miniature Crystal Wine Bottle

title: Gold Coast Cleaning Oil
flavorText: A small bottle of oil used by the Gold Coast mercenaries to clean and oil their leather armor.
name: Gold Coast Cleaning Oil

title: Beetle Drippings Thinking Oil
flavorText: A bottle of pungent oil rubbed into the scalp. The vapors are said to help concentrate on repetitive tasks.
name: Beetle Drippings Thinking Oil

title: Royal Seraglio Perfumed Oil
flavorText: A bottle of fragrant oil that some find to be a mild aphrodesiac. Others find its smell appalling.
name: Royal Seraglio Perfumed Oil

title: Color-Changing Ink
flavorText: An unusual ink crafted by alchemists at Good Titrations in Dhalmora, it appears as one color but transforms into another color.
name: Color-Changing Ink

title: Essence of Bleakrock
flavorText: A wild and wintery cologne for the discerning Nords of Bleakrock, it's surprisingly crafted from a recipe by Biiri the Dark Elf.
name: Essence of Bleakrock

title: Beetle-Be-Gone
flavorText: Guaranteed to keep biting insects out of your bed linens. It works great if you don't mind your bed smelling like rotten limes.
name: Beetle-Be-Gone

title: Kollopi Root Mouth Freshener
flavorText: The dry taste of the kollopi root may not be pleasant, but it absorbs all odors, leaving one's breath smelling perfectly fresh.
name: Kollopi Root Mouth Freshener

title: Red Asp Courting Oil
flavorText: This oil creates an intoxicating aroma. The Red Asp and his colleagues use it for wooing women and disabling their enemies.
name: Red Asp Courting Oil

title: Aurona's Breath Freshener
flavorText: Alchemist Aurona in Mournhold crafts this refreshing concoction that eliminates bad breath and removes tarnish from silver.
name: Aurona's Breath Freshener

title: Frostbite Spider Musk Oil
flavorText: Perfumed oil distilled from the musk of a frostbite spider. Some Nords regularly apply it to their wrists and ears.
name: Frostbite Spider Musk Oil

title: Vivec's Volcanic Vapors
flavorText: A sweet-smelling oil, burned at night to make a Dark Elf's bedchamber calm and fragrant.
name: Vivec's Volcanic Vapors

title: Kinhouse Cologne
flavorText: A bottle of spiced perfume from the alchemists of House Indoril, which comes in different fragrances specific to each house.
name: Kinhouse Cologne

title: Deldwine's Unusual Vintage
flavorText: A foul-tasting liquid that turns one's urine the same color of ink used by Pact officials. Desperate forgers might pay for this.
name: Deldwine's Unusual Vintage

title: Aleeto's Invigorating Tincture
flavorText: A popular salutary said to treat numerous romantic ailments, sold exclusively at the Uncanny Alembic in Fort Amol.
name: Aleeto's Invigorating Tincture

title: Essence of Mammoth
flavorText: An expensive fragrance created by alchemists in Windhelm, popular with wealthy maidens and matrons for special occasions.
name: Essence of Mammoth

title: Monkey Musk Oil
flavorText: Perfumed oil distilled from the musk of a monkey. Khajiit regularly apply generous amounts behind their tail and ears.
name: Monkey Musk Oil

title: Wart-Away Foot Balm
flavorText: A soothing ointment sold exclusively at Menoit's Emporium in Crosswych, it supposedly removes warts and foot fungus.
name: Wart-Away Foot Balm

title: Bear Musk Oil
flavorText: Perfumed oil distilled from the musk of a black bear. Bretons regularly apply generous amounts behind their wrists and ears.
name: Bear Musk Oil

title: Orc Sweat Cologne
flavorText: An expensive fragrance created by alchemists in Aldcroft, popular with wealthy Bretons who want to unleash their inner Orc.
name: Orc Sweat Cologne

title: Amorous Incense of Mara
flavorText: An expensive and illegal fragrance used to enhance romantic activity in the bedchambers of wealthy Bretons.
name: Amorous Incense of Mara

title: Bottle of Torchbug Ink
flavorText: Bottle of glowing ink that, when applied to parchment, draws greenly luminous letters.
name: Bottle of Torchbug Ink

title: Bottle of Five-Filtered Eel Unguent
flavorText: Fancy green-glass bottle of eel unguent filtered five times through cheesecloth for purity.
name: Bottle of Five-Filtered Eel Unguent

title: Carved Ivory Lotion Bottle
flavorText: Ornamental carved ivory bottle labeled "Green Witch Brand Wrinkle Remover" and containing a glowing chartreuse unguent.
name: Carved Ivory Lotion Bottle

title: Aristocrat's Alabaster Perfume Bottle
flavorText: Alabaster perfume bottle with squeeze bulb and brass atomizer, half full of "Eau de Boar Bacon."
name: Aristocrat's Alabaster Perfume Bottle

title: Essence of Ravenwatch
flavorText: House Ravenwatch has been manufacturing and selling this fragrant cologne since before the rise of King Ranser.
name: Essence of Ravenwatch

title: Argonian Cologne
flavorText: A small glass bottle filled with a strong-smelling liquid. It's a scent that only Argonians could find alluring.
name: Argonian Cologne

title: Vintage Snake Sweat Perfume
flavorText: Fine crystal perfume bottle containing bladder-aged "snake sweat," vintage 2E 555.
name: Vintage Snake Sweat Perfume

title: Essence of the Rift
flavorText: A distinct and fragrant cologne for the discerning Nord, it's surprisingly crafted from a recipe by Darva the Dark Elf.
name: Essence of the Rift

title: Nord Sweat Cologne
flavorText: An expensive fragrance created by alchemists in Riften, popular with wealthy Dark Elves who want to unleash their inner Nord.
name: Nord Sweat Cologne

title: Bottle of Red Claw Polish
flavorText: Bottle of bright crimson claw polish, with applicator brush, for use when both moons are dark ("Sangiin's Midnight").
name: Bottle of Red Claw Polish

title: Bottle of Catnip Perfume
flavorText: Delicate perfume bottle containing aromatic catnip fragrance, from The Hissing Phial.
name: Bottle of Catnip Perfume

title: Bottle of Pyandonean Snake Essence
flavorText: Maormer perfume: the liquid in this bottle has a strong reptilian odor.
name: Bottle of Pyandonean Snake Essence

title: Bottle of Kinlord's Flagstaff Vigor Pills
flavorText: Large green-glass bottle of Kinlord's Flagstaff vitality lozenges, "concocted from rare ingredients" by Aldmeri Essences.
name: Bottle of Kinlord's Flagstaff Vigor Pills

title: Desert Cologne
flavorText: Opening this gilded and polished bottle of liquid releases an overwhelming smell. At least you can sell the bottle.
name: Desert Cologne

title: Ghost Orchid Perfume
flavorText: A crystal vial of perfume scented with ghost orchid, one of the rarest and most coveted flowers in all of Tamriel.
name: Ghost Orchid Perfume

title: Grandma Singa's Hairball Remedy
flavorText: A bottle of Singa-dra's Digestive Aid and Hairball Remedy Elixer. Now in delightful Cod flavor!
name: Grandma Singa's Hairball Remedy

title: Poplar Bark Headache Strips
flavorText: A bottle of chewable strips of poplar bark, designed to relieve headaches. It's increasingly poplar!
name: Poplar Bark Headache Strips

title: Ship In A Bottle
flavorText: A finely-crafted model of the Abecean Monarch, an Altmer ship of the All Flags Navy, constructed inside a small-necked bottle.
name: Ship In A Bottle

title: Cyrodiil Combat Canteen
flavorText: An ornate and rather ostentatious drinking vessel provided to those who volunteer to fight in the Three Banners War.
name: Cyrodiil Combat Canteen

title: Caravaneer's Canteen
flavorText: A sturdy steel canteen, emblazoned with the caravaneer's guild heraldry. A valuable tool in trade negotiations.
name: Caravaneer's Canteen

title: Engraved Silver Flagon
flavorText: This imposing tankard has the seal of the Screaming Mermaid engraved on it.
name: Engraved Silver Flagon

title: Snow-Squatter's Wrap
flavorText: Some say only milk-drinkers use these fur-lined wraps when relieving themselves at night, yet most Nords keep one by the door.
name: Snow-Squatter's Wrap

title: Belt of Smaller Carpentry Tools
flavorText: Guar-leather belt carrying an assortment of smaller carpentry tools, labeled "Property of Stonecrush Lumber Camp."
name: Belt of Smaller Carpentry Tools

title: Crossed Scimitars Buckle
flavorText: A metal buckle bearing the image of crossed scimitars, a symbol with profound meaning to Redguards.
name: Crossed Scimitars Buckle

title: Snakeskin Cuffs
flavorText: One loop of these snakeskin bindings can be adjusted to fit a wrist or an ankle. The other is fitted for a common bedpost.
name: Snakeskin Cuffs

title: Horse-Hide Falconer's Gage
flavorText: This triple-layered glove was crafted for a Forebear noble and decorated with a depiction of Tava.
name: Horse-Hide Falconer's Gage

title: Belkarth Oven Mitt
flavorText: This heavy woolen glove is perfect for pulling kebabs out of a hot clay oven.
name: Belkarth Oven Mitt

title: Mammoth-Hide Falconer's Gage
flavorText: A well-made falconer's glove made of finely-stitched mammoth leather.
name: Mammoth-Hide Falconer's Gage

title: Duneripper Scale Ankle Cuff
flavorText: This honorary ankle cuff was given as a bonus to the workers who tiled the royal palace in Sentinel.
name: Duneripper Scale Ankle Cuff

title: Calf-Skin Hand Warmer
flavorText: A muff purportedly created by "indigenous tribal crafters" and sold exclusively in high-end shops throughout Tamriel.
name: Calf-Skin Hand Warmer

title: Silent Mire Hand Warmer
flavorText: A muff crafted by the Argonians of Silent Mire and sold exclusively to the highest echelon of Dark Elf society by House Hlaalu.
name: Silent Mire Hand Warmer

title: Teeba-Hatsei Hip Pad
flavorText: Worn by Murkmire "hip-and-tail-ball" players, this padding of wood and dried wasso leaves is a conversation piece in Bal Foyen.
name: Teeba-Hatsei Hip Pad

title: Sep Cultist's Cilice
flavorText: A silver barb-lined strap to dig into the wearer's chest, held in a small box. They are used by members of a secret cult of Sep.
name: Sep Cultist's Cilice

title: Rilis Tabard
flavorText: A hand-embroidered coat of arms.
name: Rilis Tabard

title: Argonian Tail Band
flavorText: A band of colored leather worn as a decorative element on the tails of some Dhalmora Argonians. This one has bells attached.
name: Argonian Tail Band

title: Cloven Silver Circlet
flavorText: An old circlet likely worn by some of Betony's lesser royalty, split in twain by an axe strike and mounted to a plaque.
name: Cloven Silver Circlet

title: Antler Headdress
flavorText: A purely decorative headdress affixed to the heads of statues on holy days.
name: Antler Headdress

title: Holiday Antler Circlet, with Bells
flavorText: Child-sized birthday wear: a croc-leather brow circlet mounted with forehead antlers, and a silver bell hanging from each point.
name: Holiday Antler Circlet, with Bells

title: Broken Nord Helm
flavorText: A cloven Nord helmet, mounted on a cracked longboat oar.
name: Broken Nord Helm

title: Broken Ornamental Horned Helm
flavorText: Full-helm, broken, ornamented with curved horns, with maker's-mark of "Defender's Domain."
name: Broken Ornamental Horned Helm

title: Broken Akaviri Hoplite's Blade
flavorText: Akaviri swordsman's steel blade, broken and missing its hilt, a souvenir of the recent invasion.
name: Broken Akaviri Hoplite's Blade

title: House Tharn Family Crest
flavorText: This highly-detailed embroidered crest of House Tharn, dating back to the First Era, is of great historical and artistic value.
name: House Tharn Family Crest

title: Bear-Claw Parchment Clasp
flavorText: A clasp cleverly crafted from the claw of a snow bear to hold sheets of loose parchment together.
name: Bear-Claw Parchment Clasp

title: Autographed Green Lady Silhouette
flavorText: Silhouette graven on copperplate of the late Green Lady, personally autographed by Her Verdant Highness.
name: Autographed Green Lady Silhouette

title: Jade Cameo Sculpture
flavorText: This lovingly polished relief sculpture depicts a Dunmer in profile.
name: Jade Cameo Sculpture

title: Enchanted Broom
flavorText: An otherwise unremarkable broom, enchanted to sweep an entire room by itself when its owner claps thrice.
name: Enchanted Broom

title: Bloodthorn Yoke
flavorText: A chain of braided, thorn-covered vines that bites into the flesh, supposedly worn by members of the Bloodthorn cult.
name: Bloodthorn Yoke

title: String of Thrassian Pearls
flavorText: Precious stones of radiant blue from the Coral Kingdoms, where no man or mer dares tread, passed down from the First Era.
name: String of Thrassian Pearls

title: Queen Nurnhilde's Nail Clipping
flavorText: A locket with a nail supposedly clipped from the corpse of Queen Nurnhilde before her interment.
name: Queen Nurnhilde's Nail Clipping

title: Ivory Lapel Pins
flavorText: These delicate lapel pins have strange symbols carved into their delicate curves.
name: Ivory Lapel Pins

title: Mournhold Memento Box
flavorText: A collection of Mournhold mementos, obviously important to their owner, including locks of hair and other sentimental items.
name: Mournhold Memento Box

title: Braided Feather Ornament
flavorText: An elaborate ornament featuring a splash of feathers, cowry shells, and dyed reed ribbons.
name: Braided Feather Ornament

title: Sentinel Cutlery
flavorText: A set of expertly crafted Redguard cutlery, imported from Alik'r for use only by the most discerning chefs.
name: Sentinel Cutlery

title: Cabbage Slicer
flavorText: To the untrained eye, this bronze cabbage slicer appears to be of Dwemer design. Everyone else knows they're made in Daggerfall.
name: Cabbage Slicer

title: Ebony Spoon
flavorText: It's hard to imagine who would waste ebony ore to forge a spoon, but that doesn't make it any less valuable.
name: Ebony Spoon

title: Pocket Knife
flavorText: Too small to be used in combat, this small knife would be perfect for general daily use while out and about.
name: Pocket Knife

title: Bright Butcher's Cleaver
flavorText: A fat cleaver with a notch designed specifically for scraping meat from bones.
name: Bright Butcher's Cleaver

title: Magnifica's Nail Trimmer
flavorText: A small, golden device used by Hammerfell's nobles to trim their nails.
name: Magnifica's Nail Trimmer

title: Shalk-Resin Nail Trimmer
flavorText: A small device made of hardened shalk resin, designed to keep a Dark Elf's nails neat and trim.
name: Shalk-Resin Nail Trimmer

title: Nord Cheese Chopper
flavorText: A polished metal chopping blade designed to slice chunks from massive cheese wheels. The hilt is carved to look like a Dragon.
name: Nord Cheese Chopper

title: Baan Dar Whittling Knife
flavorText: Ostensibly designed for whittling, Khajiit and Wood Elf alike are known to employ these blades in popular tavern games.
name: Baan Dar Whittling Knife

title: Ayleid Flesh-Sculpting Flenser
flavorText: Ancient, corroded flenser as used by Ayleid "flesh sculptors," engraved with the Ayleidoon "N" for Ne Salas.
name: Ayleid Flesh-Sculpting Flenser

title: Fine Steel Skinning Kit
flavorText: An imported Khajiiti skinning kit, only lightly used.
name: Fine Steel Skinning Kit

title: Fine Steel Paper Opener
flavorText: A small, dull sword-shaped opener for cutting open envelopes and untrimmed books; engraved "The Fighting Edge, Shornhelm."
name: Fine Steel Paper Opener

title: Oyster-Shell Drawknife
flavorText: This woodworking tool was deftly constructed. Its nacre blade shimmers in the light.
name: Oyster-Shell Drawknife

title: Dreugh-Claw Paring Knife
flavorText: This small cooking knife appears to be an antique.
name: Dreugh-Claw Paring Knife

title: Ivory-Handled Eel Flensers
flavorText: Set of razor-sharp ivory-handled eel knives for tableside skin-flensing; in a handsome presentation box.
name: Ivory-Handled Eel Flensers

title: Envelope Opener with Rilis Sigil
flavorText: This platinum-chased envelope opener bears the sigil of House Rilis on its pommel.
name: Envelope Opener with Rilis Sigil

title: Bosmer Cutlery
flavorText: A set of finely shaped cutlery made entirely of silver. Sets like these are highly valued by Bosmer who follow the Green Pact.
name: Bosmer Cutlery

title: Edifying Illusio-Scope
flavorText: Bulging device with inward-facing goggles and a crank that, when turned, shows the viewer  moving images of Bosmer procreation.
name: Edifying Illusio-Scope

title: High King's Lion
flavorText: A medal shaped like a lion's head, High King Emeric awards the Lion for acts of heroism and special service to the crown.
name: High King's Lion

title: Sentinel Lion Medal
flavorText: A Redguard medal bearing the image of a lion on the front and a Sentinel maker's mark on the back.
name: Sentinel Lion Medal

title: Tarnished Medal of Valor
flavorText: A golden emblem bearing the Covenant's heraldry, cast aside and forgotten.
name: Tarnished Medal of Valor

title: Wayrest Medal of Bravery
flavorText: One of many military decorations King Emeric bestowed upon his knights after their victory in Ranser's War.
name: Wayrest Medal of Bravery

title: Cyrodiil Badge of Honor
flavorText: A prestigious gold medal given to warriors wounded in the Three Banners War.
name: Cyrodiil Badge of Honor

title: Dwarven Compass
flavorText: Made of simple copper, this Dwemer device is used to measure or maintain orientation.
name: Dwarven Compass

title: First Auridon Marines Medal
flavorText: A sterling silver veteran's medal presented to those who have served in the First Auridon Marines.
name: First Auridon Marines Medal

title: Fine Arkay Talisman
flavorText: This golden talisman may have been worn by Frederique Lynielle. The clasp is broken, but it remains a beautiful piece.
name: Fine Arkay Talisman

title: Tribunal Medal of Honor
flavorText: One of many military decorations the Tribunal bestowed upon their best soldiers after defeating the Akaviri.
name: Tribunal Medal of Honor

title: Cyrodiil Service Medal
flavorText: The Skald-King honors soldiers who return from the War of Three Banners with one of these prestigious gold medals.
name: Cyrodiil Service Medal

title: Cyrodiil Medal of Honor
flavorText: High King Emeric honors soldiers who return from the War of Three Banners with one of these prestigious silver medals.
name: Cyrodiil Medal of Honor

title: Orc Tusk Consolation Medal
flavorText: Catgut strung with a dozen Wood Orc tusks, attached to a bone disc; engraved "Drublog Orc Hunt, Runner-Up."
name: Orc Tusk Consolation Medal

title: Chimer Talisman of Boethiah
flavorText: Ancient copper disc depicting the once-great temple to Boethiah on Ash Mountain.
name: Chimer Talisman of Boethiah

title: Commemorative "Broken Shackles" Medal
flavorText: Bronze medal depicting a set of broken shackles, inscribed "Jubilee Day 572, Lukiul Uxith."
name: Commemorative "Broken Shackles" Medal

title: Dres Grandmaster Memorial Medal
flavorText: Golden medal memorializing Grandmaster Thalthil Dres, who established Dres as a Great House by his slave-raid on Thorn.
name: Dres Grandmaster Memorial Medal

title: Icon of Almalexia Blessing Iliath Temple
flavorText: Icon depicting Almalexia blessing Iliath Temple, with the Lady rendered in genuine gold leaf.
name: Icon of Almalexia Blessing Iliath Temple

title: Naemon Commemorative Matriculation Token
flavorText: Gold token commemorating Prince Naemon's matriculation to the Sapiarchs' Labyrinth in 2E 573.
name: Naemon Commemorative Matriculation Token

title: Star-Gazer Medal
flavorText: A large, ebony medal with three constellations carved into the back of it, representing the Warrior, the Mage, and the Thief.
name: Star-Gazer Medal

title: Wooden Kynareth Talisman
flavorText: This talisman looks well-traveled. Strands of worn leather dangle like hanging moss.
name: Wooden Kynareth Talisman

title: Household Napkin Holder
flavorText: A metal band displaying a family motif to decorate and identify the owner of a particular linen napkin.
name: Household Napkin Holder

title: Indoril Councilor's Seal
flavorText: Heavy gold seal of House Indoril; used to press the house seal into warm wax when sealing official envelopes.
name: Indoril Councilor's Seal

title: Gold-Plated Napkin Holder Set
flavorText: A very rare set of gold-plated napkin holders used at the feast celebrating the coronation of King Hidellith.
name: Gold-Plated Napkin Holder Set

title: Imperial Napkin Holders
flavorText: These expensive ebony napkin holders were a gift from a Colovian noble to High King Amdashir of Hammerfell.
name: Imperial Napkin Holders

title: Brass Wedding Pin
flavorText: This simple pin symbolizes an eternal bond of love. If its bestower wasn't so cheap, it would be worth more for resale.
name: Brass Wedding Pin

title: Silver Serviette Holder
flavorText: A set of eight serviette holders, decorated with delicate filigree.
name: Silver Serviette Holder

title: Souvenir Imperial Heater
flavorText: A souvenir from a battle with Imperial forces, this cracked and dented shield has been mounted to a plaque.
name: Souvenir Imperial Heater

title: Curious Steel Platter
flavorText: Upon close inspection, this centuries-old platter was originally an ornate Breton buckler. Now it's only good for serving food.
name: Curious Steel Platter

title: Cracked Argonian Shell Boss
flavorText: A souvenir from a battle with Pact forces. There is a prominent crack in the turtle-shell casing.
name: Cracked Argonian Shell Boss

title: Cloven Centurion's Scutum
flavorText: This cracked Imperial shield is hundreds of years old. A fragile heirloom, now useless for the battlefield.
name: Cloven Centurion's Scutum

title: Thunderbug Climbing Cleats
flavorText: Ankle gaiters with in-turned cleats made of thunderbug mandibles, used for climbing trees to archery platforms.
name: Thunderbug Climbing Cleats

title: Jester's Day Ox-Hoof Cleats
flavorText: When attached to boots, these cleats leave prints like oxen for Jester's Day pranks; they still smell slightly of ox-dung.
name: Jester's Day Ox-Hoof Cleats

title: Jester's Day "Platform Boots"
flavorText: Hilarious attachable prank stilts for standing in deep puddles to make them seem shallow. "Gets 'em every time," says the label.
name: Jester's Day "Platform Boots"

title: Calf-Skin Baby Shoes
flavorText: A pair of baby shoes, never worn.
name: Calf-Skin Baby Shoes

title: Nix-Hound Booties
flavorText: Councilor Tredere Redoran commissioned specially crafted footwear for her beloved nix-hound, Flanish.
name: Nix-Hound Booties

title: Nord Snowshoes
flavorText: A well-crafted pair of Nord snowshoes with intricately-woven mesh and polished bentwood frames.
name: Nord Snowshoes

title: Hozzin's Snowshoe
flavorText: A single contrivance consisting of a frame of stretched-leather thongs that, in pairs, enable a wearer to walk across deep snow.
name: Hozzin's Snowshoe

title: Fine Waterproof Stilt-Boots
flavorText: Waterproof snakeskin stilt-boots for fishing in the shore-swamps, crafted at Vineshade Lodge.
name: Fine Waterproof Stilt-Boots

title: Stuffed Troll Head
flavorText: A stuffed and mounted troll head, the eyes surprisingly alert and bright, they seem to follow you with hungry anticipation.
name: Stuffed Troll Head

title: Golden Mudcrab Plaque
flavorText: Gilded mudcrab mounted on dreugh-shell plaque, inscribed "Best in Class, Sunscale Strand Mudcrab Heave."
name: Golden Mudcrab Plaque

title: Mounted Trophy Slaughterfish
flavorText: This large slaughterfish is displayed on a simple wooden mount. A plaque underneath claims it to be the largest ever caught.
name: Mounted Trophy Slaughterfish

title: Mounted Stag Head
flavorText: Inanimate, but still imposing. It would make an excellent decorative piece on any mantle.
name: Mounted Stag Head

title: Stuffed Nix-Hound
flavorText: Hlanus Hlaalu's son adored his many nix-hounds, so much so that when they died, he had them stuffed.
name: Stuffed Nix-Hound

title: Elden Tree Golden Acorn Plaque
flavorText: Fist-sized golden acorn mounted on a wall plaque, reading "Winner, Annual Elden Tree Speed Climb."
name: Elden Tree Golden Acorn Plaque

title: Lifelike Stuffed Dog
flavorText: A prized pet dog, stuffed and mounted for display, shows how far wealthy citizens will go to keep memories alive.
name: Lifelike Stuffed Dog

title: Creepy Stuffed Crow
flavorText: A prized pet crow, stuffed and mounted for display, shows how far wealthy Rivenspire citizens will go to hold onto the past.
name: Creepy Stuffed Crow

title: Stuffed Kwama Scrib
flavorText: A stuffed and mounted baby kwama. It is undeniably adorable.
name: Stuffed Kwama Scrib

title: Mounted Troll Head
flavorText: Though it makes an unsightly trophy, someone was clearly very proud of killing this young she-troll and mounted her head.
name: Mounted Troll Head

title: Depressing Stuffed Goat
flavorText: A prized pet goat, stuffed and mounted for display, shows how far wealthy Riften citizens will go to hold onto the past.
name: Depressing Stuffed Goat

title: Stuffed Scamp Head
flavorText: A stuffed and mounted Scamp head, the eyes surprisingly alert and bright, covered with a fine layer of dust.
name: Stuffed Scamp Head

title: Dragonstar Arena Consolation Prize
flavorText: The steel-dipped spine of a failed Dragonstar Arena competitor. Typically presented to next of kin, or sold on the black market.
name: Dragonstar Arena Consolation Prize

title: Ornamental Taxidermied Alit Head
flavorText: Carefully-preserved alit head, tanned skin stretched over skull, painted with Green Pact symbols, with emeralds for eyes.
name: Ornamental Taxidermied Alit Head

title: Mounted Bat's Head
flavorText: A massive bat head, mounted on a stone plaque. The fangs are still sharp.
name: Mounted Bat's Head

title: Stuffed Bat
flavorText: It seems someone fired an arrow right through this bat's head, then had it stuffed and mounted for bragging rights.
name: Stuffed Bat

title: Stuffed Camel Head
flavorText: A stuffed and mounted camel head, the eyes surprisingly alert and bright, covered with a fine layer of dust.
name: Stuffed Camel Head

title: Stuffed Sentinel Cat
flavorText: Fahara'jad's daughters adopted many stray cats. The girls loved them so much, that when they died, he had them stuffed.
name: Stuffed Sentinel Cat

title: Lifelike Stuffed Chicken
flavorText: A prized pet chicken, stuffed and mounted for display, shows how far wealthy Daggerfall citizens will go to keep memories alive.
name: Lifelike Stuffed Chicken

title: Thizzrini Grand Champion Medal
flavorText: This medal, in the shape of a three-sided pyramid, is engraved with depictions of a swordmaster, sorcerer and summoner.
name: Thizzrini Grand Champion Medal

title: Stuffed Fox
flavorText: A stuffed, taxidermied fox mounted on a polished mahogany base.
name: Stuffed Fox

title: Mounted Gargoyle Head
flavorText: As difficult as killing a gargoyle may be, removing one's head is even harder, making this noble's trophy extremely valuable.
name: Mounted Gargoyle Head

title: Golden Royal Fishing Statuette
flavorText: Gold-plated statuette of a leaping trout engraved "Royal Camoran Fishing Tournament, 2E 561."
name: Golden Royal Fishing Statuette

title: Pet Monkey Red Vest and Fez
flavorText: Tiny embroidered red vest and tiny red fez with yellow tassel; a label inside the lapel reads "Noryariel, Tailor."
name: Pet Monkey Red Vest and Fez

title: Combination Letter Opener and Rodent Skewer
flavorText: Small slim blade the length of an index finger, weighted for throwing across the room, but harmless to all but small rodents.
name: Combination Letter Opener and Rodent Skewer

title: Ivory-Handled Plume Trimmer
flavorText: A small, slim pair of scissors that fold into a handle of timber-mammoth ivory.
name: Ivory-Handled Plume Trimmer

title: Souvenir Cyrodiil Hammer Head
flavorText: A souvenir from a battle in the War of the Three Banners, this detached warhammer head makes a compelling paperweight.
name: Souvenir Cyrodiil Hammer Head

title: Three Banners War Memorabilia
flavorText: Mementos recovered from fallen warriors in the Three Banners War and preserved for posterity by a Craglorn relic hunter.
name: Three Banners War Memorabilia

title: Dwemer Hammer Hilt
flavorText: The hilt of an ancient Dwemer warhammer, retained as an heirloom by some Dark Elf family.
name: Dwemer Hammer Hilt

title: Orc Chieftain's Spearhead
flavorText: A souvenir from the Breton-Orc conflicts of the past, this ornate spearhead was probably wielded by an Orc chieftain.
name: Orc Chieftain's Spearhead

title: Royal Mahout's Ceremonial Ankus
flavorText: Bejeweled ankus of the First Era formerly used on holidays by a mahout of the Royal Camoran Timber Mammoth Corps.
name: Royal Mahout's Ceremonial Ankus

title: At-Tura Scimitar Sheath
flavorText: Count Hosni at-Tura is known for keeping a vast collection of ornate scimitar sheaths from all over Hammerfell.
name: At-Tura Scimitar Sheath

title: Aldmeri Ceremonial Saber
flavorText: A purely ornamental saber. The refined artistic design is matched only by the fragility of its construction.
name: Aldmeri Ceremonial Saber

title: Nedic Sword Pommel
flavorText: The pommel of an ancient Nedic sword, retained as an heirloom by some Breton family.
name: Nedic Sword Pommel

title: Sword-Disciple's Jewelled Pommel
flavorText: A pommel fashioned in the Yokudan style, and possibly constructed in that faraway land.
name: Sword-Disciple's Jewelled Pommel

title: Snake-Sword Hilt
flavorText: The hilt of an Akaviri weapon, undoubtedly a souvenir taken from a fallen Snake during the war.
name: Snake-Sword Hilt

title: Atmoran Dagger Hilt
flavorText: The hilt of an ancient Atmoran dagger, retained as an heirloom by some Nord household.
name: Atmoran Dagger Hilt

title: Wooden Letter Opener
flavorText: Decorative lines are carved into the handle of the dark wooden letter opener.
name: Wooden Letter Opener

title: Silver Shaving Razor
flavorText: A shave doesn't get much closer with this silver razor.
name: Silver Shaving Razor

title: Monkeybone Fruit Peeler
flavorText: A thin, curved tool made from monkeybone and designed to peel fruit.
name: Monkeybone Fruit Peeler

title: Golden Letter Opener
flavorText: Taken from a well-stocked Aldmeri tradeship, this tool has Dominion heraldry emblazoned on the handle.
name: Golden Letter Opener

title: Royal Accolade of the Hunt
