title: Psijic Ambrosia
abilityDescription: You gain a |cffffff50|r% Experience Point bonus from all sources for |cffffff30|r minutes. The timer pauses when you are offline, and resumes when you return. This bonus is compatible with other foods or drinks.
name: Psijic Ambrosia

title: Perfect Roe
flavorText: Beautiful and fragrant, Perfect Roe is prized by Provisioners the world over as an ingredient in the rarest of recipes.
name: Perfect Roe

title: The Birthsign Amulet
enchantDescription: Adds |cffffff10|r Magicka Recovery.
flavorText: The centerpiece of this necklace is emblazoned with the constellation of your birthdate. What are the odds, eh?
name: The Birthsign Amulet

setBonuses.description: (4 items) Adds 1 Weapon and Spell Damage

traitDescription: Increases Maximum Magicka by |cffffff17|r.

title: Dunmer Cultural Garb
flavorText: This stylish Dark Elf clothing displays a variety of garish colors.
name: Dunmer Cultural Garb

title: Brain Broth
abilityDescription: You gain a |cffffff100|r% Experience Point bonus from all sources for |cffffff40|r minutes. The timer pauses when you are offline, and resumes when you return.
name: Brain Broth
traitDescription: Increases inspiration gained from deconstruction of this item by |cffffff400|r%, and gain additional refined material upon deconstruction of this item.

title: Illegible Page From the Oghma Infinium
flavorText: This torn page depicts multiple circular diagrams adorned with Daedric letters in a deep, black ink.
name: Illegible Page From the Oghma Infinium

title: Piece of Volendrung's Handle
flavorText: Reputedly of Rourken clan make, this shattered hilt-shard is emblazoned with the blunt runes of the Dwarves.
name: Piece of Volendrung's Handle

title: Golden Tooth of a Golden Saint
flavorText: A detailed emblem depicting an elderly man with three faces is carved into this gleaming tooth.
name: Golden Tooth of a Golden Saint

title: Haft of a Daedric Scythe
flavorText: This hilt begins and ends with silver guards, though the blades are missing. A single, fanged Daedric letter adorns each hilt.
name: Haft of a Daedric Scythe

title: Bone Fragment From the Spine of Ashpit
flavorText: This grey block is so light as to be hollow, and it sheds dust of a similar color as if it were made of the stuff.
name: Bone Fragment From the Spine of Ashpit

title: Star Tooth Shard
flavorText: This thin slice of crystal glows with a soft, inner light.
name: Star Tooth Shard

title: Blade From a Razor Pit
flavorText: Daedric inscriptions adorn this scalpel-thin blade in a stark, blood-red.
name: Blade From a Razor Pit

title: Petal From the Sanguine Rose
flavorText: From a rare flower said to bloom in the myriad planes of Oblivion.
name: Petal From the Sanguine Rose

title: Jar of Wild Hunt Vapor
flavorText: An Altmeri label on this jar of thick, vacuous liquid claims it was collected in the wake of a Wild Hunt in Skyrim.
name: Jar of Wild Hunt Vapor

title: Dwemer Animunculi Schematics
flavorText: These complex schematics detail several types of Dwemer builder constructs.
name: Dwemer Animunculi Schematics

title: Vein From the Heart of Lorkhan
flavorText: This red, crystal vein is said to have been chipped from the Heart of Lorkhan itself.
name: Vein From the Heart of Lorkhan

title: Vial of Ashpit Air
flavorText: This small ampoule is filled with a thick, roiling vapor. A small label with Mages Guild letterhead reads, "Air from Ashpit."
name: Vial of Ashpit Air

title: Haft-shard of Sunder
flavorText: A massive splinter of rune-carved oak, this artifact seems to be evidence of Kagrenac's legendary tools.
name: Haft-shard of Sunder

title: Banner of House Dagoth
flavorText: This ancient banner is torn, but the seal of the infamous House Dagoth shines through despite the grime and tattered cloth.
name: Banner of House Dagoth

title: Ruby from the Ruby Throne
flavorText: This sparkling gem is the size of a grown Orc's fist and has been shaped to form a simulacrum of the Imperial Ruby.
name: Ruby from the Ruby Throne

title: Box of Shehai Essence
flavorText: This wooden box is covered in Yokudan runes. Altmeri writing on an attached label reads, "Essence of Shattered Spirit Sword."
name: Box of Shehai Essence

title: Auriel's Quiver
flavorText: This ivory case is embossed with gold. Scholarly markings identify it as "Auriel's Quiver," for whatever that's worth.
name: Auriel's Quiver

title: Sword-Singer Manual
flavorText: This well-worn collection of pages lacks a proper cover, but contains detailed diagrams and illustrations of sword techniques.
name: Sword-Singer Manual

title: Dwemer Red Mountain Standard
flavorText: This tattered banner bearing the seal of some forgotten Dwemeri house is said to have come from the battlefield of Red Mountain.
name: Dwemer Red Mountain Standard

title: Shatter-shard of Mehrunes' Razor
flavorText: This piece of shattered black metal seems to drink light. Part of an emblazoned Daedric script runs along its length.
name: Shatter-shard of Mehrunes' Razor

title: Lantern of the Golden Era
flavorText: This fog lamp bears the crest of the "Golden Era," flagship for the fabled All-Flags Navy.
name: Lantern of the Golden Era

title: Hairbrush of the First Mane
flavorText: The headdress worn by Rid-Thar-ri'Datta was woven from the manes of two dozen chieftains. It required a lot of brushing.
name: Hairbrush of the First Mane

title: Hunding's Blade-Shard
flavorText: A shard from the shattered blade of Frandar Hunding himself, a relic of the battle at Hattu Mountain.
name: Hunding's Blade-Shard

title: Prayer Cloth of the Yokudan War-Gods
flavorText: An ancient wall scroll studied by the Maidens of the Spirit Sword, somehow spirited away from the now-lost island nation.
name: Prayer Cloth of the Yokudan War-Gods

title: Serpent-Veil of Orgnum
flavorText: Tattered silk embroidered with Maormer runes of rulership and bearing the entwined image of mating sea serpents.
name: Serpent-Veil of Orgnum

title: Many-Hued Bird Feather
flavorText: Touching this feather brings a happy little tune, and a brush of mania, to your mind.
name: Many-Hued Bird Feather

title: Ancestor Moth Pupa
flavorText: A green-hued casing from the molt of a rare Ancestor Moth. It smells ever so faintly of fresh grass and clean water.
name: Ancestor Moth Pupa

title: Stamp of the Black Drake
flavorText: A cracked stamp, an official seal from the reign of Durcorach, the first of the Longhouse Emperors.
name: Stamp of the Black Drake

title: Deathbringer Clan Facepaint
flavorText: This small pot of facepaint smells pungently of blood. The sigil of Valkynaz Seris is stamped on the bottom of the glass.
name: Deathbringer Clan Facepaint

title: Skaal-Carved Horker Tusk
flavorText: This scrimshaw depicts the early ancestors of the Skaal people running their boats aground on the isle of Solstheim.
name: Skaal-Carved Horker Tusk

title: Bendu Olo's Sextant
flavorText: The precision of this instrument is uncanny despite its age—a worthy tool for Baron-Admiral Bendu Olo of the All Flags Navy.
name: Bendu Olo's Sextant

title: Fang of Krahjotdaan
flavorText: Faded inscriptions cover the surface of this prodigious yellow fang. They depict the slaying of the high Dragon Krahjotdaan.
name: Fang of Krahjotdaan

title: Sacred Inkwell of Marukh the Seer
flavorText: This finely crafted inkwell was likely used by the prophet Marukh during the days of the Alessian Order.
name: Sacred Inkwell of Marukh the Seer

title: Bolt of the Numidium
flavorText: A massive dwarven bolt, unnaturally warm to the touch. Scholarly markings link it to the legendary Brass God, Numidium.
name: Bolt of the Numidium

title: Scute of the Mock Turtle
flavorText: Most scholars dismiss tales of a massive turtle dwelling beyond the Weir Gate as pure nonsense … but this shell is really big.
name: Scute of the Mock Turtle

title: Blood of St. Pelin
flavorText: This crystal phial is full of what is said to be the blood of St. Pelin the martyr. Even if emptied, the blood always returns.
name: Blood of St. Pelin

title: Plait of Jurgen Windcaller's Beard
flavorText: This ancient nord coffer contains a long braid of gray hair. The plait almost certainly came from the chin of Jurgen Windcaller.
name: Plait of Jurgen Windcaller's Beard

title: Eldergleam Amber
flavorText: A gleaming golden amber that sings a faint and soothing melody. It could only have come from the ancient tree, Eldergleam.
name: Eldergleam Amber

title: Ashes of Lamae Beolfag
flavorText: Looking at these ashes elicits a deep revulsion. They were likely taken from the pyre of the first vampire, Lamae Beolfag.
name: Ashes of Lamae Beolfag

title: Phial of Daedric Whispers
flavorText: This glass phial appears to be empty, but utters dark and seductive whispers when uncorked. The voice is likely that of Mephala.
name: Phial of Daedric Whispers

title: Morihaus Wing Feather
flavorText: A massive golden feather that is lighter than a sparrow, but stronger than steel. This may be a relic of the legendary Morihaus.
name: Morihaus Wing Feather

title: Shard of the Ideal Masters
flavorText: This sliver of crystal buzzes angrily, releasing intermittent pulses of purple light. It may be a fragment of an Ideal Master.
name: Shard of the Ideal Masters

title: Ancient Dragonguard Burial Mask
flavorText: This ancient silver mask is of Akaviri design. It bears the likeness of a hissing serpent devouring the Dragon Vuljotnaak.
name: Ancient Dragonguard Burial Mask

title: Bucket
flavorText: "A Bucket helm? Nope, sorry—who would wear such a thing? It's far too silly and undignified. Be off. …Ha ha ha, fooled you! That sounds splendid! Where can I get one?" —Sir Cadwell of Codswallop
name: Bucket

title: Broom
flavorText: "Lifts-Her-Tail: 'But, my lord, your broom is so very long and stiff! To move it back and forth, I shall have to use both hands!'" — Excerpt from The Dusty Argonian Maid
name: Broom

title: False Teeth Collection
flavorText: A small collection of false teeth, in a mixed assortment of brass and iron. Some are still flecked with dried blood.
name: False Teeth Collection

title: Twisted Nose Ring
flavorText: This bronze-plated hoop became twisted when it was torn from the nostril of a combatant, skin chunk and all.
name: Twisted Nose Ring

title: Decorative Scalp
flavorText: A long set of hair pleats threaded with small glass beads, still attached to a desiccated chunk of skull and skin.
name: Decorative Scalp

title: Not-So-Lucky Nose Needle
flavorText: A long steel needle, once slotted firmly through the nose of a mighty warrior before it was forcibly removed.
name: Not-So-Lucky Nose Needle

title: Tattoo-Skin Wrist Cozy
flavorText: This wristband shows off the delicate tattoo artistry sought out by the skin's original owner.
name: Tattoo-Skin Wrist Cozy

title: Polished Gut-Rock
flavorText: The remnants of a painful buildup passed through the body. Some are polished to a dull sheen and sold by artistic alchemists.
name: Polished Gut-Rock

title: Skeever Skull Trophy
flavorText: A massive alit fang driven straight through the skull of a skeever. The fang is decorated with rustic symbols.
name: Skeever Skull Trophy

title: Kwama Egg Stein
flavorText: A crude stein fashioned from a resin-hardened kwama egg.
name: Kwama Egg Stein

title: Scorpion Barb Sewing Needle
flavorText: A thick barb from a giant scorpion, modified with an eyelet to accommodate ropy thread.
name: Scorpion Barb Sewing Needle

title: Scrimshaw Boot Scraper
flavorText: The end of a carved mammoth's tusk serves as the perfect instrument to scrape mud off of one's boots.
name: Scrimshaw Boot Scraper

title: Harpy Feather Pillow
flavorText: A small road pillow stuffed with harpy feathers. It smells absolutely terrible.
name: Harpy Feather Pillow

title: Traveling Smith's Kit
flavorText: A dusty satchel with a scratched hammer, tongs, and a cracked set of bellows.
name: Traveling Smith's Kit

title: Moon-Sugar Chawbox
flavorText: A small tin box for holding "chewing sugar," a thick form of moon-sugar favored by Baandari traders.
name: Moon-Sugar Chawbox

title: Practice Sword Hilt
flavorText: The cracked hilt of a wooden practice sword. It is sized for a child's hand and carefully wrapped in a piece of cloth.
name: Practice Sword Hilt

title: Cast Iron Toothed Spoon
flavorText: A well-used travel utensil, still flecked with its owner's last meal.
name: Cast Iron Toothed Spoon

title: Tin of Wound Resin
flavorText: A small tin of amber resin, used to seal up small cuts after a fight.
name: Tin of Wound Resin

title: Torn Dominion Rank Insignia
flavorText: A rank insignia torn from the uniform of a Dominion officer. Dark stains suggest they did not survive the encounter.
name: Torn Dominion Rank Insignia

title: Torn Pact Rank Insignia
flavorText: A rank insignia torn from the uniform of a Pact officer. Dark stains suggest they did not survive the encounter.
name: Torn Pact Rank Insignia

title: Torn Covenant Rank Insignia
flavorText: A rank insignia torn from the uniform of a Covenant officer. Dark stains suggest they did not survive the encounter.
name: Torn Covenant Rank Insignia

title: Wolf Leg Baton
flavorText: A wolf's leg reinforced with an iron rod makes for a fierce and festive parade ornamentation.
name: Wolf Leg Baton

title: Cocoa-Coated Leaf Pack
flavorText: A small leather pack filled with cocoa-dusted leaves. When added to tea, it adds a delightful chocolatey tang.
name: Cocoa-Coated Leaf Pack

title: Royal Cartographer's Kit
flavorText: This sturdy satchel contains a silver-coated sextant, fine vellum, inks, and a number of quills.
name: Royal Cartographer's Kit

title: Axe-Haft Incense Holder
flavorText: An incense holder made from the scarred base of a battleaxe haft. A crude inscription reads "Peace, Not Blood."
name: Axe-Haft Incense Holder

title: Dwemer-Metal Shavings
flavorText: A leather pouch containing Dwemer metal shavings, meticulously sliced from a construct.
name: Dwemer-Metal Shavings

title: Finger Bone Charm
flavorText: A calcified finger bone hangs from a simple wrist chain. There is no indication of its original owner.
name: Finger Bone Charm

title: Obsidian Mini Cleaver
flavorText: A stone meat cleaver, sized for the hands of a small child. It is razor sharp to the touch.
name: Obsidian Mini Cleaver

title: Orichalcum Mystery Sphere
flavorText: A dozen colored glass beads cross its surface. Touching a bead causes the color to change, but nothing else seems to happen.
name: Orichalcum Mystery Sphere

title: Hematite Worry Stone
flavorText: A silvery-black worry stone with the symbol of Mephala on its surface. Rubbing it causes blinding headaches.
name: Hematite Worry Stone

title: Horrified Flesh-Mask
flavorText: The dried, frayed face of an elf. The expression on its face is one of abject horror. Either a trophy or a conversation piece.
name: Horrified Flesh-Mask

title: Preserved Sheogorath Tract
flavorText: A bottle of an unidentified liquid, in which floats a chapbook of mad lore. It's unclear how the book got inside the bottle.
name: Preserved Sheogorath Tract

title: Ivory Abacus Rod
flavorText: This ivory rod has six flat sides, each inscribed with simple equations. Intended to help young scholars learn their maths.
name: Ivory Abacus Rod

title: Dwarven-Rune Handkerchief
flavorText: A high quality silk handkerchief, artfully embroidered with Dwemeri runes across its surface.
name: Dwarven-Rune Handkerchief

title: Sload Stomach Pouch
flavorText: A torn coin pouch, apparently made from the voluminous stomach of a Sload bloat-warrior.
name: Sload Stomach Pouch

title: Wamasu Organ Lantern
flavorText: A metal frame sheathed in leather, surrounding the "lightning organ" of a wamasu. It gives off a bright, intermittent light.
name: Wamasu Organ Lantern

title: Imga Fur Hand Warmer
flavorText: A luxurious hand warmer made from a thick, warm pelt. A sewn label inside claims it was made from a "treacherous" Imga.
name: Imga Fur Hand Warmer

title: Hist Bark Cane
flavorText: A cane made of twisted and blackened bark. Putting an ear to the wood allows one to hear quiet sobbing, as if from far off.
name: Hist Bark Cane

title: Dreugh Wax Corker
flavorText: A wax stopper for any open bottle. Some swear it makes the contents more flavorful; others claim it adds a waxy aftertaste.
name: Dreugh Wax Corker

title: Sanguine Devotional Card
flavorText: An illustrated card depicting the Daedric Prince Sanguine offering the bearer a bottle.
name: Sanguine Devotional Card

title: Pouch of "Coins"
flavorText: Flattened brass discs good for fooling less-than-sober gamblers. Best used in poorly lit rooms.
name: Pouch of "Coins"

title: Skeever Tail Stirring Stick
flavorText: A skeever's tail, preserved in wax. Some believe stirring one's drink with it brings good luck. Others believe it's disgusting.
name: Skeever Tail Stirring Stick

title: Prurient Kerchief
flavorText: A kerchief with a red-stained beeswax kiss pressed into it. A blackmailer might find this useful.
name: Prurient Kerchief

title: Pocket Goblin
flavorText: A small pewter Goblin. It is said to bring good luck when dropped into any drink. (But not wine. Never wine.)
name: Pocket Goblin

title: Cat Whisker Ear Scraper
flavorText: A small stick with cat whiskers glued to the end, intended to clean one's ears. A forger might have use for this.
name: Cat Whisker Ear Scraper

title: Tippler's Tiny Tidbit Tin
flavorText: An empty circular tin with four-section divider. Typically used to carry morsels that pair best with drink.
name: Tippler's Tiny Tidbit Tin

title: Piffle Trumpet
flavorText: A tiny conical brass bell tapering into a small tube. When held to the ear, one can overhear distant gossip at loud parties.
name: Piffle Trumpet

title: "Gentle Touch" Servant Baton
flavorText: A baton with a sponge on the end. Once sold as a merciful way to strike misbehaving servants, it has since found other uses.
name: "Gentle Touch" Servant Baton

title: Autographed Calling Card
flavorText: A signed, sloppily illustrated card depicting someone of indeterminate race and gender. A forger might find use for this.
name: Autographed Calling Card

title: Palm Flask
flavorText: A small wooden container with a hidden reservoir. It can easily be hidden in a coin pouch, a sleeve, or the palm of one's hand.
name: Palm Flask

title: Hooked Scraper
flavorText: A small hooked metal tool designed to clean grime from beneath nails or claws.
name: Hooked Scraper

title: Tin of Eyeblack
flavorText: A foul-smelling, waxy black paste. Rubbing this around the eyes helps reduce the sun's glare. Also useful for sneak thieves.
name: Tin of Eyeblack

title: Footwear Repair Kit
flavorText: A folded leather kit with tools for repairing sandals, shoes, and boots. It could be useful for traveling forgers.
name: Footwear Repair Kit

title: Baling Hook
flavorText: A metal hook with a wooden handle, often used for carrying bales of hay. Sneak thieves could fashion it into a crude grapnel.
name: Baling Hook

title: Joint Salve Jar
flavorText: A tiny unguent jar. The label claims its powerful numbing properties reduce joint pain. It could be useful to skooma slingers.
name: Joint Salve Jar

title: Bloody Buttons' Ragamuffin
flavorText: A ghastly doll depicting the villain of the popular children's tale. Its eyes are red-painted buttons. (It's probably paint.)
name: Bloody Buttons' Ragamuffin

title: Knee Pillow
flavorText: A small square of padding with a strap to wrap around one's knee.
name: Knee Pillow

title: Swaddler's Sack
flavorText: A variety of tightly wrapped bandages, stored in a small leather pouch.
name: Swaddler's Sack

title: Planter's Monocular
flavorText: A small, hardy spyglass. Initially sold for farmers in separate fields to see distant hand signals, it's mostly used for spying.
name: Planter's Monocular

title: Secret Ointment Jar
flavorText: The label claims the jar contains horse liniment, but a hidden internal label declares it "Proud Stallion Bedroom Ointment."
name: Secret Ointment Jar

title: Mustache Wax
flavorText: This ghastly-smelling kwama wax is perfect for making facial hair set "just so."
name: Mustache Wax

title: Bloody Tongue Stud
flavorText: Some dried blood still clings to this brass tongue piercing. As does a little bit of tongue.
name: Bloody Tongue Stud

title: Wolfen Socks
flavorText: Hand-knitted socks shaped to fit over the unique structure of a werewolf's foot.
name: Wolfen Socks

title: Scribbled Farm Ideas
flavorText: A torn sheet with dozens of scribbled and crossed-off ideas. The only legible note: "Werewolf Farm: endless wolf steaks."
name: Scribbled Farm Ideas

title: Wolf Trick Mirror
flavorText: Looking into the mirror shows you a vision of a wolf superimposed over your face.
name: Wolf Trick Mirror

title: Shredded Pants
flavorText: These simple cotton pants are ripped to shreds, seemingly from powerful legs tearing through the fabric.
name: Shredded Pants

title: Bristled Fang Brush
flavorText: An oversized toothbrush caked with blood. The cuts into the bristles seem designed to fit large fangs.
name: Bristled Fang Brush

title: Fang Charm
flavorText: A carefully-made plaster cast of a humanoid fang attached to a simple chain.
name: Fang Charm

title: Bronze Tail Chain
flavorText: Bristled fur still clings to this intricate chain, apparently intended to be worn on the tail of a full-sized werewolf.
name: Bronze Tail Chain

title: Silver Piercing Needle
flavorText: Clearly meant as a body piercing, the blood clinging to this needle still sizzles audibly.
name: Silver Piercing Needle

title: Golden Fang Caps
flavorText: These gilded tooth caps are shaped to fit over the fangs of a wolf.
name: Golden Fang Caps

title: Bag of Letter Tiles
flavorText: Cloth bag of small wooden tiles, each with a letter burned into its face. Used in a traditional commoner spelling game.
name: Bag of Letter Tiles

title: Petrified Bull Charm
flavorText: What at first glance appears to be a short, withered cane is actually an ossified bull member … perhaps a lucky charm?
name: Petrified Bull Charm

title: Disappointing Birdhouse
flavorText: A set of seven rough-cut wood squares, sloppily nailed together to form a very badly-made birdhouse.
name: Disappointing Birdhouse

title: Practice Whittlestick
flavorText: A whittled stick of wood, twisted and formed at the end into intricate angles and points. A daily project for an apprentice.
name: Practice Whittlestick

title: Twisted In-law Carving
flavorText: A careful carving of a twisted, cruel-looking woman. On the bottom is scrawled "Namira take your first-born, the Mother-in-Law."
name: Twisted In-law Carving

title: Favored Shears
flavorText: A pair of clothing shears, well worn from use. A name was once inscribed on the handle, but work has worn it away.
name: Favored Shears

title: Burnt Spellbook
flavorText: The charred husk of a leather spellbook, only recognizable by the runes on the cover. It is warm to the touch.
name: Burnt Spellbook

title: Rune Chunk
flavorText: A shattered piece of a once-potent runestone. It hums quietly with latent power.
name: Rune Chunk

title: Portal Seed
flavorText: A marble-sized enchanted rock, a common component in apprentice-level portal creation.
name: Portal Seed

title: Spell Gel
flavorText: A jar of sweet-smelling goo labeled "Spell Gel: Hair resin for the active mage!"
name: Spell Gel

title: Taxidermied Kitten
flavorText: A stuffed kitten curled into a ball, appearing very lifelike in death. The leather tag on the collar reads "Thesis Project."
name: Taxidermied Kitten

title: Vanus Galerion Doll
flavorText: A crude straw representation of Mages Guildmaster Vanus Galerion. A quill is shoved through the doll's eye.
name: Vanus Galerion Doll

title: Shalidor's Nail Clippings
flavorText: A small glass phial with curled, yellowed nail clippings inside. Label reads "Archmagus Shalidor."
name: Shalidor's Nail Clippings

title: Spidersilk Kerchief
flavorText: A plain gray kerchief. Primarily used to wipe sweat from one's brow, but strong enough to double as an emergency tourniquet.
name: Spidersilk Kerchief

title: Temporary Hobbling Stone
flavorText: A smooth, flat stone. It creates a convincing limp when placed inside a footwrap. Useful for paupers in need of added sympathy.
name: Temporary Hobbling Stone

title: Tin of Dubbin
flavorText: A small tin of waterproofing wax. This could be valuable to anyone who travels in wet climates. Or pirates.
name: Tin of Dubbin

title: Poorly Groomed False Teeth
flavorText: A set of disgusting false teeth designed to fit over one's natural, presumably less disgusting teeth.
name: Poorly Groomed False Teeth

title: Disgusting Prosthetic Nose
flavorText: A false nose with what appears to be a large, hairy boil at the end of it. It could be resold to an actor, or perhaps a spy.
name: Disgusting Prosthetic Nose

title: Prayer Kerchief
flavorText: A colorful kerchief with inspirational prayers worked along the border. Bandit gangs with similar colors could use this.
name: Prayer Kerchief

title: Balithil's "Potato Porridge"
flavorText: Mushy, foul-smelling, and lukewarm to the touch. The very thought of consuming this is repellent.
name: Balithil's "Potato Porridge"

title: Simple Stitching Awl
flavorText: This awl is fashioned from bone.
name: Simple Stitching Awl

title: Netch-hide Lunch Sack
flavorText: This empty netch-hide sack smells faintly of hearty bread and pungent cheese.
name: Netch-hide Lunch Sack

title: Brassy Livestock Whistle
flavorText: A brass whistle in the shape of a leaping guar. Its clarion tone is designed to beckon delicious beasts.
name: Brassy Livestock Whistle

title: Wine-stained Jug
flavorText: An empty wine jug of Imperial design, labeled with the phrase, "Good Will, Good Wine."
name: Wine-stained Jug

title: Dried Prayer Garlands
flavorText: Lay priests occasionally hang dried flower garlands from tree branches in offerings to the gods.
name: Dried Prayer Garlands

title: Logic Fob
flavorText: This heavy fob, meant to hang from a bracelet or belt, is mathematically exact in its dimensions.
name: Logic Fob

title: Pungent Incense
flavorText: This pungent incense is traditionally used to mask the odor of rotting corpses.
name: Pungent Incense

title: Claw of Akatosh
flavorText: This large claw, most likely from a troll, is carved with a prayer. Young children are told they're the claws of Dragons.
name: Claw of Akatosh

title: Lacquered Feather
flavorText: While lacquered and preserved, this feather catches the air gracefully when released into the wind.
name: Lacquered Feather

title: Blessed Seed
flavorText: A germinating seed that's been trapped in resin and carved with a prayer. Sometimes ritually planted with a crop.
name: Blessed Seed

title: Zenithar's Measure
flavorText: A heavy pewter scale weight engraved with a blue star. Kept in the coin purse for financial luck in trying times.
name: Zenithar's Measure

title: Horn of the Chieftain
flavorText: An ox horn elaborately inscribed in the Colovian style with an ancient highlands prayer.
name: Horn of the Chieftain

title: Stuffed Rat Carcass
flavorText: Stuffed with dried grain, this rat carcass seems to be useful for not only holding down papers but also impromptu tossing games.
name: Stuffed Rat Carcass

title: Darksky Ritual Sand
flavorText: A pouchful of dyed sand, used by certain occult groups to ritually stain skins and mark foreheads.
name: Darksky Ritual Sand

title: Hist-soaked Vine Clippings
flavorText: Soaked in the hist sap, these vine clippings have become brittle and odiferous.
name: Hist-soaked Vine Clippings

title: Caliper Cozy
flavorText: A knitted pouch for a traveling blacksmith. Keeps soot from one's apron and caliper handles from biting flesh on cold days.
name: Caliper Cozy

title: Forgeburn Unguent
flavorText: A jar of lime-green paste to be rubbed upon one's face after a busy day in the forge. Smells faintly of mudcrab effluvia.
name: Forgeburn Unguent

title: Ash-Begone Soap
flavorText: A bar of "soap" that is likely a small block of bleached pumice. The blood it draws helps wash soot-stained hands clean.
name: Ash-Begone Soap

title: Utility Sash
flavorText: A leather workman's sash, fitted with multiple cloth loops to hold nails, small tools, or small vials.
name: Utility Sash

title: Never-Wet Whetstone
flavorText: An enchanted whetstone. One side exudes a thin sheen of oil when touched to metal.
name: Never-Wet Whetstone

title: Steel Calipers
flavorText: A pair of steel calipers intended for superior measuring, gripping, or holding down of loose papers.
name: Steel Calipers

title: Smith's Rolling Rule
flavorText: A metallic contraption for measuring heated metal objects. (Truthfully, it's a precisely hash-marked steel rolling pin.)
name: Smith's Rolling Rule

title: Orichalipers
flavorText: This pair of orichalcum calipers provides the best possible measuring, gripping, or holding down of loose papers in Tamriel.
name: Orichalipers

title: Scar Cream
flavorText: A jar of vile-smelling goop. The label insists it can remove scars if applied daily, and liberally, for five consecutive years.
name: Scar Cream

title: Miniature Silver Puzzlebox
flavorText: An intricate, handheld puzzlebox with a complex internal mechanism. Attempting to solve the puzzle also polishes the silver.
name: Miniature Silver Puzzlebox

title: Fishing Hook
flavorText: A heavy fishing hook.
name: Fishing Hook

title: Boning Knife
flavorText: A thin, flexible knife for cleaning fish in the field.
name: Boning Knife

title: Musty Bait Tin
flavorText: It doesn't smell recognizably like anything. It does smell bad, however.
name: Musty Bait Tin

title: Simple Feather Lure
flavorText: A small white feather, for tying to a fishing line.
name: Simple Feather Lure

title: Hauler's Straps
flavorText: A bundle of leather straps meant to assist in the movement of heavy objects.
name: Hauler's Straps

title: Refreshing Retching Tablets
flavorText: A tin of hardened scrib-jelly tablets packed with scents and herbs. Evidently they freshen breath and intoxicate nix-hounds.
name: Refreshing Retching Tablets

title: Vial of Perfumed Rouge
flavorText: A vial of strongly-scented facial cosmetics, for dressing up one's complexion while masking the stench of the common folk.
name: Vial of Perfumed Rouge

title: Scented Cosmetic Padding
flavorText: A scented pouch of something soft. Perfect for filling out anywhere one feels might be … lacking.
name: Scented Cosmetic Padding

title: Forge-Blind Drops
flavorText: A vial of grayish liquid with a small dropper. Said to protect one's vision from bright forge fires when dripped onto the eyes.
name: Forge-Blind Drops

title: Bellows Sealant
flavorText: A jar of sticky red sap meant to seal tiny punctures to forge bellows. The label insists the mixture isn't flammable.
name: Bellows Sealant

title: Spool of Bendy Wire
flavorText: A small spool of wire. The wire is soft enough to bend and hard enough to retain its shape once bent.
name: Spool of Bendy Wire

title: Arrowhead Mold
flavorText: A small mold for a common arrowhead. The certification stamped on the base would be of interest to crooked smiths.
name: Arrowhead Mold

title: Forge Mark Stamps
flavorText: A set of personalized stamps used by smiths throughout Tamriel. A forger with a forge might find this valuable.
name: Forge Mark Stamps

title: Folding Calipers
flavorText: A pair of brass folding calipers for a traveling smith. The grips lock on place when unfolded, nearly doubling its size.
name: Folding Calipers

title: Used Candlestick Mold
flavorText: Though the mold itself is worth something, its greater value comes from the partial silver candlestick fitted snuggly inside.
name: Used Candlestick Mold

title: Folding Pocket Rule
flavorText: A stack of hinged, hand-length, hash-marked metal rectangles. They form a leg-length rulestick when rotated and locked in place.
name: Folding Pocket Rule

title: Burn Jelly
flavorText: A jar of greasy blue numbing paste applied directly to fresh forge burns. "Do not apply to tongue," the label also reads.
name: Burn Jelly

title: Used Dibella Figurine
flavorText: A highly detailed mold used to form a figurine of Dibella. The partial golden remnants of a previous attempt are still inside.
name: Used Dibella Figurine

title: Portable Bellows
flavorText: When the metal nozzle is removed and stowed, this small, handheld bellows collapses into a finger-thick circular disc.
name: Portable Bellows

title: Ever-Breath Smith's Bit
flavorText: An enchanted bit that absorbs common airborne impurities when clenched between the teeth. Best to wash before reuse.
name: Ever-Breath Smith's Bit

title: Maormer Waterstone
flavorText: A small, glowing stone that clears water of impurities. Perfect for a smith's trough, or a poisoner looking to refine a recipe.
name: Maormer Waterstone

title: Smith's Detailing Pad
flavorText: A single fireproof pad, meant to fit over a hand or glove. A flame atronach's claw extends from the back.
name: Smith's Detailing Pad

title: Embossed Throwing Shoes
flavorText: Hard-tempered and neatly forged, these horse shoes are embossed with the symbol of the Rilis household of Auridon.
name: Embossed Throwing Shoes

title: Crawler Tube
flavorText: A simple wooden tube used to carry live crawlers. Alternatively, to hide one's gold beneath live crawlers.
name: Crawler Tube

title: Hook Sponge
flavorText: At least a dozen intricately fashioned fishhooks jabbed into a sponge. Useful for fisherfolk and desperate cutpurses.
name: Hook Sponge

title: Pole Ring Pouch
flavorText: A small pouch with replacement metal rings. Though intended for fishing poles, bandits could use these to fashion rope traps.
name: Pole Ring Pouch

title: Measuring Strap
flavorText: A hash-marked leather strap rule, slightly shrunken from water damage. Useful for boastful fisherfolk and crooked merchants.
name: Measuring Strap

title: Shiny Copper Spinner
flavorText: A lightweight piece of shiny copper, cut to attract a fish's eye in murky water.
name: Shiny Copper Spinner

title: Ashen Blood of Malacath
abilityDescription:
Locked scale bracket return: |cffffff0|r
Current upper bound: |cffffff0|r
Current lower bound: |cffffff0|r
flavorText: A potent tincture, useful for myriad arcane practices.
name: Ashen Blood of Malacath

title: Old Orsinium Blood Soup
abilityDescription: Increase Max Health by |cffffff6773|r for |cffffff1.1|r hours.
flavorText: Made with the very finest of meats, bloods, and meats and bloods.
name: Old Orsinium Blood Soup

title: Key Fragment
abilityDescription: Xivkyn motif chapters can be obtained only from caches within Imperial City proper. The chance of finding a chapter increases with your Tel Var Stone Multiplier.
flavorText: This item is no longer used. Placing it in your inventory will consume it automatically, converting to Imperial Key fragments.
name: Key Fragment

title: Mara's Blessing
flavorText: This delicate, gold-chased cameo depicts the goddess Mara and is a traditional Imperial wedding gift.
name: Mara's Blessing

title: Rubedite Ingot
flavorText: An ingredient for crafting metal weapons and armor.

title: Carved-Bone Key
flavorText: This cold iron key resembles a charred, skeletal finger. It should unlock the Bone Shard Trophy Chest.
name: Carved-Bone Key

abilityDescription:
Increase Stamina Recovery by |cffffff565|r for |cffffff2.5|r hours.
These effects are scaled based on your level, up to Veteran Rank 10.
name: Crown Endurance Tonic

title: Star Dew
flavorText: A stellar ingredient for crafting Champion potions.
name: Star Dew

title: Lorkhan's Tears
flavorText: A lunar ingredient for crafting Champion potions.
name: Lorkhan's Tears

title: Sanded Ruby Ash
flavorText: An ingredient for crafting wooden weapons and shields.
name: Sanded Ruby Ash

title: Ancestor Silk
flavorText: An ingredient for crafting cloth armor.
name: Ancestor Silk

title: Rubedo Leather
flavorText: An ingredient for crafting leather armor.
name: Rubedo Leather

title: Jehade
flavorText: Jehade
name: Jehade

title: Rejera
flavorText: Rejera
name: Rejera

title: Crown Health Potion
abilityDescription:
Restore |cffffff7984|r Health immediately.
Grants Major Fortitude which increases your Health Regeneration by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff36.3|r seconds.
These effects are scaled based on your level.
name: Crown Health Potion

title: Dominion Cold Fire Trebuchet

title: The First Charter
flavorText: This fabled tome outlines the first laws for the original settlement of Orsinium. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: The First Charter

title: Horn of Beasts
flavorText: Last sounded during the Siege of Old Orsinium, this horn once summoned the beasts of Wrothgar to the city's defense. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Horn of Beasts

title: Guthrag's Mask
flavorText: Once, this mask allowed Orcs to walk disguised among all the races of Tamriel. Now, it stands as a historic oddity. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Guthrag's Mask

title: Centurion's Signet
flavorText: The Emperor awarded this signet to the first Orsimer to earn the rank of Centurion in the Imperial Legion. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Centurion's Signet

title: Frostbreak Chalice
flavorText: A goblet emblazoned with the seal of the fort, some Orcs believe it imbued restorative powers on any liquid drunk from it. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Frostbreak Chalice

title: Trinimac House Idol
flavorText: This ancient statue once protected the home of a worshiper of Trinimac. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Trinimac House Idol

title: Nuzava's Anvil
flavorText: The travel anvil of the famed forge-wife of Morkul Clanhold, it was said no other smith could use it. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Nuzava's Anvil

title: Map of Clans
flavorText: This ancient map displayed the original 13 Orc strongholds at the end of the Dawn Era, but much of it is faded and hard to read. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Map of Clans

title: Dwarf Light
flavorText: A mechanical-looking lantern made by the Dwemer. It no longer functions, but the exquisite crafting is a wonder to behold. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Dwarf Light

title: Torc of Baloth Bloodtusk
flavorText: This heavy necklace of gold and bearing the symbol of the hammer once belonged to the legendary Orc leader. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Torc of Baloth Bloodtusk

title: Heart of Zandadunoz
flavorText: This vile relic, once a beating heart, serves as a phylactery that supposedly has the power to recall the titan from Oblivion. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Heart of Zandadunoz

title: Thukhozod's Bracer
flavorText: According to legend, the first Thukhozod crafted and wore this armband to display his warrior's prowess. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Thukhozod's Bracer

title: Liquid Silver
flavorText: A vial of heavy, viscous silver, cool to the touch and moving like a thing alive. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Liquid Silver

title: Black Quill
flavorText: An enchanted quill made from the feather of a hagraven, legend claims that whatever it writes is never forgotten. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Black Quill

title: Eye of Zthenganaz
flavorText: According to legend, the Eye was used to spy upon the Orsimer until it was cursed by a powerful shaman. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Eye of Zthenganaz

title: Scepter of the Riekr King-Chief
flavorText: Once the symbol of power for an Orc chief, the scepter recently rested in the hands of the Riekr king-chief. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Scepter of the Riekr King-Chief

title: Hammer of Glass
flavorText: Though the hammer appears made of glass, it is as hard as diamond. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Hammer of Glass

title: Mad Urkazbur's Ice-Effigy
flavorText: Made entirely of ice, this tiny replica of the ogre elder refuses to melt. Donate this to Curator Umutha and the House of Orsimer Glories in Orsinium.
name: Mad Urkazbur's Ice-Effigy
